52026.real_text: Revelation - Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the most clues on it, and put Party Guest into play at that asset's location. Investigators cannot parley with [[Bystander]] assets at Party Guest's location. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. Move Party Guest to a connecting location.
52026.text: 显现 - 找出线索最多的[[旁人]]支援，将宴会宾客放置入场，放到该支援所在地点。 位于宴会宾客所在地点的调查员不能与[[旁人]]支援谈判。 [action]花费2资源：谈判。将宴会宾客移动到一个连接地点。

52027.name: 令人震惊的一幕
52027.real_text: Revelation - Randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. Cannot be canceled.
52027.text: 显现 - 结算冒险参考卡牌底下的随机一张令人作呕的现实卡牌。不能被取消。

52028.back_text:
- 在将地点放置入场时，将全部3张宁静的走廊与剩余8张历史协会地点一同放置入场。(3张[[地下室]]地点应在3张[[一楼]]地点下方排成一行。) - 将两张誓约看守人敌人放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在调查员推进到场景2或场景3后：将放在一边的一个誓约看守人生成在任意无人历史协会地点。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
52028.name: 重返往事回声
52028.real_name: Return to Echoes of the Past
52028.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Echoes of the Past shown here. - Randomly choose one [[Basement]] Historical Society location and remove it from the game, without looking at its revealed side. (Continued on reverse side.)
52028.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返往事回声找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 随机选择一张[[地下室]]历史协会地点从游戏中移除，不要查看它的已揭示面。 (继续阅读背面。)

52029.back_flavor: 你向下步入协会深处的地下室，脚步声在石地板上空洞地回荡。
52029.back_text: 宁静的走廊与其他每个[[地下室]]地点连接。
52029.name: 宁静的走廊
52029.real_text: Entry Hall is connected to Quiet Halls. Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Basement]] location. [action] If each location in play is revealed and there are no clues on locations in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Quiet Halls (from the token bank).
52029.text: 宁静的走廊与其他每个[[地下室]]地点连接。 [action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。

52030.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
52030.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
52030.name: 历史协会
52030.real_text: While you have at least 1 hidden card in your hand, you cannot investigate this location.
52030.text: 你有至少1张隐私卡牌在手牌中时，你不能调查本地点。

52031.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
52031.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
52031.name: 历史协会
52031.real_text: Forced - When you investigate this location, if there is at least 1 [[Cultist]] enemy in play: This location gets -3 shroud for this investigation. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, move 1 clue from this location to the [[Cultist]] enemy farthest from you (before resolving the effects of the test).
52031.text: 强制 - 在你调查本地点时，如果场上有至少1个[[异教徒]]敌人：本次调查本地点的隐藏值-3。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，将本地点的1个线索移动到离你最远的[[异教徒]]敌人上(在结算检定效果前)。

52032.back_flavor: 朴素的木门后是历史协会地下室的某间房间。
52032.back_text: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。
52032.flavor: 朴素的木门通向历史协会使用的一间地下室房间。
52032.name: 历史协会
52032.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: One at a time, draw that many cards from the top of the encounter deck.
52032.text: 强制 - 你发现本地点的1个或更多线索后：一次一张，从遭遇牌库顶抽取等量的卡牌。

52033.name: 誓约看守人
52033.real_text: While the number of the current act is greater than the number of the current agenda, Keeper of the Oath gains hunter. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Find each investigator whose location shares a [[Trait]] with Keeper of the Oath's location. Move 1 clue from each of those investigators to Keeper of the Oath.
52033.text: 当前场景编号大于当前密谋编号时，誓约看守人获得猎手。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：找出每位所在地点与誓约看守人所在地点有相同[[特性]]的调查员。将这些调查员的各1个线索移动到誓约看守人上。

52034.back_text: - 将疯狂之主敌人和根除疗法诡计卡放在一边，位于场外。 - 在决定使用哪个版本的场景2时，不要遵循原版的执行设置。改为将原版的场景2从游戏中移除，并检查剧本日志。如果你的确信高于(或等于)疑惑，使用新的场景2——真正可怕的人(版本三)。如果你的疑惑高于确信，使用新的场景2——真正可怕的人(版本四)。
52034.name: 重返邪秽誓约
52034.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Unspeakable Oath shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
52034.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返邪秽誓约找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

52035.back_flavor: 你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他蜷缩在房间的一个角落里，一边抽泣，一边摇晃着身子。“不要面具，不要面具……”他反复嘟囔着。你搀扶他起身，问他是否还记得有关《黄衣之王》的事情，但他打断了你。“我早就告诉过你了！”他疯狂地大叫，瞪大的双眼中泛出了黄色的光泽。“你不记得了吗？你上次来这儿的时候？”他的话意义不明。你只不过刚刚才到这儿……不是吗？“不、不、不……”男子结结巴巴地说着，向后摔回房间角落那张肮脏的小床上。“永远不会结束。这一切永远不会结束，除非他不再出现，而只要你们在这里，他就永远不会离开！让我出去！我想要离开——”丹尼尔尖声求救，但唯一回应他的只有突然从他床下出现的生物。在你做出反应前，它的卷须已经裹住了丹尼尔的身体，将他整个吞噬了。他最后的尖叫只化为了那个生物巨大身体里的一声闷响。
52035.back_text: 将放在一边的疯狂之主生成在病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)。将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
52035.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
52035.name: 真正可怕的人(版本三)
52035.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
52035.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。

52036.back_flavor: 你走进丹尼尔的囚室，发现他坐在椅子上，面对着房间的一个角落。他正在墙上潦草地写着什么，他的表情非常平静。不，并不是平静——是几乎完全没有任何情感。你询问他对黄衣之王的了解，他虽然没有说话，但你注意到他将回答写在了墙上：“我们都知道会有什么下场。”惊愕之下，你检查了房间的其他地方。墙上还有一些类似的语句：“你早已知道誓约。”“代价已经支付。”“通道已开启了一次又一次。”这些看着都没有任何意义，但你的直觉告诉你这些信息中蕴含的更多是真相而不是疯言疯语。你扶起丹尼尔，试着把他带出房间，你希望你能帮他点什么。
52036.back_text: 选择位于病人拘禁室(丹尼尔的囚室)的一位调查员。将放在一边的丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德卡牌(支援面朝上)放置入场，放到该调查员的控制之下。然后，将放在一边的根除疗法诡计卡附属到丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德。 将遭遇弃牌堆和场景牌库底下的每张敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
52036.flavor: 丹尼尔和其他一些最危险的病人都被关在地下室的禁闭区里。现在你手握地下室钥匙，可以前去一探究竟了。
52036.name: 真正可怕的人(版本四)
52036.real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
52036.text: 忽略[[阿卡姆疯人院]]地点未揭示面上的文字。 目标 - 找到关着丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的病人拘禁室地点。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。

52037.name: 疯狂之主
52037.real_text: Massive. Hunter. Host of Insanity gets +2 [per_investigator] health. [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: Parley. You reveal the clasp to the creature. It freezes in place, whispering a garbled prayer. Automatically evade Host of Insanity.
52037.text: 庞大。猎手。 疯狂之主得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 [action]如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环：谈判。你向这个生物展示扣环。它停滞在原地，低语着混乱的祷言。自动躲避疯狂之主。

52038.name: 根除疗法
52038.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round: Daniel Chesterfield's controller takes 2 horror. [action] If you are at Infirmary: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (6). If you succeed, detach Radical Treatment and add it to the victory display. If you control Clasp of Black Onyx, reduce the difficulty of this test by 3.
52038.text: 强制 - 当一轮结束时：丹尼尔·契斯特菲尔德的控制者受到2点恐惧。 [action]如果你位于医务室：检定[willpower]或[intellect](6)。如果你检定成功，根除疗法解除附属并将其加入胜利区。如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环，本次检定难度-3。

52039.name: 朦胧记忆
52039.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Forget something an investigator has "remembered" from an ability on a location. (It is no longer true.) - Take 1 horror and Clouded Memory gains surge.
52039.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 忘记一位调查员通过一个地点上的能力“记住”的事。(这个条件不再达成)。 - 受到1点恐惧且朦胧记忆获得涌动。

52040.back_text:
……2张圣马丁运河地点中选择1张，2张巴黎圣母院地点中选择1张，2张卢森堡公园地点中选择1张。将所选地点放置入场。将这些地点的其他版本从游戏中移除。 - 将两张影中身形放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在风琴手入场后：将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一边的两张影中身形洗入遭遇牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
52040.name: 重返真相幻影
52040.real_name: Return to A Phantom of Truth
52040.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to A Phantom of Truth shown here. - Randomly choose 1 of the 2 Montparnasse locations, 1 of the 2 Grand Guignol locations, 1 of the 2 Père Lachaise Cemetery locations... (Continued on reverse side.)
52040.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返真相幻影找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 随机从2张蒙巴纳斯地点中选择1张，2张大木偶剧场地点中选择1张，2张拉雪兹神父公墓地点中选择1张…… (继续阅读背面。)

52041.back_flavor: 这个街区以其咖啡馆和酒吧著称，也是穷困潦倒的艺术家经常光顾的地方。说不定哪一天，这里某个天才艺术家还能名扬四海。但你清楚，大部分只会默默无名。
52041.name: 蒙巴纳斯
52041.real_text: Forced - After you discover any number of clues from Montparnasse: Discard cards from your hand with that many [willpower] icons among them. If you cannot, take 1 horror.
52041.text: 强制 - 你发现蒙巴纳斯任意数量的线索后：弃掉你至少总计带有等量[willpower]图标的手牌。如果你不能这么做，改为受到1点恐惧。

52042.back_flavor: 大木偶剧场的恐怖剧特别有名，这里的演出生动，有时甚至有违人伦。它坐落在巴黎一条著名的小道上。
52042.flavor: 似乎最近剧院在上演一出有关疯狂的戏剧。你不禁好奇这里是不是也上演过《黄衣之王》。
52042.name: 大木偶剧场
52042.real_text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or remove 1 doom from the current agenda. (Group limit once per game.)
52042.text: [action]花费5资源：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，或从当前密谋上移除1个毁灭标记。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

52043.back_flavor: 拉雪兹神父公墓是巴黎最大的公墓，同时也是城里第一座公园墓地，这里风景优美，但也阴森恐怖。
52043.flavor: 石子铺成的小路蜿蜒曲折，连接着成排的墓穴和数不清的陵墓。密集的墓地纵横交错，在死者的包围中，你陷入了淡淡的忧伤。
52043.name: 拉雪兹神父公墓
52043.real_text: Forced - After an enemy moves into Père Lachaise Cemetery: It gets +1 horror value for the remainder of the round.
52043.text: 强制 - 在一个敌人移动进入拉雪兹神父公墓后：其得到+1恐惧值，直到本轮结束。

52044.back_flavor: 这条地下运河连通了塞纳河与乌尔克运河。一道古老开裂的楼梯通向下面的运河入口。
52044.name: 圣马丁运河
52044.real_text: While you are at Canal Saint-Martin, you must use your [combat] in place of your [agility], and vice versa.
52044.text: 你位于圣马丁运河时，你必须用你的[combat]代替你的[agility]，反之亦然。

52045.back_flavor: Notre-Dame de Paris在法语中的意思为“我们巴黎的圣母”，这里是全市最为著名的大教堂，它不仅是这座城市的名片，也是全世界哥特式建筑的标志。彩色的玻璃窗后透出了灯光，你可以听到教堂内有管风琴高声演奏着古怪混乱的旋律。
52045.name: 巴黎圣母院
52045.real_text:
Each enemy at Notre-Dame gets +1 fight and -1 evade.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Notre-Dame by 3 or more during your turn: You may take an additional action this turn. (Group limit once per round.)
52045.text:
位于巴黎圣母院的每个敌人得到+1攻击与-1躲避。
[reaction]在你成功躲避位于巴黎圣母院的一名敌人且至少超过难度3点后：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动。(团队每轮仅限一次。)

52046.back_flavor: 卢森堡宫的公园中散落着数以百计的雕像、纪念碑和喷泉。可惜你来这里是为了躲避夜空中尖叫飞翔着的怪物，要是换一个情况，这里应该是休闲散步的好地方。
52046.name: 卢森堡公园
52046.real_text: Forced - After you enter Gardens of Luxembourg, if there is at least 1 [[Byakhee]] enemy in play: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, each [[Byakhee]] enemy in play readies and moves to Gardens of Luxembourg.
52046.text: 强制 - 你进入卢森堡公园后，如果场上有至少1个[[拜亚基]]敌人：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，将场上每个[[拜亚基]]敌人重整并移动到卢森堡公园。

52047.name: 影中身形
52047.real_text: Revelation - Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Doubt than Conviction, move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). - If you have more Conviction than Doubt, resolve The Organist's hunter keyword.
52047.text: 显现 - 检查剧本日志。 - 如果你的疑惑高于(或等于)确信，将其朝着远离最近的调查员的方向移动1个地点(如可能，移动到一个没有调查员的地点)。 - 如果你的确信高于疑惑，结算风琴手的猎手关键词。

52048.back_text:
- 接着，随机选择4张地下墓穴地点，并将其从游戏中移除，不要查看。
- 按照常规设置创建地下墓穴剩余部分。
<hr>本场冒险期间，加入以下规则：
“结算尸体寄居者的生成能力时，苍白面具下的男子不视为[[类人]]敌人。
当前场景为场景2时，苍白面具下的男子不能离开暗影坟墓。”
将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
52048.name: 重返苍白面具
52048.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter set for Return to The Pallid Mask shown here. - When building the Catacombs deck, first set aside the Tomb of Shadows and the Blocked Passage, as normal. - Next, add the 4 new Catacombs locations included in this encounter set with the remaining Catacombs locations, and determine your starting location, as normal. (Continued on reverse side.)
52048.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返苍白面具找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在创建地下墓穴牌库时，首先按照常规设置将暗影坟墓和堵塞通道放在一边。 - 接着，将本遭遇组中4张新的地下墓穴地点与剩余地下墓穴地点放在一起，按照常规设置决定你的起始地点。 (继续阅读背面。)

52049.back_flavor: 宽敞的走廊两边装饰着大量头骨和尸骨，显得异常恐怖。
52049.back_text: 作为你进入地下墓穴的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
52049.name: 秘密通道
52049.real_text: [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: You place the clasp within the skull's eye socket, and the passage opens. Reveal the Catacombs location to the right of Secret Passage. Forced - When Secret Passage is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play to the right of Secret Passage.
52049.text: [action]如果你控制黑玛瑙扣环：你将扣环放入头骨的眼窝，通道开启了。揭示秘密通道右方的地下墓穴地点。 强制 - 在秘密通道揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在秘密通道的右方。

52050.back_flavor: 这条宽阔走廊的墙壁以头骨和骸骨装饰，显得格外阴森。
52050.back_text: 作为你进入地下墓穴的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
52050.name: 骸骨堆
52050.real_text: Forced - When Mound of Bones is revealed: Put the top 4 Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, to the left, and to the right of Mound of Bones. At the end of the current round, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Malformed Skeleton and spawn it at Mound of Bones.
52050.text: 强制 - 在骸骨堆揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的4张地下墓穴放置入场，分别放在白骨迷阵的上方、下方、左方和右方。当本轮结束时，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个畸形骸骨敌人并将其生成在骸骨堆。

52051.back_flavor: 这条宽阔走廊的墙壁以头骨和骸骨装饰，显得格外阴森。
52051.back_text: 作为你进入地下墓穴的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
52051.name: 研究站点
52051.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Research Site: Reveal any Catacombs location. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - When Research Site is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, or to the right of any other location.
52051.text: [reaction]在你成功调查研究站点后：揭示任意一个地下墓穴地点。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 强制 - 在研究站点揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在任意一个其他地点的上方、下方或右方。

52052.back_flavor: 这条宽阔走廊的墙壁以头骨和骸骨装饰，显得格外阴森。
52052.back_text: 作为你进入地下墓穴的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
52052.name: 颅骨之海
52052.real_text: Forced - After you end your turn at Sea of Skulls: You must either take 1 direct horror or choose and discard 3 cards from your hand. Forced - When Sea of Skulls is revealed: Put the topmost Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play above, below, or to the right of the location farthest from Sea of Skulls and mark it with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, Sea of Skulls is connected to the marked location.
52052.text: 强制 - 在你于颅骨之海结束回合后：你必须受到1点直接恐惧，或从手牌选择并弃掉3张卡牌。 强制 - 在颅骨之海揭示时：将地下墓穴牌库顶的1张地下墓穴放置入场，放在离颅骨之海最远的地点的上方、下方或右方，并在其上放置1点恐惧标记。直到冒险结束，颅骨之海与标记地点互相连接。

52053.name: 畸形骸骨
52053.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Malformed Skeleton would resolve its hunter keyword: If there are no investigators within 2 locations of Malformed Skeleton, instead of resolving its hunter keyword, move it to the Catacombs location nearest to an investigator. Forced - When Malformed Skeleton attacks you: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.
52053.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在畸形骸骨将要结算其猎手关键词时：如果其2个地点内没有调查员，不结算其猎手关键词，改为将其移动到离调查员最近的地下墓穴地点。 强制 - 在畸形骸骨攻击你时：它会造成伤害或恐惧，而不是两者同时。

52054.back_text: - 根据已揭示面的遭遇组图标，将回廊和骑士大厅分为两组。一组为原版的回廊和骑士大厅，一组为本扩展的新版本。然后将它们都翻到背面，只能看到黑星升起的遭遇组图标。将这两组牌随机打乱直到你无法分辨它们属于原版或新版。随机选择一组从游戏中移除，另一组在冒险设置时使用。
52054.name: 重返黑星升起
52054.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Black Stars Rise shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
52054.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返黑星升起找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

52055.back_flavor: 回廊上空荡荡的，平时这里只对寺院的僧侣和宗教领袖开放，但眼下修道院里看来空无一人，你没花什么功夫就偷偷溜了进去。
52055.flavor: 一个僧侣在长廊上孤独地徘徊。嘴里默默念着祷文。他的腰带上挂着一大串铜钥匙。
52055.name: 回廊
52055.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remember that you have "found the tower key."
52055.text: [action]如果回廊没有线索：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了塔楼的钥匙”。

52056.back_flavor: 对称的石柱排列得整整齐齐，让这个大厅显得安宁而恬静，与屋外的滔天洪水形成了强烈的对比。
52056.flavor: 你听到附近的一扇门砰砰作响，有个修道院的僧侣正试图逃离外面的毁灭。“让我进去！”他惊慌失措地喊道。“拜托，我求求你！”
52056.name: 骑士大厅
52056.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."
52056.text: [action]如果骑士大厅没有线索：谈判。检定[combat]或[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，记住你“找到了一个向导”。

52057.name: 哈斯塔的凝视
52057.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Hastur's Gaze to your hand. Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda: Take 2 horror and discard Hastur's Gaze from your hand.
52057.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的凝视秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 有毁灭标记放置到“c”密谋牌库后：受到2点恐惧并从你手牌中弃掉哈斯塔的凝视。

52058.name: 哈斯塔的抓攫
52058.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Hastur's Grasp to your hand. Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "a" agenda: Take 2 damage and discard Hastur's Grasp from your hand.
52058.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的抓攫秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 有毁灭标记放置到“a”密谋牌库后：受到2点伤害并从你手牌中弃掉哈斯塔的抓攫。

52059.back_text:
- 将原版的王之宫殿地点从游戏中移除，使用本扩展新版的王之宫殿(哈斯塔的领域)地点替换，然后按照常规进行地点设置。 - 将以下地点放在一边，位于场外：你的内心深处、王座之间和沃德剧院舞台。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “除非有调查员‘知道了秘密’，否则哈斯塔的生命值不能低于2[per_investigator]点。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
52059.name: 重返卡城幽影
52059.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Dim Carcosa shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
52059.text: 遵循卡尔克萨之路的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返卡城幽影找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

52060.flavor:
我祈求上帝诅咒这位作者，正如作者用这部美丽而宏伟的作品诅咒世界；它质朴得可怕，真实得令人无法抗拒……
- 罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，《声名修复者》，<u>黄衣之王</u>

linked_card.flavor:
You stand before the palace of the King. Hastur’s incessant whispering fills your mind, and you find it difficult to block his poisonous words from your thoughts. Seeing the palace in all its spectacle and glory, you realize its true nature. You know now what you must do.
The doors to the palace open.
linked_card.name: Hastur's Last Stand
linked_card.pack_name: Return to the Path to Carcosa
linked_card.real_text: Check Campaign Log: - If Hastur (The King in Yellow) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Recesses of Your Own Mind location into play. - If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside The Throne Room location into play. Move Hastur to The Throne Room. - If Hastur (The Tattered King) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Stage of the Ward Theatre location into play. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
linked_card.text:
Check Campaign Log:

- If Hastur (The King in Yellow) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Recesses of Your Own Mind location into play.

- If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside The Throne Room location into play. Move Hastur to The Throne Room.

- If Hastur (The Tattered King) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Stage of the Ward Theatre location into play.

Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

52060.name: 王之宫殿
52060.real_text: Palace of the King cannot be flipped over while Hastur has more than 2 [per_investigator] remaining health.
52060.text: 哈斯塔剩余生命值多于2[per_investigator]时，王之宫殿不能翻面。

linked_card.flavor: You invented all of this, but that does not mean it is not real. It is the will of the Writer that makes it so. The stroke of a pen. The press of ink on paper. You hold within you the power to change your own fate. You are the author of your own demise.
linked_card.name: The Writer
linked_card.pack_name: Return to the Path to Carcosa
linked_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
linked_card.text:
Remember that you "know the secret."

Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

52061.name: 你的内心深处
52061.real_text:
While you are in the Recesses of Your Own Mind, set the base value of your [willpower] to 0.
Each investigator at Recesses of Your Own Mind is considered to be at a different copy of Recesses of Your Own Mind for the purposes of player card effects and committing cards to each other's skill tests.
52061.text:
你位于你的内心深处时，将你[willpower]的基础值设为0。
每位位于你的内心深处的调查员视为在不同的你的内心深处，此能力影响玩家卡牌效果或在其他人的技能检定中投入卡牌。

linked_card.flavor: The king and the throne are one and the same. It is his seat of power and his final resting place.
linked_card.name: The Entity
linked_card.pack_name: Return to the Path to Carcosa
linked_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
linked_card.text:
Remember that you "know the secret."

Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

52062.name: 王座之间
52062.real_text:
Hastur cannot leave The Throne Room.
Hastur cannot be exhausted.
Hastur cannot make attacks of opportunity.
52062.text:
哈斯塔不能离开王座之间。
哈斯塔不能被横置。
哈斯塔不能进行趁乱攻击。

linked_card.flavor:
The crowd’s applause is thundering. Ceaseless. Your heart is filled with overflowing joy and accomplishment.
The show must go on.
linked_card.name: The Delusion
linked_card.pack_name: Return to the Path to Carcosa
linked_card.real_text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
linked_card.text:
Remember that you "know the secret."

Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

52063.name: 沃德剧院舞台
52063.real_text:
While Hastur is moving, if there is an investigator at Stage of the Ward Theatre, Hastur's location is considered to be connected to Stage of the Ward Theatre.
While you are at Stage of the Ward Theatre, you cannot attack Hastur.
52063.text:
哈斯塔移动时，如果有调查员位于沃德剧院舞台，哈斯塔所在地点视为与沃德剧院舞台连接。
你位于沃德剧院舞台时，你不能攻击哈斯塔。

52064.name: 哈斯塔的高阶祭司
52064.real_text: Spawn - Palace of the King. Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When High Priest of Hastur attacks you, if you have a copy of Possession in your hand: Reveal it. The high priest welcomes you into the grand company of the King. You are eliminated and driven insane.
52064.text: 生成 - 王之宫殿。 猎物 - 手牌最多。 猎手。 强制 - 在哈斯塔的高阶祭司攻击你时，如果你的手牌中有至少一张恶灵附身：将其揭示。哈斯塔的高阶祭司盛情邀请你加入王的圣列。你被击败且发疯。
52064.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英

52065.name: 虚妄之邪
52065.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - You must either secretly add Delusory Evils to your hand, or place 1 doom on the current agenda and discard Delusory Evils (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance). Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test by 3 or more: You automatically fail, instead. Discard Delusory Evils from your hand.
52065.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将虚妄之邪秘密加入你的手牌，或在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记并弃掉虚妄之邪(本效果可以导致当前密谋推进)。 强制 - 在你技能检定将要成功并超过难度3点或更多时：改为本次检定自动失败。弃掉你手牌中的虚妄之邪。

52066.name: 渗血墙壁
52066.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, lose 1 action and take 1 horror.
52066.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果你检定失败，失去1个行动并受到1点恐惧。

52067.name: 脆弱思绪
52067.real_text: Revelation - Discard events from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of your location. If no cards are discarded by this effect, Fragile Thoughts gains surge.
52067.text: 显现 - 从你手牌中弃掉一定数量的事件卡牌，且这些卡牌上的印刷资源费用总计至少为X，其中X为你所在地点的隐藏值。如果没有因本效果弃掉卡牌，脆弱思绪获得涌动。

52068.name: 蛆群
52068.real_text:
Maggot Swarm's location gets +2 shroud.
While Maggot Swarm is at a location with no clues, it gains hunter.
52068.text:
蛆群所在地点得到+2隐藏值。
蛆群所在地点没有线索时，其获得猎手。

52069.name: 猎食的拜亚基
52069.real_text: Prey - Lowest remaining sanity only. Hunter. While engaged with an investigator with remaining sanity 4 or fewer, swap Preying Byakhee's fight and evade values.
52069.text: 猎物 - 仅限剩余神智值最低。 猎手。 猎食的拜亚基与剩余神智值在4或以下的调查员交战时，交换猎食的拜亚基的攻击值和躲避值。

52070.name: 哈斯塔的印记
52070.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Attach The Sign of Hastur to either the current agenda or the current act. Limit 1 per agenda/act. Forced - Each time an investigator takes 1 or more horror: He or she takes 1 additional horror.
52070.text: 险境。 显现 - 将哈斯塔的印记附属到当前密谋或当前场景。 每个密谋或场景仅限1张。 强制 - 每次一位调查员受到1点或更多恐惧时：其受到额外1点恐惧。

52071.name: 脑中幻象
52071.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 play action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
52071.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次打出行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。

52072.name: 脑中幻象
52072.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 resource action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
52072.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次资源行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。

52073.name: 脑中幻象
52073.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 move action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
52073.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次移动行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。

52074.name: 脑中幻象
52074.real_text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When your turn ends, if you did not perform at least 1 draw action during your turn: Discard this card from your hand and take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
52074.text: 险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在你的回合结束时，如果你没有在回合期间执行过至少1次抽取行动：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌并受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧。

52075.name: 发狂妄想
52075.real_text: Surge. Revelation - If you have 1 or more hidden cards in your hand, take 1 horror.
52075.text: 涌动。 显现 - 如果你手牌中有1张或更多隐私卡牌，受到1点恐惧。

52076.name: 特鲁恩布拉之音
52076.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must choose a different option: - Lose 2 resources. - Take 1 horror. - Get -2 to the next skill test you perform this round.
52076.text: 险境。 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须选择下列一个不同的选项： - 失去2资源。 - 受到1点恐惧。 - 本轮你的下一次技能检定得到-2。

52077.name: 忧郁
52077.real_text: Revelation - Put Melancholy into play in your threat area. Increase the resource cost of each card in your hand by 1. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Melancholy.
52077.text: 显现 - 将忧郁放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你每张手牌的资源费用提升1点。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉忧郁。

52078.name: 苦痛回响
52078.real_text: Revelation - Put Painful Reflection into play in your threat area. Forced - When you play an event: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it is a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token, cancel that event, take 1 horror, and discard Painful Reflection.
52078.text: 显现 - 将苦痛回响放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你打出事件时：从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，取消该事件，受到1点恐惧，然后弃掉苦痛回响。

53001.name: 鲜血失色
53001.real_text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take 2 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +2 damage for this attack.
53001.text: 作为打出鲜血失色的额外费用，受到2点伤害。 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并造成+2伤害。

53002.name: 求生匕首
53002.real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] When an enemy attacks you during the enemy phase (before resolving that attack), exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
53002.text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [reaction]在敌军阶段期间，敌人攻击你时(在此次攻击结算前)，横置求生匕首：攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
53002.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

53003.flavor:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。
“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”<cite>路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》</cite>
53003.name: 去伪存真
53003.real_text: Place 2 secrets among assets controlled by investigators at your location (3 secrets instead if there is a clue at your location).
53003.text: 在你所在地点的调查员控制的支援卡牌上放置总计2秘密。(如果你所在地点有线索，改为3秘密。)

53004.name: 古代巨石
53004.real_text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Move that many times.
53004.text:
研究完成。使用(X秘密)。X为“你鉴定了古代巨石”旁括号内的数字。
[reaction]在你抽取任意数量的卡牌时，花费等量的秘密：移动等量的次数。

53005.name: 彩饰骷髅
53005.real_text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend up to 3 charges: Draw that many cards and gain that many resources.
53005.text: 使用(0充能)。 [reaction]在你所在地点有调查员、[[盟友]]支援或敌人被击败后：在彩饰骷髅上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为充能。 [action]花费最多3充能：抽取等量的卡牌并获得等量资源。
53005.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

53006.name: 柯尔特袖珍手枪
53006.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round, if you triggered Colt Vest Pocket's "[action]" ability: Discard it.
53006.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果你执行过柯尔特袖珍手枪的“[action]”能力：将其弃掉。
53006.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

53007.name: 拉莱耶迷雾
53007.real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +1 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.
53007.text: 使用(5充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次躲避尝试得到+1[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。

53008.name: 钻地魔虫之石
53008.real_text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Uses (3 charges). If The Chthonian Stone has no charges, return it to your hand. Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Remove 1 charge from The Chthonian Stone.
53008.text: 封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。使用(3充能)。如果钻地魔虫之石没有充能，将其返回你的手牌。 强制 - 你在技能检定中揭示[auto_fail]符号后：移除钻地魔虫之石上的1充能。
53008.traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

53009.flavor: 我们的命运由自己书写。
53009.name: 改变命运
53009.real_text: Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy.
53009.text: 选择并弃掉场上一张没有附属到[[精英]]敌人上的非弱点诡计卡牌。

53010.name: 自食其力
53010.real_text: Exceptional. Permanent. Your investigator gains: "Deckbuilding Restrictions: No assets that take up an ally slot." [reaction] When you play a [survivor] event, exhaust On Your Own: Reduce that event's cost by 2.
53010.text: 卓越。永久。 你的调查员获得：“牌库构建限制：无占用盟友槽位的支援。” [reaction]在你打出一张[survivor]事件时，横置自食其力：该事件费用减2。

53011.name: 背包
53011.real_text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 12 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.
53011.text:
[reaction]在背包入场后：查找你牌库顶的12张卡牌，找出最多3张非弱点[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌，正面朝下附属到背包上。混洗你的牌库。
附属到背包的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。如果没有卡牌附属在背包，弃掉背包。

53012.name: 植形异变
53012.real_text: Revelation - Put Dendromorphosis into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play while it has no damage on it. [fast] Take 1 direct damage: Deal 1 damage to Dendromorphosis. Card design by the Botanists at Arkham Nights 2018.
53012.text: 显现 - 将植形异变放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。植形异变上没有伤害时不能离场。 [free]受到1点直接伤害：对植形异变造成1点伤害。 本卡牌由植物学家设计于阿卡姆之夜2018。

53013.name: 无法拒绝的提议
53013.real_text: Campaign Mode only. When you become the bearer of this weakness, gain 2 experience. Revelation - Lose 5 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Offer You Cannot Refuse from your deck, search the collection for Fine Print, and place it in your discard pile.
53013.text: 剧本模式专用。 在你成为本弱点的承受者时，获得2经验。 显现 - 失去5资源。如果你不能这么做，将无法拒绝的提议从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出附加条款，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。

53014.flavor: 你猩红的签名正从其表面滴落。
53014.name: 附加条款
53014.real_text: Revelation - Lose 7 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Fine Print from your deck, search the collection for Sell Your Soul, and place it in your discard pile.
53014.text: 显现 - 失去7资源。如果你不能这么做，将附加条款从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出出卖灵魂，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。

53015.flavor: 这笔债，终须以某种方式偿还。
53015.name: 出卖灵魂
53015.real_text: Revelation - Lose 10 resources. If you cannot, your dark patron tears your consciousness from your body. You are driven insane.
53015.text: 显现 - 失去10资源。如果你不能这么做，你的黑暗恩主将你的意识从躯体中剥离。你发疯。

53016.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、橙色心形。将其余4张[[丛林]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(总计应有5张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “探险营地的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53016.name: 重返荒莽密林
53016.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Untamed Wilds shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
53016.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返荒莽密林找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

53017.back_text:
- 在冒险设置前，使用本遭遇组新版的遗迹入口、古代石厅、华美石室和时间石室地点替换原版的。 -在冒险设置前，使用新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)替换原版的瓦卢西亚的预示者。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用封印通道、彩砖石室、古代墓穴、王座大厅、蛇洞、古代石厅和华美石室。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53017.name: 重返埃兹特里的覆灭
53017.real_name: Return to The Doom of Eztli
53017.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Doom of Eztli shown here. - Gather the 3 Pit Viper cards from the Serpents encounter set and set them aside, out of play. - Before setup, remove the original Burial Pit, Underground Ruins, and Secret Passage locations from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)
53017.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返埃兹特里的覆灭找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 从蛇族遭遇组中找出3张蝮蛇，将它们放在一边，位于场外。 - 在冒险设置前，将原版的坑葬墓室、地下遗迹和秘密通道地点从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)

53018.name: 瓦卢西亚的预示者
53018.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. While this enemy has 5 [per_investigator] or more damage on it, it gets +2 fight and -2 evade. Forced - After a successful attack or evasion attempt against this enemy ends: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)
53018.text: 警戒。猎手。反击。 瓦卢西亚的预示者上有5[per_investigator]点或更多伤害时，其得到+2攻击值和-2躲避值。 强制 - 在对本敌人进行的一次成功的攻击或躲避尝试结束后：在该卡牌上放置1资源。然后，如果该卡牌上有2[per_investigator]资源，瓦卢西亚的预示者发出奸险的嘶嘶声并遁去身影。(将该卡牌放在一边，位于场外。该卡牌保留所有伤害标记。)
53018.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族. 精英

53019.back_flavor: 日落余晖洒在神庙遗迹，所有石块都沐浴在温暖的光辉下.当你踏入漆有颜色的遗迹入口时，丛林的种种声音离你远去。在遗迹入口里，诸多厅室淹没在漆黑之中。
53019.flavor: 数百年之前，这座神庙或许就是一座美丽而受人敬畏的精神圣殿，坐落在这片危机四伏的丛林中。
53019.name: 遗迹入口
53019.real_text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped... for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches: Look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard 1 treachery or enemy looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck. This ability can be used at any location.
53019.text: [action]：撤退。你暂时……逃出来了。 [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有火把：查看探索牌库顶的2张卡牌。弃掉以此效果查看到的1张诡计或敌人卡牌。混洗探索牌库。本能力可以在任意地点使用。

53020.name: 封印通道
53020.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have the Key of Eztli: Search the exploration deck and all set-aside cards for Chamber of Time and put it into play. If it is act 1a, skip directly to act 2a. For the remainder of this act, Sealed Passage is connected to Chamber of Time and vice versa. (Group limit once per game.)
53020.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有埃兹特里之钥：查找探索牌库或所有放在一边的卡牌，找出时间石室并将其放置入场。如果当前场景是场景1a，直接跳至场景2a。在该场景的剩余时间里，封印通道和时间石室连接，反之亦然。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

53021.name: 彩砖石室
53021.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have a canteen: The chamber accepts your gift of water. Remove 1 doom from any location in play. (Group limit once per game.)
53021.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有水壶：石室接受你供奉的净水，从在场任意地点上移除1个毁灭标记。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

53022.name: 古代墓穴
53022.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If an investigator at Tomb of the Ancients has rope: Move to a revealed location up to 3 connections away. Until the end of the round, Tomb of the Ancients is considered to be connected to that location, and vice versa. (Group limit once per round.)
53022.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果位于古代墓穴的调查员带有绳索：移动到一个连接次数最多为3的已揭示地点。直到本轮结束，古代墓穴视为和该地点连接，反之亦然。(团队每轮仅限一次。)

53023.name: 王座大厅
53023.real_text:
While Throne Room has doom on it, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
[action] If there are no clues or doom on Throne Room: Record "mysterious scepter" in your supplies. (Group limit once per game.)
53023.text:
王座大厅上有毁灭标记时，该地点视为在胜利区中(用以计入复仇点数)。
[action]如果王座大厅上没有线索和毁灭标记：在你的补给品中记录“神秘权杖”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

53024.name: 蛇洞
53024.real_text: Forced - After you put Snake Pit into play by exploring successfully, but before moving to it: Spawn 1 [per_investigator] set-aside Pit Viper enemies in Snake Pit (to a maximum of 3). Check your supplies. If an investigator at your location has binoculars, you may choose not to move to Snake Pit. Otherwise, you must move to it.
53024.text: 强制 - 在你探索成功并将蛇洞放置入场后，但在移动进入前：将放在一边的1[per_investigator]个蝮蛇敌人生成在蛇洞(最多3个)。检查你的补给品。如果你所在地点的调查员带有双筒望远镜，你可以选择不移动到蛇洞。否则，你必须移动到蛇洞。

53025.name: 古代石厅
53025.real_text:
Ancient Hall enters play with 1 [per_investigator] doom on it.
[action]: Flip 1 doom on Ancient Hall to its clue side.
[fast]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, flip 1 doom on Ancient Hall to its clue side. (Group limit once per round.)
53025.text:
古代石厅入场时带有1[per_investigator]个毁灭标记。
[action]：将古代石厅上的1个毁灭标记翻到线索面。
[free]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有指南针，将古代石厅上的1个毁灭标记翻到线索面。(团队每轮仅限一次。)

53026.name: 华美石室
53026.real_text: [action] Check your supplies. If you have a map and there are no clues on Grand Chamber: For the remainder of the scenario (and its resolution), Grand Chamber loses Vengeance 1 and gains Victory 1. (Group limit once per game.)
53026.text: [action]检查你的补给品。如果你带有地图且华美石室上没有线索：在本场冒险的剩余时间里(包括结局)，华美石室失去复仇1并获得胜利1。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

53027.flavor: 这个石室中央的地面雕刻着精细纹路，发出诡异的光芒……
53027.name: 时间石室
53027.real_text: Forced - After Chamber of Time enters play: Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages asset to the Chamber of Time. Place 1 doom on Chamber of Time.
53027.text: 强制 - 在时间石室入场后：将放在一边的古代遗物支援附属到时间石室上。在时间石室上放置1个毁灭标记。

53028.back_text: - 本遭遇组包含第四套“g/h”场景牌库。按如下方式调整“g/h”场景牌库。调查员必须选择一项： 若要寻找广告人报文章所述的情报来源，从“g/h”场景牌库移除以下场景卡：寻找意义、两张蔓生庄园，以及两张寻找麻烦中随机一张。 若要寻找问题根源，从“g/h”场景牌库移除以下场景卡：寻找来源、两张寻找麻烦，以及两张蔓生庄园中随机一张。
53028.name: 重返命运之线
53028.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Threads of Fate shown here. - Set the Veda Whitsley story asset aside, out of play. (Continued on reverse side.)
53028.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返命运之线找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将薇达·惠茨利剧情支援放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)

53029.flavor: 你决定前往马歇尔·黑斯廷斯的庄园，进一步了解《广告人报》文章中提到的怪异事件。或许这一新的事态能为你最近遇到的其他麻烦带来一些线索。

linked_card.flavor: Several caretakers and members of the expedition lie paralyzed and comatose nearby. What in the hell happened here?
linked_card.name: The Hastings Estates
linked_card.real_text: Revelation - Put The Hastings Estate into play. [action] Cross medicine off from your supplies: Discover all of the clues on The Hastings Estate.
linked_card.text:
Revelation - Put The Hastings Estate into play.

Cross medicine off from your supplies: Discover all of the clues on The Hastings Estate.

53029.name: 寻找意义
53029.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
53029.text: 目标 - 只有在河岸城的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。

53030.flavor: 为了查明这起新事件的真相，你决定追查《广告人报》那篇文章的匿名消息来源。或许前往北区的报社办公室能打探到更多线索——不过为了得到所需情报，恐怕免不了得打点些“好处费”。

linked_card.name: Merle Garvin
linked_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Merle Garvin into play at Miskatonic University. [action]: Parley. Mr. Garvin tries to give you the slip. Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Merle Garvin (from the token pool) and move him 1 location away from you. If you fail, move him 2 locations away from you.
linked_card.text:
Revelation - Put Merle Garvin into play at Miskatonic University.

: Parley. Mr. Garvin tries to give you the slip. Test (2). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Merle Garvin (from the token pool) and move him 1 location away from you. If you fail, move him 2 locations away from you.

53030.name: 寻找来源
53030.real_text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
53030.text: 目标 - 只有在北区的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。

53031.back_flavor: 你在庄园仔细搜查了一遍，却只找到些《广告人报》文章里早已提过的东西。仿佛你的噩梦成真：那片雨林真的尾随你一路来到了阿卡姆。长久以来的提心吊胆，此刻反倒让你生出一种直面它的释然。就在这时，一阵熟悉的响环声在庄园走廊里回荡。那骇人的声响让你毛骨悚然。这肯定不可能……对吧？
53031.back_text: 查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将它生成在黑斯廷斯庄园。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数小于等于5，其入场时处于横置状态。 推进到场景3g——“不可能的追猎”。
53031.flavor: 当你抵达黑斯廷斯庄园时，发现它的状况比新闻描述的还要糟糕得多。雨林已现身于阿卡姆，几乎完全吞噬了庄园及其周边区域。
53031.name: 蔓生庄园
53031.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
53031.text: 目标 - 只有在黑斯廷斯庄园的调查员能够共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。

53032.flavor: 抵达黑斯廷斯庄园时，你发现状况比原先描述的糟糕得多。雨林已经来到阿卡姆，几乎吞没了庄园及周边区域。

linked_card.name: Clinton Freeman
linked_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Clinton Freeman into play at Velma's Diner. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Clinton Freeman (from the token pool) and take 1 horror. If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you failed by.
linked_card.text:
Revelation - Put Clinton Freeman into play at Velma's Diner. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth."

: Parley. Test or (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Clinton Freeman (from the token pool) and take 1 horror. If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you failed by.

53032.name: 蔓生庄园
53032.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
53032.text: 目标 - 只有位于黑斯廷斯庄园的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。

53033.back_flavor: 你终于追上了加文先生，把他逼的无路可逃。他吓坏了——但不是因为你，而是因为别的什么东西。“它来了，”他警告道。“不把我们全弄死它绝不会停。求求你，一定要帮帮我！你得把我藏起来！”你还没来得及问究竟是什么把他吓成这样，一阵熟悉的响环声便已回答了你未说出口的疑问。那骇人的声响让你毛骨悚然。它怎么可能出现在阿卡姆？
53033.back_text: 查找收藏，找出瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将它生成在默尔·加文所在地点。按照剧本日志括号内记录的伤害总数，瓦卢西亚的预示者在入场时带有对应数量的伤害。如果你剧本日志里的“伊格之怒”下方的记录次数小于等于5，其入场时处于横置状态。 推进到场景3g——“不可能的追猎”。
53033.flavor: 你已查明《广告人报》消息源的身份：一个名叫默尔·加文的男人，他最近刚从一场探险中归来，而这场探险的资助人正是马歇尔·黑斯廷斯。他最后一次被人看见，是在大学图书馆里焦躁地翻找着什么，不过没人知道确切缘由。
53033.name: 自找麻烦
53033.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.
53033.text: 目标 - 如果默尔·加文上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。

53034.flavor: 你已得知广告人报的情报来源：一名叫梅尔·加文的男子，他刚从一场由马歇尔·黑斯廷斯资助的探险归来。最近有人看见他焦躁地翻找大学图书馆，但没人知道原因。

linked_card.name: Loading Docks
linked_card.real_text: Revelation - Put Loading Docks into play with 4 resources on it. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." While there are no resources on Loading Docks, clues on it cannot be discovered by any means. Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 resource from Loading Docks.
linked_card.text:
Revelation - Put Loading Docks into play with 4 resources on it. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth."

While there are no resources on Loading Docks, clues on it cannot be discovered by any means.

Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 resource from Loading Docks.

53034.name: 寻找麻烦
53034.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.
53034.text: 目标 - 如果梅尔·加文上有1[per_investigator]个线索：必须移除这些线索并立即推进。

53035.back_text:
如果克林顿·弗里曼在场：
弗里曼先生终于对你吐露了真相：他那场探险的一部分资金出自墨西哥城的一位神秘“慈善家”，对方要求用几件遗物作为回报。出于好奇和担忧，他和他的同伴们主动提出要帮助你查明事件背后的真相。
距离克林顿·弗里曼最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
如果装货码头在场：
多亏了加文先生提供的信息，你发现探险队的诸多收获正被运往一个令人意外的目的地：墨西哥城的一位不明收货人。出于对你相助的感激，几位探险队成员主动提出要助你一臂之力。
距离装货码头最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
53035.flavor: 你即将揭开这另一场探险背后的真相。他们究竟在寻找什么，原因又是什么？这一切是否和伊塔卡以及埃兹特里有所关联？
53035.name: 探寻真相
53035.real_text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Clinton Freeman: You must remove them and immediately advance. Objective - If Loading Docks is in play and there are no clues remaining on it: You must immediately advance.
53035.text: 目标 - 如果克林顿·弗里曼上有1[per_investigator]个线索：你必须移除这些线索并立即推进。 目标 - 如果装货码头在场且其上没有剩余线索：你必须立即推进。

53036.back_flavor: 那蛇形生物来得突然，去得也快。你仍不确定它是否真的存在过，但至少此刻，你似乎是安全的。出于对你相助的感激，另一支探险队的几位成员主动提出要助你一臂之力。至于他们发现的文物是否与埃兹特里有关，仍有待查证。无论如何，如果这类怪物继续纠缠不休，他们的专业知识无疑能派上用场。
53036.back_text: 距离瓦卢西亚的预示者最近的调查员控制放在一边的薇达·惠茨利。 将剩余的“g/h”场景牌库从游戏中移除。如果场上有另一张场景卡牌，继续游戏。否则，进入(→结局1)。
53036.flavor: 你从未想过这生物会一路追踪你到阿卡姆。又或许它只是你臆想的产物。是你脑海中的幽灵。是你潜意识的一块碎片，想要让你远离这场调查。
53036.name: 不可能的追猎
53036.real_text: Objective - If the Harbinger of Valusia leaves play, advance.
53036.text: 目标 - 如果瓦卢西亚的预示者离场，推进场景。

53037.name: 薇达·惠茨利
53037.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Veda Whitsley: Look at the top card of the exploration deck or encounter deck. If it is an enemy, you may deal 1 damage to Veda Whitsley to discard it. If it is a treachery, you may deal 1 horror to Veda Whitsley to discard it. Otherwise, return it to the top of its deck.
53037.text: [free]横置薇达·惠茨利：查看探索牌库或遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。如果是敌人，你可以对薇达·惠茨利造成1点伤害来将其弃掉。如果是诡计，你可以对薇达·惠茨利造成1点恐惧来将其弃掉。否则，将其放回其牌库顶。

53038.back_text: - 将新的[[现代]]地点加入原版界限彼端的遭遇组中。在每2张同名地点中，随机选择1张从游戏中移除。将剩余地点放置入场。 - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用12张单面[[古代]]地点。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
53038.name: 重返界限彼端
53038.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Boundary Beyond shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
53038.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返界限彼端找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

53039.back_flavor: 尽管特诺奇蒂特兰主神庙的确切位置仍未得知，但挖掘工作已经开展，以搜寻这片区域曾经存在的多座神庙的遗迹。
53039.name: 神庙遗迹
53039.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Temple Ruins: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53039.text: [reaction]在你成功调查神庙遗迹后：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53040.back_flavor: 大都会教堂坐落在索卡洛广场北边，西班牙征服者们在攻陷阿兹特克王朝后建造了这座建筑。在这座教堂的每个钟塔上方，有一缕缕云彩在诡异地打旋。
53040.name: 大都会教堂
53040.real_text: [action] Take 1 horror: Gain 2 resources. [action] If you have 10 or more resources: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53040.text: [action]受到1点恐惧：获得2资源。 [action]如果你有至少10点资源：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53041.back_flavor: 查普尔特佩克森林是西部最大的城市公园之一，也是俯瞰全城的美丽生态地标；数个世纪前，这里曾是一片神圣森林。
53041.name: 查普尔特佩克公园
53041.real_text: Forced - After you fail an [agility] test while at Chapultepec Park: Take 1 damage. [action]: Explore. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53041.text: 强制 - 你位于查普尔特佩克公园时，[agility]技能检定失败后：受到1点伤害。 [action]：探索。检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点在左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53042.back_flavor: 墨西哥城中央的主广场就在你眼前，这里曾是特诺奇蒂特兰的仪式中心。银色的闪电出现在上空的重重乌云之中，而你震惊地发现一股鲜血洪潮在广场上漫延。整座城市异常地毫无生机，死气沉沉。
53042.name: 索卡洛广场
53042.real_text: [action] Discard cards with a combined total of at least 4 skill icons from your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53042.text: [action]弃掉你技能图标总计至少有4个的手牌：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53043.back_flavor: 一艘小木船撞在运河边上，在潺潺流动的河水上荡漾起水波。旁边的浅水滩头上有一株醒目的松树，在微风中轻轻摇曳。
53043.name: 霍奇米尔科
53043.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an enemy at Xochimilco: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53043.text: [reaction]在你成功在霍奇米尔科攻击或躲避一个敌人后：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53044.back_flavor: 尽管科约阿坎区曾经不属于墨西哥城，但它始终是一块历史悠久的地区，其特征是有着诸多狭窄的鹅卵石街道和广场。当你走在这个村落的狭窄小道上时，地面伴有震动，你怀疑还有着更多的未知生命居于地下……
53044.name: 科约阿坎区
53044.real_text: While you are at Coyoacán, damage/horror cannot be healed from cards you control. [action] If you have 5 or more total damage and/or horror on your investigator: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
53044.text: 你位于科约阿坎区时，你控制的卡牌上的伤害/恐惧不能被治愈。 [action]如果你的调查员上总计有至少5点伤害和/或恐惧：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果抽出的地点左上角带有对应地点符号，将其放在本地点上方并替代本地点。

53045.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、橙色心形。将其余4张[[丛林]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(总计应有6张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “昆扬之口的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53045.name: 重返久远腹地，第一部分
53045.real_name: Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 1
53045.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 1 shown here. - Remove Act 1a - "Search for the Pattern" from the game and replace it with the new Act 1a - "A Familiar Pattern." (Continued on reverse side.)
53045.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返久远腹地，第一部分找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将场景1a——“研究图案”从游戏中移除，使用新的场景1a——“熟悉的图案”替代。 (继续阅读背面。)

53046.flavor: 六根石柱围绕着洞穴入口，每根石柱都刻着许多异常的凹槽和象形文字，形成了错综复杂的图案。触摸石柱的时候凹槽上的光芒会变得明亮，而转动石柱时则会使得图案转动并改变。或许这些图案与在丛林其他地方找到的象形文字是对应的？

linked_card.name: The Winged Serpent
linked_card.real_text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - If there are 5 or more damage on this enemy, or after a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Heal all damage from this enemy and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.
linked_card.text:
Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan.

Hunter. Massive.

Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity.

Forced - If there are 5 or more damage on this enemy, or after a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Heal all damage from this enemy and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

53046.name: 熟悉的图案
53046.real_text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
53046.text: 目标 - 在调查员拥有所需数量的线索时，必须立即花费线索并推进。

53047.name: 鲜翎蛇族
53047.real_text: X is the number of pillar tokens on Mouth of K'n-yan. While X is 3 or higher, Feathered Serpent gains alert and hunter. [action]: Evade. Check your supplies. If you have a mysterious scepter, you automatically evade the serpent and command it to deal its damage to another enemy at its location.
53047.text: 其中X为昆扬之口上石柱标记的数量。X为3或更高时，鲜翎蛇族获得警戒和猎手。 [action]：躲避。检查你的补给品。如果你带有神秘权杖，你自动躲避鲜翎蛇族，并命令它对其所在地点的另一个敌人造成它的伤害。

53048.back_text:
- 在创建探索牌库时，从以下每个地点符号的2张地点中随机选择1张加入：紫色月亮、蓝色三角、红色方形、绿色菱形。将其余4张[[古代]]地点从游戏中移除，不要查看。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。(不计入放在一边的深入幽嘶，总计应有5张卡牌。)
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “昆扬之口的‘检查你的补给品’能力可以在任意地点使用，且该能力既能弃掉诡计，也能弃掉敌人。 强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53048.name: 重返久远腹地，第二部分
53048.real_name: Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 2
53048.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Heart of the Elders, Part 2 shown here. - After setup, search the collection for the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and set it aside, out of play. If the Harbinger of Valusia would enter play during this scenario, use this version instead of the original one. (Continued on reverse side.)
53048.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返久远腹地，第二部分找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 (继续阅读背面。)

53049.name: 昆扬遗迹
53049.real_text: [action] [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, discover 2 clues on Ruins of K'n-yan. (Group limit once per game.)
53049.text: [action][action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有指南针，发现昆扬遗迹的2个线索。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)
53049.traits: 古代. 洞穴. 遗迹

53050.name: 地下沼泽
53050.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Subterranean Swamp: Check your supplies. If you have a canteen, place 1 doom on this location and record "sticky goop" in your supplies. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Subterranean Swamp: Check your supplies. If you do not have a pocketknife, lose all remaining actions and end your turn.
53050.text: [free]如果地下沼泽上没有线索：检查你的补给品。如果你带有水壶，在本地点上放置1个毁灭标记并在你的补给品中记录“粘液团”。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。) 强制 - 在你调查地下沼泽时，技能检定失败后：检查你的补给品。如果你没有折叠小刀，失去所有剩余行动并结束你的回合。

53051.name: 钻地魔虫深渊
53051.real_text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Chthonian Depths: Check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has torches, place 1 doom on it.
53051.text: 强制 - 在钻地魔虫深渊的最后一个线索被发现后：检查你的补给品。如果本地点没有调查员带有火把，在其上放置1个毁灭标记。

53052.name: 险恶坡道
53052.real_text: [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a pickaxe, reduce the shroud value of Treacherous Descent by 2 for the remainder of the scenario. (Group limit 3 times per game.)
53052.text: [action]：检查你的补给品。如果你带有鹤嘴锄，在本场冒险的剩余时间里，险恶坡道的隐藏值降低2点。(团队每场游戏仅限3次。)

53053.back_text: - 将巨石密库和异星培育所放在一边，位于场外。(这些地点应在场景1b“将所有放在一边的地点放置入场”时放置入场。) - 将场景2a——“禁止通行”从游戏中移除，用新版的场景2a——“自由通行”替换。
53053.name: 重返天机之城
53053.real_name: Return to The City of Archives
53053.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The City of Archives shown here. - Put Halls of Pnakotus (Southern Corridors) into play. (Continued on reverse side.)
53053.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返天机之城找出新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将纳克特廊道(南翼通道)放置入场。 (继续阅读背面。)

53054.back_flavor: 事实令人难以接受。你的身体从未被带到这里来。你的意识已被转移到这具身体中，属于这群生物的其中一个同胞。在其他的某个地方——在某个时空——这群该死的生物中的一员就居住在你的身体中。
53054.back_text: 你再也不必执行以下任何任务。但是，你在本场冒险结束之前执行的任务越多，就越容易能转移到你的人类身体中，这项程式失败或产生反作用的几率也更低。但要当心…… 将本场景放到胜利区，本面朝上，作为提醒。 - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。 - 有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”。 - 有调查员“看到了熟悉的样本”。
53054.name: 自由通行
53054.real_text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian. - An investigator "read about Earth." - An investigator "saw a familiar specimen."
53054.text: 目标 - 如果以下情况中，有三种情况已发生，你必须推进场景： - 有调查员“找到了归位程式”。 - 有调查员“解剖了一个器官”。 - 有调查员“进行了一次会谈”。 - 有调查员“发现了现在的年份”。 - 有调查员“启动了设备”。 - 有调查员控制了看管人。 - 有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”。 - 有调查员“看到了熟悉的样本”。

53055.back_text: 本地点与纳克特廊道(东翼通道)和纳克特廊道(西翼通道)连接，反之亦然。
53055.name: 纳克特廊道
53055.real_text: This location is connected to Halls of Pnakotus (Eastern Corridors) and Halls of Pnakotus (Western Corridors), and vice versa. [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
53055.text: 本地点与纳克特廊道(东翼通道)和纳克特廊道(西翼通道)连接，反之亦然。 [free]在你回合期间，选择并弃掉一张手牌：移动到另一个纳克特廊道。(每回合仅限一次。)

53056.back_flavor: 我最终来到一处低矮的圆形地窟，周围环列着拱门——保存得惊人地完好——向各个方向延伸。墙面上，或者说火把照亮的类似墙面的部分，都是密密麻麻象形文字，还刻满了典型的曲线符号——其中一些，是在我那些梦境之后才添上的。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
53056.name: 巨石密库
53056.real_text:
[action]: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand.
[action] If you have no cards in your hand: Remember that you "read about Earth."
[action] [action] If you have fewer than 5 cards in your hand: Draw cards until you have exactly 5 cards in your hand.
53056.text:
[action]：弃掉你所有非弱点手牌。
[action]如果你没有手牌：记住你“阅读了关于地球的知识”。
[action][action]如果你的手牌少于5张：抽取卡牌，直到你有正好5张手牌。

53057.back_flavor: ……伟大种族本身已近乎全知，继而致力于与其他行星的智慧生命建立意识交换，探索它们的过去与未来。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《超越时间之影》</cite>
53057.name: 异星培育所
53057.real_text:
While you are in the Alien Conservatory, decrease your maximum hand size by 2.
[action]: Test [willpower] (1). If you succeed, test [agility] (2). If you succeed, test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "saw a familiar specimen."
53057.text:
你位于异星培育所时，你手牌上限减少2张。
[action]：检定[willpower](1)。如果你检定成功，检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，记住你“看到了熟悉的样本”。

53058.name: 被奴役的实验体
53058.real_text: Spawn - Alien Conservatory. Aloof. Retaliate. If an investigator "read about Earth" or "saw a familiar specimen," Captive Subjects loses aloof and gains hunter.
53058.text: 生成 - 异星培育所。 冷漠。反击。 如果有调查员“阅读了关于地球的知识”或“看到了熟悉的样本”，被奴役的实验体失去冷漠并获得猎手。

53059.back_text:
- 在冒险设置期间创建探索牌库后，将幽嘶险境诡计洗入探索牌库。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在场景1b期间创建新的探索牌库后：查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有场外区域，找出幽嘶险境并将其洗入探索牌库。如果查找过遭遇牌库，将其混洗。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53059.name: 重返幽嘶深渊
53059.real_name: Return to The Depths of Yoth
53059.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Depths of Yoth shown here. - After setup, search the collection for the new Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and set it aside, out of play. If the Harbinger of Valusia would enter play during this scenario, use this version instead of the original one. (Continued on reverse side.)
53059.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返幽嘶深渊找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在冒险设置后，查找收藏，找出新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)并将其放在一边，位于场外。在本场冒险期间，如果要将瓦卢西亚的预示者放置入场，使用该版本替代原版。 (继续阅读背面。)

53060.name: 幽嘶险境
53060.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Set Perils of Yoth aside, out of play. (This exploration fails.) - Set Perils of Yoth aside, out of play: take horror or damage equal to the current depth level; and continue exploring as if you had not drawn Perils of Yoth.
53060.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 将幽嘶险境放在一边，位于场外。(本次探索失败。) - 将幽嘶险境放在一边，位于场外；受到等于当前深度等级的伤害或恐惧；并继续探索如同你没有抽取幽嘶险境。

53061.back_text:
- 将新的[[破碎]]地点放在一边，位于场外。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53061.name: 重返破碎永世
53061.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Shattered Aeons shown here. - When building the exploration deck, use only the 4 single-sided [[Otherworld]] locations. Do not include any of the other encounter cards listed in the original setup instructions. (Continued on reverse side.)
53061.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返破碎永世找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用4张单面[[异界]]地点。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。 (继续阅读背面。)

53062.name: 塞拉伊诺大图书馆
53062.real_text: [reaction] After you move to Great Hall of Celeano, place 1 doom on it: Look at the top card of the encounter deck, the exploration deck, or any player deck. You may discard that card.
53062.text: [reaction]在你移动到塞拉伊诺大图书馆后，在其上放置1个毁灭标记：查看遭遇牌库、探索牌库或任意玩家牌库顶的牌。你可以弃掉该卡牌。

53063.name: 布宜诺斯艾利斯
53063.real_text: Buenos Aires gets -2 shroud for each doom on it. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Buenos Aires.
53063.text: 布宜诺斯艾利斯上每有1个毁灭标记，其隐藏值-2。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在布宜诺斯艾利斯上放置1个毁灭标记。

53064.name: 极北之地
53064.real_text: Forced - After Ultima Thule enters play: Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Ultima Thule.
53064.text: 强制 - 在极北之地入场后：查找混乱袋，找出[elder_sign]混乱标记并将其封印在此地点上。

53065.name: 不可知的过去
53065.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Reveal 4 chaos tokens. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand and shuffle Unknowable Past into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Unknowable Past was drawn from the exploration deck.
53065.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 揭示4个混乱标记。每揭示1个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 - 选择并弃掉你的1张手牌，并将不可知的过去洗入探索牌库。不可知的过去如果是从探索牌库抽出的，你不能选择这个选项。

53066.back_text:
- 在冒险设置前，使用本遭遇组新版的遗迹入口、古代石厅、华美石室和时间石室地点替换原版的。 - 在冒险设置前，使用新版的瓦卢西亚的预示者(沉睡者归来)替换原版的瓦卢西亚的预示者。 - 在创建探索牌库时，仅使用封印通道、彩砖石室、古代墓穴、王座大厅、蛇洞、古代石厅和华美石室。不要加入原版常规设置中列出的其他遭遇。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “强制 - 在一次成功的探索结束后：将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
53066.name: 重返时间倒流
53066.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Forgotten Age Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Turn Back Time shown here. - Gather the 3 Pit Viper cards from the Serpents encounter set and set them aside, out of play. - Before setup, remove the original Burial Pit, Underground Ruins, and Secret Passage locations from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)
53066.text: 遵循失落的时代的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返时间倒流找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 从蛇族遭遇组中找出3张蝮蛇，将它们放在一边，位于场外。 - 在冒险设置前，将原版的坑葬墓室、地下遗迹和秘密通道地点从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)

53067.name: 河畔神庙
53067.real_text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered at Riverside Temple: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Riverside Temple has chalk, shuffle an equal number of cards from the top of the encounter deck into the exploration deck.
53067.text: 强制 - 在你发现河畔神庙任意数量的线索后：检查你的补给品。如果位于河畔神庙的调查员没有粉笔，将等量遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。

53068.name: 瀑布
53068.real_text: [reaction] When you investigate Waterfall: Check your supplies. If an investigator at Waterfall has rope, reduce Waterfall's shroud by 3 for this investigation. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Waterfall: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
53068.text: [reaction]在你调查瀑布时：检查你的补给品。如果位于瀑布的调查员带有绳索，本次调查瀑布的隐藏值降低3点。 强制 - 在你调查瀑布时，技能检定失败后：随机弃掉你的1张手牌。

53069.name: 亡者之径
53069.real_text: Forced - After you investigate or explore while at Trail of the Dead: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Trail of the Dead has binoculars, take 1 horror.
53069.text: 强制 - 在你在亡者之径调查或探索后：检查你的补给品。如果位于亡者之径的调查员没有双筒望远镜，受到1点恐惧。

53070.name: 云雾林
53070.real_text: Forced - When an enemy at Cloud Forest would be dealt any amount of damage: Check your supplies. If no investigator at Cloud Forest has torches, cancel that damage.
53070.text: 强制 - 在云雾林上的敌人将要受到任意数量的伤害时：检查你的补给品。如果位于云雾林的调查员没有火把，取消该伤害。

53071.name: 兄弟会侍僧
53071.real_text: Spawn - Location with the most [[Cultist]] enemies. Aloof. Forced - After Brotherhood Acolyte enters plaay: Place 1 doom on each other [[Cultist]] enemy at its location.
53071.text: 生成 - 有最多[[异教徒]]敌人的地点。 冷漠。 强制 - 在兄弟会侍僧入场后：在其所在地点的其他每个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。

53072.name: 被窃取的思维
53072.real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Retaliate. Stolen Mind gets +1 fight for each doom on it. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Stolen Mind.
53072.text: 生成 - 任意无人地点。 反击。 被窃取的思维上每有一个毁灭标记，其得到+1攻击值。 强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在被窃取的思维上放置1个毁灭标记。

53073.name: 来自另一个时代
53073.real_text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). Place X doom on [[Cultist]] enemies in play, divided as evenly as possible. X is the amount you failed by. If you fail and there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, instead search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it (shuffle the encounter deck).
53073.text: 显现 - 检定[intellect](4)。在场上的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置总计X个毁灭标记，尽可能平均分配。其中X为你检定失败且低于难度的点数。如果你检定失败且场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，改为查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[异教徒]]敌人并将其抽取(混洗遭遇牌库)。

53074.name: 怨愤荒野
53074.real_text: Revelation - Take 1 horror and attach Resentful Wilds to the nearest location without a copy of Resentful Wilds attached. Forced - After you successfully explore at attached location: Add Resentful Wilds to the victory display.
53074.text: 显现 - 受到1点恐惧，并将怨愤荒野附属到最近的且没有附属怨愤荒野的地点。 强制 - 在你在附属的地点探索成功后：将怨愤荒野加入胜利区。

53075.name: 最精心的计划
53075.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck.
53075.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)： - 失去2个行动。 - 将遭遇牌库顶的卡牌洗入探索牌库。

53076.name: 时间线合并
53076.real_text: Revelation - Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. For each card in your hand that matches one of the cards (by title), discard that card from your hand and lose 1 action. Shuffle each weakness discarded by this effect into your deck.
53076.text: 显现 - 弃掉你牌库顶的5张卡牌。对于你的与被弃掉的卡牌名称相同的每张手牌(相同标题)，弃掉该卡牌并失去1个行动。将每张因此效果弃掉的弱点洗回你的牌库。

53077.name: 廷达洛斯头犬
53077.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Tindalos Alpha attacks you: Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. Discard Tindalos Alpha. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Tindalos Alpha.
53077.text: 警戒。反击。 强制 - 在廷达洛斯头犬攻击你后：将一张你控制的非剧情支援洗回你的牌库，将该支援卡牌上的所有伤害和恐惧移动到你的调查员上。弃掉廷达洛斯头犬。 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束后：弃掉廷达洛斯头犬。
53077.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯

53078.name: 复仇蛇人
53078.real_text: Hunter. Forced - After you draw Vengeful Serpent: Draw each Vengeful Serpent in the victory display as well.
53078.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在你抽取复仇蛇人后：抽取胜利区中每张复仇蛇人。
53078.traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族

53079.name: 蛇族守卫
53079.real_text: Spawn - Nearest location with at least 1 clue. Aloof. While Serpent Guardian is unengaged, its location gets +2 shroud. While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent Guardian loses aloof and gains hunter.
53079.text: 生成 - 最近的有至少1个线索的地点。 冷漠。 蛇族守卫未交战时，其所在地点隐藏值+2。 胜利区内有至少3点复仇点数时，蛇族守卫失去冷漠并获得猎手。

53080.name: 伊格的怒火
53080.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you fail, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area (if you cannot, take 2 damage).
53080.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。胜利区内有每有1点复仇点数，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定失败，将放在一边的一个中毒弱点放置入场，放到你的威胁区域(如果你不能，受到2点伤害)。

54001.name: 星星·XVII
54001.real_text:
Each asset you control with health gets +1 health.
Each asset you control with sanity gets +1 sanity.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Star • XVII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54001.text:
你控制的每个有生命值的支援得到+1生命值。
你控制的每个有神智值的支援得到+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星星·XVII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54002.name: 圣化之镜
54002.real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Soothing Melody: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Hallowed Mirror enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.
54002.text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张舒缓旋律时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在圣化之镜入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张舒缓旋律。将其中一张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
54002.traits: 道具. 遗物. 密教. 祝福

54003.name: 世界·XXI
54003.real_text:
[fast] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, exhaust The World • XXI: Draw 1 card.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The World • XXI is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54003.text:
[free]如果你拥有8张或更多手牌，横置世界·XXI：抽取1张卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果世界·XXI在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54004.name: 密教词典
54004.real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Blood-Rite: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Occult Lexicon enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Blood-Rite. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.
54004.text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张鲜血仪式时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在密教词典入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张鲜血仪式。将其中一张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
54004.traits: 道具. 书籍. 密教

54005.name: 宝剑骑士
54005.real_text:
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test: You get +1 skill value for this test. You may discard Knight of Swords to get +3 instead.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Knight of Swords is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54005.text:
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时：你本次技能检定得到+1技能值。你可以弃掉宝剑骑士，改为得到+3技能值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果宝剑骑士在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54006.name: 良好人脉
54006.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)
54006.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有4资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
[free]花费2资源：重整良好人脉。(每轮仅限一次。)

54007.name: 教皇·V
54007.real_text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
Your arcane slots can be used to hold cards that take up accessory slots, and vice versa.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Hierophant • V is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54007.subname: 真正的导师正等待着你
54007.text:
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。
你的法术槽位可以携带占用饰品槽位的支援，反之亦然。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果教皇·V在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54008.name: 魔法手势
54008.real_text: Fast. You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset. [reaction] After you activate an [action] ability on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset, exhaust Sign Magick: Activate an [action] ability on a different [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset you control (without paying its [action] cost).
54008.text: 快速。 你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来携带一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援。 [reaction]在你执行一个[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援的[action]能力后，横置魔法手势：执行一个你控制的不同的[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援的[action]能力(不支付其[action]费用)。

54009.name: 权杖九
54009.real_text:
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness encounter card, exhaust Nine of Rods: Cancel all of that card's effects and shuffle it into the encounter deck. Then, draw another card from the top of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Nine of Rods is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54009.text:
[reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点遭遇卡牌时，横置权杖九：取消该卡牌的所有效果，将其洗回遭遇牌库。然后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果权杖九在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54010.flavor: 只有在你性命受到威胁时，你才会认识到自己能力的极限。
54010.name: 勇闯火线
54010.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, set the base value of each of your skills to 5, or the base value of one of your skills to 7.
54010.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到你回合结束，将你所有技能的基础值设为5，或将你一项技能的基础值设为7。

54011.name: 愚者·0
54011.real_text:
[reaction] When you play a card, exhaust The Fool • 0: Reduce that card's cost by 1.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Fool • 0 is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54011.text:
[reaction]在你打出一张卡牌时，横置愚者·0：该卡牌费用减1。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果愚者·0在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54012.name: 月之吊坠
54012.real_text:
You have 1 additional tarot slot.
Each non-weakness [[Tarot]] asset in your hand or committed to a skill test gains [wild] [wild].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Moon Pendant is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
54012.text:
你拥有额外1个塔罗牌槽位。
你手牌中或投入技能检定中的每张非弱点[[塔罗]]支援获得[wild][wild]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月之吊坠在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

54013.name: 赐福注目
54013.real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per investigator.
Before setting up each game, draw 3 random cards from the tarot deck and choose 1. Place the chosen card in front of you, in the upright position. Each other investigator ignores its effects. Shuffle the rest back into the tarot deck.
54013.text:
永久。每位调查员仅限1张。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取3张卡牌并选择其中1张。将其以正位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。将其余卡牌洗回塔罗牌库。

54014.name: 诅咒缠身
54014.real_text:
Permanent.
Before setting up each game, draw a random card from the tarot deck and place the chosen card in front of you, in the reverse position. Each other investigator ignores its effects.
54014.text:
永久。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取1张卡牌，并将其以逆位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。

54015.name: 恶魔·XV
54015.real_text: You cannot play assets other than The Devil • XV while it is in your hand. If The Devil • XV is drawn in your opening hand during setup (before or after taking a mulligan), you cannot replace it. It must stay in your opening hand.
54015.text: 恶魔·XV在你手牌中时，你不能打出其他支援。 如果冒险设置期间你抽取了恶魔·XV作为你起始手牌(不论在重调之前还是之后)，你不能将其替换。其必须留在你的起始手牌中。

54016.back_text:
- 将[[幽灵]]版本的酒窖(卡牌 #28)放置入场。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “在结算看守人的攫噬诡计时，幽灵看守人在攻击后不会横置。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
54016.encounter_name: 重返暮色庄园失踪事件
54016.name: 重返暮色庄园失踪事件
54016.real_name: Return to Disappearance at the Twilight Estate
54016.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Disappearance at the Twilight Estate shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
54016.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返暮色庄园失踪事件找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

54017.back_text: - 在随机选择5张女巫作祟之林地点放置入场时，将本扩展的2张新版女巫作祟之林地点也加入遭遇组，改为从9张女巫作祟之林地点中随机选择5张。 - 将每张新版的阿卡姆密林地点放在一边，位于场外。(如果你有重返狂热之夜，你可以找出重返地底噬魔中的新版阿卡姆密林地点，一同放在一边。) - 在创建场景牌库时，使用两个版本的场景4。在推进到场景4a时，将两张场景卡牌一同放置入场；两张卡牌上的文本均有效。
54017.name: 重返巫异时刻
54017.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Witching Hour shown here. - Remove Arkham Woods (Quiet Glade) from the game. (Continued on reverse side.)
54017.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返巫异时刻找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将阿卡姆密林(静谧空地)从游戏中移除。 (继续阅读背面。)

54018.back_flavor:
那群戴兜帽的人见你既未与她们战斗也未干扰仪式，便收敛了敌意。“他们不是之前那些人——那些擅闯仪式的不速之客，”其中一人说着摘下兜帽，露出一头在火光中熠熠生辉的醒目红发。余烬在她指间飞舞。“那么，你们是否与我们志同道合？”她问道。
“不，伊琳，”女巫首领替你回答了。“他们只是迷途之人。”她以锐利的目光审视着你。“你是怎么到这儿来的？”
你解释自己如何在树林中醒来，如何遭到恐怖生物袭击，又是如何来到这片法阵中心，只为寻求所受磨难背后的真相。
“安妮特，我觉得是有人故意将他们送到这里的。”名叫伊琳的红发女巫低声呢喃，眼中透着困惑。
“我们应该在阵法闭合时完成仪式。树林里可能还有其他人。来吧，姐妹们，让我们继续。”安妮特说道。
54018.flavor: 这些人聚在一起想做什么？她们是树林骚乱的原因吗？如果真是这样，她们真正的目的又是什么？
54018.name: 未毁之环
54018.real_text: Objective - "Perhaps we can learn more from them..." If there are more than 1 [per_investigator] exhausted [[Witch]] enemies at the Witches' Circle, investigators at the Witches' Circle may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
54018.text:
你面前的地点均相互连接。 目标 -
“也许我们能从她们身上了解更多…”
如果有超过1[per_investigator]个被横置的[[女巫]]敌人在女巫圆环，在女巫圆环的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。

54019.back_flavor: 你深入阿卡姆之外闹鬼树林时，刺骨寒风在周围呼啸。
54019.name: 女巫作祟之林
54019.real_text: [fast] Take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror: Choose an investigator at a different Witch-Haunted Woods. That investigator heals 1 damage and 1 horror. (Group limit once per round.)
54019.text: [free]受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧：选择位于另一处女巫作祟之林的一位调查员。该调查员治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。(团队每轮仅限一次。)

54020.back_flavor: 你向着阿卡姆城外有女巫作祟的树林步步深入时，寒风在你身边呼啸。
54020.name: 女巫作祟之林
54020.real_text: Forced - When you discover the last clue from this location: Draw the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile. (If you cannot, instead discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Hex]] treachery is discarded, and draw it.)
54020.text: 强制 - 在你发现本地点的最后一个线索时：抽取遭遇弃牌堆最上方的[[巫术]]诡计。(如果你不能，改为从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一张[[巫术]]诡计，将其抽取。)

54021.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
54021.name: 阿卡姆密林
54021.real_text: During the "enemy attacks" step of the enemy phase, instead of their standard attack, each ready [[Witch]] enemy at this location attacks each investigator in play. Attacks made in this way do not cause the enemy to exhaust.
54021.text: 在敌军阶段的“敌人攻击”步骤期间，本地点处于重整状态的[[女巫]]敌人不进行标准攻击，改为攻击在场的每位调查员。敌人以此方式攻击不会横置。

54022.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
54022.name: 阿卡姆密林
54022.real_text: While you are at this location, you cannot cancel or ignore card or game effects, and each encounter card you draw gains peril.
54022.text: 你位于本地点时，你不能取消或忽略卡牌效果或游戏效果，且你抽取的每张遭遇卡牌获得险境。

54023.back_flavor: 你从小就被告诫在夜间远离这座树林。现在你明白了原因。
54023.name: 阿卡姆密林
54023.real_text: Forced - After you successfully investigate this location: Discard 1 card from the top of the encounter deck for each point you succeeded by. Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Each investigator at this location takes 2 damage.
54023.text: 强制 - 在你成功调查本地点后：你检定成功且每超过难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。 强制 - 当遭遇牌库的卡牌耗尽时：本地点的每位调查员受到2点伤害。

54024.back_text:
- 将纳撒尼尔·罗兹参议员敌人放置入场，放到入口大厅，其带有1[per_investigator]个线索。 - 将酒窖地点放置入场。 - 将[[幽灵]]版本的酒窖放在一边，位于场外。 - 将惘界遭遇组放在一边，位于场外，替换原版的冥界遭遇组。同样地，在场景1b指示玩家将冥界遭遇组洗入遭遇牌库时，改为将惘界遭遇组洗入遭遇牌库。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “在结算看守人的攫噬诡计时，幽灵看守人在攻击后不会横置。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
54024.name: 重返死亡门前
54024.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to At Death's Doorstep shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
54024.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返死亡门前找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

54025.flavor: “人民要求改变，我就给他们带来改变！”
54025.name: 纳撒尼尔·罗兹参议员
54025.real_text: Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2) to speak with the Senator. If you succeed, either take control of 1 of his clues, or flip 1 doom on him to its clue side. If you fail, flip one of his clues to its doom side.
54025.text: 冷漠。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower](2)来与参议员交谈。如果你检定成功，控制其上的1个线索，或将其上的1个毁灭标记翻至线索面。如果你检定失败，将其上的1个线索翻至毁灭标记面。
54025.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社

54026.name: 德米特里·康斯坦丁诺夫
54026.real_text: Spawn - The location with no other [[Silver Twilight]] enemies farthest from you. Forced - After Dmitri Konstantinov enters play: Place 2 doom on him. [reaction] After you evade Dmitri Konstantinov: For every 2 points you succeeded by, remove 1 doom from him.
54026.text: 生成 - 最远的且没有其他[[银暮秘社]]敌人的地点。 强制 - 在德米特里·康斯坦丁诺夫放置入场后：在上面放置2个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在你躲避德米特里·康斯坦丁诺夫后：你检定成功且每超过难度2点，移除其上的1个毁灭标记。
54026.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 银暮秘社

54027.back_flavor: 一段漫长幽暗的楼梯通往约瑟夫·梅吉尔的酒窖。若足够小心，或许能看见他藏在下方的东西……
54027.back_text: 维多利亚式宴会厅和酒窖相互连接。
54027.name: 酒窖
54027.real_text: Victorian Halls is connected to Wine Cellar. [action]: You disturb the tranquility of this quiet place in search of evidence. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded. Set that enemy aside, out of play. Then gain 2 clues (from the token pool). (Group limit once per game.)
54027.text: 维多利亚式宴会厅和酒窖相互连接。 [action]：你为找证据，搅了这地方的清净。从遭遇牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一张[[怪物]]敌人。将该敌人放在一边，位于场外。然后，获得2个线索(从供应堆拿取。)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

54028.back_flavor: 幽暗潮湿的楼梯尽头，那扇门后散发着血液与朽木混合的腥腐臭味。
54028.back_text: 维多利亚式宴会厅和酒窖相互连接。
54028.name: 酒窖
54028.real_text: Victorian Halls is connected to Wine Cellar. [reaction] After you successfully investigate the Wine Cellar: Either discover 1 additional clue, or remove 1 doom from a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in play. Haunted - You must either place 1 doom on a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in play, or take 1 direct horror.
54028.text: 维多利亚式宴会厅和酒窖相互连接。 [reaction]在你成功调查酒窖后：额外发现1个线索，或从场上一个[[银暮密社]]敌人上移除1个毁灭标记。 闹鬼 - 你必须在场上一个[[银暮密社]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记，或受到1点直接恐惧。

54029.back_text: 在创建“未知地点”牌库时，将4张新版“未知地点”地点加入原版7张“未知地点”地点。将巫宅遗址地点放在一边，随机将4张“未知地点”地点从游戏中移除。然后，继续按照常规设置创建“未知地点”牌库。
54029.name: 重返隐秘之名
54029.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Secret Name shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
54029.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返隐秘之名找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)
