54034.back_text:
- 检查剧本日志。如果伊琳想要会面，在创建场景牌库时，使用新的场景1a——“追寻答案”替换原版的场景1a，使用两个版本的场景2。在推进到场景2a时，将两张场景卡牌一同放置入场；两张卡牌上的文本均有效。 - 冒险设置期间，随机在两张绞刑者河地点中选择一张使用。将另一个版本从游戏中移除。 - 在随机选择4张异端者敌人放在一边时，将2张新版的异端者敌人洗入原版6张中，从共计8张中选择。
本场冒险期间，加入以下规则： “在结算看守人的攫噬诡计时，幽灵看守人在攻击后不会横置。” 将本卡牌附属到冒险参考卡牌，作为提醒。
54034.name: 重返恶罪报应
54034.real_name: Return to The Wages of Sin
54034.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Wages of Sin shown here. - Set the Erynn MacAoidh story asset aside, out of play. (Continued on reverse side.)
54034.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返恶罪报应找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： - 将伊琳·麦考伊剧情支援放在一边，位于场外。 (继续阅读背面。)

54035.back_flavor: 轻柔的咏唱声指引着你，来到废弃教堂旁边一块阴暗的空地。空地外环绕着一圈独脚金，在微风中轻轻摇曳。在空地中央，一个身披斗篷的女子跪在远离其他坟墓的、没有标识的一处坟墓前。女子唱着一首古老而忧郁的歌曲，你静静地看了她几分钟。这首歌让你想起了一首摇篮曲，却带着一股黑暗的沉重感，有违歌曲的原旨。一曲唱罢，她转身面向你。火红的头发，挂着黑眼圈的双眼，你认出这正是伊琳。“又是你。”她站起身，“你是来寻求答案的吗，就像我一样？”
54035.back_text:
在以下每个地点生成放在一边的1个异端者敌人：绞刑架、异端者的墓地、教堂阁楼、教堂地下室。在场上每个地点增加2[per_investigator]个线索。
将放在一边的伊琳·麦考伊剧情支援放置入场，放到闹鬼农田，不在任何调查员控制之下。
每位调查员将1张放在一边的幽灵迷网支援放置入场，置于自己控制之下。
54035.flavor: 你来到绞刑者山丘，调查遇鬼的报导、树林里的怪事。那位名叫伊琳的女巫让你在这里和她会面……可她究竟有何目的？
54035.name: 追寻答案
54035.real_text: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.
54035.text: 地点不能被翻到[[幽灵]]面。

54036.back_flavor:
“我……我不知道该如何理解这一切，”当你还在消化这些发现时，伊琳说道。灵魂确实因雾中那个存在而苏醒，但它似乎……在引导它们。指挥它们。你问伊琳，究竟什么样的存在能做到这种事。
“她曾是我们的一员，我们中最杰出的。或许也是最危险的。”她叹息道。如今一切都有了答案。你知道只有一个女巫能激起如此的敬畏与恐惧：凯夏·梅森。
“现今安妮特正拼命攫取凯夏曾经持有的禁忌知识。这场仪式……我不确定我们是否该继续下去。恐怕我一直以来都是个傻瓜。”她深邃的目光与你相对，眼神坚定不移。“我和你一起去。也许我们携手合作可以阻止这一切。”
54036.flavor: “我先祖的灵魂无法安息，”伊琳解释道，“但他们掌握的知识至关重要，我不能视而不见。请帮我……向他们请教。”
54036.name: 追寻彼岸
54036.real_text: [reaction] When you would "banish" a ghost: You may instead place it beneath Erynn MacAoidh, Heretic side faceup. [action] If you are at Erynn MacAoidh's location, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Parley. Choose a Heretic beneath her and place it beneath this act. Objective - Help Erynn find answers by placing Heretics beneath this act. If there are 3 beneath this act, advance.
54036.text: [reaction]当你将要“驱除”一个幽灵时：你可以改为将其异端者面朝上放在伊琳·麦考伊底下。 [action]如果你位于伊琳·麦考伊所在地点，花费1[per_investigator]个线索：谈判。选择她底下一张异端者放在本场景底下。 目标 - 通过将异端者放到本场景底下来帮助伊琳寻找答案。如果本场景底下有3张异端者，推进。

54037.flavor: 这条狭窄浅溪发源于绞刑者山顶附近的天然泉水，以安静平和的潺潺声充满周围树林。小溪向南蜿蜒下山，形成阿卡姆住宅区的西界。

linked_card.real_text:
The drowned spirit lunges for you, croaking with the garbled sounds of torment. Sodden weeds are tangled through its hair.
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round: You must either discard an asset you control or flip this card back to its enemy side. [action] If you are at Hangman's Brook and it has no clues on it: Test a skill of your choice (5). If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
At the bottom of the riverbank, you find the spirit's remains. You dig a shallow grave beside the brook and there you lay its body to rest, dry and safe at long last.
Add this card to the victory display.

linked_card.name: Unfinished Business
linked_card.real_text:
The wraith is in a panic, casting its gaze into the dark woods in search of some enigmatic predator. What could something that is dead possibly fear?
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: If The Spectral Watcher is in play, ready it. [action]: Evade. Use only on The Spectral Watcher. Use your lowest skill for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below) (in addition to evading The Spectral Watcher).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
You force the spectral horror back, buying enough time to calm the spirit down. As it dissolves into the night, its gaze never wanders from the watcher's form.
Add this card to the victory display.

Revelation - If Witchweed is drawn... - ...from the standard encounter deck, shuffle it into the spectral encounter deck. - ...from the spectral encounter deck, trigger each haunted ability on your location twice. You may give Witchweed surge to place it in the standard encounter discard pile. Otherwise, place it in the spectral encounter discard pile.
54040.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果调查员抽出了独脚金…… - ……并且是从基础遭遇牌库抽出的，将其洗入幽灵遭遇牌库。 - ……并且是从幽灵遭遇牌库抽出的，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力两次。你可以使独脚金获得涌动，来将其放到基础遭遇弃牌堆，否则，将其放到幽灵遭遇弃牌堆。

54041.real_text:

You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness [[Curse]] or [[Power]] treachery, spend 1 secret and exhaust Erynn MacAoidh: Cancel that card's revelation effect.
54041.text:
使用(3秘密)。
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点[[诅咒]]或[[力量]]诡计时，花费1秘密并横置伊琳·麦考伊：取消该卡牌的显现效果。

- 随机在两张休息室地点中选择一张。与其余起始地点一同放置入场。将另一个版本的休息室从游戏中移除。

54043.back_flavor: 你登上通往大宅二楼的楼梯时，闻到了蜡烛燃烧的气味。安静得连纸张翻页的细小沙沙声也能听见。
54043.flavor: 休息室里温暖舒适，而且居然空无一人。这儿肯定还藏着什么……对吧？
54043.name: 休息室
54043.real_text: Forced - After the Lounge is revealed: Put the set-aside Vault and Library locations into play. [action] Investigators at the Lounge spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Hidden Passageway location into play.
54043.text: 强制 - 在休息室揭示后：将放在一边的机密室和藏书室地点放置入场。 [action]休息室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将放在一边的秘密通道地点放置入场。

54044.back_text: 强制 - 你进入秘密通道时：进行一次[agility](3)检定。如果你失败，[[异教徒]]听见你移动书架的声音；在最近的[[异教徒]]敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。

54044.text: 如果有调查员控制[skull]钥匙，遗物储藏室和秘社地下墓穴相互连接。 强制 - 在遗物储藏室揭示后：将随机1个放在一边的钥匙放在遗物储藏室上。

54047.back_flavor:
在浓雾中搜索近一个小时过后，你终于抵达了秘社的仪式场所，但这儿已经一片混乱。银暮秘社的成员都披着蓝色和银色的长袍，与女巫战作一团。安妮特注意到你，对你的到来震怒不已。“你！你在这儿干什么？”她呼唤女巫集会：“姐妹们！我们绝对不能让他们插手！”
“不，安妮特，”伊琳回应道，她站到你的身边，“这次你做得太过了。我们必须阻止的人是你。”看着对峙的二人，女巫们不知道该跟随谁，只得退让到一旁。
“你必须完成仪式！”卡尔·桑福德从空地另一头命令你，“这是唯一的办法！”
54047.back_text:
揭示灵怪陷阱地点。将位于未访之岛地点的每位调查员移动到灵怪陷阱。
将放在一边的安妮特·梅森生成在灵怪陷阱，带有2[per_investigator]点伤害。
54047.flavor: 你接近了封印仪式的场地。你得点燃火盆才能找到进入的方法。然后只要把看守人引到陷阱，对它施以咒缚。
54047.name: 迷雾彼端(版本五)
54047.real_text: [fast] During a circle action, spend 1 clue: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Objective - If each Unvisited Isle location in play is revealed and the brazier on each of them is lit, advance.
54047.text: [free]在一个阵法行动期间，花费1个线索：本次技能检定难度降低2点。 目标 - 如果场上每个未访之岛地点均已翻开，且每个此类地点的火盆均已点燃，推进场景。

54048.name: 火盆附魔
54048.real_text: Revelation - Put Brazier Enchantment into play next to the agenda deck. Increase the difficulty of each skill test during circle actions on locations by 2. [action]: Circle. Test your lowest skill + your next lowest skill (6). If you succeed, discard Brazier Enchantment. If you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
54048.text: 显现 - 将火盆附魔放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 执行地点上的阵法行动期间，每次技能检定难度提升2点。 [action]：阵法。检定你技能值最低的技能+你技能值次低的技能(6)。如果你检定成功，弃掉火盆附魔。如果你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。

54049.back_text: - 对于以下每个地点，从其三个版本中随机选择一张：法兰西山、河岸城、南区、住宅区、南区教堂、商人区。将所选地点从游戏中移除。使用剩余地点如常进行冒险设置。
54049.name: 重返混沌魔掌
54049.real_name: Return to In the Clutches of Chaos
54049.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to In the Clutches of Chaos shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
54049.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返混沌魔掌找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

54050.back_flavor: 阿卡姆最为富裕，最具历史意义的街区之一，法兰西山有许多废弃的大宅和庄园，个中藏有许多古老的财宝……还有更多的秘密。
54050.name: 法兰西山
54050.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from French Hill to the current act. Then, test [willpower] (X), where X is the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
54050.text: [action]：将法兰西山任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[willpower](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。

54051.back_flavor: 在过去的几个礼拜里，河岸城的仓库和码头都笼罩着一重灰雾，让本就安静的街区变得更加空旷、荒凉。
54051.name: 河岸城
54051.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from Rivertown to the current act. Then, test [intellect] (X), where X is 1 more than the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, either take 1 horror or 1 damage.
54051.text: [action]：将河岸城任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[intellect](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量+1。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。

54052.back_flavor: 要是不知道，你会以为南区是个鬼城。所有的居民都躲在家里，紧锁家门。你能看到的唯一一盏灯火，似乎来自南边的天主教堂。
54052.name: 南区
54052.real_text: [action]: Evade. Use this ability on any enemy in play or in the encounter discard pile. If you fail, that enemy attacks you (even if it is not in play). If you succeed, instead of evading the chosen enemy, move all breaches from Southside to the current act.
54052.text: [action]：躲避。可以对场上或遭遇弃牌堆中的敌人执行本能力。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你(即使其在场外)。如果你检定成功，不躲避选择的敌人，改为将南区的所有裂口移动到当前场景。

54053.back_flavor: 通常这是个治安良好的街区，而今天晚上，住宅区的鹅卵石街道上却呈现出一种截然不同的氛围。薄雾从城镇边界的树林里蔓延开来，越过绞刑者河，沿着大街小巷蠕动。
54053.name: 住宅区
54053.real_text: [action]: Move any number of breaches from Uptown to the current act. Then, test [agility] (X), where X is the number of breaches moved. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
54053.text: [action]：将住宅区任意数量的裂口移动到当前场景。然后，检定[agility](X)，其中X为移动的裂口数量。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。

54054.back_flavor: 这座巨大的罗马式教堂耸立在住宅区，高于其他建筑，阳光会从彩窗照射进来。尽管城里发生了一件件怪事，迈克尔神父还是决定让教堂全天开放，今晚也不例外。
54054.flavor: 许多惊恐的市民坐在教堂的木质长椅上祈祷，互相窃窃私语。
54054.name: 南区教堂
54054.real_text: [action] [action]: Move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
54054.text: [action][action]：将南区教堂的所有裂口移动到当前场景。 [action]：撤退。你趁着夜色隐蔽起来。

54055.back_flavor: 商人区是阿卡姆的商业中心，通常一整天都热热闹闹的。但是今晚，码头工人和水手都不见了，这让你感到不安。远远望去，米斯卡塔尼克河漆黑的水面上笼罩着一重雾，似乎形成了一些不自然的形状。
54055.name: 商人区
54055.real_text: [action]: Move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act. You may spend any number of charges, secrets, supplies, or ammo from any assets you control to move that many additional breaches.
54055.text: [action]：将商人区的1个裂口移动到当前场景。你可以从你控制的支援上花费任意数量的充能、秘密、补给或子弹，移动等量的额外裂口。

54056.back_text: - 在创建场景牌库时，使用本遭遇组新版的场景3替换原版的场景3。将原版的场景3从游戏中移除。 - 在创建宇宙时，加入重返黑色王座遭遇组中3张新的宇宙地点。 - 在游戏开始时，调查员们可以从冒险参考卡牌上移除2个资源标记，使每位调查员开始游戏时都有一个夜魇坐骑剧情支援放置在场。将所有剩余的夜魇坐骑从游戏中移除。
54056.name: 重返黑色王座
54056.real_name: Return to Before the Black Throne
54056.real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Circle Undone Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Before the Black Throne shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
54056.text: 遵循万象无终的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外： - 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返黑色王座找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示： (继续阅读背面。)

54057.back_flavor: 你站在黑色王座前的悬崖，抬头凝视那名叫阿撒托斯的盲目而沉默的怪物。光是看见它，你的视觉就开始模糊，身体不住地颤抖。单调的笛声如今变得洪亮，让你浑身骨骼颤抖，几乎从身体内部使你呕吐出来。鲜血从你的眼睛与耳朵滴落。要是阿撒托斯苏醒，它将吞噬曾经存在的所有世界。
54057.back_text: 检查剧本日志。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局2)：你接受了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有催眠长笛、“遗留记忆”下方列有仪式道具。 - 如果达成下方至少2种情况，你可以前往(→结局3)：你拒绝了自己的命运、“遗留记忆”下方列有残影碎片、“遗留记忆”下方列有一缕鬼灵迷雾。 - 如果“遗留记忆”下方列有怪异咒语和血树雕刻，你可以前往(→结局6)。 - 否则，(→结局4)。
54057.flavor: 你现在已经很接近了。在你周围的虚空之中，你能感觉到历史长河的翻腾扭曲。这是万事万物的中心——混沌其本身的中心——你的目标与你最终的命运就在面前。
54057.name: 必竟之事(版本二)
54057.real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - If the lead investigator is a The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.
54057.text: [action]花费X个线索：抽取“宇宙”顶上的X张卡牌。选择其中一张卡牌，按照其“宇宙 -”指示放置入场，并移动到其上。将其余卡牌洗回“宇宙”。 目标 - 如果调查员队长位于黑色王座，且该地点上没有线索，推进场景。

54058.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
54058.name: 梦魇裂口
54058.real_text: Cosmos - Connect in a direction of your choice, but only onto a spot where an empty space exists. Remove that empty space from the game instead of shuffling it back into its owner's deck. Then, discard each other copy of that card from play and from each investigator's hand.
54058.text: 宇宙 - 与任意方向连接，但只能放在有虚空格子的位置。将该虚空格子的卡牌从游戏中移除，而非洗回其所有者牌库。然后，将场上和每位调查员手中与该卡牌相同的卡牌弃掉。

54059.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
54059.name: 星际深渊
54059.real_text: Cosmos - Connect in the direction nearest to The Black Throne (or any direction if The Black Throne is not in play). While you are at Interstellar Abyss, you cannot spend clues.
54059.text: 宇宙 - 与离黑色王座最近的方向连接。(如果黑色王座不在场上，则与任意方向连接。) 你位于星际深渊时，你不能花费线索。

54060.back_flavor: 群星嘲讽般舞动着，几乎每时每刻都在变换位置，组成象征毁灭的苍白符号。从未见过这个符号也不曾畏惧它的人，可能还会对它感到惊奇；就连以太形成的风呼啸时，也带着来自宇宙之外的缥缈黑暗与孤独。<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
54060.name: 曲折深壑
54060.real_text: Cosmos - Connect to the leftmost revealed location in a direction of your choice. You may choose not to move to Winding Gulf and instead place 1 doom on Azathoth. Haunted - Take 1 damage and 1 horror.
54060.text: 宇宙 - 与最靠左的已揭示地点的任意方向连接。然后，你可以选择不移动到曲折深壑，改为在阿撒托斯上放置1个毁灭标记。 闹鬼 - 受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。

54061.name: 夜魇坐骑
54061.real_text: While you control Nightgaunt Steed, you may enter empty space as if it were a location. Forced - After you enter empty space, Nightgaunt Steed takes 1 direct damage. Forced - If Nightgaunt Steed leaves play, remove it from the game and move to the nearest revealed location.
54061.text: 你控制夜魇坐骑时，你可以进入虚空格子，如同其是一个地点。 强制 - 在你进入虚空格子后：夜魇坐骑受到1点直接伤害。 强制 - 如果夜魇坐骑离场，将其从游戏中移除且你移动到最近的已揭示地点。

54062.name: 闯入者！
54062.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each non-weakness treachery in your threat area. If you fail, take 2 damage or 2 horror.
54062.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。你的威胁区域每有一张非弱点诡计，本次技能检定难度提升1点。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害或2点恐惧。

54063.name: 玷污
54063.real_text: Revelation - Put Despoiled into play in your threat area. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test during your turn: Increase the difficulty of each subsequent test you perform this turn by 1. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Despoiled. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
54063.text: 显现 - 将玷污放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你的回合期间，你技能检定成功后：本回合你后续进行的所有技能检定难度提升1点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉玷污。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。

54064.name: 恶语中伤
54064.real_text: Revelation - Put Maligned into play in your threat area. Increase the cost of each card you play by 1. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Maligned. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
54064.text: 显现 - 将恶语中伤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你打出每张卡牌的费用提升1点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉恶语中伤。如果你所在地点有处于横置状态的[[女巫]]敌人，本次检定自动成功。

54065.name: 迫近之邪
54065.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or put Impending Evils into play next to the agenda deck and it gains surge. If there are 3 copies of Impending Evils next to the agenda deck, discard them and advance the current agenda.
54065.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须受到1点伤害和1点恐惧，或将迫近之邪放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边且获得涌动。 如果密谋牌库旁边有3张迫近之邪，弃掉这3张卡牌，推进当前密谋。

54066.name: 在劫难逃
54066.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 2 damage. If you succeed, put Unavoidable Demise into play next to the agenda deck. While Unavoidable Demise is next to the agenda deck, each other copy of Unavoidable Demise gets +1 difficulty and deals +1 damage if its test is failed.
54066.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](2)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。如果你检定成功，将在劫难逃放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁边。 在劫难逃在密谋牌库旁边时，其余每张在劫难逃技能检定难度提升1点，且如果检定失败，造成+1伤害。

54067.name: 愚人的命运
54067.real_text: Revelation - If there is no other copy of Fate of All Fools in play, put Fate of All Fools into play in your threat area. Otherwise, an investigator with another copy of Fate of All Fools in their threat area draws the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains peril, its effects cannot be canceled, and cards cannot be committed to skill tests while resolving its revelation effect.
54067.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果场上没有其他愚人的命运，将愚人的命运放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。否则，威胁区域有愚人的命运的调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。该卡牌获得险境，其效果不能被取消，且结算其显现效果期间的技能检定不能投入卡牌。

54068.name: 不稳定能量
54068.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you leave attached location: Resolve each haunted ability on it. Forced - At the end of the round: If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Unstable Energies.
54068.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 在你离开附属的地点时：结算该地点的每个闹鬼能力。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：如果附属的地点上没有调查员，弃掉不稳定能量。

54069.name: 来自彼端
54069.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location (if you fail by 3 or more, resolve each of them twice, instead).
54069.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力(如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为每个结算两次)。

54070.name: 堕落恶行
54070.real_text: Revelation - Attach Vice and Villainy to a non-permanent asset you control. Limit 1 per asset. Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Discard attached asset. Forced - When attached asset leaves play: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, attach Vice and Villainy to a different non-permanent asset you control.
54070.text: 显现 - 将堕落恶行附属到你控制的一个非永久支援上。每个支援仅限1张。 强制 - 在遭遇牌库耗尽时：弃掉附属的支援。 强制 - 在附属的支援离场时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，将堕落恶行附属到你控制的一个不同的非永久支援上。

54071.name: 不洁之地
54071.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If a [[Curse]] treachery is discarded by this effect, deal 1 direct horror to your investigator and to each of your [[Ally]] assets.
54071.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](5)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。如果本效果弃掉了[[诅咒]]诡计，对你的调查员和你的每个[[盟友]]支援造成1点直接恐惧。

54072.name: 超自然风暴
54072.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). If you fail, choose and discard cards from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the amount you failed by.
54072.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，从你的场上和/或手中选择并弃掉印刷资源费用总计至少为X的牌，其中X为你失败且低于难度的点数。

54073.name: 彼端迷雾
54073.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Attached location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no clues on attached location: Move Mists from Beyond once toward the nearest location with 1 or more clues.
54073.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 所附属地点的隐藏值+1。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果附属的地点上没有线索：将彼端迷雾向最近的有1个或更多线索的地点移动一次。

54074.name: 尖啸女妖
54074.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When you deal 1 or more damage to Screeching Banshee (except from a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]]): Resolve each haunted ability at its location.
54074.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在你对尖啸女妖造成1点或更多伤害(除[[法术]]或[[遗物]]以外的)时：结算你所在地点的每个闹鬼能力。
54074.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 幽灵

54075.name: 嗜血魂灵
54075.real_text: Revelation - Put Bloodthirsty Spirits into play in your threat area. While your location is haunted, as an additional cost for you to commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, you must resolve each haunted ability on your location. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Bloodthirsty Spirits.

60166.name: 盯梢

60166.text: 调查([intellect])。你本次调查得到+2[intellect]。如果你检定成功，治愈1点恐惧。

60167.name: 适者生存

The performing investigator ignores the alert and retaliate keywords during this test.

只能投入到攻击或躲避期间的技能检定。
执行检定的调查员本次检定期间忽略警戒和反击关键词。

60168.name: 武装到牙齿

60168.text: 投入到你控制的[[道具]]支援上的技能检定时，[武装到牙齿]获得[wild][wild]。

60169.flavor: 打碎了手上的家伙，打倒了眼前的……大家伙？

60169.text: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成伤害+1。

60170.name: 警犬

60170.text: [free]你所在地点的攻击或调查期间，横置[警犬]：执行检定的调查员本次检定得到技能值+2。
60170.traits: 盟友. 生物. 警察.

60171.name: M1911手枪
60171.real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.
60171.text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]并且造成伤害+1。本次攻击忽略反击关键词。

60172.name: 加长枪管
60172.real_text:

Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
You get +1 skill value while attacking with attached asset.
60172.text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的[[枪械]]支援。
你用所附属的支援攻击时得到技能值+1。

60173.flavor: “警察要干的不只是抓人，而是成为社区的保护者。”

Fast. Play when your turn begins.
Until the end of your turn, you get +3 skill value while investigating or parleying.
60173.text:
快速。在你的回合开始时打出。
直到你的回合结束，你调查或谈判时得到技能值+3。

60174.name: 身强体健
60174.text: 移动。本次移动后，治愈3点伤害。

60175.flavor: 子弹多到不知道怎么用。

60176.flavor: 打碎了手上的家伙，打倒了眼前的……大家伙？

60176.text: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成伤害+1。（如果检定成功且超过难度至少2点，则改为造成伤害+2）。

60177.name: 警探谢尔曼

You get +1 [combat].
Detective Sherman may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] After damage is placed on Detective Sherman, exhaust him: Discover 1 clue at your location.
60177.text:
你得到+1[combat]。
你所在地点其他调查员受到的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给[警探谢尔曼]。
[reaction]伤害放置到[警探谢尔曼]后，将他横置：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
60177.traits: 盟友. 侦探. 警察.

60178.name: 耐性
60178.real_text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this is an attack or evasion). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an attack or evasion).
60178.text: 起始。（你每场游戏开始的起始手牌可以加入1张“起始”关键词的卡牌） [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat](如果是攻击或躲避，改为+2[combat])。 [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility](如果是攻击或躲避，改为+2[agility])。

60179.name: 盯梢

60179.text: 调查([intellect])。你本次调查得到+3[intellect]。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索并治愈2点恐惧。

60180.name: 坚韧不屈
60180.real_text: If an enemy has attacked an investigator at this location this round, Indomitable gains [wild] [wild] [wild].
60180.text: 如果本轮本地点有敌人攻击了调查员，[坚韧不屈]获得[wild][wild][wild]。

60181.name: 防护背心
60181.real_text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which may only be used to hold a [[Firearm]] asset.
[reaction] After you play Protective Vest: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Firearm]] or [[Upgrade]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
60181.text:
你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[枪械]]支援。

60182.name: 汤姆逊冲锋枪
60182.real_text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you resolve the above [action] ability, spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). This attack deals +1 damage.
60182.text: 使用(6子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]并且造成伤害+1。 [reaction]你结算上述[action]能力后，花费1子弹：攻击([combat])。本次攻击造成伤害+1。
60182.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械.

60201.back_flavor: 沃尔特斯教授起初痴迷于古老隐秘之物，但多年后发现，自己积累的古语言、亵渎遗物与奇异仪式知识，对应对现代危险至关重要。他既是史前遗物的热忱收藏家，也是研究那些崇拜亿万年前噩梦神明的原初宗教的知识泉源。活着且未陷入疯狂的人中，或许无人比哈维更了解秘术。超自然事件发生时，沃尔特斯教授便运用丰富资源与经验担起责任。
60201.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：知识宝库、三重诅咒的好奇心、1张随机基础弱点。
60201.name: 哈维·沃尔特斯
60201.real_text:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location draws 1 or more cards from their deck during the investigation phase: That investigator draws 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card.
60201.text:
[reaction]调查阶段期间，你所在地点的一位调查员从其牌库抽取1张或更多卡牌后：该调查员抽取1张卡牌。(每轮限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。抽取1张卡牌。

60202.name: 知识宝库
60202.real_text:
Harvey Walters deck only.
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate, exhaust Vault of Knowledge and choose an investigator at your location: That investigator draws 1 card.
60202.text:
哈维·沃尔特斯牌库专用。
你的手牌上限增加2张。
[reaction]你调查成功后，横置知识宝库并选择你所在地点的一位调查员：该调查员抽取1张卡牌。

60203.flavor:
"……我只希望我的描述能让那些完全信任我的人保持理智和谨慎，而不是勾起他们的好奇心。"
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《疯狂山脉》</cite>
60203.name: 三重诅咒的好奇心
60203.real_text: Revelation - For every 3 cards in your hand: Take 1 damage.
60203.text: 显现 - 你手牌中每有3张卡牌：受到1点伤害。

60204.name: 过分痴迷
60204.real_text: Revelation - Put Obsessive into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Discard 1 non-weakness card at random from your hand. [action] [action]: Discard Obsessive.
60204.text: 显现 - 将过分痴迷放置入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你的回合开始时：随机弃掉手牌中的一张非弱点卡牌。 [action][action]：弃掉过分痴迷。

60205.flavor: 经由增强的大脑能完整记忆整册书籍。
60205.name: 秘术启迪

Your maximum hand size is increased by 1.
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tome]] asset.
60205.text:
你的手牌上限增加1张。
你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只能用来放置一张[[书籍]]支援。

60206.name: 昴宿星团残章
60206.real_text:
While you have...
- ...5 or more cards in hand, you get +1 [intellect].

- ...15 or more cards in hand, you get +1 [intellect].

你有……
- ……至少5张手牌时，得到+1[intellect]。
- ……至少10张手牌时，得到+1[willpower]。
- ……至少15张手牌时，得到+1[intellect]。

60207.flavor: 他们害怕护符会对他们做什么，还是害怕它会对你做什么？
60207.name: 伊察姆纳圆盘
60207.real_text: [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Automatically evade that enemy or deal it 2 damage.
60207.text: [reaction]一名非[[精英]]敌人在你所在地点生成时，弃掉伊察姆纳圆盘：自动躲避该敌人，或对其造成2点伤害。

60208.name: 百科全书
60208.real_text:
Uses (5 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Encyclopedia and spend 1 secret: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.
60208.text:
使用(5秘密)。
[action]横置百科全书并花费1秘密：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员直到本阶段结束前，得到你指定的一项技能+2。

60209.name: 养神术
60209.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Feed the Mind and spend 1 secret: Test [intellect] (1). For each point you succeed by (to a maximum of 3), draw 1 card.
60209.text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置养神术并花费1秘密：进行一次[intellect](1)检定。你每成功超过难度1点(最多3点)，抽取1张卡牌。

60210.name: 禁忌之书
60210.real_text:
Uses (5 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Forbidden Tome and spend 1 secret: Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand and there are no secrets on Forbidden Tome, you may discard it to record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the tome."
60210.text:
使用(5秘密)。
[action]横置禁忌之书并花费1秘密：抽取1张卡牌。然后，如果你有至少10张手牌，且禁忌之书上没有秘密，你可以弃掉它，并在冒险日志记录"你翻译了这本书。"
60210.traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍

60211.name: 高等教育

While you have 5 or more cards in your hand, Higher Education gains:
"[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test."
60211.text:
只要你有至少5张手牌，高等教育获得：
"[fast]花费1资源：本次技能检定你得到+1[willpower]。
[fast]花费1资源：本次技能检定你得到+1[intellect]。"

60212.flavor: 他们只是为了多拿点学分

Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.

你的手牌上限增加2张。
[reaction]你打出[实验室助理]后：抽取2张卡牌。
60212.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克. 科学.

60213.name: 惠顿·格林
60213.real_text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
60213.text:
只要你控制一张[[书籍]]或[[遗物]]支援，你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你翻开一张地点卡或将一个新地点放置入场后，横置惠顿·格林：从你牌库顶6张卡牌中查找一张[[书籍]]或[[遗物]]支援，抽取它。混洗你的牌库。
60213.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克

60214.name: 燃烧午夜油
60214.real_text: Investigate. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.
60214.text: 调查。本行动开始时，获得2资源。

60215.flavor:
"……相比之下，还有少量书籍是以我无法理解的语言写成的。"
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《伦道夫·卡特的供述》</cite>
60215.name: 神秘文字
60215.real_text:
Gain 2 resources.
[reaction] After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.
60215.text:
获得2资源。
[reaction]你在自己的回合抽到神秘文字后：将其打出。

60216.flavor:
"这儿也没发现。我们还差多少没查？"
"……瞧瞧你背后这面墙？"
60216.name: 广泛研究
60216.real_text:
Reduce the cost to play Extensive Research by 1 for each other card in your hand.
Discover 2 clues at your location.
60216.text:
你手牌中每有1张其它卡牌，广泛研究的打出费用减少1点。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。

60217.name: 秘术祈求
60217.real_text: As an additional cost to play Occult Invocation, discard up to 2 cards from your hand. Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [intellect] and deal +1 damage for this attack for each card discarded as part of this card's cost.
60217.text: 作为打出秘术祈求的额外费用，弃掉你手牌中至多2张卡牌。 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[intellect]。你为支付本卡牌费用每弃掉1张手牌，本次攻击便得到+1[intellect]并造成+1伤害。

60218.name: 荒唐的素描像
60218.real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.
60218.text:
你的地点有线索才能打出。
抽取3张卡牌。

60219.flavor: 更大的秘密中一点小小碎片。
60219.name: 推理

60219.text: 如果调查一个地点时本次技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。

60220.name: 图书馆讲解员
60220.real_text: [reaction] After Library Docent enters play, return a [[Tome]] asset you control to its owner's hand: Play a different [[Tome]] asset (by title) from your hand, reducing its cost by 2.
60220.text: [reaction]图书馆讲解员入场后，将一张你控制的[[书籍]]支援返回其所有者的手牌：打出你手牌中的另一张名称不同的[[书籍]]支援，其资源费用减少2。
60220.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克

60221.flavor: 无知是福，但你无福消受。
60221.name: 窥看不思议之事
60221.real_text: Draw 1 card. Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Then, draw that many cards.
60221.text: 抽取1张卡牌。将你手牌中任意数量的非弱点卡牌混洗入你的牌库。然后，抽取等量卡牌。

60222.name: 绝密地图集
60222.real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Choose a revealed location up to 3 connections away from your location. Move to that location.
60222.text:
使用(4秘密)。
[action]花费1秘密：选择一个与你所在地点之间至多有3次连接的已揭示地点。移动到该地点。

60223.name: 惠顿·格林
60223.real_text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
60223.text:
只要你控制一张[[书籍]]或[[遗物]]支援，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你翻开一张地点卡或将一个新地点放置入场后，横置惠顿·格林：从你牌库顶9张卡牌中查找一张[[书籍]]或[[遗物]]支援，抽取它。混洗你的牌库。
60223.traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克

60224.flavor:
"……相比之下，还有少量书籍是以我无法理解的语言写成的。"
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《伦道夫·卡特的供述》</cite>
60224.name: 神秘文字
60224.real_text:
Gain 3 resources (4 resources instead if you have 10 or more other cards in hand).
[reaction] After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.
60224.text:
获得3资源(如果你手牌中有至少10张其它卡牌，改为获得4资源)。
[reaction]你在自己的回合抽到神秘文字后：将其打出。

60225.flavor: "这应该是我听过最烂的计划了。好吧，那么还等什么？快动手吧！"
60225.name: "我有个计划！"
60225.real_text: Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [intellect] for this test. You deal +1 damage for this attack for each clue you have (max +3 damage).
60225.text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[intellect]。本次检定你得到+2[intellect]。你每有1个线索，本次攻击造成+1伤害(最多+3伤害)。

60226.name: 心胜于物

Fast. Play during your turn.
Until the end of the round, add your [intellect] to your [combat] and [agility]. Draw 1 card.
60226.text:
快速。只能在你的回合打出。
直到本轮结束，将你的[intellect]分别加到你的[combat]和[agility]上。抽取1张卡牌。

60227.flavor: 有些人会不惜一切代价来找到真相。但是有些真相却能伤人。

60227.text: 调查。如果你成功，不发现你所在地点的1个线索，改为从你所在地点和连接地点发现总计2个线索。(FAQ, v1.9)

60228.name: 洞察力
60228.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
60228.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌(如果成功超过难度至少2点，改为抽取2张卡牌)。

60229.name: 禁忌之书
60229.real_text:

60251.back_flavor: 卡洛琳·弗恩多年来一直倾听病人描绘梦境，其中有一些栩栩如生，就像真实的记忆。但她没想到自己有朝一日也会有这种体验。梦境中有地表之下的黑暗洞窟，阴影中爬行的古怪生物，还有千丝万缕闪闪发亮的蛛网。是意识在让她回想起过去见证的往昔吗？还是她去过的地方？或者，是在警告她有危险的、异界的，甚至灾祸的事情就要降临？

60301.back_flavor: 温妮弗雷德——父母叫她温特尔，朋友们叫她温妮——在寄宿学校里是最聪明的孩子之一。但是，她做事不顾后果，不把权威放在眼里，常因此陷入麻烦。一天，她在一个农夫的车库里发现一架陈旧的双翼飞机，决定"开上天兜一圈。"她的人生从此彻底改变。飞机主人曾是一战飞行员，被温妮的天赋折服，主动提出将自己所有技艺传授给她。如今，温妮在全国巡回表演，展示自己的技术，大家都知道她是个"无所畏惧的女人"。但她的无畏在一场表演中受到挑战：她发现一种自己差点无法描述的生物，有皮质的翅膀和一只鼓着脓疱的眼睛。

60303.text:
你进行的每次可以投入嚣张的技能检定，必须投入嚣张。
本技能的图标不增加你的技能值，改为从中减去。
如果本次技能检定成功，将本技能返回手牌。

60304.name: 不顾后果
60304.real_text: Commit only to a skill test you are performing (of any type) that has no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test. If this test fails, return this skill to your hand. Forced - If Reckless is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and lose 2 resources.
60304.text: 只能投入你进行的、未投入其它卡牌的任意类型技能检定。其它卡牌不能投入本次技能检定。 如果本次检定失败，将本技能返回手牌。 强制 - 你的回合结束时，如果不顾后果在你手牌中：展示它并失去2资源。

60305.name: 撬锁工具
60305.real_text: [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, discard Lockpicks.
60305.text: [action]横置撬锁工具：调查。本次调查中，将你的[agility]加到你的技能值上。如果你未成功超过难度至少2点，弃掉撬锁工具。
60305.traits: 道具. 工具. 违法

60306.name: 毛瑟C96手枪
60306.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Exhaust Mauser C96 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Mauser C96 or gain 1 resource.
60306.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]横置毛瑟C96手枪并花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你成功超过难度至少2点，你可以重整毛瑟C96手枪，或获得1资源。
60306.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

60307.name: 弹簧刀
60307.real_text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
60307.text: 快速。 [action]：攻击。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
60307.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 违法

60308.flavor: “其实没那么幸运，就只是想抽根烟。”
60308.name: 幸运烟盒
60308.real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.
60308.text: [reaction]你在一次技能检定中成功且超过难度2点或更多后，横置幸运烟盒：抽取1张卡牌。

60309.name: 朗尼·里特纳
60309.real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Exhaust Lonnie Ritter and spend 1 resource: Choose an [[Item]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Heal 1 damage from that asset and 1 horror from Lonnie Ritter.
60309.text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[fast]横置朗尼·里特纳并花费1资源：选择你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张[[道具]]支援。治愈该支援的1点伤害和朗尼·里特纳的1点恐惧。

60310.flavor:
"你是不是觉得自己穿上这衣服看起来酷毙了？"
"不呀。我一直觉得自己酷毙了。这身衣服只是让别人也知道这一点。"
60310.name: 皮夹克

60311.name: 街头浪子
60311.real_text:
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +2 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +2 [agility] for this skill test.
60311.text:
[fast]花费2资源：本次技能检定你得到+2[intellect]。
[fast]花费2资源：本次技能检定你得到+2[agility]。

60312.flavor: “瞄准眼晴。”他们这么告诉我的。
60312.name: 暗中偷袭
60312.real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
60312.text: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，自动躲避被攻击敌人。

60313.flavor:
“麦克格林，你想让我们两个都送命吗？”
“这次不会了，伙计。这次不会了。”
60313.name: 艺高胆大
60313.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +2 skill value for this test.
60313.text:
快速。在你技能检定将要成功时打出。
你本次检定得到+2技能值。

60314.name: 悄然遁去
60314.real_text: Evade. Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 2 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
60314.text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[intellect]加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，且被躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，其在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。

60315.name: 小偷小摸
60315.real_text: Investigate. This investigation uses [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at your location.
60315.text: 调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]。如果你成功，额外发现你所在地点的2个线索。

60316.flavor: 别人都劝你别做的事情，温妮弗雷德会示意你按计划执行。
60316.name: 悄然溜过
60316.real_text: Evade. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.
60316.text: 躲避。本行动开始时，获得2资源。

60317.name: 身手矫捷
60317.real_text: For each point this skill test succeeds by, after it resolves, you may immediately move to a connecting location (to a maximum of 3 times).
60317.text: 本次技能检定每成功超过难度1点，结算后你便可以立即移动到一个连接地点(最多移动3次)。

60318.flavor:
"你是个疯子，温妮！"
"我知道！这难道不是件好事吗？"
60318.name: 虎口拔牙
60318.real_text: After you commit Daredevil to a skill test, discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a [rogue] skill you can commit to this test. Commit it. Shuffle each weakness that was discarded by this effect back into your deck.
60318.text: 你将虎口拔牙投入一次技能检定后，从你牌库顶弃掉卡牌，直到弃掉一张可以投入本次检定的[rogue]技能。将其投入本次检定。将以此效果弃掉的所有弱点混洗回你的牌库。

60319.name: 机会主义者
60319.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.
60319.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。

60320.name: 酒胆
60320.real_text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests [willpower] (2). If the test succeeds, they draw 1 card. If the test fails, they heal 1 additional horror and discard 1 card at random from their hand.
60320.text:
使用(4补给)。
[action]花费1补给：选择你所在地点的一位调查员，治愈1点恐惧。然后，该调查员进行一次[willpower](2)检定。如果检定成功，该调查员抽取1张卡牌。如果检定失败，该调查员额外治愈1点恐惧，并随机弃掉其手牌中的一张卡牌。

60321.name: 毛瑟C96手枪
60321.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Exhaust Mauser C96 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Mauser C96 or gain 1 resource (if you succeed by 4 or more, do both).
60321.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]横置毛瑟C96手枪并花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你成功超过难度至少2点，执行以下一项：重整毛瑟C96手枪，或获得1资源(如果你成功超过难度至少4点，改为执行两项)。
60321.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

60322.flavor:
"麦克格伦，你想让我们两个都送命吗？"
"这次不会了，伙计。这次不会了。"
60322.name: 艺高胆大
60322.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +3 skill value for this test. Draw 1 card.
60322.text:
快速。你的技能检定将要成功时打出。
本次技能检定你的技能值+3。抽取1张卡牌。

60323.flavor: "瞄准眼睛。"他们这么告诉我的。
60323.name: 暗中偷袭
60323.real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Cheap Shot to your hand at the end of your turn.
60323.text: 攻击。本次攻击中，将你的[agility]加到你的技能值上。如果你成功超过难度至少1点，自动躲避受到本次攻击的敌人。如果你成功超过难度至少3点，你的回合结束时将暗中偷袭返回手牌。

60324.name: 悄然遁去
60324.real_text: Evade. Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 1 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Slip Away to your hand at the end of your turn.
60324.text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试中，将你的[intellect]加到你的技能值上。如果你成功超过难度至少1点，且被躲避的敌人不是[[精英]]，该敌人在下一个补给阶段不重整。如果你成功超过难度至少3点，你的回合结束时将悄然遁去返回手牌。

60325.name: 心灵手巧
60325.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
60325.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌(如果成功超过难度至少2点，改为抽取2张卡牌)。

60326.name: 幸运烟盒
60326.real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you succeeded by.
60326.text: [reaction]你技能检定成功超过难度至少1点后，横置幸运烟盒：从你牌库顶X张卡牌中查找一张卡牌，抽取它，并将其余卡牌混洗入你的牌库。其中X为你成功超过难度的点数。

60327.name: 神射手
60327.real_text:
[reaction] When you use a fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset, exhaust Sharpshooter: Choose one, or both - 
- This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. All modifiers to your [combat] for this attack modify your [agility] instead.
- Use the attacked enemy's evade value for this attack, instead of their fight value.
60327.text:
[reaction]你使用一张[[枪械]]支援的攻击能力时，横置神射手：选择以下一项或两项：
- 本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击中对你的[combat]的所有修正，改为修正你的[agility]。
- 本次攻击不使用被攻击敌人的攻击值，改为使用其躲避值。

60328.name: 小偷小摸
60328.real_text: Investigate. This investigation uses [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, return Pilfer to your hand at the end of your turn.
60328.text: 调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]。如果你成功，额外发现你所在地点的2个线索。如果你成功超过难度至少2点，你的回合结束时将小偷小摸返回手牌。

60329.name: 背刺
60329.real_text: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. This attack deals +2 damage. If you succeed by 2 or more, return Backstab to your hand at the end of your turn.
60329.text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击造成+2伤害。如果你成功超过难度至少2点，你的回合结束时将背刺返回手牌。

60330.name: 学人精
60330.real_text: After you commit Copycat to a skill test, search the discard pile of another investigator for a skill you can commit to this test, and commit it. After this test ends, place that card on the bottom of its owner's deck.
60330.text: 你将学人精投入一次技能检定后，在另一位调查员的弃牌堆中查找一张可以投入本次检定的技能，并将其投入。本次检定结束后，将该卡放到其所有者牌库底。

60331.name: 贝雷塔M1918冲锋枪
60331.real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Exhaust Beretta M1918 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +4 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Beretta M1918, or this attack deals an additional +1 damage (if you succeed by 4 or more, do both).
60331.text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]横置贝雷塔M1918冲锋枪并花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+4[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你成功超过难度至少2点，执行以下一项：重整贝雷塔M1918冲锋枪，或本次攻击额外造成+1伤害(如果你成功超过难度至少4点，改为执行两项)。
60331.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

60332.name: 查克·费格斯
60332.real_text:
[reaction] When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose two -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.
60332.text:
[reaction]你打出一张[[策略]]或[[技巧]]事件时，横置查克·费格斯：选择以下两项：
- 该事件获得快速。
- 该事件的打出费用减少2资源。
- 你在结算该事件期间进行技能检定时，技能值+2。

60351.back_flavor: 安德烈13岁的时候，父母讨到了足够的钱给他买一张区巴黎中心剧院的电影票。这种艺术形式折服了安德烈，他很快醉心于银幕，不知疲倦地工作，就为实现自己的好莱坞梦。就在好莱坞拍摄《宇宙之旅》的时候，安德烈经历了无法解释、天翻地覆的事情。现实和幻想的界限已在他脑海中模糊。这时候同行朋友贝琪·巴克斯特建议他换换环境。在贝琪的推荐下，安德烈收拾行装，搬到了马萨诸塞州的小镇阿卡姆。他太需要休息了。
60351.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[退场娴熟]、[台词娴熟]、[情景娴熟]、[举世之重]、1张随机基础弱点。
60351.name: 安德烈·帕特尔
60351.real_text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more during your turn: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Gain 1 resource.
60351.text:
[reaction]你在自己回合期间技能检定成功且超过难度至少2点后：你本回合可以进行额外一个行动。（每轮仅限一次）
[elder_sign]效果：+2。获得1资源。

60352.name: 退场娴熟
60352.real_text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to an attack or an evasion, it gains [wild] [wild].
60352.text:
安德烈·帕特尔牌库专用。
本卡牌投入到攻击或躲避时，其获得[wild][wild]。

60353.name: 台词娴熟
60353.real_text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to a skill test on a scenario card, it gains [wild] [wild].
60353.text:
安德烈·帕特尔牌库专用。
本卡牌投入到冒险卡牌上的技能检定时，其获得[wild][wild]。

60354.name: 情景娴熟
60354.real_text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to an investigation or parley, it gains [wild] [wild].
60354.text:
安德烈·帕特尔牌库专用。
本卡牌投入到调查或谈判时，其获得[wild][wild]。

60355.flavor: 所有的眼睛都盯着你呢。
60355.name: 举世之重
60355.real_text: Revelation - Put Weight of the World into play in your threat area. Forced - When you fail a skill test while Weight of the World is in play, take 1 horror and shuffle it back into your deck.
60355.text: 显现-将[举世之重]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制-[举世之重]在场上时，在你的技能检定失败时，受到1点恐惧并将[举世之重]混洗回你的牌库。

60356.name: 浑然不觉
60356.real_text: Revelation - Put Unaware into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you fail a skill test during your turn: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, discard Unaware.
60356.text: 显现-将[浑然不觉]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制-你在你的回合期间第一次技能检定失败：抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。如果该卡是敌人，弃掉[浑然不觉]。

60357.name: 舞台中央
60357.real_text: Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 renown). If there is no renown on Center Stage, discard it. [fast] During a skill test, spend 1 renown and exhaust Center Stage: You get +1 skill value for each action you have spent this round (including this one, if this is triggered during one of your actions).
60357.text: 每位调查员仅限1张。使用(3名望)。如果[舞台中央]上没有名望，将其弃掉。 [free]技能检定期间，花费1名望并横置[舞台中央]：你本轮每花费过一个行动，你得到技能值+1（如果本能力在你的行动期间触发，也包括本行动）。

60358.name: 声名
60358.real_text: Uses (4 renown). If there is no renown on Fame, discard it. [action] If there is an enemy at your location, spend 1 renown: Parley. Gain 2 resources.
60358.text: 使用(4名望)。如果[声名]上没有名望，将其弃掉。 [action]如果你所在地点有敌人，花费1名望：谈判。获得2资源。

60359.name: 小道消息
60359.real_text: Uses (3 rumors). If there are no rumors on The Grapevine, discard it. [action] Spend 1 rumor and exhaust The Grapevine: Parley. Choose an enemy at a revealed location up to 2 connections away. Move (one location at a time) along the shortest path to that enemy's location and engage it.
60359.text: 使用(3流言)。如果[小道消息]上没有流言，将其弃掉。 [action]花费1流言并横置[小道消息]：谈判。选择一个位于已揭示地点，且其所在地点与你的连接次数不超过2的敌人。沿最短路径移动到该敌人所在地点（每次一个地点），并与该敌人交战。

60360.name: 奢华戒指
60360.real_text:
Uses (3 renown).
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test, spend 1 renown and exhaust Extravagant Ring: You get +2 skill value for this test.
60360.text:
使用(3名望)。
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时：花费1名望并横置[奢华戒指]：你本次检定得到技能值+2。

60361.name: 撬锁工具
60361.real_text: [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, discard Lockpicks.
60361.text: [action]横置[撬锁工具]：调查([intellect])。本次检定将你的[agility]加入你的[intellect]。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少2点，弃掉[撬锁工具]。
60361.traits: 道具. 工具. 违法.

60362.flavor: “我确信全城都会知道你的成就。”
60362.name: 马库斯·森斯塔克
60362.real_text: You gain 1 additional resource during the upkeep phase. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Deal 1 horror to Marcus Sengstacke.
60362.text: 补给阶段期间你获得额外1资源。 强制-你技能检定失败后：对[马库斯·森斯塔克]造成1点恐惧。

60363.name: 锃亮的手杖
60363.real_text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). Add your [agility] to your [combat] for this attack. If this attack succeeds by 2 or more against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, you may exhaust Polished Cane to automatically evade that enemy.
60363.text: [action]：攻击([combat])。本次攻击将你的[agility]加入你的[combat]。如果本次攻击对一个非[[精英]]敌人检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以横置[锃亮的手杖]以自动躲避该敌人。
60363.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战.

60364.name: 一扫而空
60364.real_text: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you discover the last clue at your location, you may move to a connecting location.
60364.text: 调查([intellect])。你本次调查得到+2[intellect]。如果你发现了所在地点的最后一个线索，你可以移动到一个连接地点。

60365.name: 有账必付
60365.real_text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with X remaining health. That enemy disengages from each investigator and gains aloof until the end of the round. Discover 1 clue at your location.
60365.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个剩余生命值为X的非[[精英]]敌人。该敌人与每位调查员解除交战，且获得冷漠，直到本轮结束。发现你所在地点的1个线索。

60366.name: 速速离去
60366.real_text: Evade ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] for this evasion. If you succeed by 2 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
60366.text: 躲避([agility])。你本次躲避得到+2[agility]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，且被躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，该敌人在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。

60367.name: 突然坠落
60367.real_text: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage.
60367.text: 攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果对象敌人处于横置状态，本次攻击造成伤害+1。

60368.name: 灯下黑
60368.real_text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location (if you succeeded by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location, instead).
60368.text:
快速。你成功躲避敌人后打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索（如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以改为发现连接地点的1个线索）。

60369.name: 殷实无忧
60369.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. Max 1 committed per skill test.
Easy Street gains [wild] for every 3 resources you have (to a maximum of [wild] [wild] [wild]).
60369.text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你每有3资源，[殷实无忧]获得[wild]（最多[wild][wild][wild]）。

60370.name: 扫地出门
60370.real_text: After Out the Door is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator gains 2 resources. If this skill test fails, that investigator loses 2 resources.
60370.text: [扫地出门]投入到技能检定后，执行检定的调查员获得2资源，如果本次技能检定失败，该调查员失去2资源。

60371.name: “吃我一招”
60371.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
60371.text: 只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。作为投入[“吃我一招”]的额外费用，花费最多3资源。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，获得两倍数量的该资源。

60372.name: 撬锁工具
60372.real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.
60372.text: 使用(3补给)。如果[撬锁工具]上没有补给，将其弃掉。 [action]横置[撬锁工具]：调查([intellect])。本次检定将你的[agility]加入你的[intellect]。如果你检定失败，或成功但没有超过难度至少2点，从[撬锁工具]移除1补给。
60372.traits: 道具. 工具. 违法.

60373.name: 扫地出门
60373.real_text: After Out the Door is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator gains 4 resources. If this skill test fails, that investigator loses 4 resources.
60373.text: [扫地出门]投入到技能检定后，执行检定的调查员获得4资源，如果本次技能检定失败，该调查员失去4资源。

60374.name: 小道消息
60374.real_text: Uses (3 rumors). If there are no rumors on The Grapevine, discard it. [action] Spend 1 rumor and exhaust The Grapevine: Parley. Choose an enemy at a revealed location up to 3 connections away. Move (one location at a time) along the shortest path to that enemy's location and engage it. Draw 1 card.
60374.text: 使用(3流言)。如果[小道消息]上没有流言，将其弃掉。 [action]花费1流言并横置[小道消息]：谈判。选择一个位于已揭示地点，且其所在地点与你的连接次数不超过3的敌人。沿最短路径移动到该敌人所在地点（每次一个地点），并与该敌人交战。抽取1张卡牌。

60375.flavor: “我确信全城都会知道你的成就。”
60375.name: 马库斯·森斯塔克
60375.real_text: You gain 1 additional resource during the upkeep phase. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Deal 1 horror to Marcus Sengstacke.
60375.text: 补给阶段期间你获得额外1资源。 强制-你技能检定失败后：对[马库斯·森斯塔克]造成1点恐惧。

60376.name: 一扫而空
60376.real_text: Investigate ([agility]). Add your [intellect] to your [agility] for this test. After this test resolves, you may move to a connecting location.
60376.text: 调查([agility])。本次检定将你的[intellect]加入你的[agility]。本次检定结算后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。

60377.name: 速速离去
60377.real_text: Evade ([agility]). Add your [willpower] to your [agility] for this test. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
60377.text: 躲避([agility])。本次检定将你的[willpower]加入你的[agility]。如果你检定成功且被躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，该敌人在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。

60378.name: 突然坠落
60378.real_text: Fight ([agility]). Add your [combat] to your [agility] for this test. If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +2 damage.
60378.text: 攻击([agility])。本次攻击将你的[combat]加入你的[agility]。如果对象敌人处于横置状态，本次攻击造成伤害+2。

60379.name: 黑色扇子
60379.real_text:
Exceptional.
While you have...
- ...10+ resources, you get +1 health and +1 sanity.
- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.
- ...20+ resources, you get +1 to each of your skills.
60379.text:
卓越。
你有……
-……10+资源时，你得到生命值+1和神智值+1。
-……15+资源时，你在自己回合期间可以进行额外一个行动。
-……20+资源时，你得到每项技能值+1。

60380.name: 三寸之舌
60380.real_text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an evasion or parley). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an evasion or parley).
60380.text: 起始。（你每场游戏开始的起始手牌可以加入1张“起始”关键词的卡牌） [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect](如果是躲避或谈判，改为+2[intellect])。 [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility](如果是躲避或谈判，改为+2[agility])。

60381.name: 良好人脉
60381.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)
60381.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置[良好人脉]：你每有4资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
[free]花费2资源：重整[良好人脉]。（每轮仅限一次）

60382.name: 灯下黑
60382.real_text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location (if you succeeded by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location, as well).
60382.text:
快速。你成功躲避敌人后打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索（如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以一并发现连接地点的1个线索）。

60383.name: 以防万一
60383.real_text: While Contingency is committed to a skill test targeting an enemy, after revealing chaos tokens, you may spend 3 resources to cancel a revealed token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)
60383.text: [以防万一]投入到以敌人为对象的技能检定时，揭示混乱标记后，你可以花费3资源以取消一个已揭示的标记，将其放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新标记。（你可以执行任意次数。）

60384.name: 红色闹钟
60384.real_text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: You may take all charges here, as resources. Place 1 charge here. If it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +4 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 3 times. - 3 charges, you may take 2 additional actions this turn.
60384.text: 卓越。使用(0充能)。 强制-你的回合开始后：你可以拿取此处所有充能，作为资源。在此放置1充能。如果它正好拥有…… -……1充能，你下次技能检定得到技能值+4。 -……2充能，你可以移动最多3次。 -……3充能，本回合你可以进行2个额外行动。

60401.back_flavor: 鲜血。火焰。毁灭。每个夜晚，杰奎琳的梦中总会出现尚未发生的事。起初，她认为这些梦是一种可怕的诅咒。但是，当她开始控制自己的灵视、仔细观察梦中事件时，她明白了这不是诅咒，而是一种召唤。世界将陷入长达千年、难以言说的混沌，只有她知道这些预兆。她的梦境预示从未出错，但她不能让每夜缠绕的噩梦成为现实。
60401.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：命运决定者、黑暗未来、1张随机基础弱点。
60401.name: 杰奎琳·法恩
60401.real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would reveal any number of chaos tokens: Reveal 2 additional tokens. Of the revealed tokens, choose and cancel 2 non-[auto_fail] tokens, or 1 [auto_fail] token. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this effect is canceled or ignored, draw 1 card.
60401.text:
[reaction]你所在地点的一位调查员将要抽取任意数量的混乱标记时：额外抽取2个标记。从抽取的标记中选择并取消2个非[auto_fail]标记，或取消1个[auto_fail]标记。(每轮限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果本效果被取消或忽略，抽取1张卡牌。

60402.flavor: 我能看见命运之线，知道它们何时会断裂。
60402.name: 命运决定者
60402.real_text:
Jacqueline Fine deck only.
[reaction] When you use Jacqueline Fine's [reaction] ability, exhaust Arbiter of Fates: This use of her ability does not count towards its limit.
60402.text:
杰奎琳·法恩牌库专用。
[reaction]你使用杰奎琳·法恩的[reaction]能力时，横置命运决定者：本次使用不计入该能力的次数限制。

60403.name: 黑暗未来
60403.real_text: Revelation - Put Dark Future into play in your threat area. You cannot cancel or ignore [elder_sign], [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], and [auto_fail] tokens. Forced - At the end of your turn: Reveal 5 random tokens from the chaos bag. If an [elder_sign] symbol is revealed, discard Dark Future.
60403.text: 显现 - 将黑暗未来放置入你的威胁区域。 你不能取消或忽略[elder_sign]、[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]和[auto_fail]标记。 强制 - 你的回合结束时：从混乱袋随机抽取5个混乱标记。如果抽取到[elder_sign]符号，弃掉黑暗未来。

60404.name: 虚无主义
60404.real_text: Revelation - Put Nihilism into play in your threat area. Forced - After you reveal, cancel, or ignore an [auto_fail] token: Take 1 damage and 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Nihilism.
60404.text: 显现 - 将虚无主义放置入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你抽取、取消或忽略一个[auto_fail]标记后：受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉虚无主义。

60405.name: 仪式蜡烛
60405.real_text: [reaction] After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test.
60405.text: [reaction]你执行的技能检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号后：你本次检定得到技能值+1。

60406.name: 预见手镜
60406.real_text: Uses (4 secrets). [reaction] After a skill test at your location begins, exhaust Scrying Mirror and spend 1 secret: Perform the "reveal chaos token" step of the test now (before committing cards), instead of after committing cards.
60406.text: 使用(4秘密)。 [reaction]你所在地点的一次技能检定开始后，横置预见手镜并花费1秘密：本次检定的"抽取混乱标记"步骤改为现在(投入卡牌前)执行，而不是在投入卡牌后执行。

60407.name: 蓝焰术
60407.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 1 damage.
60407.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到1点伤害。

60408.name: 预知术
60408.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 1 horror.
60408.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。如果本次调查期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到1点恐惧。

60409.name: 难述真相
60409.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 resource.
60409.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你成功，对你躲避的敌人造成1点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，失去1资源。

60410.flavor: "汝全然不配。但从现在开始，吾将侍奉汝。"
60410.name: 幽灵魔宠
60410.real_text: You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] asset.
60410.text: 你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来放置一张[[法术]]支援。
60410.traits: 盟友. 生物. 召唤

60411.name: 水晶灵摆
60411.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After a skill test at your location begins, exhaust Crystal Pendulum: Name a number. If this test succeeds by that number or fails by that number, draw 1 card.
60411.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你所在地点的一次技能检定开始后，横置水晶灵摆：声明一个数字。如果本次检定成功超过难度的点数为该数字，或失败低于难度的点数为该数字，抽取1张卡牌。

60412.flavor: 黑暗是外在的深渊。光明是内心的深渊。
60412.name: 永夜长袍
60412.real_text: [reaction] When you play a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Robes of Endless Night: Reduce the cost of that card by 1.
60412.text: [reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡牌时，横置永夜长袍：该卡牌的费用减少1。

60413.flavor:
跨维度的旅行存在风险，这他很清楚。
但谁能抗拒那超越时空的疆域呢？
60413.name: 星界旅行
60413.real_text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).
60413.text: 移动。移动到任意一个已揭示的地点并从混乱袋随机揭示一个标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，你必须弃掉一张你控制的[[道具]]或[[盟友]]支援(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害)。

60414.name: 催眠术
60414.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, deal the attacking enemy's damage to itself.
60414.text:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对该敌人造成其自身的伤害。

60415.flavor: "如果我说，在你濒死之际我才会把你的命运告诉你，你还想知道吗？"
60415.name: 平行命运
60415.real_text: Look at the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, shuffle those cards into the encounter deck. Otherwise, return them to the top of the encounter deck in any order.
60415.text: 查看遭遇牌库顶的4张卡牌。从混乱袋随机抽取1个标记。如果抽取到[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，将这些卡牌混洗入遭遇牌库。否则，以任意顺序将它们放回遭遇牌库顶。

60416.name: 太阳神之音
60416.real_text: Gain 1 resource. Reveal 3 random tokens from the chaos bag. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol revealed, gain an additional 2 resources.
60416.text: 获得1资源。从混乱袋随机抽取3个标记。每抽取到1个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，额外获得2资源。

60417.name: 黑暗预言
60417.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)
60417.text:
快速。在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时打出。
改为揭示5个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中1个带有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号的标记结算并忽略其余标记。(如果没有揭示上述标记，从这些标记中选择任意一个标记结算，忽略其余标记。)

60418.name: 逆反
60418.real_text: Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, choose one of the following symbols: ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Ignore the effects of the chosen symbol during this test (including its modifier).
60418.text: 在本次检定揭示混乱标记前，选择以下一个符号：([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。本次检定期间忽略所选符号的效果(包括其修正值)。

60419.name: 先见之明
60419.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
After you commit Prescient to a skill test, name "even," "odd," or "symbol." After this test ends, if a chaos token of the named type was revealed during this test, you may return a [[Spell]] card from your discard pile to your hand.
60419.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你将先见之明投入一次技能检定后，声明"双数"、"单数"或"符号"。本次检定结束后，如果本次检定中抽取到属于所声明类别的混乱标记，你可以将你弃牌堆的一张[[法术]]卡返回手牌。

60420.name: 恐怖灵感
60420.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a [mystic] card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a chaos token is revealed.
Either cancel that effect, or resolve it an additional time.
60420.text:
快速。你将要结算一张[mystic]卡牌上在抽取混乱标记时、如果抽取混乱标记或在抽取混乱标记后触发的效果时打出。
取消该效果，或额外结算一次该效果。

60421.name: 诡秘石像
60421.real_text:
Uses (3 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
60421.text:
使用(3充能)。如果诡秘石像没有充能，弃掉它。
[reaction]你将要抽取1个混乱标记时，花费1充能：改为抽取2个混乱标记。选择其中一个标记结算，并忽略其余标记。

60422.flavor: 黑暗是外在的深渊。光明是内心的深渊。
60422.name: 永夜长袍
60422.real_text: [reaction] When you play a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Robes of Endless Night: Reduce the cost of that card by 1. Playing that card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
60422.text: [reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡牌时，横置永夜长袍：该卡牌的费用减少1。打出该卡牌不会引发趁乱攻击。

60423.name: 催眠术
60423.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to its damage or horror.
60423.text:
快速。一名敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，从混乱袋随机抽取1个标记。如果抽取到[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对进行攻击的敌人造成等同于其伤害值或恐惧值的伤害。

60424.name: 胆识
60424.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
60424.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌(如果成功超过难度至少2点，改为抽取2张卡牌)。

60425.name: 蓝焰术
60425.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 1 damage.
60425.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击你得到+2[willpower]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到1点伤害。

60426.name: 预知术
60426.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 1 horror.
60426.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。本次调查你得到+2[willpower]。如果你成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。如果本次调查期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到1点恐惧。

60427.name: 难述真相
60427.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +2 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 resource.
60427.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。本次躲避尝试你得到+2[willpower]。如果你成功，对你躲避的敌人造成1点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，失去1资源。

60428.name: 神秘研究
60428.real_text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
[fast] Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Arcane Studies: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
60428.text:
使用(2资源)。每轮开始时补满这些资源。
[fast]花费你资源池或神秘研究上的1资源：本次技能检定你得到+1[willpower]或+1[intellect]。

60429.name: 重新充能
60429.real_text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, add 1 charge to the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 4 charges to the chosen asset.
60429.text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张[[法术]]或[[遗物]]支援，从混乱袋随机抽取1个标记。如果抽取到[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，在所选支援上放置1充能。否则，在所选支援上放置4充能。

60430.name: 蓝焰术
60430.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +3 [willpower] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 2 damage.
60430.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击你得到+3[willpower]并造成+2伤害。如果本次攻击期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到2点伤害。

60431.name: 预知术
60431.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +3 [willpower] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at this location. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 2 horror.
60431.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。本次调查你得到+3[willpower]。如果你成功，额外发现该地点的2个线索。如果本次调查期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，受到2点恐惧。

60432.name: 难述真相
60432.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +3 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy. If an [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 2 resources.
60432.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。本次躲避尝试你得到+3[willpower]。如果你成功，对你躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间抽取到[elder_sign]、"+1"或"0"标记，失去2资源。

60451.back_flavor: 玛丽发现祖母黑暗污秽的血魔法传承之后，她尽了最大的努力去无视。还是在阿卡姆烟雾缭绕的酒吧、人挤人的俱乐部里唱歌更简单，也安全得多。但现在大环境不好啊。顾客越来越少，老主顾脾气也越来越坏，于是玛丽开始接受祖母的力量，控制观众，让吵闹的闭嘴，诱使有钱的慷慨解囊。这份危险的力量她越用越频繁，甚至觉得没有就不行。这股新发现的力量想必不会有什么代价吧。
60451.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[祖母的护符]、[故土呼召]、1张随机基础弱点。
60451.flavor: “我今晚为你准备了一场精彩绝伦的表演。”
60451.name: 玛丽·朗博
60451.real_text:
[reaction] After damage is placed on Marie Lambeau: Draw 2 cards and discard 1 of them. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, heal 1 damage.
60451.text:
[reaction]伤害放置到[玛丽·朗博]上后：抽取2张卡牌，并弃掉其中1张。（每阶段仅限一次）
[elder_sign]效果：+0。如果你检定成功，治愈1点伤害。

60452.name: 祖母的护符
60452.real_text:
Marie Lambeau deck only.
[fast] Take 1 direct damage and exhaust Grand-Mère's Charm: Replenish 1 charge on an asset at your location.
60452.text:
玛丽·朗博牌库专用。
[free]受到1点直接伤害并横置[祖母的护符]：补充你所在地点一个支援的1充能。
60452.traits: 道具. 守护. 密教. 祝福.

60453.name: 故土呼召
60453.real_text: Revelation - Put Called to Guinée into play in your threat area. You cannot heal damage. [action] Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand: Discard Called to Guinée.
60453.text: 显现-将[故土呼召]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 你不能治愈伤害。 [action]从你手牌中选择并弃掉3张卡牌：弃掉[故土呼召]。

60454.name: 晕血
60454.real_text: Revelation - Put Hemophobia into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time each round an investigator at your location takes damage: Take 1 horror. [action] [action]: Discard Hemophobia.
60454.text: 显现-将[晕血]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制-每轮第一次你所在地点的调查员受到伤害：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉[晕血]。

60455.name: 新晋术士
60455.real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
60455.text: 强制-[新晋术士]入场后：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。 [free]横置[新晋术士]：查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。

60456.flavor: 万事万物都有价值，只是如何支付有待商榷。
60456.name: 贡品碗
60456.real_text:
Uses (3 offerings). If there are no offerings on Offering Bowl, discard it.
[fast] Spend 1 offering and exhaust Offering Bowl: Take 1 damage and gain 2 resources.
60456.text:
使用（3贡品）。如果[贡品碗]上没有贡品，将其弃掉。
[free]花费1贡品并横置[贡品碗]：受到1点伤害并获得2资源。

60457.flavor: 在古代这是生命力和勇气的象征。戴上血石的你不禁好奇，古老的传说是否也有几丝真实。
60457.name: 血石
60457.traits: 道具. 守护. 诅咒萦绕.

60458.name: 献祭人偶
60458.real_text:
While you have 3 or fewer remaining health, Sacrificial Doll does not take up a hand slot.
[reaction] After you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token during a skill test, take 1 damage and exhaust Sacrificial Doll: Cancel that token and reveal tokens from the chaos bag until a symbol token is revealed. Resolve that token and ignore the rest.
60458.text:
你的剩余生命值不超过3时，[献祭人偶]不占用手部槽位。
[reaction]技能检定期间，你揭示了非[auto_fail]混乱标记后，受到1点伤害并横置[献祭人偶]：取消该标记，从混乱袋中揭示标记，直到揭示了一个带有符号的标记。结算该标记，忽略其余标记。
60458.traits: 道具. 守护. 密教.

60459.name: 宇宙烈焰
60459.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).
60459.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：攻击([willpower])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以使本次攻击造成伤害+1。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[skull]标记，移除[宇宙烈焰]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害并弃掉本卡牌)。

60460.name: 通灵视觉
60460.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).
60460.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：调查([willpower])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以发现你所在地点额外1个线索。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[cultist]标记，移除[通灵视觉]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点恐惧并弃掉本卡牌)。

60461.name: 暗影交融
60461.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Evade ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to move to a connecting location. If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Shadowmeld (if you cannot, lose 1 action and discard this card).
60461.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]：躲避([willpower])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以移动到一个连接地点。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[tablet]标记，移除[暗影交融]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，失去1个行动并弃掉本卡牌)。

60462.name: 吞噬生命
60462.real_text: Fight ([willpower]). This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
60462.text: 攻击([willpower])。本次攻击造成伤害+1。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害。

60463.name: 巴尔山多的恩宠
60463.real_text:
As an additional cost to play Favor of Baalshandor, take 1 damage.
Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 3. Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
60463.text:
作为打出[巴尔山多的恩宠]的额外费用，受到1点伤害。
从你手牌打出一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援，其费用减3。打出本卡牌不会引起趁乱攻击。

60464.name: 灌注生命
60464.real_text: Heal 3 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location.
60464.text: 治愈你所在地点调查员和/或[[盟友]]支援总计3点伤害。

60465.name: 镜像形态
60465.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Charm]] asset in your hand and put it into play under your control. When the round ends, shuffle that asset into your deck if it is still in play.
60465.text:
快速。只能在你的回合打出。
选择你手牌中一张[[法术]]或[[守护]]支援，将其放置入场，位于你的控制之下。在一轮结束时，如果该支援依然在场上，将其混洗回你的牌库。

60466.name: 精神魅惑
60466.real_text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or at a connecting location. Move that enemy to your location, engage it, and gain resources equal to its combined damage/horror values.
60466.text: 谈判。选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。将该敌人移动到你所在地点，与你交战，并获得等于其伤害值与恐惧值之和的资源。

60467.flavor: 为什么不尝尝真正的力量呢？
60467.name: 鲜血诅咒
60467.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this skill test is successful, take 1 direct damage.
60467.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次技能检定成功，受到1点直接伤害。

60468.flavor:
“有时，人们……会因为白天游荡的黑点，夜晚闪烁不定的鬼火感到不寒而栗。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《丘》</cite>
60468.name: 宇宙指引
60468.real_text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 damage from the performing investigator.
60468.text: 如果本次技能检定成功，治愈执行检定的调查员1点伤害。

60469.name: 力量洪流
60469.real_text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].
60469.text:
作为将[力量洪流]投入技能检定的额外费用，从你控制的支援上花费总计最多3充能。
每以此方式花费1充能，[力量洪流]获得[willpower][wild]。

60470.flavor:
“如其所言，他们崇拜的旧日支配者存在的时代远远早于人类，在地球尚且年轻之时就从天而降。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>
60470.name: 仪式长袍
60470.real_text: Reduce the cost of the first [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card you play each round by 1.
60470.text: 你每轮打出的第一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌的费用减1。

60471.name: 惊悚低语
60471.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If a symbol token is revealed during this test, place up to 2 charges or 2 secrets among assets you control.
60471.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定期间揭示了符号标记，在你控制的支援上放置总计最多2充能或2秘密。

60472.name: 鲜血结界
60472.real_text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack and heal 2 damage from the targeted investigator.
60472.text:
快速。在一个非[[精英]]敌人攻击你所在地点的调查员时打出。
取消该攻击并治愈对象调查员2点伤害。

60473.name: 报应
60473.real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
You take all damage and horror from this attack. For each point of damage/horror taken, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
60473.text:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的调查员时打出。
你受到本次攻击的全部伤害和恐惧。每受到1点伤害/恐惧，对你所在地点的敌人造成1点伤害。

60474.name: 阿撒托斯的惊骇诅咒
60474.real_text: Exceptional. [action] Place 1 doom on Dread Curse of Azathoth: Fight ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, remove 1 doom from Dread Curse of Azathoth. If a [skull] or [elder_thing] token is revealed during this test, remove all doom from this card.
60474.text: 卓越。 [action]在[阿撒托斯的惊骇诅咒]上放置1个毁灭标记：攻击([willpower])。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并且造成伤害+1。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，移除[阿撒托斯的惊骇诅咒]的1个毁灭标记。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]或[elder_thing]标记，移除本卡牌所有的毁灭标记。

60475.name: 仪式匕首
60475.real_text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). Add your [willpower] to your [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] event, take 1 damage and exhaust Ritual Dagger: Shuffle that event into your deck instead of discarding it.
60475.text: [action]：攻击([combat])。本次攻击将你的[willpower]加入你的[combat]。 [reaction]你打出[[法术]]事件后，受到1点伤害并横置[仪式匕首]：不弃掉该事件，改为将其混洗回你的牌库。
60475.traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 诅咒萦绕.

60476.name: 灵感敏锐
60476.real_text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).
60476.text: 起始。（你每场游戏开始的起始手牌可以加入1张“起始”关键词的卡牌） [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower](如果是[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌上的检定，改为+2[willpower])。 [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat](如果是[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌上的检定，改为+2[combat])。

60477.flavor: 为什么不尝尝真正的力量呢？
60477.name: 鲜血诅咒
60477.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to a card with health at your location.
60477.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次技能检定成功，对你所在地点一张有生命值的卡牌造成1点伤害。

60478.flavor:
“这些女巫所属的秘密教派守卫着、传承着被遗忘的亘古纪元里惊人的秘密。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>
60478.name: 奥术体验
60478.real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
60478.text:
永久。每套牌库仅限1张。
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。

60479.flavor:
“你也看得见这些家伙？
他们真的很难让人习惯。”
60479.name: 吉姆·卡尔弗
60479.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you take damage and/or horror, exhaust Jim Culver: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
60479.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你受到伤害和/或恐惧后，横置[吉姆·卡尔弗]：抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。

60480.name: 究极献祭
60480.real_text:
Fast. Play when the investigation phase ends.
Repeat the investigation phase. At the end of that phase, you are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. Max once per game.
60480.text:
快速。在调查阶段结束时打出。
重复调查阶段。当该阶段结束时，你被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。每场游戏最多1次。

60481.name: 通灵视觉
60481.real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location or 1 clue at a connecting location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).
60481.text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]：调查([willpower])。你本次调查得到+2[willpower]。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以发现你所在地点额外1个线索，或连接地点的1个线索。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[cultist]标记，移除[通灵视觉]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点恐惧并弃掉本卡牌)。

60482.name: 暗影交融
60482.real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action]: Evade ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] for this evasion. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to move to a location up to 2 connections away. If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Shadowmeld (if you cannot, lose 1 action and discard this card).
60482.text: 使用(5充能)。 [action]：躲避([willpower])。你本次躲避得到+2[willpower]。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以移动到一个地点，该地点与你所在地点连接次数不超过2。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[tablet]标记，移除[暗影交融]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，失去1个行动并弃掉本卡牌)。

60483.name: 曲血术
60483.real_text: Fight ([willpower]). You get +3 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to each other enemy at your location. Each enemy dealt damage by Bend Blood cannot attack you for the remainder of the round.
60483.text: 攻击([willpower])。本次攻击你得到+3[willpower]并且造成伤害+1。如果你检定成功，对你所在地点的每个其他敌人造成1点伤害。每个受到[曲血术]伤害的敌人本轮剩余时间内不能攻击你。

60501.back_flavor: 自从斯特拉在阿卡姆邮局当差以来，她很清楚两件事。第一，父母错把她当成儿子，还给她取了一个男孩名字。第二，在深夜里——国王港悬崖上的小屋曾低声念出她的真名——她为自己挑选的名字："斯特拉"。斯特拉每周六无论天气如何都会派送邮件，这并不容易，但想到自己在维系人们之间的联系，她便对这份工作充满热忱。之后她开始翻找信件。每次派送结束，包里总会多出一个信封。信封上的收件人一直是她，盖着国王港的邮戳。信封里只有一封信，信上印着一个词："斯特拉"。
60501.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：3张不畏雨雪、1张雾之召唤、1张随机基础弱点。
60501.flavor: "我能听见它的声音。那它听得见我说话吗？"
60501.name: 斯特拉·克拉克
60501.real_text:
[reaction] After you fail a skill test: You may take an additional action during your turn this round. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may instead choose to automatically fail this skill test to heal 1 damage and 1 horror.
60501.text:
[reaction]你技能检定失败后：本轮你的回合期间可以进行一次额外行动。(每轮限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以改为选择让本次技能检定自动失败，治愈1点伤害和1点恐惧。

60502.flavor: ……即便夜色昏暗，邮差也不会受困，迅速完成派件任务。
60502.name: 不畏雨雪
60502.real_text:
Stella Clark deck only.
If this skill test fails, cancel all effects of the failed test.
60502.text:
斯特拉·克拉克牌库专用。
如果本次技能检定失败，取消该次失败的所有效果。

60503.name: 雾之召唤
60503.real_text: Revelation - Put Called by the Mists into play in your threat area. Forced - After you initiate a skill test with a difficulty of 4 or higher: Take 1 damage. [action] [action]: Discard Called by the Mists.
60503.text: 显现 - 将雾之召唤放置入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你发起一次难度至少为4的技能检定后：受到1点伤害。 [action][action]：弃掉雾之召唤。

60504.name: 失败恐惧症
60504.real_text: Revelation - Put Atychiphobia into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Take 1 horror. [action] [action]: Discard Atychiphobia.
60504.text: 显现 - 将失败恐惧症放置入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉失败恐惧症。

60505.name: .18大口径短口手枪
60505.real_text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you fail, place 1 ammo on .18 Derringer.
60505.text: 使用(2子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你失败，在.18大口径短口手枪上放置1子弹。
60505.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

60506.name: 格林童话
60506.real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location fails a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Grimm's Fairy Tales and spend 1 secret: Heal 1 horror from that investigator.
60506.text:
使用(4秘密)。
[reaction]你所在地点的一位调查员技能检定失败低于难度至少2点后，横置格林童话并花费1秘密：治愈该调查员的1点恐惧。

60507.name: 陈旧的钥匙圈
60507.real_text: Uses (2 keys). If there are no keys on Old Keyring, discard it. [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, remove 1 key from Old Keyring.
60507.text: 使用(2钥匙)。如果陈旧的钥匙圈上没有钥匙，弃掉它。 [action]：调查。本次调查中，你所在地点的隐蔽值-2。如果你成功，移除陈旧的钥匙圈上的1钥匙。

60508.name: 奥恩奶奶
60508.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, exhaust Granny Orne: That investigator fails by either 1 less or 1 more.
60508.text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你所在地点的一位调查员的技能检定将要失败时，横置奥恩奶奶：该调查员本次检定失败，且失败结果高1点或低1点。

60509.flavor:
"它的双眸与睡梦中的魔鬼一模一样……"
<cite>埃德加·爱伦·坡，《乌鸦》</cite>
60509.name: 神秘乌鸦
60509.real_text: [fast] Discard Mysterious Raven and take 1 horror: Discover 1 clue at your location.
60509.text: [fast]弃掉神秘乌鸦并受到1点恐惧：发现你所在地点的1个线索。

60510.flavor: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了。
60510.name: 幸运兔脚
60510.real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
60510.text: [reaction]你技能检定失败后，横置[幸运兔脚]：抽取1张卡牌。

60511.name: 拳击家
60511.real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
60511.text:
[fast]花费1资源：本次技能检定你得到+1[combat]。
[fast]花费1资源：本次技能检定你得到+1[agility]。

60512.name: 生存意志
60512.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Do not reveal chaos tokens for the next skill test you perform this turn.
60512.text:
快速。只能在你的回合打出。
你本回合进行的下一次技能检定不抽取混乱标记。

60513.flavor: 无论是否看得到希望，你所能做的只有抵抗。
60513.name: 意志考验
60513.real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, cancel that card's revelation effect.
60513.text:
快速。你所在地点的一位调查员抽到一张非弱点诡计卡时打出。
进行一次[willpower](3)检定。如果你成功，取消该卡牌的显现效果。

60514.name: 狗屎运
60514.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on top of the encounter deck.
60514.text:
快速。你对非[[精英]]敌人进行躲避尝试期间，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
将该敌人放到遭遇牌库顶。

60515.name: 咬紧牙关
60515.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test.
You get +1 to each of your skills for the remainder of the round.
60515.text:
快速。你技能检定失败后打出。
本轮剩余时间内，你的每项技能+1。

60516.name: 学无止境
60516.real_text: Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test). Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.
60516.text: 快速。在你技能检定失败且完毕后(结算该次技能检定的所有效果后)打出。 再次尝试该次检定。你本次检定得到+2技能值。

60517.name: “看看我发现了什么！”
60517.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
