Discover 2 clues in your location.
60517.text:
快速。你调查时，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。

60518.name: 哎呀！
60518.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while attacking an enemy engaged with you.
Deal this attack's damage to a different enemy at your location.
60518.text:
快速。在你攻击与你交战的敌人时技能检定失败，并且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害。

60519.name: 重拾信念
60519.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.
60519.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你可以将重拾信念投入任意类型的检定。
如果本次检定失败，执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。

60520.flavor: 帕特森先生一直告诉温蒂一切都会好起来的。但帕特森先生终究只是一只泰迪熊，它什么都不懂。
60520.name: 珍爱纪念
60520.real_text: Forced - When Cherished Keepsake is defeated by horror: Exile it.
60520.text: 强制 - 珍爱纪念因恐惧被击败时：放逐它。

60521.flavor: 皮大衣可能并不时尚，但温暖又抗寒，而且很可靠。
60521.name: 皮大衣
60521.real_text: Forced - When Leather Coat is defeated by damage: Exile it.
60521.text: 强制 - 皮大衣因伤害被击败时：放逐它。

60522.name: .18大口径短口手枪
60522.real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you fail, place 1 ammo on .18 Derringer and the next time you trigger this ability this round, you get an additional +1 [combat] for that attack.
60522.text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你失败，在.18大口径短口手枪上放置1子弹，且本轮你下次触发本能力时，该次攻击额外得到+1[combat]。
60522.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

60523.flavor: 无论是否看得到希望，你所能做的只有抵抗。
60523.name: 意志考验
60523.real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, exile A Test of Will.
60523.text:
快速。你所在地点的一位调查员抽到一张非弱点诡计卡时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，进行一次[willpower](3)检定。如果你失败，放逐意志考验。

60524.name: "看看我发现了什么！"
60524.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
60524.text:
快速。你调查时技能检定失败低于难度3点或更少后打出。
从你所在地点和连接地点发现总计2个线索。

60525.name: 狗屎运
60525.real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on the bottom of the encounter deck.
60525.text:
快速。你尝试躲避一名非[[精英]]敌人时技能检定失败低于难度3点或更少后打出。
将该敌人放到遭遇牌库底。

60526.name: 绝处逢生
60526.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return Unexpected Courage to your hand.
60526.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定失败，将绝处逢生返回手牌。

60527.name: 奥恩奶奶
60527.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, exhaust Granny Orne: That investigator either gets +1 skill value or -1 skill value for that test.
60527.text:
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你所在地点的一位调查员的技能检定将要失败时，横置奥恩奶奶：该调查员本次检定的技能值+1或-1。

60528.name: 运气好！
60528.real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location would fail a skill test.
They get +3 to their skill value for that test. That investigator draws 1 card.
60528.text:
快速。你所在地点的一位调查员的技能检定将要失败时打出。
该调查员本次检定的技能值+3。该调查员抽取1张卡牌。

60529.name: 电锯
60529.real_text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If this attack fails, either place 1 supply on Chainsaw or deal 1 damage to the attacked enemy.
60529.text: 使用(3补给)。 [action]花费1补给：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+2伤害。如果本次攻击失败，在电锯上放置1补给，或对受到攻击的敌人造成1点伤害。
60529.traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战

60530.name: 一点就通
60530.real_text:
Permanent.
During or before your first action of each of your turns, each skill test you perform gets +1 difficulty.
During or after your third action of each of your turns, each skill test you perform gets -1 difficulty.
60530.text:
永久。
你每回合的第一次行动中，或你回合期间第一次行动前，你进行的每次技能检定难度+1。
你每回合的第三次行动中，或你回合期间第三次行动后，你进行的每次技能检定难度-1。

60531.name: 似曾相识
60531.real_text:
Permanent.
In between two scenarios of a campaign, reduce the experience cost to repurchase up to 3 cards that you exiled during the last scenario by 1 each.
60531.text:
永久。
剧本的两场冒险之间，你可以以每张经验费用减少1点的价格，回购你在上一场冒险期间放逐的至多3张卡牌。

60551.back_flavor: 米格尔完全没想到自己会理一片牧场。离开了故土阿根廷之后，他不知疲倦地工作，就为了攒钱把丈夫吉列尔莫和女儿阿多尼亚也接来阿卡姆。只是他的工作有了麻烦。晚上有东西在猎杀牲畜，只留下了残尸。更奇怪的是，这东西杀害牲畜并非是为了掠食。米格尔可不只有反击的本领。他会追踪这个神秘的猎手，案入当地树林，一劳永逸也将其捕获。
60551.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入牌库卡牌张数)：[米格尔的背包]、[猫科混种]、1张随机基础弱点。
60551.name: 米格尔·德·拉·克鲁兹
60551.real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which may only be used to play an event.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add a [[Trick]] or [[Trap]] card in your discard pile to your hand.
60551.text:
你在自己回合期间可以进行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于打出事件。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以将你弃牌堆中一张[[技巧]]或[[陷阱]]卡牌加入你的手牌。

60552.name: 米格尔的背包
60552.real_text:
Miguel de la Cruz deck only.
[reaction] When you play an event, exhaust Miguel's Knapsack: Either play that event at a connecting location as if you were at that location, or draw 1 card.
60552.text:
米格尔·德·拉·克鲁兹牌库专用。
[reaction]在你打出事件时，横置[米格尔的背包]：在连接地点打出该事件，如同你在该地点，或抽取1张卡牌。

60553.flavor: 它杀戮是为了取乐，而非生存。
60553.name: 猫科混种
60553.real_text:
Elusive. Hunter. Prey (Miguel de la Cruz only).
Feline Hybrid is immune to player card effects.
60553.text:
逃逸。猎手。猎物(仅对米格尔·德·拉·克鲁兹)。
[猫科混种]免疫玩家卡牌效果。

60554.name: 饮血者
60554.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Blood Drinker attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
60554.text: 猎手。反击。 强制-[饮血者]攻击后：治愈其1点伤害。

60555.flavor: “我告诉你，这可不是普通动物的毛。”
60555.name: 丹尼尔·詹姆森
60555.real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you fail an attack or evasion, exhaust Daniel Jameson: Attempt that skill test again, with +1 skill value.
60555.text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]你攻击或躲避失败后，横置[丹尼尔·詹姆森]：以技能值+1再次尝试该技能检定。

60556.flavor: 无论如何，她都会在你身边。
60556.name: 猎犬
60556.real_text: [reaction] When an enemy enters play, exhaust Hunting Dog: Move once toward that enemy's location.
60556.text: [reaction]在敌人入场时，横置[猎犬]：朝该敌人的地点移动一次。

60557.flavor:
“我一直知道自己是个异乡人；在这个世纪，在依然是人类的物种中，我是个陌生人。”
<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《异乡人》</cite>
60557.name: 独行
60557.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Loner: Move to an empty connecting location.
60557.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]你的回合期间，横置[独行]：移动到一个连接的无人地点。

60558.flavor:
“那东西又笨重，又有裂缝，还脏兮兮的。”
“没错，但它依然能分得清南北！”
60558.name: 旧指南针
60558.real_text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. If you fail, you may exhaust Old Compass to attempt this skill test again.
60558.text: [action]：调查([intellect])。本次调查你所在地点得到隐藏值-1。如果你检定失败，你可以横置[旧指南针]以再次尝试该技能检定。

60559.flavor: 适合剥皮，削木头，以及拿取捅吓人怪物的眼睛。
60559.name: 折叠小刀
60559.real_text: [action]: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may exhaust Pocketknife to gain 1 resource.
60559.text: [action]：攻击([combat]或[agility])。你本次检定得到技能值+1。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以横置[折叠小刀]以获得1资源。
60559.traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战.

60560.flavor: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了。
60560.name: 幸运兔脚
60560.real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
60560.text: [reaction]你技能检定失败后，横置[幸运兔脚]：抽取1张卡牌。

60561.flavor: “只有我，一杯清咖，加上昨晚的鼻烟。这就是美好的早晨。”
60561.name: 一如往常
60561.real_text:
Uses (5 supplies). If there are no supplies on Same Old Thing, discard it.
You may spend supplies on Same Old Thing as resources to pay for events played by any investigator at your location.
60561.text:
使用(5补给)。如果[一如往常]上没有补给，将其弃掉。
你可以将[一如往常]的补给作为资源花费，以支付你所在地点任意调查员打出的事件。

60562.name: 诱敌陷阱
60562.real_text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Decoy Trap: Evade ([intellect] or [agility]). Evade that enemy. You get +1 skill value for this evasion. If this test succeeds, you may discard Decoy Trap to move to this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)
60562.text: 快速。附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张[[陷阱]]。 [reaction]一个敌人进入所附属的地点后，横置[诱敌陷阱]：躲避([intellect]或[agility])。躲避该敌人。你本次躲避得到技能值+1。如果本次检定成功，你可以弃掉[诱敌陷阱]以移动到本地点。（你可以从任意地点触发本能力）

60563.name: 远眺
60563.real_text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Glassing: Investigate ([intellect] or [agility]). You get +1 skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, you may discard Glassing to discover 1 additional clue at this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)
60563.text: 快速。附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张[[陷阱]]。 [reaction]一个敌人进入所附属的地点后，横置[远眺]：调查([intellect]或[agility])。你本次调查得到技能值+1。如果本次检定成功，你可以弃掉[远眺]以发现本地点额外1个线索。（你可以从任意地点触发本能力）

60564.name: 游击策略
60564.real_text: Fight ([combat]) or Evade ([agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test and you may target an enemy at a connecting location as if you were engaged with that enemy.
60564.text: 攻击([combat])或躲避([agility])。你本次检定得到技能值+1。你可以将连接地点的一个敌人作为对象，如同你与该敌人交战。

60565.name: 隐秘藏身处
60565.real_text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] When the round ends, each investigator at this location may choose one of the following: Draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, heal 1 damage, or heal 1 horror. Forced - After an enemy enters this location: Discard Hidden Shelter.
60565.text: 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 [reaction]在一轮结束时，每位本地点的调查员可以选择一项：抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，治愈1点伤害，或治愈1点恐惧。 强制-一个敌人进入本地点后：弃掉[隐秘藏身处]。

60566.name: 守株待兔
60566.real_text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters this location, exhaust Lie in Wait: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). Fight that enemy. You get +1 skill value for this attack. You may discard Lie in Wait for this attack to deal +1 damage. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)
60566.text: 快速。附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张[[陷阱]]。 [reaction]一个敌人进入所附属的地点后，横置[守株待兔]：攻击([combat]或[agility])。攻击该敌人。你本次攻击得到技能值+1。你可以弃掉[守株待兔]以使本次攻击造成伤害+1。（你可以从任意地点触发本能力）

60567.name: 尾随猎物
60567.real_text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, draw 1 card and discover 1 clue at your location. If that enemy is not at your location, you may move once toward its location.
60567.text: 查找遭遇牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个敌人，将其抽取，并混洗遭遇牌库。然后，抽取1张卡牌并发现你所在地点的1个线索。如果该敌人不在你所在地点，你可以朝其所在地点移动一次。

60568.name: 铤而走险
60568.real_text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] asset or event in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
60568.text: 如果本次技能检定成功，选择你弃牌堆中一张[survivor]支援或事件，将其加入你的手牌。

60569.flavor: 没人知道你要是越过极限会发生什么。
60569.name: 悬崖勒马
60569.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return each other card committed to this test to its owner's hand.
60569.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定失败，将投入本次检定的其他每张卡牌都返回其所有者的手牌。

60570.flavor: 不算很多，但足以让你继续坚持。
60570.name: 额外配给
60570.real_text:
Uses (4 supplies). If there are no supplies on Extra Rations, discard it.
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Extra Rations: Heal 1 damage from your investigator or an [[Ally]] asset you control.
60570.text:
使用(4补给)。如果[额外配给]上没有补给，将其弃掉。
[free]花费1补给并横置[额外配给]：治愈你的调查员或你控制的一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害。

60571.name: 野外处理
60571.real_text:
Fast. Play after a [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy at your location is defeated.
Heal up to 3 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location.
60571.text:
快速。你所在地点的一个[[生物]]或[[怪物]]敌人被击败后打出。
治愈你所在地点调查员和/或[[盟友]]支援总计最多3点伤害。

60572.flavor: 保镖，鱼人，怪物，只要有脉搏，就肯定能捶上一拳。
60572.name: 狂野
60572.real_text: For every 2 damage on you (rounded up), Rough gains [wild].
60572.text: 你身上每有2点伤害(向上取整)，[狂野]获得[wild]。

60573.flavor: 无论你倒什么进去，总是有点苦。
60573.name: 水壶
60573.real_text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Canteen: Heal 2 horror.
60573.text:
使用(3补给)。
[free]花费1补给并横置[水壶]：治愈2点恐惧。

60574.name: 猎人直觉
60574.real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies).
[reaction] After you engage an enemy, spend 1 supply and exhaust Hunter's Instinct: Add a level 0-2 event in your discard pile to your hand.
60574.text:
每位调查员仅限1张。使用(3补给)。
[reaction]你与敌人交战后，花费1补给并横置[猎人直觉]：将一张等级0-2的事件从你的弃牌堆加入你的手牌。

60575.flavor: “它是用来射的！不是拿着挥的！”
60575.name: 温彻斯特52式步枪
60575.real_text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Discard Winchester Model 52: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, automatically evade the targeted enemy.
60575.text: 使用(2子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]并且造成伤害+1。 [action]弃掉[温彻斯特52式步枪]：攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。如果你检定成功，自动躲避对象敌人。
60575.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械.

60576.name: 游击策略
60576.real_text: Fight ([combat]) or Evade ([agility]). You get +2 skill value for this test and you may target an enemy at a connecting location as if you were engaged with that enemy. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to that enemy (in addition to its standard damage).
60576.text: 攻击([combat])或躲避([agility])。你本次检定得到技能值+2。你可以将连接地点的一个敌人作为对象，如同你与该敌人交战。如果你检定成功，（在标准伤害之外，额外）对该敌人造成1点伤害。

60577.name: 喘息
60577.real_text:
Play only if there are no enemies at your location.
Choose up to 3 level 0 event and/or skill cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Draw 1 card.
60577.text:
你所在地点没有敌人才能打出。
选择你弃牌堆中最多3张等级0的事件和/或技能卡牌，将其混洗入你的牌库。抽取1张卡牌。

60578.name: 绳索陷阱
60578.real_text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] attached. [reaction] When an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Rope Trap: Deal 1 damage to that enemy. Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] token is revealed, discard Rope Trap. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)
60578.text: 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限附属1张[[陷阱]]。 [reaction]一个敌人进入所附属的地点后，横置[绳索陷阱]：对该敌人造成1点伤害。从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果揭示了[skull]或[auto_fail]标记，弃掉[绳索陷阱]。（你可以从任意地点触发本能力）

60579.name: 镇静自若
60579.real_text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a scenario card). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).
60579.text: 起始。（你每场游戏开始的起始手牌可以加入1张“起始”关键词的卡牌） [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower](如果是冒险卡牌上的检定，改为+2[willpower])。 [fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility](如果是冒险卡牌上的检定，改为+2[agility])。

60580.name: 长弓
60580.real_text: Uses (1 arrow). [action] Spend 1 arrow: Fight ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack. This attack ignores the aloof keyword. [action]: Replenish 1 arrow on Longbow.
60580.text: 使用(1箭矢)。 [action]花费1箭矢：攻击([agility])。你本次攻击得到+2[agility]并且造成伤害+2。本次攻击忽略冷漠关键词。 [action]：补充[长弓]的1箭矢。
60580.traits: 道具. 武器. 远程.

60581.name: 简易炸弹
60581.real_text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] attached. [reaction] After an enemy or investigator enters attached location, discard Makeshift Bomb: Deal 3 damage to each enemy and investigator at that location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)
60581.text: 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限附属1张[[陷阱]]。 [reaction]一个敌人或一位调查员进入所附属的地点后，弃掉[简易炸弹]：对该地点的每个敌人和每位调查员各造成3点伤害。（你可以从任意地点触发本能力）

60582.name: 及时干预
60582.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Timely Intervention from your hand after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test you are performing.
60582.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你执行的技能检定期间，你可以在揭示混乱标记后从你的手牌投入[及时干预]。

70001.back_text: 困难/专家 [skull]：-1。揭示另一个标记。如果你失败，必须选择一项：受到1点伤害或1点恐惧。 [cultist]：-3。将你的1个线索放在你所在地点。 [tablet]：-4。失去2资源。 [elder_thing]：-4。随机弃掉你手牌中的一张卡牌。
70001.name: 疯狂迷宫
70001.real_text:
Standard
[skull]: -1. Reveal another token.
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, lose 2 resources.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand.
70001.text: 简单/普通 [skull]：-1。揭示另一个标记。 [cultist]：-3。如果你失败，将你的1个线索放在你所在地点。 [tablet]：-4。如果你失败，失去2资源。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果你失败，随机弃掉你手牌中的一张卡牌。

70002.back_text: 推进当前场景卡牌并遵循其指示。 收到结算场景2冒险设置的指示时，请在规则手册中查阅对应你所在组的设置指示。
70002.flavor: 你和另外两组人被绑架，困在某种可怕的实验中。你们组的便笺上有进一步指示。
70002.name: 觉醒
70002.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 1]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
70002.text: 强制 - 在本轮结束时，如果本密谋上至少有1个毁灭标记，且尚未有任何组触发过此能力：A组调查员队长随机选择一张放在一边的[[场景1]]剧情卡牌并抽取它。向三组宣布所选卡牌的名称。每位其他调查员队长抽取该剧情卡牌。

70003.back_text: 推进当前场景卡牌并遵循其指示。 收到结算场景2冒险设置的指示时，请在规则手册中查阅对应你所在组的设置指示。
70003.flavor: 你和另外两组人被绑架，困在某种可怕的实验中。你们组的便笺上有进一步指示。
70003.name: 觉醒

70004.back_text: 推进当前场景卡牌并遵循其指示。 收到结算场景3设置的指示时，请在规则手册中查阅对应你所在组的设置指示。
70004.flavor:
你逃离第一间密室时，组内便笺上闪现出发光的文字：
“你们逃出第一间密室了吗？很好。也许你们没有我预想的那么无用。”
70004.name: 痛苦与绝望
70004.real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 2]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
70004.text: 强制 - 在本轮结束时，如果本密谋上至少有1个毁灭标记，且尚未有任何组触发过此能力：A组调查员队长随机选择一张放在一边的[[场景2]]剧情卡牌并抽取它。向三组宣布所选卡牌的名称。每位其他调查员队长抽取该剧情卡牌。

70005.back_text: 推进当前场景卡牌并遵循其指示。 收到结算场景3设置的指示时，请在规则手册中查阅对应你所在组的设置指示。
70005.flavor:
你逃离第一间密室时，组内便笺上闪现出发光的文字：
“你们逃出第一间密室了吗？很好。也许你们没有我预想的那么无用。”
70005.name: 痛苦与绝望

70006.back_flavor: 主谋扭曲的声音发出近似笑声的噼啪声。“你们的痛苦很有力量，”那声音解释道。“从安全中被抬起，带入苦难，却仍保有希望……只为了让那希望被击碎、碾压。”废弃仓库地面上的符文明亮发光，鲜血从混凝土裂缝中渗出，沿着墙壁滴落。“我知道这不公平，”那声音补充道。“但世上从来没有真正公平的事。”
70006.back_text: 在这条时间线中，仪式已经完成。 如果你正在进行史诗多人模式，将艾克索多隆上的所有伤害移动到另一组的艾克索多隆副本上。 本组每位调查员被杀死。(→结局1)
70006.flavor: 你冲入下一间密室，希望找到逃离这场噩梦的出口。面前锁死的钢门粉碎了这个希望。墙上刻着晦涩的符号，地面的印记正随着力量明灭。就在这时，一个身影从阴影中走出。
70006.name: 主谋
70006.real_text: Each [[Distortion]] location gains: "[action] [survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+: <+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 EIXODOLON. (Group limit once per game.)" Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
70006.text: 每个[[扭曲]]地点获得： “[action][survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+：<+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 艾克索多隆。(每组每场游戏限一次。)” 目标 - 如果每位调查员被击败，推进本密谋。

70007.back_text:
如果调查员拥有奥秘之钥和2[per_investigator]个线索：
你将钥匙插入锁孔，密室的墙壁缓缓敞开，露出一条由波纹金属和混凝土构成的狭窄黑暗走廊。周遭管道的嘶鸣声逐渐低落为微弱的呜咽。
调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。将奥秘之钥从游戏中移除。结算场景2冒险设置。
如果调查员没有奥秘之钥和/或2[per_investigator]个线索：
一股强烈的毒气从通风口喷涌而出，充满了房间。你的视野变得模糊，随即倒在地上。一个阴险的声音解释道：“这是我们所有人终将面对的命运。”一切归于黑暗。
本组每位调查员被杀死。(→结局1)
70007.flavor: 便笺写道：“你有一小时找出出路，否则将吸入死亡。”
70007.name: 困于其中（A组）
70007.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators must possess the Key of Mysteries and the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
70007.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进时，调查员必须拥有奥秘之钥和所需数量的线索。(注意：若密谋推进时不满足此条件，本组每位调查员将被杀死。)

70008.back_text:
如果同一地点的调查员拥有2[per_investigator]个线索：
水无害地排走了，你终于松了一口气。
同一地点的调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。结算场景2冒险设置。
如果同一地点的调查员没有2[per_investigator]个线索：
水位不断上升，灌满了水箱，继而灌入你的肺。你徒劳地隔着玻璃挣扎。自由如此接近，却又如此遥远。
每位调查员失去其所有线索。 位于雨之密室的调查员被杀死。 结算场景2冒险设置。
70008.flavor: 你们组的一名成员被困在本密室众多水箱之一中。水箱上方的机械装置启动，水从上方灌入水箱。便笺写道：“你有一小时找到解救同伴的方法，否则其命运将被注定。”
70008.name: 水之墓（B组）
70008.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators at the same location must possess the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, the investigator in the Chamber of Rain will be killed.)
70008.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进时，同一地点的调查员必须拥有所需数量的线索。(注意：若密谋推进时不满足此条件，位于雨之密室的调查员将被杀死。)

70009.back_text:
如果一位调查员发动了悔恨密室上的[action]能力，该调查员查看A组游戏区域内的密藏密室，确认其背景文字是否与拉动的拉杆相符。 - 如果不符，一排排锋利如剃刀的刀刃从密室墙壁中伸出，以骇人的精准度将你切开。你被杀死。结算场景2冒险设置。 - 如果相符，闸门升起，夜之密室的门打开。结算场景2冒险设置。
如果没有调查员发动悔恨密室上的[action]能力：
时间到了。你冲向拉杆，但为时已晚。一排排锋利如剃刀的刀刃从密室墙壁中伸出，以骇人的精准度将你切开。
距离悔恨密室最近的调查员被杀死。(若有平局，由调查员决定。)结算场景2冒险设置。
70009.flavor: 便笺写道：“你们中只有一人能做出选择。选对拉杆，否则死亡。”附近的铁门在震耳欲聋的撞击声中打开，露出一间有三个无标记拉杆的小房间。
70009.name: 拉杆（C组）
70009.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. (Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed.)
70009.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，一位调查员必须发动悔恨密室上的[action]能力。(注意：如果拉错了拉杆，你将被杀死。)

70010.back_text:
如果一位调查员发动了悔恨密室上的[action]能力，该调查员查看剧本参考卡下方的密藏密室地点，确认其背景文字是否与拉动的拉杆相符。 - 如果不符，一排排锋利如剃刀的刀刃从密室墙壁中伸出，以骇人的精准度将你切开。你被杀死。结算场景2冒险设置。 - 如果相符，闸门升起，夜之密室的门打开。结算场景2冒险设置。
如果没有调查员发动悔恨密室上的[action]能力：
时间到了。你冲向拉杆，但为时已晚。一排排锋利如剃刀的刀刃从密室墙壁中伸出，以骇人的精准度将你切开。
距离悔恨密室最近的调查员被杀死。(若有平局，由调查员决定。)结算场景2冒险设置。
70010.flavor: 便笺写道：“你们中只有一人能做出选择。选对拉杆，否则死亡。”附近的铁门在震耳欲聋的撞击声中打开，露出一间有三个无标记拉杆的小房间。
70010.name: 拉杆（C组）
70010.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed
70010.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，一位调查员必须发动悔恨密室上的[action]能力。注意：如果拉错了拉杆，你将被杀死。

70011.back_text:
如果密谋推进时场上至少有11个毁灭标记：
你将装置上的刻度盘转到最大值。肌肉紧绷、身体开始腐朽时，你奋力抓紧它。刻度盘咔哒一声停住，接着你慢慢得以继续朝同一方向转动。它缓慢地一圈又一圈转动，最终回到起点，你承受着剧烈痛苦。空气变得稀薄，时间恢复了原本的节奏。
结算场景3设置。
如果密谋推进时场上少于11个毁灭标记：
你的肌肉和皮肤紧缩，感觉身体的能量正被抽干。你想尖叫，却没有空气能穿过喉咙。器官干瘪腐朽。一个阴险的声音解释道：“这是我们所有人终将面对的命运。”几分钟内，你便化作尘土。
本组每位调查员被杀死。(→结局1)
70011.flavor: 发光的文字继续出现在便笺上：“下一间密室的时间流动不同。若你不迅速行动，就会腐朽成灰。”
70011.name: 时间扭曲（A组）
70011.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. When the agenda advances, there must be at least 11 doom in play. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
70011.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进时，场上必须至少有11个毁灭标记。(注意：若密谋推进时不满足此条件，本组每位调查员将被杀死。)

70012.back_text:
如果一位调查员发动了毒之密室上的[action]能力，该调查员阅读下列文字： - 如果你“已被注射”，这团淤泥令人作呕却无害。结算场景3设置。 - 如果你“未被注射”，毒液会渗入你的皮肤，从内到外吞噬你的器官。你被杀死。结算场景3设置。
如果没有调查员发动毒之密室上的[action]能力：
整个迷宫的地板和墙壁移动、翻转，你失去了平衡。重力扭曲时，你沿着地板滑行，被撞入毒坑。
将每位调查员移动到毒之密室。本组每位“未被注射”的调查员被杀死。结算场景3设置。
70012.flavor: 发光的文字继续出现在便笺上：“毒之密室在等待。你们中的一人必须打开道路。为更大的利益而牺牲。”
70012.name: 渗透的死亡（B组）
70012.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison.
70012.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，一位调查员必须发动毒之密室上的[action]能力。

70013.back_text:
如果你“已将艾克索多隆的宠物送往另一组”： 随机选择另一组。在本轮结束时，该组将其放在一边的艾克索多隆的宠物放置在其一个迷宫走廊，处于生成状态。结算场景3设置。
如果艾克索多隆的宠物在胜利区：
生物无力地瘫倒在地，你终于松了一口气。
结算场景3设置。
如果以上情况均不符合：
生物撞破饲养箱的玻璃，饥饿地猛扑向附近的人。
将艾克索多隆的宠物移动到饥饿密室。它依次攻击饥饿密室的每位调查员。结算场景3设置。
70013.flavor: 发光的文字继续出现在便笺上：“前方密室住着我珍贵的宠物。他非常饥饿。也许你们该打开他的门，让他进食。”
70013.name: 宠物（C组）
70013.real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Find a way to deal with Eixodolon's Pet before the agenda advances. (Beware - If the creature is still "locked away" when the agenda advances, it will break free.)
70013.text: 限时 - 在收到指示前，不要推进本场景。密谋推进前，设法处理艾克索多隆的宠物。(注意：若密谋推进时该生物仍“被锁起来”，它将挣脱束缚。)

70014.back_text:
如果任意幸存组游戏区域内的任意艾克索多隆仍有生命值：
那身影穿过时空扭曲、闪烁。
将本场景翻回正面。
如果其他每个幸存组的艾克索多隆均没有剩余生命值： - 如果你的组是唯一幸存的组，前往(→结局2)。 - 如果仅有两组幸存，这两组前往(→结局3)。 - 如果三组均幸存，三组均前往(→结局4)。
70014.flavor: “你们已接近自由。”那身影扭曲的声音噼啪作响。“你们的声音中仍有希望吗？眼中仍有光芒吗？”
70014.name: 逃离
70014.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if Eixodolon has no remaining health, you may move any damage on him in excess of his health to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Then, advance.
70014.text: 目标 - 在本轮结束时，如果艾克索多隆没有剩余生命值，你可以将其身上超过其生命值的任意伤害移动到另一组的艾克索多隆上。然后，推进。

70015.back_text:
如果你以独立模式进行游戏： 前往(→结局2)。
如果你以小型战役模式进行游戏，且这是第一个或第二个进行游戏的组： 以新的一组开始游戏，以确定最终达成的结局。
如果你以小型战役模式进行游戏，且这是第三个进行游戏的组： - 如果仅有一组幸存，前往(→结局2)。 - 如果有两组幸存，前往(→结局3)。 - 如果三组均幸存，前往(→结局4)。
70015.flavor: “你们已接近自由。”那身影扭曲的声音噼啪作响。“你们的声音中仍有希望吗？眼中仍有光芒吗？”
70015.name: 逃离
70015.real_text: Objective - If Eixodolon has no remaining health, advance.
70015.text: 目标 - 如果艾克索多隆没有剩余生命值，推进。

70016.back_flavor: 密室被严密封闭，没有出口，只有一侧墙上的奇形钥匙孔。生锈的铜管沿着房间的墙壁和天花板铺设，将你团团围住。
70016.flavor:
墙上潦草地写着一则粗陋的便条：“右”。
或许这是个线索……但指向什么？
70016.name: 密藏密室
70016.real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
70016.text: [action]：你用拳头捶打密室的墙壁。没有人回应。

70017.back_flavor: 密室被严密封闭，没有出口，只有一侧墙上的奇形钥匙孔。生锈的铜管沿着房间的墙壁和天花板铺设，将你团团围住。
70017.flavor:
墙上潦草地写着一则粗陋的便条：“中”。
或许这是个线索……但指向什么？
70017.name: 密藏密室
70017.real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
70017.text: [action]：你用拳头捶打密室的墙壁。没有人回应。

70018.back_flavor: 密室被严密封闭，没有出口，只有一侧墙上的奇形钥匙孔。生锈的铜管沿着房间的墙壁和天花板铺设，将你团团围住。
70018.flavor:
墙上潦草地写着一则粗陋的便条：“左”。
或许这是个线索……但指向什么？
70018.name: 密藏密室
70018.real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.
70018.text: [action]：你用拳头捶打密室的墙壁。没有人回应。

70019.back_flavor: 水从密室墙壁倾泻而下，灌满了舱室。令你恐惧的是，水流没有停止。
70019.name: 雨之密室
70019.real_text: The Chamber of Rain is sealed shut while the water flows. While it is Act 1, this location gains: "Investigators cannot move into or out of this location. Forced - When an investigator here draws an enemy card: Discard it and draw a new card to replace it."
70019.text: 水流不断时，雨之密室保持封闭。场景1期间，本地点获得： “调查员不能移入或移出本地点。 强制 - 本地点的一位调查员抽取一张敌人卡牌时：弃掉该卡牌，并抽取一张新卡牌替代之。”

70020.back_flavor: 这间密室内有数个带玻璃窗的金属水箱，其中大多数装满了水。你看见里面有动物的尸体，它们一定经历了缓慢而痛苦的溺亡。究竟什么样的人会想看这种事……？
70020.name: 悲伤密室
70020.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (1) to try to break down the door to the flooding terrarium. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, it does not budge. Remember that you "tried your best."
70020.text: [action]：检定[combat](1)，尝试打破通往进水饲养箱的门。无论你成功或失败，它都纹丝不动。记录你“已尽力而为”。

70021.back_flavor: 这间密室内有数个带玻璃窗的金属水箱，其中大多数装满了水。你看见里面有动物的尸体，它们一定经历了缓慢而痛苦的溺亡。究竟什么样的人会想看这种事……？
70021.name: 悲伤密室
70021.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to interpret the diagram inscribed on the glass. If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on an investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain (or from that location if you are the only investigator in the game). Any investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain may perform this action.
70021.text: [action]：检定[willpower](2)，尝试解读刻在玻璃上的图样。如果你成功，控制悲伤密室或雨之密室中一位调查员身上的1个线索（如果你是游戏中唯一的调查员，则控制这些地点上的1个线索）。悲伤密室或雨之密室的任意调查员均可执行此行动。

70022.back_flavor: 这间储藏室唯一的光源来自几支零散的蜡烛。板条箱、瓶子和盒子从四面八方包围着你，但在昏暗的光线下，你几乎什么都看不见。
70022.flavor: 这间黑暗密室中的木架腐朽得厉害，居然还能承受物品而不散架，令你十分惊讶。
70022.name: 夜之密室
70022.real_text: [action]: You call out for help as loud as you can. Nobody responds.
70022.text: [action]：你尽可能大声地呼救。没有人回应。

70023.back_flavor: 这间储藏室唯一的光源来自几支零散的蜡烛。板条箱、瓶子和盒子从四面八方包围着你，但在昏暗的光线下，你几乎什么都看不见。
70023.name: 夜之密室
70023.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, you notice strange writing inscribed along the wall; look at the revealed side of the location underneath the scenario reference card. When you are satisfied, place it back underneath the scenario reference card.
70023.text: [action]：检定[intellect](4)。如果你成功，注意到墙上刻有奇怪的文字；查看剧本参考卡下方地点的已揭示面。查看完毕后，将该地点放回剧本参考卡下方。

70024.back_flavor: 石墙内凹陷出一间小型壁橱般的密室，里面有三个没有标记的拉杆。一扇升起的铁门仿佛威胁着：若你胆敢踏入其中，它就会将密室封死。
70024.back_text: 悔恨密室内同时至多有一位调查员。
70024.name: 悔恨密室
70024.real_text:
No more than one investigator may be in the Chamber of Regret at a time.
[action] The investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You pull one of the 3 levers (choose one): left, middle, or right. As soon as you do, the gate slams shut behind you. You cannot leave the Chamber of Regret for the remainder of the current act.
70024.text:
悔恨密室内同时至多有一位调查员。
[action]调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：你拉动3个拉杆中的一个（选择一项）：左、中或右。你一这么做，身后的铁门立刻砰然关闭。本场景剩余时间内，你不能离开悔恨密室。

70025.back_flavor: 波纹钢板和混凝土构成的走廊遍布这座诡异的工业设施。无数上锁的门和死路让你觉得自己永远无法逃脱。
70025.flavor: 你继续深入走廊，腐臭的气味扑面而来。
70025.name: 迷宫走廊
70025.real_text: [fast] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: You find an old lockbox in a pile of refuse, and decide to leave something behind. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator draws 2 cards. (Group limit once per game.)
70025.text: [free]选择并弃掉你手牌中的2张卡牌：你在一堆废物中发现一个旧锁箱，决定留下些东西。在本轮结束时，选择任意一组的另一位调查员。该调查员抽取2张卡牌。(每组每场游戏限一次。)

70026.back_flavor: 波纹钢板和混凝土构成的走廊遍布这座诡异的工业设施。无数上锁的门和死路让你觉得自己永远无法逃脱。
70026.flavor: 形容枯槁的生物尸体填满了这片设施，有些本属自然，有些则诡异莫名。
70026.name: 迷宫走廊
70026.real_text: [fast] Spend 4 resources: You find the corpse of someone you think you once knew, and wish you could have saved them. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator gains 4 resources. (Group limit once per game.)
70026.text: [free]花费4资源：你发现一具似曾相识之人的尸体，希望自己本能救下他们。在本轮结束时，选择任意一组的另一位调查员。该调查员获得4资源。(每组每场游戏限一次。)

70027.back_flavor: 波纹钢板和混凝土构成的走廊遍布这座诡异的工业设施。无数上锁的门和死路让你觉得自己永远无法逃脱。
70027.flavor: 你继续穿行走廊，发现苔藓、霉菌和常春藤沿着墙壁与地面蔓延。
70027.name: 迷宫走廊
70027.real_text: [action] [action]: You peer through an overgrown mirror and see an unfamiliar reflection. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator may take 2 additional actions during his or her next turn. (Group limit once per game.)
70027.text: [action][action]：你透过一面长满植物的镜子窥视，看见陌生的倒影。在本轮结束时，选择任意一组的另一位调查员。该调查员在其下个回合可以进行额外2次行动。(每组每场游戏限一次。)

70028.back_flavor: 此处是一座生物展览馆，有些自然，有些污秽畸形。一个怪物看见你进入后，猛撞自己笼子的玻璃。
70028.flavor: 这里就像为施虐狂准备的动物园。
70028.name: 饥饿密室
70028.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Hunger: There is something strange drawn on the glass. Take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram.
70028.text: [free]如果饥饿密室上没有线索：玻璃上画着奇怪的东西。控制放在一边的饥饿图样。

70029.back_flavor: 这间房内摆满成排的植物，形态、品种各异，分别处于生长或腐朽的不同阶段。房间中央附近有一块控制面板，覆盖着神秘的拉杆和刻度盘。
70029.flavor: 空气浓稠而潮湿，刺痛你的双眼，让你无法控制地咳嗽。
70029.name: 腐朽密室
70029.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Decay: There's a journal here with some strange scribblings. Take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram.
70029.text: [free]如果腐朽密室上没有线索：此处有一本写着奇怪涂鸦的日记。控制放在一边的腐朽图样。

70030.back_flavor: 这间密室堆满垃圾、污泥和人类遗骸。酸腐刺鼻的气味灼烧着你的鼻腔。
70030.flavor: 地板上的活板门通向下方一间独立的密室。
70030.name: 腐烂密室
70030.real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Rot: There is something strange etched on the walls. Take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram.
70030.text: [free]如果腐烂密室上没有线索：墙上刻着奇怪的东西。控制放在一边的腐烂图样。

70031.back_flavor: 一架凸起的梯子通向一间混凝土密室的中部，密室内充满冒泡的污泥，散发着令人作呕的恶臭。
70031.back_text: 通往毒之密室的梯子必须降下。作为进入毒之密室的额外费用，腐烂密室的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。
70031.flavor: 黄绿色的污泥可怖地冒泡翻涌。坑的对面有一块控制面板，上面只有一个铜制阀门。
70031.name: 毒之密室
70031.real_text: [action]: You cross the noxious pit and turn the valve at the end. (Beware - activating this ability without the antidote may be deadly.)
70031.text: [action]：你穿过有毒的坑，转动尽头的阀门。(注意：没有解药时发动此能力可能致命。)

70032.flavor: 另外两扇厚重的保险库门通向废弃仓库，严密地锁着。你能听见另一侧和周围传来的声音，仿佛横跨多个维度。
70032.name: 废弃仓库

70033.back_text:
如果你在B组：
逐渐被水灌满的舱室玻璃上刻着图样，你看见它开始发光。
本组每位调查员可以立刻互相交换线索。将任意数量的线索从雨之密室移动到悲伤密室，或反之亦然。将本卡牌翻回正面。
如果你在A组：
符文发出光芒，一块墙壁滑开，露出装满小饰物的秘密隔间。
将奥秘之钥放置入场，放在密藏密室。将本卡牌翻回正面。
如果你在C组：
你所在密室中的符文移动，组成一个单词。
你看见的单词与A组游戏区域内密藏密室墙上刻的单词相同（你可以查看A组游戏区域）。将本卡牌翻回正面。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
If you are in Group B:
Etched upon the glass of the capsule slowly filling with water, you can see a blueprint begin to glow.
Each investigator in this group may immediately trade clues among one another. Move any number of clues from Chamber of Rain to Chamber of Sorrows, or vice-versa. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group A:
The runes glow, and a piece of the wall slides to reveal a secret compartment, filled with trinkets.
Put the Key of Mysteries into play at the Chamber of Secrets. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group C:
The runes in your chamber shift to form a word.
The word you see is the same word inscribed upon the wall of the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area (you may examine Group A's play area) Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
If you are in Group B:

Etched upon the glass of the capsule slowly filling with water, you can see a blueprint begin to glow.

Each investigator in this group may immediately trade clues among one another. Move any number of clues from Chamber of Rain to Chamber of Sorrows, or vice-versa. Flip this card back over.

If you are in Group A:

The runes glow, and a piece of the wall slides to reveal a secret compartment, filled with trinkets.

Put the Key of Mysteries into play at the Chamber of Secrets. Flip this card back over.

If you are in Group C:

The runes in your chamber shift to form a word.

The word you see is the same word inscribed upon the wall of the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area (you may examine Group A's play area) Flip this card back over.

70033.name: 奥术符文
70033.real_text:
In your chamber, you see a set of arcane runes etched upon the wall. If you can decode them and set them in the correct order, perhaps it will change something...
Revelation - Attach Arcane Runes to a [[Distortion]] location. [fast] If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: sTte[intellect])3(. fI uoy ucdee,cs ceapl 1 cesueorr no tsih cr.ad If an investigator in this group has successfully resolved the above ability, this card gains: "[action]: es)3T[intellect](t. oYu ancnto mctmio rdcsa ot htsi klisl e.tts fI uyo duec,esc ealcp 1 srcrouee no nhotera ugpro's coyp fo raeAnc nRues."
70033.text:
你在密室中看见一组刻在墙上的奥术符文。若能将它们破译并按正确顺序排列，或许会改变什么……
显现 - 将奥术符文附属到一个[[扭曲]]地点。 [free]如果本卡牌上有1[per_investigator]资源：将其翻面并遵循其背面的指示。 [action]：定检[intellect])3(。果如你功成，置放1源资在此卡上。 如果本组一位调查员成功结算了上述能力，本卡牌获得：“[action]：定检[intellect])3(。你不能将卡牌投入本次技能检定。果如你功成，置放1源资在另一组的奥术符文上。”

70034.back_flavor: 你发现自己身处一个枢纽般的地方，一条位于以太之中的通路。其他囚徒也找到了这里。或许你们能合作找到逃脱的方法。
70034.back_text: 每位进入裂隙的调查员拿走本剧情卡牌，远离各组私下会面。裂隙中的调查员可以自由交谈，并可以交换任意数量的线索、资源、手牌或其控制的剧情支援。调查员满意后，每位调查员回到其原本的组。将本卡牌翻回正面。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.

Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.

70034.name: 裂隙
70034.real_text:
With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through...
Revelation - Attach The Rift to the current act. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 3 doom on each group's agenda: The rift opens wide enough for an investigator to step through. Choose an investigator at any location to enter the rift. Then, that investigator flips this card over and follows the instructions on its other side.
70034.text:
一道闪光之后，附近墙壁上开始裂开一道缝隙，能量慢慢凝聚成传送门的形状。它现在太小，无法进入，但很快就足以让人穿过……
显现 - 将裂隙附属到当前场景。如果是场景1，B组和C组将放在一边的奥秘之钥放置入场，放在一个[[扭曲]]地点。 强制 - 在本轮结束时，如果每组的密谋上均至少有3个毁灭标记：裂隙张开到足以让一位调查员穿过。选择任意地点的一位调查员进入裂隙。然后，该调查员将本卡牌翻面并遵循其背面的指示。

70035.back_flavor: 物品顺着井道滚落，在墙后和地板下发出巨大的撞击声。希望另一组能找到它们……
70035.back_text:
拿走本卡牌上或下方的卡牌、标记和便笺，将它们放在另一组的通风井副本上或下方。
将本卡牌翻回正面。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
The objects tumble down through the shaft, making loud banging noises behind the walls and underneath the floor. Hopefully another group can find them...
Take the cards, tokens, and notes on or underneath this card and place them on or underneath another group's copy of The Vent. Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
The objects tumble down through the shaft, making loud banging noises behind the walls and underneath the floor. Hopefully another group can find them...

Take the cards, tokens, and notes on or underneath this card and place them on or underneath another group's copy of The Vent.

Flip this card back over.

70035.name: 通风井
70035.real_text:
You find a ventilation shaft through which you can fit some important items...
Revelation - Place The Vent in a [[Distortion]] location. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at that location. [fast]: Place any number of your resource tokens or clues on this card, and/or place any number of [[Item]] assets you control underneath this card. You may also place a written note underneath this card. [action]: Take control of any number of tokens, cards, or notes on/underneath this card. [reaction] At the end of the round: You send all of the tokens and cards gathered here through the ventilation shaft. Flip this card over and follow the instructions on the other side.
70035.text:
你发现一条通风井，可以放进一件或多件重要物品……
显现 - 将通风井放在一个[[扭曲]]地点。如果是场景1，B组和C组将放在一边的奥秘之钥放置入场，放在该地点。 [free]：将任意数量的资源标记或线索放在本卡牌上，和/或将任意数量你控制的[[道具]]支援放在本卡牌下方。你也可以将一张写下的便笺放在本卡牌下方。 [action]：控制任意数量本卡牌上或下方的标记、卡牌或便笺。 [reaction]在本轮结束时：你将聚集在此处的所有标记和卡牌通过通风井送出。将本卡牌翻面并遵循其背面的指示。

70036.back_flavor: 你在便笺上写下“我选择死亡”。你的文字下方出现更多文字，拼成一句回应：“你真的以为我会让你这么轻易地死去吗？”
70036.back_text:
你必须选择并弃掉你手牌中除X张外的所有卡牌，并移除你资源池中除X个外的所有资源。X为当前密谋上的毁灭标记数量。
向每组大声读出下列文字：
便笺上的文字和字母移动、变化，组成一幅奇怪的图样。
A组的调查员队长控制放在一边的腐烂图样。 B组的调查员队长控制放在一边的饥饿图样。 C组的调查员队长控制放在一边的腐朽图样。 将每组的两难抉择副本从游戏中移除。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
You write "I choose death" on the note. Words appear just below yours, spelling out a sentence in reply. "Did you really think I would let you die that easily?"
You must choose and discard all but X cards from your hand, and remove all but X resources from your resource pool. X is the amount of doom on the current agenda.
Read the following to each group aloud:
The words and letters on the note shift and change to form a strange diagram.
The lead investigator of Group A takes control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. The lead investigator of Group B takes control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. The lead investigator of Group C takes control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove each group's copy of The Dilemma from the game.
linked_card.text:
You write "I choose death" on the note. Words appear just below yours, spelling out a sentence in reply. "Did you really think I would let you die that easily?"

You must choose and discard all but X cards from your hand, and remove all but X resources from your resource pool. X is the amount of doom on the current agenda.

Read the following to each group aloud:

The words and letters on the note shift and change to form a strange diagram.

The lead investigator of Group A takes control of the set-aside Rot Diagram.

The lead investigator of Group B takes control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram.

The lead investigator of Group C takes control of the set-aside Decay Diagram.

Remove each group's copy of The Dilemma from the game.

70036.name: 两难抉择
70036.real_text:
Glowing words appear on your group's note as though written by an unseen entity. It reads: "Worry not. I shall give your friends a chance to escape. All you have to do is perish at their expense, and they will be given the means to escape. Just write 'I choose death' on this note here, and the deed will be done."
Revelation - Put The Dilemma into play, next to the act deck. The current act gains: "[reaction] At the end of the round: Desperate, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for the benefit of the other groups. Flip The Dilemma over and follow the instructions on the other side."
70036.text:
你们组的便笺上浮现出发光的文字，仿佛出自某个看不见的实体：“别担心。我会给你的朋友一个逃脱机会。你只需为他们而死，他们就会获得逃脱的方法。只要在这张便笺上写下‘我选择死亡’，事情就办成了。”
显现 - 将两难抉择放置入场，放在场景牌库旁。 当前场景获得：“[reaction]在本轮结束时：绝望之下，你愿意为其他组的利益牺牲自己。将两难抉择翻面并遵循其背面的指示。”

70037.back_flavor: 你一穿过闸门，它就消失在身后。暂时只能靠你自己了……
70037.back_text:
根据你所在的组，将一个不同地点放置入场，如下：
- 如果你在A组，将腐烂密室放置入场。
- 如果你在B组，将饥饿密室放置入场。
- 如果你在C组，将腐朽密室放置入场。
与每个敌人脱离交战，并移动到刚放置入场的地点。
当前密谋上至少有5个毁灭标记前，该地点不视为与任何其他地点连接。
将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
As soon as you step through the gate, it vanishes behind you. You are on your own, for now...
Depending on which group you are in, put a different location into play, as follows: - If you are in Group A, put the Chamber of Rot into play. - If you are in Group B, put the Chamber of Hunger into play. - If you are in Group C, put the Chamber of Decay into play. Disengage from each enemy and move to the location just put into play. Until there is at least 5 doom on the current agenda, that location is not considered to be connected to any other location. Remove this card from the game.
linked_card.text:
As soon as you step through the gate, it vanishes behind you. You are on your own, for now...

Depending on which group you are in, put a different location into play, as follows:

- If you are in Group A, put the Chamber of Rot into play.

- If you are in Group B, put the Chamber of Hunger into play.

- If you are in Group C, put the Chamber of Decay into play.

Disengage from each enemy and move to the location just put into play.

Until there is at least 5 doom on the current agenda, that location is not considered to be connected to any other location.

Remove this card from the game.

70037.name: 闸门
70037.real_text:
You notice a doorway in your chamber that wasn't there before. On the other side, the hall is pitch black. Where does it lead?
Revelation - Attach The Gate to a [[Distortion]] location. [action] Spend 1 clue: You enter the doorway. Flip this story card over and follow the instructions on its other side.
70037.text:
你注意到密室中多了一扇原本不存在的门。门的另一侧是漆黑的走廊。它通向哪里？
显现 - 将闸门附属到一个[[扭曲]]地点。 [action]花费1个线索：你进入门内。将本剧情卡牌翻面并遵循其背面的指示。

70038.back_flavor: 密室中的符文发光，墙上拼出一则奇怪的信息。
70038.back_text:
如果你在A组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的腐烂图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
如果你在B组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的饥饿图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
如果你在C组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的腐朽图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

linked_card.name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
linked_card.real_text:
The runes in the chamber glow, and a strange message is spelled out across the wall.
If you are in Group A: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group B: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group C: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
linked_card.text:
The runes in the chamber glow, and a strange message is spelled out across the wall.

If you are in Group A:

Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. Remove this card from the game.

If you are in Group B:

Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. Remove this card from the game.

If you are in Group C:

Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove this card from the game.

70038.name: 加密符文
70038.real_text:
In your chamber, you see three lines of strange glyphs etched upon the wall. One line seems brighter than the others.
Revelation - Attach Encrypted Glyphs to a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - If there is at least 1 horror and 1 [per_investigator] damage on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to attempt to decipher the glyphs. If you succeed, place 1 damage on this card. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to move the glyphs to their proper order. If you succeed, place 1 horror on each group's copy of Encrypted Glyphs.
70038.text:
你在密室中看见墙上刻着三行奇怪的符号，其中一行似乎比其他两行更明亮。
显现 - 将加密符文附属到一个[[扭曲]]地点。 强制 - 如果本卡牌上至少有1点恐惧和1[per_investigator]点伤害：将其翻面并遵循其背面的指示。 [action]：检定[intellect](2)，尝试破译符文。如果你成功，在本卡牌上放置1点伤害。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)，将符文移至正确顺序。如果你成功，在每组的加密符文副本上放置1点恐惧。

70039.flavor: A@ B# C% D< E+ F= G~ H> I\ J3 K7 L2 M6 N1 O9 P4 Q8 R5 S[survivor] T[willpower] U[cultist] V[elder_thing] W[intellect] X[tablet] Y[auto_fail] Z[elder_sign] 1T 2R 3H 4D 5U 6P 7Q 8Z 9B [action][action]
70039.name: 艾克索多隆的便笺
70039.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Eixolodon's Note to another investigator.
70039.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将艾克索多隆的便笺交给另一位调查员控制。

70040.name: 奥秘之钥
70040.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Place Key of Mysteries at your location. While the Key of Mysteries is uncontrolled, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the Key of Mysteries."
70040.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将奥秘之钥放在你所在地点。 奥秘之钥未被控制时，它获得：“[action]：调查。如果你成功，改为不发现线索，而是控制奥秘之钥。”

70041.name: 神秘注射器
70041.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Mysterious Syringe to another investigator. [action]: Choose an investigator at your location and remove Mysterious Syringe from the game. Remember that the chosen investigator has "been injected"
70041.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将神秘注射器交给另一位调查员控制。 [action]：选择你所在地点的一位调查员，将神秘注射器从游戏中移除。记录所选调查员“已被注射”。

70042.flavor: 或许有一组能看懂这个？
70042.name: 腐烂图样
70042.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Rot Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Decay, it gains: "[action]: Place 1 doom here. Flip any number of your clues to their doom side and place them here."
70042.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将腐烂图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于腐朽密室时，它获得：“[action]：在此处放置1个毁灭标记。将你任意数量的线索翻到毁灭面并放置在此处。”

70043.name: 腐烂图样
70043.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Rot Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Rot, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the set-aside Mysterious Syringe."
70043.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将腐烂图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于腐烂密室时，它获得：“[action]：调查。如果你成功，改为不发现线索，而是控制放在一边的神秘注射器。”

70044.flavor: 或许有一组能看懂这个？
70044.name: 饥饿图样
70044.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Hunger Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Rot, it gains: "[action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, take control of the set-aside Mysterious Syringe."
70044.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将饥饿图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于腐烂密室时，它获得：“[action]：调查。如果你成功，改为不发现线索，而是控制放在一边的神秘注射器。”

70045.name: 饥饿图样
70045.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Hunger Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Hunger, it gains: "[action] If Eixodolon's Pet is 'locked away,' spend 1 clue: Deal 4 damage to Eixodolon's Pet."
70045.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将饥饿图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于饥饿密室时，它获得：“[action]如果艾克索多隆的宠物“被锁起来”，花费1个线索：对艾克索多隆的宠物造成4点伤害。”

70046.flavor: 或许有一组能看懂这个？
70046.name: 腐朽图样
70046.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Hunger, it gains: "[action] If Eixodolon's Pet is 'locked away,' spend 1 clue: Deal 4 damage to Eixodolon's Pet."
70046.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将腐朽图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于饥饿密室时，它获得：“[action]如果艾克索多隆的宠物“被锁起来”，花费1个线索：对艾克索多隆的宠物造成4点伤害。”

70047.name: 腐朽图样
70047.real_text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Decay, it gains: "[action]: Place 1 doom here. Flip any number of your clues to their doom side and place them here."
70047.text: 强制 - 你被击败时：将腐朽图样交给另一位调查员控制。 你位于腐朽密室时，它获得：“[action]：在此处放置1个毁灭标记。将你任意数量的线索翻到毁灭面并放置在此处。”

70048.name: 艾克索多隆
70048.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate. Eixodolon gets +6 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if there is a copy of Harvested Pain in the victory display: Ready Eixodolon.
70048.subname: 你的痛苦即是我的力量
70048.text: 猎手。反击。 艾克索多隆得到+6[per_investigator]生命，且不能因伤害被击败。 强制 - 敌军阶段开始时，如果胜利区有一张收割的痛苦：重整艾克索多隆。
70048.traits: 类人. 仆从. 精英

70049.name: 艾克索多隆的宠物
70049.real_text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
While Eixodolon's Pet is "locked away," it is immune to player card effects and Chamber of Hunger gains: "[action] Investigators at Chamber of Hunger spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Set Eixodolon's Pet aside, out of play. Remember that you "sent Eixodolon's Pet to another group."
70049.subname: 你不是它的第一个受害者，也不会是最后一个
70049.text:
猎手。反击。
艾克索多隆的宠物“被锁起来”时，其免疫玩家卡牌效果，且饥饿密室获得：“[action]饥饿密室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将艾克索多隆的宠物放在一边，位于场外。记录你“已将艾克索多隆的宠物送往另一组”。”

70050.name: 艾克索多隆的宠物
70050.real_text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
While Eixodolon's Pet is "locked away," it is immune to player card effects.
70050.subname: 你不是它的第一个受害者，也不会是最后一个
70050.text:
猎手。反击。
艾克索多隆的宠物“被锁起来”时，其免疫玩家卡牌效果。

70051.name: 狱卒
70051.real_text: Spawn - Nearest Labyrinthine Halls. Hunter. Eixodolon's Note gains: "[action] Fight. Use only on The Jailor. Use either [willpower] or [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, set The Jailor aside, out of play. At the end of the round, move The Jailor to another group's Labyrinthine Halls (it keeps all tokens and attachments)."
70051.text: 生成 - 最近的迷宫走廊。 猎手。 艾克索多隆的便笺获得：“[action]攻击。仅可对狱卒使用。本次攻击使用[willpower]或[combat]。如果你成功，将狱卒放在一边，位于场外。在本轮结束时，将狱卒移动到另一组的迷宫走廊(其保留所有标记和附属卡牌)。”

70052.name: 无面掳掠者
70052.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[Prison]] location. Hunter. Forced - After Faceless Abductor attacks an investigator: Move that investigator to a [[Prison]] location.
70052.text: 生成 - 最近的[[牢房]]地点。 猎手。 强制 - 无面掳掠者攻击一位调查员后：将该调查员移动到一个[[牢房]]地点。

70053.name: 受折磨的受害者
70053.real_text: Revelation - You must either discard a random card from your hand, or Tortured Victim makes an immediate attack against you.
70053.text: 显现 - 你必须随机弃掉你手牌中的一张卡牌，或受折磨的受害者立刻攻击你。

70054.name: 米戈守卫
70054.real_text: Prey - Most remaining health. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token revealed during an attack against Mi-Go Guard, that attack deals 1 fewer damage.
70054.text: 猎物 - 剩余生命值最高。 攻击米戈守卫期间，每揭示一个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]标记，该次攻击少造成1点伤害。

70055.name: 非自然的疲惫
70055.real_text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must choose a different option: - Lose 3 resources. - Lose 1 action. - Discard a random card from your hand.
70055.text: 险境。 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你每低于难度1点，必须选择一项不同的选项： - 失去3资源。 - 失去1次行动。 - 随机弃掉你手牌中的一张卡牌。

70056.name: 毒气
70056.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, lose 1 action (2 actions instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.
70056.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你失败，失去1次行动（如果你低于难度至少2点失败，改为失去2次行动）。本次技能检定开始时，你所在地点的一位调查员可以将其1个线索放在你所在地点，使本次检定难度-2。

70057.name: 可怕的机关
70057.real_text: Revelation - Put Dreadful Mechanism into play in your threat area. Forced - After you perform an action other than the [action] ability below: Take 1 damage, discard an asset taking up at least 1 hand slot, and discard Dreadful Mechanism. [action]: Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, discard Dreadful Mechanism.
70057.text: 显现 - 将可怕的机关放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你执行下方[action]能力以外的一次行动后：受到1点伤害，弃掉一个占用至少1个手部槽位的支援，并弃掉可怕的机关。 [action]：检定[combat](2)。如果你成功，弃掉可怕的机关。

70058.name: 鲜血与锈蚀
70058.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 damage (2 damage instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.
70058.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你失败，受到1点伤害（如果你低于难度至少2点失败，改为受到2点伤害）。本次技能检定开始时，你所在地点的一位调查员可以将其1个线索放在你所在地点，使本次检定难度-2。

70059.name: 悖论效应
70059.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you succeed, put Paradox Effect into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Paradox Effect and choose an investigator in another group. You and that investigator may talk in private and may exchange resources, story assets, and cards in hand.
70059.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。如果你成功，将悖论效应放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在本轮结束时：弃掉悖论效应并选择另一组的一位调查员。你与该调查员可以私下交谈，并可以交换资源、剧情支援和手牌。

70060.flavor:
现实摇曳。
现实分裂。
现实重组，悖论崩塌。
70060.name: 悖论效应
70060.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
70060.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。

70061.name: 收割的痛苦
70061.real_text: Peril. Revelation - If you have 3 or fewer remaining health or sanity, add Harvested Pain to the victory display. Otherwise, take 1 damage and 1 horror. While Harvested Pain is in the victory display, Eixodolon gets +1 fight.
70061.text: 险境。 显现 - 如果你的剩余生命值或神智值不超过3，将收割的痛苦加入胜利区。否则，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。 收割的痛苦在胜利区时，艾克索多隆得到战斗值+1。

71001.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前密谋编号加1。
[cultist]：-X。X为你所在地点的剧情支援数量。
[tablet]：-3（如果你位于[[私人]]地点，改为-5）。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你失败，或无血者在你所在地点，受到1点恐惧。
71001.name: 仲冬晚会
71001.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of [[Guest]] assets at your location (to a maximum of 5).
[tablet]: -2. (-4 instead if you are at a [[Private]] location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail or if The Bloodless Man is at your location, take 1 horror.
71001.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前密谋编号。
[cultist]：-X。X为你所在地点的[[宾客]]支援数量（最多为5）。
[tablet]：-2。（如果你位于[[私人]]地点，改为-4。）
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失败，或无血者在你所在地点，受到1点恐惧。

71002.back_flavor: 庄园深处传来一声巨响，紧接着是尖叫。德克兰·皮尔斯现身安抚舞厅中的人群，但你不禁注意到，戴面具的侍从已分别守在庄园的每个出口前。
71002.back_text: 将每个放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人、两张恶毒伏击诡计，以及遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
71002.flavor: 这场晚会注定充满阴谋与奇观，秘密和低语将如饮品与音乐一般，成为娱乐的一部分。
71002.name: 戴面具的狂欢者
71002.real_text: Each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be dealt damage. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
71002.text: 每个[[灯笼会]]敌人不能受到伤害。 卡牌效果不能从本密谋移除毁灭标记。 强制 - 一个单面[[宾客]]支援将要离场时：改为其被咒缚(将其翻至背面，失去对其的控制，并治愈其所有伤害和恐惧)。

71003.back_text:
如果无血者(无声潜伏者)在场：
你转身，看见无血者带着杀意大步朝你走来。还来不及反应，这个高大的身影便踉跄了一下，脸朝下倒在红地毯上。

片刻后，尖锐的裂帛声打破寂静。闪亮的附肢从无血者破裂的西装和四肢中钻出，绽放为由血肉和扭动触手组成的骇人混合体。那生物的骨白色面具从梦魇般的肢体和咬合的尖牙之口中俯视着你，令你胃中翻腾。
将无血者(无声潜伏者)翻至(释放)面。
否则：
你周围的喧嚣似乎暂时平息了。
每位调查员可以治愈其所在地点一位调查员或[[宾客]]支援的1点恐惧。
71003.flavor: 庄园深处开始骚动，许多宾客要求侍从放他们出去。其他宾客则目光呆滞、神情空洞地在庄园中游荡。
71003.name: 不速之客
71003.real_text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
71003.text: 每个[[灯笼会]]敌人的谈判能力不能发动。 卡牌效果不能从本密谋移除毁灭标记。 强制 - 一个单面[[宾客]]支援将要离场时：改为其被咒缚(将其翻至背面，失去对其的控制，并治愈其所有伤害和恐惧)。

71004.back_flavor: 恶臭弥漫在曾经庄严的宅邸中。越来越多梦魇般的生物扑向受伤或晕眩的宾客，你冲出藏身处，直奔出口。一只贪婪的怪物嗅到你的气味，死死追赶你到出口。你撞破厚实的玻璃窗，摔在一堆覆着薄雪的血肉尸体上时，感觉到它的利爪已经扼住你的喉咙。
71004.back_text: 每位调查员被击败，并遭受1点精神创伤。
71004.flavor: 派对彻底陷入混乱，宾客们为逃离异界怪物，纷纷撞破玻璃门窗冲出庄园。
71004.name: 致命派对
71004.real_text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
71004.text: 每个[[灯笼会]]敌人的谈判能力不能发动。 卡牌效果不能从本密谋移除毁灭标记。 强制 - 一个单面[[宾客]]支援将要离场时：改为其被咒缚(将其翻至背面，失去对其的控制，并治愈其所有伤害和恐惧)。

71005.back_flavor: 你与联系人会见几位宾客，他们都确认德克兰·皮尔斯从舞厅的陈列柜中取走了宝石。此外，庄园二楼开始传出奇怪的声响……
71005.back_text: 随机选择一个放在一边的[[二楼]]地点，将其直接放置入场，位于门厅正上方。本场游戏剩余时间内，该地点与门厅视为连接，反之亦然。将另外2个放在一边的地点依次放置入场，位于先前放置的[[二楼]]地点右侧。 将放在一边的对手剧情卡牌放置入场，放在密谋旁，对手面朝上，并遵循其冒险设置文字。 阅读幕间故事：传说中的宝石(第13页)。
71005.flavor: 你注意到宝石已经不在舞厅中。也许有宾客看见是谁把它拿走了？
71005.name: 会面寒暄
71005.real_text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. [action] If you control a [[Guest]] asset: Give control of it to another investigator at your location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator controls a [[Guest]] asset and the current agenda is 2a or 3a, they may spend the requisite amount of clues, as a group, to advance.
71005.text: [[宾客]]支援不占用盟友槽位。 [action]选择你所在地点的一个[[宾客]]支援及其上的一个技能图标：谈判。检定该技能(3)。如果你成功，控制该支援。 [action]如果你控制一个[[宾客]]支援：将其交给你所在地点的另一位调查员控制。 目标 - 如果每位未被击败的调查员均控制一个[[宾客]]支援，且当前密谋为2a或3a，他们可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

71006.back_flavor: 你踉跄着走进寒冷的夜色，深吸一口气。厚厚的雪落在原本洁净、如今已被鲜血染红的草坪上。庄园在你身后死一般寂静。萨纳斯之宝在你掌心搏动着异界光芒，片刻间，你感到一阵温暖的微风，带着另一个既熟悉又如梦似幻之地的气息。这颗宝石值得如此巨大的毁灭吗？
71006.flavor: 无论代价如何，你都必须帮助你的联系人及其同伴。
71006.name: 寻找宝石
71006.real_text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. Objective - Complete the objective on your faction story card, and try to accomplish as many tasks as you can (see page 24 of the rulebook).
71006.text: [[宾客]]支援不占用盟友槽位。 [action]选择你所在地点的一个[[宾客]]支援及其上的一个技能图标：谈判。检定该技能(3)。如果你成功，控制该支援。 目标 - 完成你的阵营剧情卡牌上的目标，并尽力完成尽可能多的任务(参见规则书第24页)。

71007.back_flavor: 豪宅的正门通向一间摆满艺术品、宾客和华丽吊灯的房间。给自己拿杯饮料吧，今晚可能会很漫长。
71007.flavor: 冬日的寒意渗入你的骨髓。有什么不对劲。
71007.name: 门厅
71007.real_text: [fast] If the current agenda is 2a or 3a, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Someone is fashionably late. Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
71007.text: [fast]如果当前密谋为2a或3a，花费1[per_investigator]资源：有人时髦地迟到了。揭示宾客牌库顶的卡牌，并将其放置入场，放在本地点。(每组每轮限一次。)

71008.back_flavor: 当你把手放在这间寂静圣所的门把上时，感到一阵冰冷的寒意。
71008.back_text: 作为进入本地点的额外费用，你必须受到1点恐惧。
71008.name: 灯笼密室
71008.real_text:
[fast] During your turn, name a card: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If it is the named card, cancel its effects and discard it. Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per turn.)
[action] If this location has no clues: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, flip over any spellbound card.
71008.text:
[fast]在你回合期间，命名一张卡牌：抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。如果该卡牌是所命名卡牌，取消其效果并将其弃掉。在本地点发现1个线索。(每回合限一次。)
[action]如果本地点没有线索：检定[willpower](4)。如果你成功，将任意一张被咒缚的卡牌翻面。
71008.traits: 庄园. 私人. 地下室

71009.back_flavor: 庄严的走廊中充满音乐与欢笑声。
71009.flavor: 这里展出的藏品独一无二。
71009.name: 美术馆
71009.real_text: [action]: There's more to be discovered in this room full of strange works of art. Place up to 2 clues (from the token pool) on this location. Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
71009.text: [action]：这间房中满是奇异的艺术作品，还有更多有待发现。在本地点放置至多2个线索(从标记池中)。获得2资源。(每组每轮限一次。)

71010.back_flavor: 庄严的走廊中充满音乐与欢笑声。
71010.flavor: 他们正在演奏不甚知名的作曲家E.赞恩所作的《D小调梦与狂想》。
71010.name: 舞厅
71010.real_text: [action]: Parley. You persuade two of the guests to have a dance. Exhaust 2 [[Guest]] assets at this location. Then, heal 1 horror from each of them.
71010.text: [action]：谈判。你说服两位宾客共舞。横置本地点的2个[[宾客]]支援。然后，分别治愈它们的1点恐惧。

71011.back_flavor: 庄严的走廊中充满音乐与欢笑声。
71011.name: 酒吧
71011.real_text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Buy a drink! Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
71011.text: [fast]花费1资源：买杯饮料！治愈本地点一位调查员或[[宾客]]支援的1点伤害或1点恐惧。(每组每轮限一次。)

71012.name: 卧室
71012.real_text: [action] Choose an enemy at any [[Second Floor]] location: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 clue for this attack to deal +2 damage. (Limit once per turn.)
71012.text: [action]选择任意[[二楼]]地点的一个敌人：攻击。本次攻击中，你可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。如果你检定成功，可以花费1个线索，使本次攻击造成伤害+2。(每回合限一次。)
71012.traits: 庄园. 私人. 二楼

71013.name: 图书馆
71013.real_text:
You get +1 skill value while parleying at this location.
[fast] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either place 1 damage on the Jewel of Sarnath or remove 1 token from it. (Group limit once per game.)
71013.text:
你在本地点谈判时得到技能值+1。
[fast]如果萨纳斯之宝在本地点：检定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，选择一项：在萨纳斯之宝上放置1点伤害，或从其上移除1个标记。(每组每场游戏限一次。)
71013.traits: 庄园. 私人. 二楼

71052.text: 显现 - 将萨纳斯之宝放置入场，受你控制，其上有3点伤害和1个毁灭标记。 强制 - 萨纳斯之宝离场时：将其混洗入遭遇牌库。 [fast]横置萨纳斯之宝：检定[willpower]或[agility](1)。如果你成功，将其上的1个标记移动到你所在地点的一个敌人上。

If you fail and... - ...The Bloodless Man is at your location, a [[Guest]] asset you control becomes spellbound. - ...The Bloodless Man is at another location, he readies, moves (one location at a time) until he reaches your location, and engages you. - ...The Bloodless Man is not in play, Entrap gains surge.
71055.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](3)。如果你失败且…… - ……无血者在你所在地点，一个你控制的[[宾客]]支援被咒缚。 - ……无血者在另一个地点，其重整，每次移动一个地点，直至其到达你所在地点并与你交战。 - ……无血者不在场，诱捕获得涌动。

71056.name: 难以解释的寒冷
71056.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must choose one: - Choose and discard 1 card from your play area. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. - Take 1 damage.
71056.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。你每低于难度1点，必须选择一项： - 选择并弃掉你游戏区域的一张卡牌。 - 选择并弃掉你手牌中的一张卡牌。 - 受到1点伤害。

71057.name: 心智抽取
71057.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is 1 plus the current agenda number. If you fail, take 2 horror. Then, if The Bloodless Man is in play and an investigator controls The Pale Lantern, flip it over and attach it to The Bloodless Man (leaving all tokens on it).
71057.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)。X为当前密谋编号加1。如果你失败，受到2点恐惧。然后，如果无血者在场且一位调查员控制苍白灯笼，将其翻面并附属到无血者(保留其上的所有标记)。

71058.name: 有毒烟雾
71058.real_text: Revelation - In player order, each investigator at your location must choose: - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to flee before the gas fills the room. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 2 damage. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to hold your breath. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
71058.text: 显现 - 按玩家顺序，你所在地点的每位调查员必须选择一项： - 检定[agility](3)，尝试在毒气充满房间前逃离。如果你成功，移动到一个连接地点。如果你失败，受到2点伤害。 - 检定[combat](3)，尝试屏住呼吸。你每低于难度1点，受到1点伤害。

71059.name: 推入彼界
71059.real_text: Revelation - Choose and shuffle a non-story asset you control into its owner's deck. Discard the top 3 cards of that deck. If a copy of that asset is discarded, take 2 horror.
71059.text: 显现 - 选择一个你控制的非剧情支援，将其混洗入其拥有者的牌库。弃掉该牌库顶3张卡牌。如果弃掉了该支援的一个副本，受到2点恐惧。

71060.name: 密门
71060.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the location with the most investigators, and without a Secret Door attached. Investigators cannot leave this location. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to search for the passage or [intellect] (3) to discern the way out. If you succeed, discard Secret Door.
71060.text: 显现 - 附属到调查员最多且没有附属密门的地点。 调查员不能离开本地点。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)，寻找通道；或检定[intellect](3)，辨明出路。如果你成功，弃掉密门。

71061.name: 恐惧之门
71061.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if a [[Rival]] enemy is in play. If you fail and you allied with... - ...the [guardian] faction, take 2 damage. - ...the [seeker] faction, discard 2 cards from your hand. - ...the [rogue] faction, lose 3 resources. - ...the [mystic] faction, take 2 horror. - ...the [survivor] faction, lose 1 action.
71061.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](2)。如果场上有[[对手]]敌人，本次检定难度+2。如果你失败且你与……结盟： - ……[guardian]阵营，受到2点伤害。 - ……[seeker]阵营，弃掉你手牌中的2张卡牌。 - ……[rogue]阵营，失去3资源。 - ……[mystic]阵营，受到2点恐惧。 - ……[survivor]阵营，失去1次行动。

71062.name: 暴力命令
71062.real_text: Revelation - Put Violent Commands into play in your threat area. [action]: Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location and discard Violent Commands. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.
71062.text: 显现 - 将暴力命令放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 [action]：对你所在地点的一位调查员造成2点伤害，并弃掉暴力命令。 强制 - 在你回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你失败，受到1点恐惧。
