87033.name: 苦涩的竞争
87033.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below.
Past: Set Thoman Corrigan aside, out of play; he has been abducted. Place Mary Zielinski at Arkham Gazette. Set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
87033.text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你对应时代的指示。
过去：将托马斯·科里根放在一边，位于场外；他已被绑架。将玛丽·杰林斯基放置入场，位于阿卡姆公报。将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一边，位于场外。
现在和未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一边，位于场外；他们已被绑架。如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一边，位于场外。

87034.back_text: [action][action]：重整艾德温·贝内特，将其移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：谈判。进行一次[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费X个线索，其中X为全局玩家人数。然后，在他身上放置1个资源，作为救赎。 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3个或更多救赎，且他与托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于任意米斯卡塔尼克大学，他得到救赎。移除他身上的所有救赎并将他翻面。将每个时代的本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
87034.flavor: 艾德温·贝内特对旧日同事的怨恨已然失控，必须尽快制服他。你毫不退缩，决心恢复他的理智，化解这场复仇。

linked_card.name: Redeem a Former Colleague
linked_card.real_text: [action] [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend X clues, as a group where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a redemption. Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 or more redemption on him and he is at any Miskatonic University with Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski, he is redeemed. Remove all redemption from him and flip him over. Add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era).

If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Parley. Test (3) or (3). If you succeed, spend X clues, as a group where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a redemption.

Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 or more redemption on him and he is at any Miskatonic University with Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski, he is redeemed. Remove all redemption from him and flip him over. Add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.

87034.name: 救赎旧日同事
87034.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Set Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; she has been abducted. Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. Spawn the Edwin Bennet enemy at Miskatonic University.
Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
87034.text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你对应时代的指示，然后将本剧情卡牌翻面。
过去：将玛丽·杰林斯基放在一边，位于场外；她已被绑架。将托马斯·科里根放置入场，位于童年之家。如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一边，位于场外。
现在：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一边，位于场外；他们已被绑架。将艾德温·贝内特敌人生成在米斯卡塔尼克大学。
未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一边，位于场外；他们已被绑架。如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一边，位于场外。

87035.back_text: [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点且处于重整状态：谈判。将你的1个线索放在他身上。你可以进行一次[intellect](4)检定。如果你成功，再将你的1个线索放在他身上。如果你失败，将其横置。 [action]：重整并将艾德温·贝内特移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 强制 - 一轮结束时：移除艾德温·贝内特上的1个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为移除2个线索)。如果你无法如此做，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 艾德温·贝内特将要被绑架时：改为移除其所有伤害和恐惧，并在当前密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。 目标 - 如果"托马斯和玛丽获得了诺贝尔奖。"，且任意时代的场上都没有[[情节]]剧情卡牌，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
87035.flavor: 过去的一切似乎都没有异常。你不禁怀疑艾德温·贝内特是否值得信任。他渊博的知识无疑能在帮助你时发挥极大作用。尽管不情愿，你还是说服自己，回报值得冒险；但要阻止艾德温背叛你，还得费尽唇舌。

linked_card.name: Uneasy Alliance
linked_card.real_text: [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location and he is ready: Parley. Place 1 of your clues on him. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, place 1 more of your clues on him. If you fail, exhaust him. [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your loaction (even if he is in another era). Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 clue from Edwin Bennet (2 clues instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode). If you cannot, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - When Edwin Bennet would be abducted: Remove all damage and horror from him and place 2 doom on the current agenda instead. Objective - If "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize" and there is no [[Plot]] story card in play in any era, add this story card to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
If Edwin Bennet is at your location and he is ready: Parley. Place 1 of your clues on him. You may test (4). If you succeed, place 1 more of your clues on him. If you fail, exhaust him.

: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your loaction (even if he is in another era).

Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 clue from Edwin Bennet (2 clues instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode). If you cannot, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

Forced - When Edwin Bennet would be abducted: Remove all damage and horror from him and place 2 doom on the current agenda instead.

Objective - If "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize" and there is no Plot story card in play in any era, add this story card to the victory display.

87035.name: 不安的联盟
87035.real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. Place Mary Zielinski at O'Malley's Watch Shop. Place the Edwin Bennet asset at Arkham Gazette with 12 clues on him, then remove 3 [per_investigator] clues from him.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet asset aside, out of play.
87035.text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你对应时代的指示，然后将本剧情卡牌翻面。
过去：将托马斯·科里根放置入场，位于童年之家。将玛丽·杰林斯基放置入场，位于奥马利钟表店。将艾德温·贝内特支援放置入场，位于阿卡姆公报，在他身上放置12个线索，然后从他身上移除3[per_investigator]个线索。
现在和未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一边，位于场外；他们已被绑架。如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，将艾德温·贝内特支援放在一边，位于场外。

87038.back_text: 有异常地点上的能力不能触发。 [action]花费任意数量的线索：进行一次[willpower](3)或[agility](3)检定。以此方式每花费1个线索，你本次检定得到+3技能值。如果你成功，移除你所在地点的1个异常(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为移除2个异常)。然后，如果你成功超过难度至少4点，且"科里根工业成立"，移除任意时代中一处与本地点同名地点上的1个异常。 目标 - 如果当前密谋为2a，且每个地点均没有异常，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
87038.flavor: 看似随机的异常现象正在影响时空。阿卡姆各处的怪异热点扰乱了日常生活，令居民惶恐不安。显然，这些异常始于米斯卡塔尼克大学；有些人将这种扭曲归咎于科学大楼实验室中的禁忌实验。

linked_card.name: Anomalies in Spacetime
linked_card.real_text: Abilities on locations with an anomaly cannot be triggered. [action] Spend any number of clues: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). You get +3 skill value to this test for each clue spent this way. If you succeed, remove 1 anomaly from your location (2 anomalies instead if you succeed by 3 or more). Then, if you succeed by 4 or more and "Corrigan Industries has been founded," remove 1 anomaly from a location with the same title as your location, in any era. Objective - If it is agenda 2a and each location has no anomalies, add this story card to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
Abilities on locations with an anomaly cannot be triggered.

Spend any number of clues: Test (3) or (3). You get +3 skill value to this test for each clue spent this way. If you succeed, remove 1 anomaly from your location (2 anomalies instead if you succeed by 3 or more). Then, if you succeed by 4 or more and "Corrigan Industries has been founded," remove 1 anomaly from a location with the same title as your location, in any era.

Objective - If it is agenda 2a and each location has no anomalies, add this story card to the victory display.

87038.name: 时空异常
87038.real_text: Setup: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on each Miskatonic University location, as anomalies. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, also place 1 [per_investigator] horror on the following locations, as anomalies: Arkham Gazette, Arkham Advertiser, O'Malley's Watch Shop, and Tick-Tock Club. Remove the following enemies from the game: Tyr'thrha, Old Sadie Sheldon, and all 3 copies of Sheldon Gang. Flip this story card over.
87038.text: 冒险设置：在每个米斯卡塔尼克大学地点上放置1[per_investigator]点恐惧，作为异常。如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，也在以下地点上各放置1[per_investigator]点恐惧，作为异常：阿卡姆公报、阿卡姆广告报、奥马利钟表店和滴答俱乐部。 将以下敌人移出游戏：提尔斯哈、老萨迪·谢尔顿和全部3名谢尔顿帮。将本剧情卡牌翻面。

87039.back_text: [action]如果"债务已偿还"，作为团队花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查找游戏区域、遭遇牌库或遭遇弃牌堆，找出一名谢尔顿帮敌人，将其加入胜利牌区。如果查找遭遇牌库，将其混洗。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果全部3名谢尔顿帮敌人均位于胜利牌区，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
87039.flavor: 非常时期只能行非常之事。你别无选择，只得去找臭名昭著的犯罪头目老萨迪·谢尔顿。谢尔顿以私运大量加拿大威士忌而闻名，他和手下帮派为急需借款的人备有一大笔现金。只是务必及时偿还这位脾气暴躁的老大的债务……

linked_card.name: Mob Troubles
linked_card.real_text: [action] If "the debt has been paid," spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the play area, encounter deck, or encounter discard pile for a Sheldon Gang enemy and add it to the victory display. If you searched the encounter deck, shuffle it. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity. Objective - If all 3 Sheldon Gang enemies are in the victory display, add this story card to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
If "the debt has been paid," spend 1 clues, as a group: Search the play area, encounter deck, or encounter discard pile for a Sheldon Gang enemy and add it to the victory display. If you searched the encounter deck, shuffle it. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity.

Objective - If all 3 Sheldon Gang enemies are in the victory display, add this story card to the victory display.

87039.name: 黑帮麻烦
87039.real_text: Setup: Set the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Tyr'thrha enemy from the game. You make a deal with Old Sadie Sheldon: each investigator playing the present era gains 2 resources.
87039.text: 冒险设置：将老萨迪·谢尔顿敌人和全部3名谢尔顿帮敌人放在一边，位于场外。将提尔斯哈敌人移出游戏。你与老萨迪·谢尔顿达成交易：每位处于现在时代的调查员获得2个资源。

87040.name: 老萨迪·谢尔顿
87040.real_text: Aloof. Each Sheldon Gang enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group, to add Old Sadie Sheldon to the victory display and announce "the debt has been paid."
87040.text: 冷漠。 每名谢尔顿帮敌人得到战斗+1、躲避+1。 [action]：谈判。进行一次[intellect](2)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费3[per_investigator]个资源，将老萨迪·谢尔顿加入胜利牌区，并宣告"债务已偿还。"
87040.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙

87041.name: 谢尔顿帮
87041.real_text: Surge. Hunter. Massive. Sheldon Gang gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at Sheldon Gang's location plays a card: Ready Sheldon Gang and discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way into play at that location.
87041.text: 涌动。猎手。庞大。 谢尔顿帮得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 谢尔顿帮所在地点的一位调查员打出卡牌后：重整谢尔顿帮，并弃掉遭遇牌库顶的3张卡牌。将以此方式弃掉的每名[[罪犯]]敌人放置入场，位于该地点。
87041.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙. 精英

87042.back_text: [action]如果提尔斯哈位于你所在地点，花费1个线索：进行一次[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，对提尔斯哈造成2点伤害(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为3点伤害)。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果提尔斯哈被击败，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
87042.flavor:
廷达洛斯中极度扭曲的时空影响了其中的一切。萨提尔和廷达洛斯猎犬并非唯一游荡在角度时间领域中的存在：有一个比它们大上不知多少倍、也强大得多的存在，甚至能扭曲时空本身。
那些不断行走于这座巨大迷宫路径上的人，必将招致此地主人的愤怒；而没有什么能比得上廷达洛斯大领主的怒火。

linked_card.name: Unspeakable Abomination
linked_card.real_text: [action] If Tyr'thrha is at your location, spend 1 clue: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, deal 2 damage to Tyr'thrha (3 damage instead if you succeed by 3 or more). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Objective - If Tyr'thrha is defeated, add this story card to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
If Tyr'thrha is at your location, spend 1 clue: Test (3). If you succeed, deal 2 damage to Tyr'thrha (3 damage instead if you succeed by 3 or more). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Objective - If Tyr'thrha is defeated, add this story card to the victory display.

87042.name: 不可名状的怪物
87042.real_text: Setup: Set the Tyr'thrha enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy from the game.
87042.text: 冒险设置：将提尔斯哈敌人放在一边，位于场外。将老萨迪·谢尔顿敌人和全部3名谢尔顿帮敌人移出游戏。

87043.name: 提尔斯哈
87043.real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). *Tyr'thrha has a global health pool of 6 [per_investigator]. Forced - When Tyr'thrha enters a location: Each [[Scientist]] asset at that location is abducted.
87043.text: 庞大。反击。巡逻(最近的有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 *提尔斯哈拥有6[per_investigator]的全局生命池。 强制 - 提尔斯哈进入一个地点时：位于该地点的每张[[科学家]]支援被绑架。
87043.traits: 古神. 廷达洛斯. 精英

87044.name: 可怕的萨提尔
87044.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Ghastly Satyr gets +1 fight while it is at a [[Past]] location and +2 fight while it is at a [[Present]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Ghastly Satyr is ready: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location.
87044.text: 巡逻(最近的有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 可怕的萨提尔位于[[过去]]地点时得到战斗+1，位于[[现在]]地点时得到战斗+2。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时，如果可怕的萨提尔处于重整状态：对其所在地点的每张[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。
87044.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯

87045.name: 廷达洛斯猎犬
87045.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Hound of Tindalos gets +1 health while it is at a [[Present]] location and +2 health while it is at a [[Future]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Hound of Tindalos is ready: Deal 1 horror to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location, and move each [[Scientist]] asset and investigator at its location to Tindalos.
87045.text: 巡逻(最近的有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 廷达洛斯猎犬位于[[现在]]地点时得到生命+1，位于[[未来]]地点时得到生命+2。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时，如果廷达洛斯猎犬处于重整状态：对其所在地点的每张[[科学家]]支援造成1点恐惧，并将其所在地点的每张[[科学家]]支援和调查员移动到廷达洛斯。
87045.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯

87046.name: 多角之物
87046.real_text: Spawn - Tindalos. Hunter. While Many-Angled Thing is at a... - ...[[Past]] location, it gets +1 evade and gains alert. - ...[[Present]] location, it gets +1 damage and +1 horror. - ...[[Future]] location, it gets +1 fight and gains retaliate.
87046.text: 生成 - 廷达洛斯。 猎手。多角之物位于…… - ……[[过去]]地点时，得到躲避+1并获得警戒。 - ……[[现在]]地点时，得到伤害值+1、恐惧值+1。 - ……[[未来]]地点时，得到战斗+1并获得反击。
87046.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯. 精英

87047.name: 廷达洛斯阿尔法
87047.real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Tindalos Alpha attacks you: Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. Discard Tindalos Alpha. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Tindalos Alpha.
87047.text: 警戒。反击。 强制 - 廷达洛斯阿尔法攻击你后：将你控制的一张非剧情支援混洗入你的牌库，将该支援上的所有伤害和恐惧转移至你的调查员。弃掉廷达洛斯阿尔法。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时：弃掉廷达洛斯阿尔法。
87047.traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯

87048.flavor: 我们曾将时间设想为一条从一点向下一点延伸的直线。真相却截然不同。
87048.name: 时间裂缝
87048.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
87048.text: 显现 - 进行一次[willpower](3)检定。你每低于难度1点，必须失去1次行动或受到1点恐惧。

87049.flavor: 往来于猎犬领域的人，可能会成为被追猎的目标。
87049.name: 被绑架
87049.real_text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no [[Ally]] assets at your location, Abducted gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (5). If you fail, exhaust all [[Ally]] assets at your location and deal 5 horror to one of them.
87049.text: 凶险。 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有[[盟友]]支援，被绑架获得涌动。否则，进行一次[willpower](5)检定。如果你失败，横置你所在地点的所有[[盟友]]支援，并对其中一张造成5点恐惧。

87050.name: 破碎空间
87050.real_text: Revelation - If you are at a... - ...[[Past]] location, lose 3 resources. - ...[[Present]] location, place 2 of your clues on it. - ...[[Future]] location, lose 1 action.
87050.text: 显现 - 如果你位于…… - ……[[过去]]地点，失去3个资源。 - ……[[现在]]地点，将你的2个线索放置在此。 - ……[[未来]]地点，失去1次行动。

87051.name: 维度裂缝
87051.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Portal]] location. Place 1 doom on Dimensional Breach. Each enemy at attached location gets +1 fight, +1 evade, and +1 health. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Dimensional Breach.
87051.text: 显现 - 叠加到最近的[[传送门]]地点。在维度裂缝上放置1个毁灭标记。 被叠加地点的每名敌人得到战斗+1、躲避+1、生命+1。 [action]：进行一次[willpower](3)检定。如果你成功，弃掉维度裂缝。

87052.name: 来自各个角度
87052.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail and you are at a... - ...[[Past]] location, exhaust all assets at it. - ...[[Present]] location, take 1 direct damage. Deal 1 damage to each [[Ally]] asset at your location. - ...[[Future]] location, take 1 direct horror. Deal 1 horror to each [[Ally]] asset at your location.
87052.text: 显现 - 进行一次[agility](4)检定。如果你失败，且位于…… - ……[[过去]]地点，横置该地点的所有支援。 - ……[[现在]]地点，受到1点直接伤害。对你所在地点的每张[[盟友]]支援造成1点伤害。 - ……[[未来]]地点，受到1点直接恐惧。对你所在地点的每张[[盟友]]支援造成1点恐惧。

87053.name: 迷失于时间
87053.real_text: Revelation - Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. If no asset is shuffled into your deck by this effect, choose and discard 3 cards from your hand.
87053.text: 显现 - 将一张你控制的非剧情支援混洗入你的牌库，将该支援上的所有伤害和恐惧转移至你的调查员。如果没有支援因本效果混洗入牌库，选择并弃掉3张手牌。

87054.name: 时间线融合
87054.real_text: Revelation - Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. For each card in your hand that matches one of the discarded cards (by title), discard that card from your hand and lose 1 action. Shuffle each weakness discarded by this effect into your deck.
87054.text: 显现 - 弃掉你牌库顶的5张卡牌。你手牌中每有一张与被弃掉卡牌(名称)相同的卡牌，弃掉该卡牌并失去1次行动。将以此效果弃掉的每张弱点混洗入你的牌库。

87055.flavor: 门的另一边有引人向往的目的地……也可能是可怕猎犬咆哮的巨颚。
87055.name: 开启传送门
87055.real_text: Revelation - Take 1 damage. Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 additional damage and move to Tindalos.
87055.text: 显现 - 受到1点伤害。进行一次[agility](3)检定。如果你失败，额外受到1点伤害，并移动到廷达洛斯。

87056.name: 时间扭曲
87056.real_text: Revelation - Attach to the current agenda. Abilities on story cards cannot be triggered. [action]: If you are at a [[Past]] location, you may test [willpower] (2). If you are at a [[Present]] location, you may test [agility] (3). If you are at a [[Future]] location, you may test [combat] (4). If you succeed at 1 or more of these tests, discard Temporal Distortion.
87056.text: 显现 - 叠加到当前密谋。 剧情卡牌上的能力不能触发。 [action]：如果你位于[[过去]]地点，可以进行一次[willpower](2)检定；如果位于[[现在]]地点，可以进行一次[agility](3)检定；如果位于[[未来]]地点，可以进行一次[combat](4)检定。如果你成功通过其中一项或更多检定，弃掉时间扭曲。

87057.name: 消失的历史
87057.real_text: Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Discard a non-story [[Item]] asset you control. - Choose and discard 3 non-weakness cards from your hand.
87057.text: 显现 - 你必须选择一项： - 弃掉你控制的一张非剧情[[道具]]支援。 - 选择并弃掉你手牌中的3张非弱点卡牌。

88001.back_text:
困难 / 专家
[skull]：-X。X等同于你的警戒等级。
[cultist]：再抽取一个标记。如果你检定失败，将你的警戒等级提升1。
[tablet]：-4。最近的敌人朝你移动一次。
[elder_thing]：-6。你可以将你的警戒等级提升1，改为自动成功。
88001.name: 时运与愚行
88001.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you.
[elder_thing]: -5. You may raise your alarm level by 1 to automatically succeed, instead.
88001.text:
简单 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X等同于你的警戒等级的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：再抽取一个标记。如果你检定失败，将你的警戒等级提升1。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，最近的敌人朝你移动一次。
[elder_thing]：-5。你可以将你的警戒等级提升1，改为自动成功。

88002.back_flavor: 你越来越频繁地感受到守卫和发牌员投来的视线。在一个阴暗角落，有一群便衣保全正在交头接耳。当你与他们视线交错，其中一人抬手指向你，接着他们开始朝你的方向走来……
88002.back_text: 如果调查员作为团队持有10[per_investigator]或更多资源，请记住你"满载而归"。(→结局1)
88002.flavor: 你走进轮盘挑战的大门。如果你想带走时运泉源，就必须多了解这座赌场，以及经营它的邪教。
88002.name: 警觉的庄家
88002.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
88002.text: 强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：每位与一名重整状态的[[赌场]]敌人位于同一地点的调查员将自己的警戒等级提升1。 强制 - 一位调查员击败一名[[赌场]]敌人后：该调查员的警戒等级提升1。

88003.back_flavor: 一道声音从轮盘桌传来，响彻整个大厅："红色19！"桌子附近有人兴奋地大喊。片刻后，同一声音再次响起："又是红色19！"你周围传来窃窃私语，这种情况几乎不可能发生。一瞬间，你感到周围的空气仿佛破裂，却摇摇头不予理会。大厅气氛快要恢复正常时，同样的声音难以置信地大喊："红色19！这是第三次了！"这次你无法再忽视碎裂的感觉；碎裂声变得更密集，四周一切突然变模糊。视线恢复后，一只超乎想象的恐怖生物出现在赌场中央，居高临下盯着周遭人类。你的心情沉到谷底，想起伊萨玛拉说过那个遗物可能带来灾难。更糟的是，你很清楚那场灾难会降临在不受泉源拥有者欢迎的人身上。
88003.back_text: 将放在一旁的异空间漫步者生成到轮盘赌桌。将遭遇弃牌堆与放在一旁的无序计划遭遇组混洗入遭遇牌库。 将每位调查员的警戒等级提升1。
88003.flavor: 今晚的赌场一片忙碌，对你和你的团队来说是最好的掩护。希望你计划许久的行动能成功。
88003.name: 掀开底牌
88003.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
88003.text: 强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：每位与一名重整状态的[[赌场]]敌人位于同一地点的调查员将其警戒等级提升1。 强制 - 一位调查员击败一名[[赌场]]敌人后：该调查员的警戒等级提升1。

88004.back_flavor: 就在你以为情况不可能更糟时，赌场气氛突然改变，犹如暴风雨前的宁静。接着，如同窒息者奋力争取最后一丝气息，不幸的风暴在人群中爆发……
88004.back_text:
混洗放在一旁的3张时运不济剧情卡牌，随机选择1张并结算其文字。
将每位调查员的警戒等级提升1。
88004.flavor: 这场劫案的棘手程度，是你从未预料过的。恐怖的怪物在赌场大厅出现，但赌客们似乎毫无所觉；赌场员工依旧将注意力放在寻找可疑活动上。难道他们都看不见自己身处危险之中吗？
88004.name: 转折点
88004.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
88004.text: 强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：每位与一名重整状态的[[赌场]]敌人位于同一地点的调查员将其警戒等级提升1。 强制 - 一位调查员击败一名[[赌场]]敌人后：该调查员的警戒等级提升1。

88005.back_flavor: 你绝望地想要逃脱，但你的运气终究用尽。几个佩戴熟悉护身符的邪教徒挡在你面前。身后，可怕的生物在赌场中肆虐，四周一片混乱。群众和赌场保全终于意识到有恐怖存在在他们之间穿梭。你尽全力击退邪教徒和怪物，侥幸逃出生天。
88005.back_text: 每位未撤退的调查员被击败，并受到1点肉体创伤。(→结局3)
88005.flavor: 邪教与你为敌；超越时空而来的怪物与你为敌；现在连运气本身都与你为敌。你早就知道这一切不会这么容易。
88005.name: 梭哈
88005.real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
88005.text: 强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：每位与一名重整状态的[[赌场]]敌人位于同一地点的调查员将其警戒等级提升1。 强制 - 一位调查员击败一名[[赌场]]敌人后：该调查员的警戒等级提升1。

88006.back_flavor: 离开赌场前，你回头看了最后一眼。你很有自信，发牌员和保全只看见你扮演的角色：又一个满怀希望的普通赌客。不管今晚在牌桌上输赢如何，你真正的奖品是搜集到的信息。你希望这些足够让你为即将到来的惊世劫案做好准备。
88006.back_text: 每位被击败的调查员将其警戒等级提升2。 如果调查员作为团队持有10[per_investigator]或更多资源，请记住你"满载而归"。(→结局2)
88006.flavor: 你必须步步为营，引起不必要的注意可能会导致计划胎死腹中。
88006.name: 编织计划
88006.real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
88006.text: [reaction]你触发一个[[游戏]]地点上的[action]能力后：移除时运泉源上的1个线索(如果你从[[游戏]]地点的能力获得资源，改为移除2个线索)。 目标 - 在被注意到前尽可能完成最多任务并离开！如果每位未被击败的调查员都撤退，推进。

88007.back_text:
如果阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加仍在场……
正当你准备庆祝胜利时，一个声音从身后的门边传来："你跑进我的赌场，还想偷走我的东西？"阿巴兰站在门边，全身因愤怒而颤抖。"你会毁了我的心血！我不会让你得逞！"他所有文明的伪装都已撕裂，露出危险本质。
将阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加(失控的阿巴兰)移动到遗物室。
如果阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加在胜利牌区……
一个愤怒的声音嘶声道："我不会让你带走它！"阿巴兰不知为何仍能站着，倚靠在你身后的门廊边。即使他看起来摇摇欲坠，眼中的恨意仍在沸腾。你还来不及阻止，他的手已捶向墙上某个机关，然后倒地不起。大片钢制天花板开始从头顶砸落……
每位调查员必须进行一次[agility](3)检定。每位检定失败的调查员受到2点伤害。
88007.flavor: 行动开始。你必须开启金库的门，找出时运泉源的位置，通过它的秘法防护，然后设法打开存放它的容器。
88007.name: 好戏上场
88007.real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.
88007.text: [reaction]你触发一个[[游戏]]地点上的[action]能力后：移除时运泉源上的1个线索(如果你从[[游戏]]地点的能力获得资源，改为移除2个线索)。 目标 - 如果有调查员控制时运泉源，推进。

88008.back_flavor: 你曾一瞬间觉得自己不可能完好如初地逃出赌场、保有肉体和灵魂的完整，但你做到了。感觉像是一场梦，但还能清楚听见赌场中的骚动声。是时候离开，并消失得无影无踪了。
88008.back_text: 每位未撤退的调查员被击败，并受到1点肉体创伤。(→结局1)
88008.flavor: 进来是一回事；出去又是另一回事了。你现在必须带着你的战利品逃离，感觉像是整座赌场都挡在你与自由之间。
88008.name: 出口
88008.real_text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)
88008.text: 每个[[赌场]]敌人失去冷漠和巡逻。 每个[[赌场]]敌人获得猎手和"猎物 - 控制时运泉源的调查员。" 目标 - 如果控制时运泉源的调查员撤退，推进。(小心，任何尚未撤退的调查员都会被留下！)

88009.flavor: 站在赌场大厅中央令人眼花缭乱，到处都是富丽堂皇的装饰和大呼小叫的热情赌客。

linked_card.name: Casino Floor
linked_card.real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)
linked_card.text:
: Resign. It's time to get out of here!

If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Casino enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)

88009.name: 赌场大厅
88009.real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action]: Place an asset from your hand or play area facedown beneath Casino Floor, as part of your crew's "stash for the heist." (Limit once per turn.)
88009.text: [action]：撤退。是时候离开这里了！ [action]：从你手牌或游戏区域将一张支援面朝下放到赌场大厅下方，作为你团伙"为劫案藏匿"的一部分。(每回合限一次。)

88010.back_flavor: 扑克一直都是热门游戏，每张桌子都坐满来自世界各地的赌客。筹码相互碰撞的声音，无论出于快乐或不情愿，每一声都代表着对抗命运的赌注。空气中烟雾萦绕，充满紧张的汗味，还有虚张声势的紧绷。
88010.flavor: 奥马哈扑克，没什么好顾虑的，赌注比天高。
88010.name: 扑克赌桌
88010.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.
88010.text: [action]花费2资源：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子，或至少3张卡牌大小相同，获得5资源。
88010.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

88011.back_flavor: 轮盘游戏是赌客间最热门的游戏，似乎也是经营者的偏好。毕竟蒙特卡罗的这家赌场就是以此命名的。
88011.flavor: 红还是黑，哪个才是你的幸运色？
88011.name: 轮盘赌桌
88011.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.
88011.text: [action]花费1资源：声明一个颜色和一个大小。然后，弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。如果其颜色与大小都和你的声明相符，获得5资源。
88011.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

88012.back_flavor: 百家乐近百年，甚至更长的时间中，都在法国的贵族与上流社会十分流行。即使在这座赌场中也是如此，衣着华丽、出手阔绰的客人们聚集在百家乐桌边。
88012.name: 百家乐
88012.real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.
88012.text: [action]花费2资源：声明"玩家"、"庄家"或"平局"。弃掉遭遇牌库顶的2张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果其大小总和大于18，"玩家"获胜；小于18，"庄家"获胜；等于18，则为"平局"。如果结果与声明相符，获得4资源。
88012.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

88013.back_flavor: 墙边放着一排机器，等着贪婪的灵魂上钩，引诱他们沉浸在无尽的投币与拉杆中。不需要任何技巧或知识，只要放手臣服于命运的操弄。
88013.name: 拉霸机
88013.real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.
88013.text: [action]花费1资源：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的3张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果3张卡牌的花色全部相同，或大小全部相同，获得3资源。
88013.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

linked_card.name: High Roller's Table
linked_card.real_text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."
linked_card.text: Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."

88014.name: 高注赌桌
88014.real_text: [action] If there are no clues here, spend 4 resources: Remember that you "impersonated a high roller." Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 of the cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources.
88014.text: [action]如果此处没有线索，花费4资源：请记住你"扮演高额赌客"。弃掉遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子、花色全部相同，或其中4张卡牌大小相同，获得8资源。
88014.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

88015.flavor: 这个奢华的区域提供美味佳肴，宽敞的舞台能容纳各种余兴节目，无数桌椅提供讨论生意的空间——无论合不合法。

linked_card.name: Casino Lounge
linked_card.real_text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.
linked_card.text:
If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.)

While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.

88015.name: 赌场交谊厅
88015.real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Casino Lounge: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "found a vent."
88015.text: [action]如果赌场交谊厅上没有线索：进行一次[agility](3)检定。如果你成功，请记住你"找到通风口"。

88016.back_flavor: 通往管制区域的门透着亮光……你必须找个办法在无人看守入口时偷偷溜进去。
88016.back_text: 作为进入员工通道的额外费用，位于连接地点的调查员必须作为团队共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
88016.name: 员工通道
88016.real_text: Forced - When Staff Access Hallway is revealed: Spawn Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) at Owner's Office. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Fortune's Chosen encounter set into the encounter deck.
88016.text: 强制 - 员工通道被翻开时：将阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加(失控的阿巴兰)生成到老板办公室。将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一旁的时运之选遭遇组一同混洗入遭遇牌库。

88017.back_flavor: 门上的牌子写着"监控室"。你听说他们有某种办法监视整个赌场，也许门后会有答案？
88017.name: 监控室
88017.real_text: [action]: Choose 1, 2, or 3. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If an icon matches the rank of an enemy in play, remember that you "observed the staff." If the combined value of the discarded cards is 19 or higher, draw the top card in the encounter discard pile.
88017.text: [action]：选择1、2或3张。从遭遇牌库顶弃掉该数量的卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果有图示与场上一名敌人的大小相符，请记住你"监视员工们"。如果其大小总和大于等于19，抽取遭遇弃牌堆顶的1张卡牌。

88018.back_flavor: 透过门缝，你看见一个满是保全制服与装备的房间。
88018.name: 守卫室
88018.real_text:
[action] If all of the following are true, remember that you "impersonated a guard:"
- There are no enemies at Guard Room.
- There are no clues remaining on Guard Room.
- An investigator "obtained an employee uniform."
88018.text:
[action]如果以下所有条件均满足，请记住你"伪装成守卫"：
- 守卫室没有敌人。
- 守卫室上没有剩余线索。
- 有调查员"取得员工制服"。

88019.back_flavor: 门上的名牌写着"阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加"。里面一定藏着重要的秘密或宝物，如果你能设法进去的话……
88019.back_text: 老板办公室被锁上了。作为进入老板办公室的额外费用，位于连接地点的调查员必须作为团队共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索，除非有调查员"盗取阿巴兰的钥匙"。
88019.flavor: 阿巴兰办公室中的抽屉和保险箱都上了锁。办公室另一端的墙上有个透过假墙窥视赌场大厅的孔洞。
88019.name: 老板办公室
88019.real_text:
X is equal to the highest alarm level among investigators at Owner's Office.
[action] If there are no clues on Owner's Office: Remember that you "found Abarran's sigil."
88019.text:
X等同于位于老板办公室的调查员中最高的警戒等级。
[action]如果老板办公室上没有剩余线索：请记住你"找到阿巴兰的符咒"。

88020.back_flavor: 筹码和钱币的碰撞声从门内传来，你不是为了钱而来的，对吧……？
88020.name: 会计室
88020.real_text:
[action] Investigators at Counting Room spend 10 [per_investigator] resources, as a group (5 [per_investigator] instead if you "found a vent"): Remember that you "obtained a schematic."
[reaction] After you successfully investigate Counting Room by 2 or more: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per turn.)
88020.text:
[action]位于会计室的调查员可以作为团队共同花费10[per_investigator]资源(如果你"找到通风口"，改为花费5[per_investigator]资源)：请记住你"取得蓝图"。
[reaction]你成功调查会计室超过难度2点或更多后：获得2资源。(每回合限一次。)

88021.back_flavor: 巨大的钢门挡在你面前，细致的沟纹由上至下镌刻在金库门上，似乎用来导引维持大门封闭的秘术能量。
88021.back_text: 赌场的金库大门锁上了、被严密看守着，且还有魔法保护。你不能进入金库大门，除非已经完成劫案开始剧情卡牌上的至少4项任务。
88021.name: 金库大门
88021.real_text: [action] Move. Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon (if an investigator "obtained a schematic," you may mulligan up to two times): - Ifits suit is ♣ or ♠: Move to Guard Room. - If its suit is ♥: Move to Casino Lounge. - If its suit is ♦: Move to Baccarat Table.
88021.text: [action] 移动。弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。(如果有调查员"取得蓝图"，你可以最多重调两次)： - 如果其花色为♣或♠：移动到守卫室。 - 如果其花色为♥：移动到赌场交谊厅。 - 如果其花色为♦：移动到百家乐。

88022.back_text:
你不能进入遗物室。
金库大门获得："[action]除非有调查员"找到阿巴兰的符咒"，否则受到1点伤害和1点恐惧：进行一次[willpower]或[agility](4)检定。如果你成功，位于金库大门的调查员可以作为团队共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索，以翻开遗物室。
88022.flavor: 钱币外形的遗物以令人不安的速度伴随能量脉动。希望你能找到办法破解它的秘密。
88022.name: 遗物室
88022.real_text: Forced - After Relic Room is revealed: Move all clues from The Wellspring of Fortune to Relic Room. [action] If there are no clues on Relic Room: Take control of The Wellspring of Fortune and attach it to your investigator card.
88022.text: 强制 - 遗物室被翻开后：将时运泉源上的所有线索移动到遗物室。 [action]如果遗物室上没有剩余线索：控制时运泉源，将其叠加到你的调查员卡牌上。

88023.back_text: 以下是你可以在时运与愚行，第二部分中完成的任务： □调查员"赢得邪教的护身符"。 □调查员"监视员工们"。 □调查员"找到阿巴兰的符咒"。 □调查员"取得蓝图"。 □调查员"伪装成守卫"。 □调查员"成功隐匿"。 □调查员"运送诱饵包裹"。 □ "伊萨玛拉用歌声迷惑守卫"。 提示：你必须至少完成4项任务才能打开金库大门。
88023.name: 事前准备
88023.real_text:
Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part I: □ An investigator "found a vent." □ An investigator "impersonated a high roller." □ An investigator "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist." □ An investigator "obtained an employee uniform." □ An investigator "stole Abarran's keys." □ An investigator "cleaned out the house."
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this story card, instead of placing them at their location.
88023.text:
以下是你可以在时运与愚行，第一部分中完成的任务： □调查员"找到通风口"。 □调查员"扮演高额赌客"。 □调查员"说服伊萨玛拉参与劫案"。 □调查员"取得员工制服"。 □调查员"盗取阿巴兰的钥匙"。 □调查员"满载而归"。
强制 - 一位调查员退场(被击败或撤退)时：将该调查员的所有线索放到本剧情卡牌上，而不是放到其所在地点。

88024.back_text:
你将包裹交给员工。
被叠加敌人的巡逻地点改为金库大门。被叠加的敌人失去[[赌场]]特性。 如果被叠加的敌人进入金库大门，包裹已送达(阅读以下部分)。 如果被叠加的敌人离场，从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
如果包裹已送达： 选择一位调查员，该调查员查找自己的牌库，找出一张[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，将其面朝下放到金库大门下方。请记住你"运送诱饵包裹"。 弃掉被叠加的敌人，并将本剧情卡牌叠加到金库大门。 [action]：将面朝下放在金库大门下方的支援放置入场，在你的控制之下。从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
88024.name: 制服合身的话……
88024.real_text:
This casino employee looks like they are wearing a uniform in your size.
[action]: Fight. Perform this attack only on the attached enemy. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy has been knocked out (read the section below). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If attached enemy is knocked out: Remember that you "obtained an employee uniform." Raise your alarm level by 1 if another enemy is at your location or a connecting location. Discard the attached enemy. Remove this story card from the game.
88024.text:
这名员工的制服大小看起来很适合你。
[action]：攻击。本次攻击只能对被叠加的敌人执行。进行一次[combat](3)检定。如果你成功，被叠加的敌人被击倒(阅读以下部分)。如果你失败，将你的警戒等级提升1。 如果被叠加的敌人离场，从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
如果被叠加的敌人被击倒： 请记住你"取得员工制服"。 如果另一名敌人位于你所在地点或一个连接地点，将你的警戒等级提升1。 弃掉被叠加的敌人。从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。

88025.back_text:
正要开始行动时，灯光闪烁几下后完全熄灭，赌场陷入一片黑暗，周边响起恐慌的惊呼。这厄运背后似乎有某种力量作祟。除非你能找到办法恢复电力，否则现在必须摸黑行事。
将本卡牌放置入场，位于密谋牌堆旁。在每个地点上放置1个伤害标记。 每个有伤害标记的地点没有照明并获得："本地点得到+1隐藏值。作为触发本地点上能力的额外费用，你必须额外花费一次行动或受到1点恐惧。" 有调查员位于监控室时，可以执行以下行动： [action]：花费1[per_investigator]个线索。选择一项： - 恢复公共区域的电力。从每个[[开放区域]]地点移除1个伤害标记。 - 恢复员工区域的电力。从每个[[管制区域]]地点移除1个伤害标记。
88025.name: 时运不济
88025.real_text:
Isamara warned you that the relic you seek possesses strange abilities that bring misfortune upon those who are not favored by its bearer. Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...
Flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.
88025.text:
伊萨玛拉警告过你，追寻的遗物有呼唤不幸的力量，尤其会降临在不合其拥有者心意的人身上。也许你应该将突发状况考虑进计划内；劫案进行途中，所有事情都可能发生……
将本卡牌翻到背面，并结算另一面的文字。

88026.back_text:
发生在赌场内的意外只能用极度不寻常、甚至诡异来形容。玻璃破碎，赌客因踩到骰子而跌倒，还有人被吊灯砸到头。
将本卡牌放置入场，位于密谋牌堆旁。依次执行，每位调查员弃掉遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。游戏剩余期间，以下受伤类型将影响该调查员： - 如果其花色为♥：你每回合只能执行一次移动行动。 - 如果其花色为♦：你每回合只能执行一次调查行动。 - 如果其花色为♣：你每回合只能执行一次攻击行动。 - 如果其花色为♠：你每回合只能执行一次启动行动。 [free]受到1点伤害或1点恐惧：忽略你的受伤效果，直到你的回合结束。任何调查员可以触发此能力。(每回合限一次。)
88026.name: 时运不济
88026.real_text:
Isamara warned you that the relic you seek possesses strange abilities that bring misfortune upon those who are not favored by its bearer. Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...
Flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.
88026.text:
伊萨玛拉警告过你，追寻的遗物有呼唤不幸的力量，尤其会降临在不合其拥有者心意的人身上。也许你应该将突发状况考虑进计划内；劫案进行途中，所有事情都可能发生……
将本卡牌翻到背面，并结算另一面的文字。

88027.back_text:
你认出了几名过去工作中认识的熟人——这种概率有多大？不幸的是阿巴兰也得知了这层关系，你必须在太迟前将他们救出来！
将本剧情卡牌叠加到老板办公室。本剧情卡牌代表调查员队长过去的熟人。 [action]位于老板办公室的调查员可以作为团队共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时：在本剧情卡牌上放置1点恐惧(如果有敌人位于老板办公室，改为放置2点恐惧)。
如果本剧情卡牌上有6点或更多恐惧： 你太迟了。调查员队长受到1点精神创伤。每位调查员受到2点直接恐惧。从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。

88027.real_text:
Isamara warned you that the relic you seek possesses strange abilities that bring misfortune upon those who are not favored by its bearer. Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...
Flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.

伊萨玛拉警告过你，追寻的遗物有呼唤不幸的力量，尤其会降临在不合其拥有者心意的人身上。也许你应该将突发状况考虑进计划内；劫案进行途中，所有事情都可能发生……
将本卡牌翻到背面，并结算另一面的文字。

88028.flavor: 有这种笑容，谁还需要口红？

linked_card.name: The Face
linked_card.real_text: Cannot be discarded. [action] Parley. Choose a [[Casino]] enemy at your location or a connecting location and test [willpower] or [intellect] (2). If you succeed, exhaust The Face to reduce any investigator's alarm level by 1.
linked_card.text:
Cannot be discarded.

Parley. Choose a Casino enemy at your location or a connecting location and test or (2). If you succeed, exhaust The Face to reduce any investigator's alarm level by 1.

88028.name: 万人迷
88028.real_text: Cannot be discarded. [action] Parley. Choose a [[Casino]] enemy at your location and test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, exhaust The Face to reduce any investigator's alarm level by 1.
88028.text: 不能被弃掉。 [action] 谈判。选择你所在地点的一名[[赌场]]敌人并进行一次[willpower]或[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，横置万人迷并将任意一位调查员的警戒等级降低1。

linked_card.flavor: Shh. Shhhhh. Go to sleep.
linked_card.name: The Muscle
linked_card.real_text:
Cannot be discarded.
[reaction] After you defeat a [[Casino]] enemy, exhaust The Muscle: Reduce your alarm level by 1 (2 instead if there are no other [[Casino]] enemies at your location).
linked_card.text:
Cannot be discarded.

After you defeat a Casino enemy, exhaust The Muscle: Reduce your alarm level by 1 (2 instead if there are no other Casino enemies at your location).

88029.name: 打手
88029.real_text:
Cannot be discarded.
[reaction] After you defeat a [[Casino]] enemy, exhaust The Muscle: Reduce your alarm level by 1 (2 instead if there are no other [[Casino]] enemies at your location or a connecting location).
88029.text:
不能被弃掉。
[reaction]你击败一名[[赌场]]敌人后，横置打手：将你的警戒等级降低1(如果你所在地点或一个连接地点没有其它[[赌场]]敌人，改为降低2)。

linked_card.name: The Thief
linked_card.real_text:
Cannot be discarded.
[reaction] When a Casino enemy up to 2 locations away resolves its patrol keyword, exhaust The Thief: Change the patrol location of that enemy from "clockwise" to "counterclockwise," or vice versa, for this move.
linked_card.text:
Cannot be discarded.

When a Casino enemy up to 2 locations away resolves its patrol keyword, exhaust The Thief: Change the patrol location of that enemy from "clockwise" to "counterclockwise," or vice versa, for this move.

88030.name: 神偷
88030.real_text:
Cannot be discarded.
[reaction] When a [[Casino]] enemy at a connecting location resolves its patrol keyword, exhaust The Thief: Change the patrol location of that enemy from "clockwise" to "counterclockwise," or vice versa, for this move.
88030.text:
不能被弃掉。
[reaction]一个连接地点的一名[[赌场]]敌人结算其巡逻关键词时，横置神偷：将该敌人本次移动的巡逻方向从"顺时针"改为"逆时针"，反之亦然。

linked_card.name: The Grifter
linked_card.real_text: Cannot be discarded. [reaction] When you check game icons while resolving an ability on a [[Game]] location, exhaust The Grifter: Choose one - - Raise your alarm level by 1 to change the rank, suit, or color of up to 2 discarded game icons (to anything). - Reduce your alarm level by 1.
linked_card.text:
Cannot be discarded.

When you check game icons while resolving an ability on a Game location, exhaust The Grifter: Choose one -

- Raise your alarm level by 1 to change the rank, suit, or color of up to 2 discarded game icons (to anything).

- Reduce your alarm level by 1.

88031.name: 老千
88031.real_text: Cannot be discarded. [reaction] When you check game icons while resolving an ability on a [[Game]] location, exhaust The Grifter: Choose one - - Raise your alarm level by 1 to change the rank, suit, or color of a discarded game icon (to anything). - Reduce your alarm level by 1.
88031.text: 不能被弃掉。 [reaction]你结算一个[[游戏]]地点上的能力并检查游戏图标时，横置老千：选择一项： - 将你的警戒等级提升1，以改变一个弃掉的游戏图标的大小、花色或颜色(改为任意值)。 - 将你的警戒等级降低1。

linked_card.name: Isamara Ordoñez
linked_card.real_text: [action]: Parley. Take control of Isamara Ordoñez. [action]: If you control Isamara Ordoñez: Parley. Automatically evade all [[Casino]] enemies at your location. Then, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, lose 2 actions. If at least 1 enemy at a [[Restricted]] location was evaded by this effect, remember that "Isamara mesmerized the guards with her song." (Group limit once per game.)
linked_card.text:
: Parley. Take control of Isamara Ordoñez.

: If you control Isamara Ordoñez: Parley. Automatically evade all Casino enemies at your location. Then, test (3). If you fail, lose 2 actions. If at least 1 enemy at a Restricted location was evaded by this effect, remember that "Isamara mesmerized the guards with her song." (Group limit once per game.)

88032.name: 伊萨玛拉·奥多涅斯
88032.real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (X), where X is the highest alarm level among the investigators. If you succeed, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on Isamara Ordoñez. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on her, remember that you "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist."
88032.text: [action]：谈判。进行一次[willpower](X)检定，其中X等同于调查员中最高的警戒等级。如果你成功，在伊萨玛拉·奥多涅斯上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。然后，如果她身上有1[per_investigator]个线索，请记住你"说服伊萨玛拉参与劫案"。
88032.traits: 盟友. 赌场. 未同谋

88033.name: 现金推车

89011.back_text:
仅当“护送失败”时阅读： 将米戈毁灭者、装甲车和本卡牌从游戏中移除。每位调查员受到1点伤害。失去1对策。
仅当“装甲车抵达目标”时阅读：
完全释放的战争机器何等可怕，但在这次你却因它的炮火轰鸣和轮胎碾过异星地面的巨响而感到宽慰。此区域既已安全，军方就能将精力集中在异常现象本身。虽然他们没有直接感谢你的努力，但跟在你身边的那队特工表明，他们认为你是值得利用的资产。
将放在一边的联邦探员剧情支援放置入场，受任意一位调查员控制。将装甲车从游戏中移除。将米戈毁灭者和本卡牌加入胜利区。对个体代号8L-08造成5点伤害。
89011.flavor: 你听从隔离区逃往边缘的平民说，军方正派遣装甲部队来保卫黑水镇。你不确定更大的枪是否就是答案，但它或许能震慑那些在镇上肆虐的生物。如果你能清理道路，防止它像其他被派进来的车辆一样遭到吞噬，或许真能带来改变。

89014.back_text:
仅当“大脑被带走”时阅读： 将米戈科学家、脑盒和本卡牌从游戏中移除。调查员共同将其3个线索放回标记池。
仅当“大脑已夺回”时阅读：
科学家们听完你的故事，检查圆筒。令你惊讶的是，你从罐子中伸出的奇怪扬声器里听见一个扭曲的声音。里面的大脑振动起来。“噢，谢天谢地。我能听见你们。我在哪里？”它问道。你解释了发生的一切，并问那些生物为什么追逐它。“我知道它们需要的东西。来，我可以教你们——你们有笔吗？”
将放在一边的腐蚀云雾剧情支援放置入场，受任意一位调查员控制。将脑盒从游戏中移除。将米戈科学家和本卡牌加入胜利区。任意一位调查员可以从至多2个地点各发现1个线索。获得1对策。
89014.flavor: 你本以为已见识过一切，但看到一只生物飞过头顶、爪中抓着人脑时，你意识到自己大错特错。更令人惊讶的是，它似乎将大脑安全地安放在玻璃圆筒中，仿佛那是一份科学样本。这些怪物在收集人脑吗？讽刺的是，这些生物很可能正在进行与研究营地科学家相同的研究；但无论如何，你必须找到这只生物并阻止这场病态的实验！

89015.text: 米戈科学家处于重整状态时，其获得： “强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：如果脑盒附属在米戈科学家上，将米戈科学家朝真菌丘移动1次。否则，将米戈科学家朝脑盒所在地点移动1次；如果其位于脑盒所在地点，将脑盒附属到其上(如果脑盒受一位调查员控制，该调查员失去对其的控制)。”
89015.traits: 怪物. 米戈. 精英

89016.name: 脑盒
89016.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89016.real_text:
If uncontrolled and unattached, attach Brain Case to its location.
While attached to a location or an exhausted enemy, Brain Case gains: "[action]: Test [intellect] or [agility] (6). If you succeed, detach Brain Case and take control of it."
89016.text:
脑盒未被控制且未附属时，将其附属到其所在地点。
脑盒附属到一个地点或横置敌人时，其获得：“[action]：检定[intellect]或[agility](6)。如果你成功，解除脑盒的附属并控制它。”

89017.back_text:
仅当“米戈完成研究”时阅读： 将两名米戈研究员和本卡牌从游戏中移除。每个被研究的[[软泥]]敌人重整，并治愈其所有伤害。一位调查员将其1个线索放回标记池。
仅当“米戈研究被阻止”时阅读：
最终，这些生物对知识的渴望不足以让它们留在这个敌对环境中，它们逃回太空的虚空之中——至少暂时如此。事后，你找回了其中一件生物携带的奇怪工具：一把玻璃般材质制成、锋利如剃刀的手术刀。
将放在一边的外星器具剧情支援放置入场，受任意一位调查员控制。将两名米戈研究员和本卡牌加入胜利区。游戏结束前，每个[[米戈]]敌人生命值-2，躲避值-2。任意一位调查员在任意已揭示地点发现1个线索。
89017.flavor: 外星实体在夜空中飞掠、降下，搜索，观察。但目的为何？是它们把软泥怪带来这里，还是它们也被蒙在鼓里？有一点可以确定：它们正恐吓黑水镇被隔离的居民，制造混乱。如果它们不打算帮助收容个体，就只是在捣乱。或许你可以“劝阻”它们进行研究，让你能专注于真正的威胁。
89017.name: 阻止它们的研究
89017.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89017.real_text: Revelation - Spawn both set-aside Mi-Go Researcher enemies, one at the Fungus Mound, and the other at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If there are no Mi-Go Researcher enemies in play: Remember that "the Mi-Go research was stopped." Flip this card over. Forced - If there are 6 resources on this story card: Remember that "the Mi-Go completed their research." Flip this card over.
89017.text: 显现 - 将两名放在一边的米戈研究员敌人生成：一名在真菌丘，另一名在距离真菌丘最远的地点。将本卡牌放置入场，放在场景牌库旁。 强制 - 如果场上没有米戈研究员敌人：记录“米戈研究被阻止”。将本卡牌翻面。 强制 - 如果本剧情卡牌上有6个资源：记录“米戈完成研究”。将本卡牌翻面。

89018.name: 米戈研究员
89018.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89018.real_text: Aloof. While Mi-Go Researcher is ready, it gains: "Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Move Mi-Go Researcher once toward the nearest [[Ooze]] enemy that has not been researched. For each such enemy at its location, place 1 resource on Prevent Their Research and 1 resource on that enemy; that enemy is 'researched.'"
89018.text: 冷漠。 米戈研究员处于重整状态时，其获得： “强制 - 敌军阶段开始时：将米戈研究员朝最近一个未被研究的[[软泥]]敌人移动1次。其所在地点每有一个此类敌人，在阻止它们的研究上放置1资源，并在该敌人上放置1资源；该敌人“已被研究”。”
89018.traits: 怪物. 米戈. 精英

89019.name: 联邦探员
89019.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89019.real_text: You get +1 to all skills. [reaction] When you would fail a skill test by exactly 1: Play G-Men from your hand. (This may cause the test to succeed.) Forced – At the end of the phase: Return G-Men to your hand.
89019.text: 你得到全技能值+1。 [reaction]在你技能检定将要失败并正好低于难度1点时：从你手牌中打出联邦探员。(此效果可能导致检定成功。) 强制 - 本阶段结束时：将联邦探员返回你的手牌。

89020.name: 腐蚀云雾
89020.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89020.real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. If you succeed, automatically evade each enemy at your location and deal 1 damage to each of them. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, each investigator at your location takes 1 damage and loses 1 action.
89020.text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。如果你成功，自动躲避你所在地点的所有敌人，并对其各造成1点伤害。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]标记，你所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害并失去1次行动。

89021.name: 外星器具
89021.pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
89021.real_text: [action]: Investigate. Choose an exhausted [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy at your location. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen enemy’s evade value. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy and discover 1 additional clue at your location.
89021.text: [action]：调查。选择你所在地点的一个横置[[生物]]或[[怪物]]敌人。本次技能检定的难度等于所选敌人的躲避值。如果你成功，对所选敌人造成1点伤害并发现你所在地点额外1个线索。
89021.traits: 道具. 工具. 科学

90001.back_flavor: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊惧，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……
90001.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：[[书籍]]卡牌等级0-5，探求者([seeker])卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它的等级0守卫者卡牌和/或潜修者卡牌([guardian]和/或[mystic])。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：黛西的手提包、死灵之书(约翰·迪伊译本)、1张随机基础弱点。

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Guardian and/or Mystic cards

90001.flavor: “我知道有些书强大无比，甚至能改写现实。”
90001.name: 黛西·沃克
90001.real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 sanity for each [[Tome]] asset you control.
[fast]: One at a time, resolve an [action] ability on each [[Tome]] asset you control, ignoring their [action] cost. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may return a [[Tome]] asset from your discard pile to your hand.
90001.text:
你每控制一本[[书籍]]支援，你获得+1[willpower]和+1神志。
[free]：依次结算你控制的所有[[书籍]]支援的[action]能力，无须支付[action]费用。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以从弃牌堆将1张[[书籍]]支援置入手牌。

90002.name: 黛西的手提包
90002.real_text:
Daisy Walker deck only. Advanced.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.
[reaction] When you play a [[Tome]] asset during your turn, exhaust Daisy's Tote Bag: That asset gains fast.
90002.text:
黛西·沃克牌库专用。进阶。
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。
[reaction]当你在你的回合打出[[书籍]]支援时，横置黛西的手提包：该支援获得快速。

90003.name: 死灵之书
90003.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Put this card into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. While it is in play, treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] (resolve all three). [action]: Move 1 horror from this card to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.
90003.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将死灵之书放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有3点恐惧。死灵之书上有恐惧时不能离场。 将你揭示的每个混乱标记上的[elder_sign]视为[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing](同时结算它们)。 [action]：将死灵之书的1点恐惧移动到黛西·沃克上。然后，如果死灵之书没有恐惧，将其弃掉。

90004.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为黛西·沃克控制的[[书籍]]支援数量+1。
[cultist]：再揭示一个混乱标记，如果本次检定失败，弃掉你牌库顶的3张牌。
[tablet]：-3。如果这是对死书之灵的攻击或躲避检定，且你没有成功超过难度3点，它攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你检定失败，黛西·沃克受到1点恐惧。
90004.name: 死亡阅读
90004.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Tome]] assets Daisy Walker controls.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack or evasion attempt against Namer of the Dead and you do not succeed by at least 2, it attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, Daisy Walker takes 1 horror.
90004.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为黛西·沃克控制的[[书籍]]支援数量。
[cultist]：再揭示一个混乱标记，如果本次检定失败，弃掉你牌库顶的2张牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果这是对死书之灵的攻击或躲避检定，且你没有成功超过难度2点，它攻击你。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，黛西·沃克受到1点恐惧。

90005.back_flavor: 一股巨大的旋风伴随着雷鸣般的声音从《死灵之书》中迸发，将书页的龙卷抛向天空。一道不祥的阴影笼罩了整个校园，随即在随之而来的风暴中遁逃。当一切平息后，那本魔法书哐当一声掉落在地，能量尽失。它先前所蕴含的存在如今已荡然无存。在你手中，它只余一片空洞。
90005.flavor: 无论何种实体已从《死灵之书》中被释放，它都如致命的阴影般在校园中蔓延。你必须在它变得过于强大而无法遏制之前，将其阻止。
90005.name: 凡人求索
90005.real_text:
Dr. Henry Armitage does not take up an ally slot and gains: "You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets."
"Jazz" Mulligan gains: "[action]: Move to a [[Miskatonic]] location up to 3 connections away."
90005.text:
亨利·阿米蒂奇博士不占用盟友槽位并获得“ 你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。”
“爵士”马利根获得：“[action]：移动到最多3个距离以内的[[米斯卡塔尼克]]地点。”

90006.back_flavor: 你站在奥恩图书馆的禁区内，四周环绕着成卷古老而离经叛道的典籍。你所寻得的咒文或许足以驱散那个实体——亦或将其重新封印回它诞生的《死灵之书》中。你的声音随着咒文的重复逐渐升至顶点。阴影在房间里蔓延爬行，墙壁与天花板开始扭曲。书页在暴烈的狂风中翻飞，你每一根发丝都被卷入空中。万物都在随之而来的混沌中被席卷而去，宛若一支湿润的画笔亲吻着现实的画布。
90006.flavor: 写了封印这东西的方法的书籍肯定散落在校园四周……
90006.name: 快速阅读
90006.real_text: Ignore all Objectives on locations. [fast] If you are Daisy Walker, investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Shuffle 1 facedown player card beneath this location into your deck. Objective - Find a way to banish the Namer of the Dead before it is too late.
90006.text: 忽略所有地点上的目标。 [free]如果你是黛西·沃克，你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将此地点下方的一张玩家卡洗入你的牌库。 目标 - 在一切都太迟了之前驱除死书之灵！

90007.name: 死书之灵
90007.real_text: Hunter. Prey - Daisy Walker only. Forced - When Namer of the Dead would be defeated: Instead, fully heal it, exhaust it, and move it to Orne Library. [action] If you are Daisy Walker and you control at least 4 non-weakness [[Tome]] assets: Parley. Test [willpower] (18). This test gets -2 difficulty for each [[Tome]] asset you control. If you succeed, advance the act.
90007.text: 猎手。 猎物 - 仅限黛西·沃克。 强制 - 如果死书之灵将要被击败：改为治愈其所有伤害，将其横置并移动到奥恩图书馆。 [action]如果你是黛西·沃克且你控制了至少4本非弱点[[书籍]]支援：谈判。检定[willpower](18)。你每控制一本非弱点[[书籍]]支援，本次检定难度降低2。如果你成功，推进场景。
90007.traits: 怪物. 灵怪. 精英

90008.back_flavor: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自已的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘴喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒莓蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。
90008.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：25。 牌库构建选项：流浪者([rogue])卡牌等级0-5，[[幸运]]卡牌等级0-3，[[局势]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：在逃中、医院债务、1张随机基础弱点。 额外选项：当你升级一张[[幸运]]或[[局势]]卡牌时，你可以在支付高等级卡牌的全额经验值之后，来将该卡牌的低等级版本保留在你的牌库中(此牌不计入你的牌库卡牌张数，也不计入该卡牌的数量限制)。
90008.name: “倒霉蛋”奥图尔
90008.real_text:
[fast] Spend up to 3 resources: Test a base skill value of 3 against a difficulty equal to the amount of resources just spent. If you succeed, gain twice the number of spent resources. Only [agility] and [wild] skill icons may be committed to this test. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Choose a level 2 or less card in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.
90008.text:
[free]花费至多3资源：进行一次基础值为3，难度为你花费的资源数量的技能检定。如果你检定成功，获得两倍于花费数量的资源。在本次检定中你只能投入[agility]和[wild]图标。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。从你的弃牌堆选择一张等级不超过2的牌，将其置入你的手牌。

90009.name: 在逃中
90009.real_text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only. Advanced.
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you. At the end of the round, you may disengage from each engaged enemy and move up to 2 locations away.
90009.text:
“倒霉蛋”奥图尔牌库专用。进阶。
快速。在任意[free]窗口打出。
直到本轮结束，非[[精英]]敌人不能攻击你。在本轮结束时，你可以与每个和你交战的敌人解除交战，并移动至多2个地点。

90010.name: 医院债务
90010.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit three times per round.) Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 9 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.
90010.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将医院债务放置入你的威胁区域。 [free]：将你资源池1资源移动到医院债务上。(每轮限制3次。) 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果医院债务的资源少于9：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。

90011.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：你每控制1个线索，-2。
[cultist]：-4。(如果你拥有至少10资源，改为-8)。
[tablet]：-3。失去3资源。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你检定失败，“倒霉蛋”奥图尔受到1点恐惧。
90011.name: 破釜沉舟
90011.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for each clue you have.
[cultist]: -2 (-4 instead if you have 10 or more resources).
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, lose 3 resources.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, "Skids" O'Toole takes 1 horror.
90011.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：你每控制1个线索，-1。
[cultist]：-2。(如果你拥有至少10资源，改为-4)。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，失去3资源。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，“倒霉蛋”奥图尔受到1点恐惧。

90012.back_flavor: 已经过去很长时间了，你赌了整夜。精疲力竭的你试图站起来，却一个踉跄，把酒全洒在了同桌一个胡子拉碴的家伙身上。那个魁梧的恶棍缓缓转过身，一脸狞恶地怒视着你，眼神充满鄙夷。他猛地从座位跃起，向你扑来。这下你可闯祸了。这帮黑帮分子肯定会把你扔出去……
90012.back_text: 每位没有撤退调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。 如果“倒霉蛋”奥图尔已撤退，进入(→结局1)。否则进入(→结局2)。
90012.flavor: 四叶草俱乐部里挤满了三教九流的黑帮分子和赌徒。想不动声色地大赢一笔，恐怕没你想的那么容易。
90012.name: 众目睽睽
90012.real_text: [action] If you are in the Clover Club Cardroom, spend any number of clues: You cash in your chips. Gain 5 resources for each clue just spent. Forced - If "Skids" O'Toole is defeated: (→R2)
90012.text: [action]如果你位于俱乐部卡牌室，花费任意数量的线索：你兑现了筹码，每花费1个线索，获得5资源。 强制 - 如果“倒霉蛋”奥图尔被击败：(→结局2)。

90013.back_flavor:
被运气和肾上腺素驱使，你赢得有点多，没能保持低调。欧巴尼恩家族的人已经知道你在这儿，并且痛恨自己的钱被“老千”偷走。从月下美人那边传来一声威严的喝令：“奥图尔那个杂种在这儿。分头行动，抓住他！”

听到自己的名字，你浑身一僵，头脑瞬间清醒。或许是时候收手了。原本毫不留意的黑帮分子们此刻纷纷起身，带着狠厉的决心追捕你。你是要在逃离前从正门直面这场麻烦，还是试着去找后门？
90013.back_text:
将放在一边的西尔班·莱利生成在月下美人。
每位调查员各将一张放在一旁的俱乐部保安生成并与自己交战。
90013.flavor: 你不想惹麻烦，所以最好别主动生事。尽量别太快赌上全部筹码，否则很可能会被轰出去。
90013.name: 来玩牌吧
90013.real_text: Investigators cannot resign. Clover Club Pit Boss gains aloof. Forced - After a [[Criminal]] enemy is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. Objective - At the end of the round: If an investigator has 15 or more resources, advance.
90013.text: 调查员不能撤退。 俱乐部赌场管理员获得冷漠。 强制 - 每当一个[[罪犯]]敌人被击败：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 目标 - 一轮结束时，如果有一位调查员拥有至少15资源，你必须推进。

90014.back_flavor: 你攥着赢来的钱夺门而出，冲过街角。那股肾上腺素的激涌感无与伦比。跑到安全距离后，你清点了手中的钞票。你深吸一口气，如释重负；今晚这一趟大大减轻了你的债务负担。无疑，今夜的经历只会让你的“名声”更响。幸运女神总是站在你这边！
90014.name: 紧追不放
90014.real_text: Each [[Criminal]] enemy gains hunter and gets +1 health. Forced - When an investigator resigns: Place each of that investigator's resources on this act. Objective - Collect as many resources as you can and get out. When each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
90014.text: 所有[[罪犯]]敌人获得猎手和+1生命。 强制 - 当调查员撤退时，将该调查员拥有的所有资源放在本场景牌上。 目标 - 尽可能多带点资源然后逃跑。当每位未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。

90015.name: 西尔班·莱利
90015.real_text: Forced - After Siobhan Riley engages you: For every 5 resources you have, lose 1 resource. Forced - After an investigator at Siobhan Riley's location gains 1 or more resources during the investigation phase: Siobhan Riley readies, engages that investigator, and makes an attack.
90015.text: 强制 - 当西尔班·莱利与你交战时，你每有5资源，失去1资源。 强制 - 在调查阶段，如果有调查员在西尔班·莱利的所在地点获得1或更多的资源：将其重整，与该调查员交战，并立刻攻击一次。
90015.traits: 类人. 罪犯. 精英

90016.name: 俱乐部保安
90016.real_text: When Clover Club Bouncer is engaged with you, it gets +1 fight and +1 evade for every 5 resources you have. [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, disengage from Clover Club Bouncer and exhaust it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
90016.text: 当俱乐部保安与你交战时，你每有5资源，其获得+1攻击和+1躲避。 [action]花费3资源：谈判。检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，与俱乐部保安解除交战，将其横置，且在下一个维持阶段不会重整。

90017.back_flavor: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。
90017.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：25。 牌库构建选项：潜修者([mystic])卡牌等级0-5，[[法术]]卡牌等级0-3，[[密教]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：希波利尔传家宝、黑暗回忆、1张随机基础弱点。 额外选项：当你升级一张[[法术]]卡牌时，你可以在支付高等级卡牌的全额经验值之后，来将该卡牌的低等级版本保留在你的牌库中(此牌不计入你的牌库卡牌张数，也不计入该卡牌的数量限制)。
90017.flavor:
“魔力流淌在我的血脉中，
穿行于我的经脉，
搏动于我的心脏。”
90017.name: 艾格尼丝·贝克
90017.real_text:
As an additional cost to play a [[Spell]] event, you may take 1 damage. If you do, reduce the cost to play that event by 2, and you may shuffle that event back into your deck instead of discarding it.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage.
90017.text:
作为你打出[[法术]]事件的额外费用，你可以受到1点伤害。如果你如此做，降低其资源花费2点，且将该事件洗回牌库而不是置入弃牌堆。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以治愈1点伤害。

90018.name: 希波利尔传家宝
90018.real_text:
Agnes Baker deck only. Advanced.
Only damage and/or horror from player card effects can be assigned to Heirloom of Hyperborea.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.
90018.text:
艾格尼丝·贝克牌库专用。进阶。
只有来自玩家卡的伤害和/或恐惧才能被分配到希波利尔传家宝上。
[reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡后：抽取1张卡牌。

90019.name: 黑暗回忆
90019.real_text: Advanced. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
90019.text: 进阶。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 如果当你回合结束时，黑暗回忆在你手中：将其揭示并受到2点恐惧。

90020.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为艾格尼丝·贝克控制的回忆数量+1。
[cultist]：-3。重整艾尔佩斯·博丹并结算其巡逻关键词，如果其与调查员交战，立刻攻击一次。
[tablet]：-5。如果你检定失败，且艾尔佩斯·博丹的所在地点有回忆，将该混乱标记放到其所在地点。
[elder_thing]：-8。艾格尼丝·贝克可以受到最多3点伤害，每受到1点，本次技能检定期间你获得+2技能值。
90020.name: 血海深仇
90020.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of memories Agnes Baker has collected.
[cultist]: -2. Ready Elspeth Baudin and resolve her patrol keyword.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail and there is a memory at Elspeth Baudin's location, place this token on that location.
[elder_thing]: -6. Agnes Baker may take up to 3 damage to increase your skill value by 2 for each damage taken.
90020.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为艾格尼丝·贝克控制的回忆数量。
[cultist]：-2。重整艾尔佩斯·博丹并结算其巡逻关键词。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，且艾尔佩斯·博丹的所在地点有回忆，将该混乱标记放到其所在地点。
[elder_thing]：-6。艾格尼丝·贝克可以受到最多3点伤害，每受到1点，本次技能检定期间你获得+2技能值。

90021.back_flavor: 一道奥术能量的裂响撕裂长空，直扑你与你的同伴而来。刹那间，折磨变得难以承受。痛楚如毒液般在你血脉中分叉窜行，视野后方的一阵闪光令你目眩。紧接着，一切又戛然而止。但似乎缺了什么，有什么东西遗失了。她难道是在试图窃取你的记忆？
90021.back_text: 艾尔佩斯·博丹依次攻击每位调查员，无论地点(即使其处于横置状态)。 将本密谋翻面。
90021.name: 希波利尔之血
90021.real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Elspeth Baudin is ready and there is a memory at her location: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag and place it on that location. Forced - If there are 1 or more chaos tokens on a location without a memory: Return them to the chaos bag. Forced - If there are chaos tokens on a location with a memory that have a combined value of 6 or more (ignoring +/- and treating each [auto_fail] and [elder_sign] as a -6): Return them to the chaos bag, and Elspeth Baudin collects that memory.
90021.text: 强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时，如果艾尔佩斯·博丹处于重整状态且其所在地点有回忆：随机揭示一个混乱标记并将其放在该地点。 强制 - 如果一个没有回忆的地点上有混乱标记：将这些混乱标记放回混乱袋。 强制 - 如果一个地点上的混乱标记的修正值总和达到6或更多(忽略+/-号，[elder_sign]和[auto_fail]视为-6。)：将这些混乱标记放回混乱袋，艾尔佩斯·博丹收集该回忆。

90022.back_text:
如果艾格尼丝·贝克的回忆多于艾尔佩斯·博丹：
艾尔佩斯倒在你面前，痛苦在她体内奔窜。“动手啊，来个了结吧。”她齿间嘶嘶作响，沸腾的恨意凝成瞪视你的目光。奥术能量在你手中噼啪作响。她是你的敌人，你的战利品。她的生命，她的记忆，尽在你掌握之中。你应取回理应属于你的一切。
(→结局1)。
如果艾尔佩斯·博丹的回忆多于艾格尼丝·贝克：
你双膝跪地，被剧痛压倒。艾尔佩斯俯视着你，双手跃动着奥术能量的电弧。“你太软弱了，”她嘲弄道，“你配不上这份力量。但我……”她咧嘴一笑，“我会比你强得多。”
(→结局2)。
90022.flavor: 你必须在艾尔佩斯之前收集到丢失的回忆！
90022.name: 搜集回忆之路
90022.real_text: [fast] Investigators at Agnes Baker's location spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Agnes Baker collects the memory at her location. Forced - If Agnes Baker is defeated, proceed to (→R2). Objective - Collect more memories than Elspeth. If all 9 memories have been collected (by either party), advance.
90022.text: [free]位于艾格尼丝·贝克所在地点的调查员共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：艾格尼丝·贝克收集该地点的回忆。 强制 - 如果艾格尼丝·贝克被击败：(→结局2)。 目标 - 收集比艾尔佩斯更多的回忆。如果场上9个回忆全部被收集(被任意一方)，推进场景。

linked_card.flavor: Light crashes against the night sky as your magic and Elspeth's intersect. A blaring peal - like an otherworldly siren, calling for judgment - sends you and Elspeth both to your knees. She reels in pain, digging her nails into her temples. You reach out with your power, grasp at her memories, and pull with all your strength.
linked_card.name: Triumph and Subjugation
linked_card.real_text:
Agnes Baker must decide (choose one):
- Agnes Baker collects 1 memory from Elspeth Baudin.
- Agnes Baker gains 2 [per_investigator] clues from the token bank.
Then, flip this card over, exhausted and unengaged.
linked_card.text:
Agnes Baker must decide (choose one):

- Agnes Baker collects 1 memory from Elspeth Baudin.

- Agnes Baker gains 2 clues from the token bank.

Then, flip this card over, exhausted and unengaged.

90023.name: 艾尔佩斯·博丹
90023.real_text: Alert. Patrol (nearest location with at least 1 memory). Retaliate. Elspeth Baudin cannot be automatically evaded and gets -1 fight and -1 evade for each memory she has collected. Forced - When Elspeth Baudin would be defeated: Instead, heal all damage from her, flip her over, and resolve the text on her other side.
90023.text: 警戒。巡逻(最近的有回忆的地点)。反击。 艾尔佩斯·博丹不能被自动躲避，其每收集一个回忆，获得-1攻击和-1躲避。 强制 - 如果艾尔佩斯·博丹将要被击败：改为治愈其所有伤害，然后将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。
90023.traits: 类人. 法师. 精英

90024.back_flavor: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。
90024.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者([guardian])卡牌等级0-3，[[策略]]卡牌等级0-3，[[洞察]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：罗兰 的.38特制手枪、掩盖罪证、1张随机基础弱点。 额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
90024.flavor: “警长，我要是惹事，也是因为有事儿在那儿等着被惹出来。”
90024.name: 罗兰·班克斯
90024.real_text: At deck creation, choose 3 different Directive assets to add to your deck. [fast]: Flip a Directive asset facedown (ignoring its permanent keyword). (Limit once per game.) [elder_sign] effect: +2. Choose a Directive asset. You may ignore its regulation ability this round.
90024.text: 在牌库构建时，选择3个不同的准则并将其加入牌库。 [free]：将你的一张准则翻到面朝下(忽略其永久关键词)。(每场游戏仅限一次。) [elder_sign]效果：+2。选择你控制的一个准则，直到本轮结束，你忽略其规章。

90025.name: 准则
90025.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Permanent. Regulation - You cannot fight more than twice each round. [fast] During a skill test while investigating, evading, or parleying, exhaust this Directive: You get +2 skill value for this test for each enemy engaged with you.
90025.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。永久。 规章 - 你每轮不能攻击超过2次。 [free]当你调查、躲避或谈判时，横置本准则：每有一个敌人与你交战，你获得+2技能值。

90026.name: 准则
90026.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Permanent. Regulation - You cannot play more than 2 cards each round. [reaction] When you play an [[Insight]] or [[Tactic]] event, exhaust this Directive: That event gains fast.
90026.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。永久。 规章 - 你每轮不能打出超过2张牌。 [reaction]当你打出一张[[洞察]]或[[策略]]事件时，横置本准则：该牌获得快速。

90027.name: 准则
90027.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Permanent. Regulation - You cannot voluntarily assign damage or horror to [[Ally]] assets. You have 1 additional ally slot.
90027.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。永久。 规章 - 你不能主动将伤害或恐惧分配到[[盟友]]支援。 你拥有额外1个盟友槽位。

90028.name: 准则
90028.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Permanent. Regulation - When your location has 1 or more clues, you cannot commit cards to skill tests unless you have discovered a clue this round. [reaction] After you discover a clue, if an enemy is at your location, exhaust this Directive: Draw 1 card.
90028.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。永久。 规章 - 如果你所在地点至少有1个线索，除非你本轮发现过线索，否则你不能在技能检定中投入卡牌。 [reaction]当你发现1个或更多线索时，如果有敌人在你的所在地点，横置本准则：抽取1张卡牌。

90029.name: 准则
90029.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Permanent. Regulation - You cannot move more than twice each round. You get +3 sanity.
90029.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。永久。 规章 - 你每轮不能移动超过2次。 你获得+3神智。

90030.name: 罗兰 的.38特制手枪
90030.real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Advanced. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +4 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy and there are no clues on your location, place 1 ammo on Roland's .38 Special
90030.text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。进阶。 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat](如果你所在地点至少有1个线索，改为你得到+4[combat])。本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击击败了一个敌人且你所在地点没有线索，在本支援上放置1子弹。
90030.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

90031.name: 掩盖罪证
90031.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 4 clues on it. [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead. Forced - When the game ends, if there are any clues on Cover Up: You suffer 1 mental trauma.
90031.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将掩盖罪证放置入你的威胁区域，并在上面放置4个线索。 [reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时：改为弃掉掩盖罪证上同等数量的线索。 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果掩盖罪证上有线索：你承受1点精神创伤。

90032.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为胜利区的[[异教徒]]敌人数量+1。
[cultist]：-3。如果你与[[异教徒]]敌人交战，额外揭示一个混乱标记。
[tablet]：-4。重整所有与你交战的[[异教徒]]敌人。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你检定失败，罗兰·班克斯受到1点伤害。
90032.name: 循规蹈矩
90032.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Cultist]] enemies in the victory display, to a maximum of 5.
[cultist]: -2. If a [[Cultist]] enemy is engaged with you, reveal an additional chaos token.
[tablet]: -3. Ready each [[Cultist]] enemy engaged with you.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, Roland Banks takes 1 damage.
90032.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为胜利区的[[异教徒]]敌人数量，最大为5。
[cultist]：-2。如果你与[[异教徒]]敌人交战，额外揭示一个混乱标记。
[tablet]：-3。重整所有与你交战的[[异教徒]]敌人。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败，罗兰·班克斯受到1点伤害。

90034.back_flavor:
“证据还不够，”你的上司斥责道，“抱歉，但这些材料在我看来太过牵强，难以取信。如果连我都无法相信，法庭更不会采信。说真的，邪教？活人献祭？”

你咬紧牙关，一掌拍在积攒成堆的文件与证据上。所有线索都在这儿了，你坚持道。
“已经几周了，你手里根本没有实质性的案件，只有一堆间接的胡说八道，”他搪塞着，“况且，格雷先生是本社区的支柱。你竟用这些指控来诋毁他……”他话音里那丝对你的轻蔑出卖了他。难道他收了格雷的好处？还是更糟？无论如何，继续争辩显然毫无意义。你深知此时不宜声张。若想在阿卡姆有所作为，就必须保持低调，按自己的方式行事。
90034.back_text: 从胜利区移除一个[[异教徒]]敌人(如果可能，优先选择格雷先生)。 (→结局1)。
90034.flavor: 你的上级正施压让你放弃调查。毫无疑问，这背后是格雷先生的影响力在作祟。与此同时，他和他的爪牙正用尽一切手段，企图悄无声息地将你从这场博弈中永久抹除。
90034.name: 最后期限
90034.real_text: Forced - When a non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy would be defeated: Heal damage from that enemy until it has 1 remaining health, instead. Forced - If Roland Banks is defeated: Proceed to (→R2) [action]: Resign. You don't want to miss your deadline, so you close the case.
90034.text: 强制 - 当[[异教徒]]敌人将要被击败时：改为治愈其伤害直到剩余1点生命。 强制 - 如果罗兰·班克斯被击败：(→结局2)。 [action]：撤退。你不想错过最后期限，草草结案。

90035.back_flavor:
格雷先生在牢房里来回踱步，隔着铁栏怒视着你。“你会后悔的，班克斯探员，”他嘶吼道，“等这事了结，你会跪下来求我宽恕。”
你礼貌地提醒格雷先生，威胁联邦探员是重罪。
“这世上还有比你这种人更可怕的东西值得畏惧。”他答道，随后颓然瘫倒在牢房角落，一副败溃之态。
真凶已锒铛入狱，但你仍不清楚他协助那些谋杀案共犯的真实目的。究竟是什么，能驱使一个人夺走如此多的生命？你尚不知晓——但你决心查明真相。
90035.flavor: 要将献祭仪式背后的真凶绳之以法，唯有依靠证据，通过法庭的审判。你必须光明正大地完成这一切。
90035.name: 逮捕同谋
90035.real_text: [fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Flip over a facedown conspirator at your location and put it into play engaged with you. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Exhaust a [[Cultist]] enemy engaged with you (it remains engaged). Only Roland Banks may trigger this ability.] Objective - Parley with as many conspirators as you can. If 10 [[Cultist]] enemies are in the victory display, advance.
90035.text: [free]调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将你所在地点面朝下的同谋翻面并与你交战。 [free]花费1资源：横置一个与你交战的[[异教徒]]敌人(其依然与你交战)。只有罗兰·班克斯可以使用此能力。 目标 - 尽可能揭露异教徒的阴谋。如果胜利区有10个[[异教徒]]敌人，推进。

90036.back_flavor: 既然恩格尔警长和其他警员都对您的怀疑不以为然，您决定独自展开调查，追查这些命案的真相。
90036.back_text: 阿卡姆警察局与商业区、东城区和河岸城相互连接。
90036.name: 阿卡姆警察局
90036.real_text: Arkham Police Station is connected to Rivertown, Downtown, and Easttown, and vice versa. [fast]: Move to a connecting location. [fast] Choose a non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy at this location and spend clues equal to its remaining health: Parley. Add that enemy to the victory display.
90036.text: 阿卡姆警察局与商业区、东城区和河岸城相互连接。 [free]：移动到连接地点。 [free]：选择你所在地点的一个非弱点[[异教徒]]敌人并花费等于其剩余生命的线索：谈判。将该敌人置入胜利区。

90037.back_flavor: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。
90037.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 [[特性]]选择：当构建牌库时，选择下列一个特性：[[祝福]]或[[诅咒萦绕]]。你可以两者都选择并+5牌库卡牌张数。 牌库构建选项：求生者([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，你所选[[特性]]等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：温蒂的护身符、被抛弃的孤单、1张随机基础弱点。
90037.flavor: "细微的事最重要了。大人们却搞不懂。"
90037.name: 温蒂·亚当斯
90037.real_text:
Add Tidal Memento to your deck.
[reaction] After you successfully evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy: Seal either 1 [bless] or [curse] token from the chaos bag, or any [bless] or [curse] tokens revealed from the chaos bag during this test, on that enemy.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the chaos bag for up to 2 [bless] and/or [curse] tokens and reveal them, ignoring their effects.
90037.text:
将潮汐信物加入你的牌库。
[reaction]当你成功躲避一个非[[精英]]敌人时：从混乱袋中查找1个[bless]或[curse]标记，或将本次检定期间从混乱袋中揭示的任意数量[bless]和/或[curse]标记封印到该敌人上。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。从混乱袋中查找并揭示至多2个[bless]和/或[curse]标记，忽略它们的效果。
90037.traits: 漂泊者. 祝福. 诅咒萦绕

90038.name: 潮汐信物
90038.real_text:
Wendy Adams deck only. Permanent.
[reaction] When an enemy would ready or doom would be placed on it, release a [bless] or [curse] token sealed on that enemy: Cancel that effect.
[reaction] During a skill test you are performing, when a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve a [bless] or [curse] token sealed on an enemy instead.
90038.text:
温蒂·亚当斯牌库专用。永久。
[reaction]当一个敌人将要重整或在其上放置毁灭标记时，释放其上的一个[bless]或[curse]标记：取消此效果。
[reaction]当你进行技能检定，将要揭示混乱标记时：改为结算一个敌人上封印的[bless]或[curse]标记。

90039.name: 温蒂的护身符
90039.real_text: Wendy Adams deck only. Advanced. You may play any event in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Forced - After you play an event or discard an event from play: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.
90039.text: 温蒂·亚当斯牌库专用。进阶。 你可以打出你弃牌堆的任意事件，如同其是你的手牌。 强制 - 你打出一张事件后：不将其放入你的弃牌堆，改为将其放到你的牌库底。

90040.flavor: 我不需要他们。我不需要任何人。
90040.name: 被抛弃的孤单
90040.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Remove all non-weakness cards in your discard pile from the game. If no cards were removed by this effect, shuffle this card back into your deck. Otherwise, take 3 direct horror.
90040.text: 进阶。 显现 - 将你弃牌堆的所有非弱点卡牌从游戏中移除。如果没有移除卡牌，将此牌洗回你的牌库。否则受到3点直接恐惧。

90041.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为胜利区的[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌数量总和。
[cultist]：-3。(如果你正在与[[嫌犯]]敌人谈判，或正在调查[[窝点]]地点，改为-5)。
[tablet]：-4。如果你检定成功，查看迹象牌库顶的牌，你可以选择是否混洗迹象牌库。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，将遭遇牌库顶的牌洗入迹象牌库。
90041.name: 赤潮升涌
90041.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of [[Suspect]] and [[Hideout]] cards in the victory display (rounded up).
[cultist]: -2. (-4 instead if you are parleying with a [[Suspect]] enemy or investigating a [[Hideout]] location).
[tablet]: -3. If you succeed, look at the top card of the Leads deck. You may choose to shuffle the Leads deck.
[elder_thing]: -1. If you fail, shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the Leads deck.
90041.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为胜利区的[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌数量总和的一半。
[cultist]：-2。(如果你正在与[[嫌犯]]敌人谈判，或正在调查[[窝点]]地点，改为-4)。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定成功，查看迹象牌库顶的牌，你可以选择是否混洗迹象牌库。
[elder_thing]：-1。如果你检定失败，将遭遇牌库顶的牌洗入迹象牌库。

90042.back_flavor: 你早已习惯被人拒绝和排斥，但不知为何，此地的居民对你刨根问底的抵触情绪远超预期。最后与你交谈的那人浑身鱼腥味，皮肤苍白病态，脖颈上还有诡异的隆起褶皱。紧接着，你发现自己无论走到哪儿都被尾随，而那群跟踪者看来绝非善类。
90042.back_text:
将放在一边的愤怒暴民以横置状态生成在印斯茅斯广场。
在场上所有[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌上各放置1[per_investigator]个线索。
90042.flavor: 你刚一来到印斯茅斯，就立刻开始询问当地人，寻找你爸爸的踪迹，又或者这个照片的所在地点，亦或是这个落下照片的德比帽男人。
90042.name: 新来的女孩
90042.real_text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and shuffle a random set-aside [[Monster]] enemy into the [[Leads]] deck. Then, if there are no set-aside [[Monster]] enemies, advance to agenda 1b.
90042.text: 强制 - 在本密谋将因达到毁灭阈值而推进时：改为移除场上所有毁灭标记并将随机一张放在一边的[[怪物]]敌人洗入迹象牌堆。然后如果没有[[怪物]]敌人被放在一边，推进至密谋1b。

90043.back_flavor: 你躲在一堆散发酸臭的垃圾后面，听着搜寻你的暴民们沉重而不懈的脚步声在四周擂响。你不明白他们为何追捕你——你不过问了些问题！——但显然此地已不可久留。在阿卡姆，像你这样的街头流浪儿根本无人注目。此刻，你忽然但愿这里也是如此。
90043.flavor: 你逗留得越久，追问得越多，危险就越是如影随形。当地人对你投来愤怒与猜疑的目光，更糟糕的是：长着翅膀的怪异生物在屋顶徘徊，伺机寻找猎物……
90043.name: 线索渐消
90043.real_text:
Angry Mob cannot be defeated.
[reaction] After Wendy Adams evades Angry Mob: She may discover 1 clue from its location.
Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and enters play with +1 [per_investigator] clues.
Each [[Hideout]] location gets +1 [per_investigator] clue value.
90043.text:
愤怒暴民不能被击败。
[reaction]当温蒂·亚当斯躲避愤怒暴民后：其发现该敌人所在地点的1个线索。
所有[[嫌犯]]敌人失去冷漠，且入场时额外带有1[per_investigator]个线索。
所有[[窝点]]地点获得+1[per_investigator]个线索数量。

90044.back_flavor:
没用的。爸爸或许确实来过印斯茅斯，可他早就离开了。而镇民们似乎对任何打听他消息的人都充满敌意。他们可能知道些什么却不愿透露，也可能只是在守护其他不相干的秘密。无论如何，继续留在这里已经不安全了。

但就在你准备放弃、动身返回巴士站赶回阿卡姆时，你瞥见了一个穿着熟悉装束的男人：一件长羊毛外套，头戴一顶棕色德比帽。
90044.flavor: 说这个地方比阿卡姆不友善，还是太高看它了。
90044.name: 寻找爸爸
90044.real_text: [[Suspect]] and [[Hideout]] cards cannot be added to the victory display except using Mysterious Photo. Forced – If there are no [[Suspect]] or [[Hideout]] cards in play: Wendy Adams must draw cards from the top of the Leads deck until she draws a [[Suspect]] or [[Hideout]] card. Objective – Search for Dad using Mysterious Photo. The fewer cards that remain in the Leads deck, the better. If it is empty, advance.
90044.text: 除非使用神秘相片，否则[[嫌犯]]和[[窝点]]卡牌不能进入胜利区。 强制 - 如果场上没有[[嫌犯]]或[[窝点]]卡牌：温蒂·亚当斯必须依次抽取迹象牌库顶的卡牌，直到抽取了一张[[嫌犯]]或[[窝点]]卡牌。 目标 - 使用神秘相片将卡牌置入胜利区。迹象牌库剩余的卡牌越少越好，如果它为空，推进。

90046.back_flavor: “灰堆”皮特一路流浪，晚上走到哪里就睡在哪里：田野间，火车上，运气好的话则是谷仓里。他身边睡着自己忠实的猎犬——杜克，另一边则是自己的旧吉他。皮特睡着的时候，有时会做梦。他梦到恶灵萦绕、饱受折磨的地方，梦到可怕的怪物。每每醒来之时，他知道有人需要帮助，因为他的梦境绝非虚假。他不知道自己凭着机智已经走了多久，但他确定只要有人需要帮助，任何地方都无法弗届。只要皮特还能对别人施以援手，他就会一直流浪下去。
90046.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-3，[[临时制品]]和[[策略]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它的等级0守卫者卡牌([guardian])。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：杜克、噩梦来袭、1张随机基础弱点。

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 level 0 Guardian cards

90046.name: “灰堆”皮特
90046.real_text:
You begin the game with Pete's Guitar in play.
[reaction] When a card you own that is attached to a scenario card would be discarded: Add it to your hand instead. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Choose a card you own attached to a scenario card. You may return the chosen card to your hand.
90046.text:
你以皮特的吉他在场上开始游戏。
[reaction]在一张附属到冒险卡上的，属于你的卡牌将要离场时：将该牌返回你的手中。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。选择一张附属到冒险卡上的，属于你的卡牌，你可以将该牌返回你的手中。

90047.name: 皮特的吉他
90047.real_text:
"Ashcan" Pete deck only. Replacement.
[fast] Exhaust Pete's Guitar: Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or a connecting location. Move that enemy once in a direction of your choice. Then, if there are no enemies at your location, either heal 1 horror or gain 1 resource.
90047.text:
“灰堆”皮特牌库专用。替换。
[free]横置皮特的吉他：选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人，将其按照你选择的方向移动一次。然后如果你所在地点没有敌人，治愈1点恐惧或获得1资源。

90048.name: 艰难时刻
90048.real_text: Replacement. Revelation - Put Hard Times into play in your threat area. Forced - After you draw 1 or more cards: Choose and discard that many cards from hand. [action][action]: Discard Hard Times.
90048.text: 替换。 显现 - 将艰难时刻放置入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你抽取1张或更多卡牌后：选择并弃掉相同数量的手牌。 [action][action]：弃掉艰难时刻。

90049.back_flavor: 自打吉姆拿起父亲的小号那天，爵士乐对他来说就只剩下了麻烦。但魂灵乐于听到吉姆的演奏，所以他也没有理由停止。
90049.back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-3，[[法术]]或[[诅咒萦绕]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它的等级0求生者卡牌([survivor])。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：吉姆的小号、最后的狂想曲、彼端、1张随机基础弱点。 灵魂牌库张数：10。 灵魂牌库选项：任意职介的9张不同的[[盟友]]支援，等级0-2，复仇怨灵。 灵魂牌库指南：游戏开始时，将灵魂牌库单独洗混并面朝下放在彼端旁。灵魂牌库里面的牌也可使用未花费的经验升级。

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Survivor cards.

90049.name: 吉姆·卡尔弗
90049.real_text:
[reaction] After you reveal 1 or more [skull] or [curse] tokens during a skill test you are performing: Replenish 1 charge on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may treat this token as if it were a [skull] or [curse] token instead.
90049.text:
[reaction]当你在技能检定中揭示1个或更多的[skull]或[curse]标记时：补满你控制的支援上的1个充能。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将此标记视为[skull]或[curse]。

90050.name: 吉姆的小号
90050.real_text:
Jim Culver deck only. Advanced.
[reaction] When a [skull] or [curse] token is revealed during a skill test you are performing, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from each investigator and [[Ally]] asset at your location or a connecting location.
90050.text:
吉姆·卡尔弗牌库专用。进阶。
[reaction]在技能检定期间揭示[skull]或[curse]标记时，横置吉姆的小号：治愈你所在地点和连接地点的所有调查员以及[[盟友]]支援的1点恐惧。
90050.traits: 道具. 乐器. 遗物

90051.flavor: 要是连亡者都开始谈论它们害怕的东西，那真该好好听听了。
90051.name: 最后的狂想曲
90051.real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each non-[elder_sign], non-[bless] symbol token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
90051.text: 进阶。 显现 - 从混乱袋中揭示5个混乱标记。每揭示一个[elder_sign]和[bless]以外的符号标记，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。

linked_card.real_text:

If it is... - ... an [elder_sign] token: You may either heal 1 horror, or attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. (Do not reveal tokens for the spirit you attach after resolving this effect.) - ... an [auto_fail] token: Discard this spirit. Take 1 direct damage/horror. - ...a [skull] token: Discard this spirit. Heal 1 horror. - ...a [cultist], [elder_thing], [tablet], or [curse] token: You must either discard this spirit or take 1 direct damage. - ...any other token: Discard this spirit. Flip this card back to its asset side.
Reminder: Spirits attached to The Beyond are in play but only retain their names and text boxes. Spirits do not take up slots and do not have health or sanity values. When a unique spirit is attached to The Beyond, any other asset that shares its name and is already in play is discarded. Spirits are always discarded to the bottom of the spirit deck.
