06140.name: 塞拉尼安
06140.real_text:
Veiled.
As an additional cost for you to enter or leave Serannian, you must choose and discard a card from your hand.
06140.text:
掩藏。
作为你进入或离开塞拉尼安的额外费用，你必须选择并弃掉你的一张手牌。
06140.traits: 欧斯-纳尔盖. 城市. 港口

06140b.flavor: 美丽的塞拉尼安城是远离世间一切灾厄的避难所。在天空之上高悬的这些带有塔楼的云中城堡中，时间停滞不前。这座城市的魅力永恒不变。你可能在这里的大理石街道和完美的花园中迷失上千个日夜，而察觉不到时间的流动。这里的一切是如此平静，使你几乎忘记了自己的任务，也忘记了自己的肉体还在现实世界里沉睡着。即便如此，你依然忍不住想知道：即使你的肉体在衰老、萎缩，留在这个平静的地方，让内心得到安宁会不会更好？
06140b.name: 永恒美景
06140b.real_text: Each investigator at Serannian heals 2 damage and gains 2 resources. You have uncovered a Sign of the Gods (place 1 resource on the scenario reference card). Flip this card back over.
06140b.text: 位于塞拉尼安的每位调查员治愈2点伤害并获得2资源。 你发现了一个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置1资源)。 将本卡牌翻面。

06141.flavor: 哈祖斯-克列格与永恒王国其他地方的显著差异在于，这是一座破败的城市，不受塞勒菲斯之王管辖，有着肮脏的蜿蜒小道和玄武岩筑成的高塔。这里的一切似乎都不符合建筑学的基本定律，尽管这座城市的许多寺庙都供奉着神明，但它们都不是你要找的受人敬仰的那些。

linked_card.flavor: Deep within the run-down city of Hazuth-Kleg, along the street of the pantheon, lies the Temple of Unattainable Desires. It is a grand temple of onyx, its iron gate fashioned to look like a mass of twisted and intermingled serpents with amethyst eyes. Lanterns cast a baleful red glow at the entrance. You shudder at the thought of what profane rituals might transpire within its unhallowed halls, and yet, your gut tells you this awful place may hold the answers you seek.
linked_card.name: Unattainable Desires
linked_card.real_text:
Put the set-aside Temple of Unattainable Desires location into play.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Put the set-aside Temple of Unattainable Desires location into play.

Flip this card back over.

06141.name: 哈祖斯-克列格

06141b.flavor: 在破败的哈祖斯-克列格城中，沿着万神街道前行，就到了无以达愿之庙。这座宏伟的神庙以缟玛瑙筑成，它的铁门看起来就像扭曲盘结的蛇群，蛇目如同紫水晶一般。入口处的灯笼发出不详的红光。你一想到这里不洁的殿堂里可能会发生渎神的仪式，你就感到不寒而栗。然而，直觉告诉你，你要找的答案可能就在这里。
06141b.name: 无以达愿
06141b.real_text:
Put the set-aside Temple of Unattainable Desires location into play.
Flip this card back over.
06141b.text:
将放在一边的无以达愿之庙地点放置入场。
将本卡牌翻面。

06142.flavor: 神庙内部比其所在的这座城市更加昏暗，更加蜿蜒。蒙着的灯笼发出深红色的光芒，将整座殿堂笼罩其中，你也没有受到任何形式的友善欢迎。

linked_card.flavor: In the deepest section of the temple lies its greatest hall and its greatest curse. The moment you pass under its low, narrow doorway, you find yourself in another realm altogether: a twisted, hellish version of the city outside. The streets are lined with tottering houses that lean together so that they almost form tunnels, blotting out what passes for the sky in this nightmare realm. Only a single baleful star shines in the perpetual twilight, visible between the leaning basalt towers and twisted streets.
linked_card.name: The City Inside
linked_card.real_text:
Put the set-aside City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map location into play.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Put the set-aside City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map location into play.

Flip this card back over.

06142.name: 无以达愿之庙
06142.real_text:
Veiled.
The way into the temple is barred shut. You cannot enter the Temple of Unattainable Desires unless an investigator has "beseeched the king."
06142.text:
掩藏。
进入神庙的道路已被堵住。你不能进入无以达愿之庙 ，除非调查员“向王祈求帮助”了。

06142b.flavor: 神庙最深处有着最大的殿堂，也有着最可怕的诅咒。当你穿过低矮狭窄的门道，你发现自己来到了另一个迥异的地方：眼前是这座城市外部，但景象变得扭曲，令人毛骨悚然。街道两旁是摇摇欲坠的房屋，它们挨在一起，几乎形成了一条隧道，遮蔽了这个噩梦般的世界里的天空。在永恒的暮色之中，只有一颗凶星在倾斜的玄武岩塔楼和蜿蜒的街道之间闪烁。
06142b.name: 城中之城
06142b.real_text:
Put the set-aside City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map location into play.
Flip this card back over.
06142b.text:
将放在一边的地图未见之城地点放置入场。
将本卡牌翻面。

linked_card.flavor: You traverse the tangled streets of this dark, abandoned realm for what seems like many hours. You cannot tell the passage of time, for the star that hangs above you never moves, and the rest of the sky is empty and devoid of all light. Finally you reach the square in the center of town, directly below the baleful star. Its red glare shines down on a statue depicting an otherworldly abomination. The inscription in the stone before the statue is riddled with astrological symbols and strange names, but nothing more. The moment you read one of the names, the city begins to collapse, and you are whisked away by an incomprehensible force. You awaken several hours later, your head spinning. Your arms and legs are covered in thin, bloody incisions.
linked_card.name: The Baleful Star
linked_card.real_text: You have uncovered two Signs of the Gods (place 2 resources on the scenario reference card). Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Temple of Unattainable Desires (cannot be canceled). Flip this card back over and add it to the victory display.
linked_card.text:
You have uncovered two Signs of the Gods (place 2 resources on the scenario reference card).

Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Temple of Unattainable Desires (cannot be canceled). Flip this card back over and add it to the victory display.

06143.name: 地图未见之城
06143.real_text: Veiled. For each Priest of a Thousand Masks at the City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map, reduce its shroud by 1. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the City-Which-Appears-On-No-Map: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Priest of a Thousand Masks and spawn it here. Shuffle the encounter deck.
06143.text: 掩藏。 每有一个千面祭司位于地图未见之城，其隐藏值-1。 强制 - 你调查地图未见之城时，技能检定失败后：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张千面祭司并将其生成在此。混洗遭遇牌库。

06143b.flavor: 你在这个黑暗的、被遗弃的地方穿行了数个小时。你不知道过了多久，因为高悬在你上方的星星从未移动，而此外天上什么都没有，也没有一星半点的光亮。最后你走到了城市中心的广场，正在那颗凶星下方。它的红光照耀在一尊外形异常可憎的雕像上。雕像前的石头上刻满了占星学的符号和奇怪的名字，除此之外就没有别的了。当你读到其中一个名字的那一刻，这座城市就开始崩塌，一股不可思议的力量将你拂去。几个小时之后你醒了过来，感觉头脑天旋地转。你的双手双脚都布满了狭长的、血淋淋的伤口。
06143b.name: 凶星
06143b.real_text: You have uncovered two Signs of the Gods (place 2 resources on the scenario reference card). Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Temple of Unattainable Desires (cannot be canceled). Flip this card back over and add it to the victory display.
06143b.text: 你发现了两个神迹(在冒险参考卡牌上放置2资源)。 弃掉本地点的每个敌人。将本地点的每位调查员移动到无以达愿之庙(不能取消)。将本卡牌翻面并加入胜利牌区。

06144.name: 维吉尔·格雷
06144.real_text: [reaction] After 1 or more Signs of the Gods are uncovered: Either draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, or heal 1 horror from Virgil Gray. If there is more than 1 investigator in the game, give control of Virgil Gray to another investigator. Forced - If Virgil Gray leaves play: Remove him from the game.
06144.text: [reaction]发现至少1个神迹后：抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，或治愈维吉尔·格雷的1点恐惧。如果游戏中有超过1位调查员，将维吉尔·格雷的控制权交给另一位调查员。 强制 - 如果维吉尔·格雷离场：将他从游戏中移除。(FAQ，v2.0)

06145.name: 乌撒之猫
06145.real_text: Swarming 2. When you reveal chaos tokens while attempting to evade this enemy, reveal an additional token. (Limit once per test.) Forced - The first time an investigator defeats Cats of Ulthar (or one of its swarm cards): Add 3 swarm cards to the host and record in your Campaign Log (your investigator name) has broken the law of Ulthar.
06145.text: 蜂拥2。 在你尝试躲避本敌人，揭示混乱标记时，揭示额外一个混乱标记。(每次检定仅限一次。) 强制 - 调查员第一次击败乌撒之猫(或击败其1张蜂拥卡牌)时：增加3张蜂拥卡牌到其头领卡牌，并在你的剧本日志中记录(你的调查员姓名)已打破乌撒的法则。

06146.name: 跟踪的蝎狮
06146.real_text: Forced - If you successfully evade Stalking Manticore: Disengage from it, but do not exhaust it. Until the end of the phase, it cannot engage you.
06146.text: 强制 - 如果你成功躲避跟踪的蝎狮：与其解除交战，但不要横置它。其不能与你交战，直到本阶段结束。
06146.traits: 生物. 怪物. 精英

06147.name: 夜色怪群
06147.real_text:
Massive. Swarming 1 [per_investigator].
Horde of Night's swarm cards cannot attack.
Horde of Night's host card cannot be defeated. If it would be defeated, exhaust Horde of Night, instead.
06147.text:
庞大。蜂拥1[per_investigator]。
夜色怪群的蜂拥卡牌不能攻击。
夜色怪群的头领卡牌不能被击败。如果其将被击败，改为横置夜色怪群。

06148.name: 伊伯生物
06148.real_text: Prey - Investigator at a [[Ruins]] location only. Aloof. Hunter. Swarming 1 [per_investigator]. During the "enemy attacks" step of the enemy phase, instead of attacking its engaged investigator, Beings of Ib attacks each investigator at its location (even if it is unengaged).
06148.text: 猎物 - 仅限位于[[遗迹]]地点的调查员。 冷漠。猎手。蜂拥1[per_investigator]。 敌军阶段的“敌人攻击”步骤期间，伊伯生物不攻击与其交战的调查员，改为攻击位于其地点的每位调查员(即便未与其交战)。

06149.name: 千面祭司
06149.real_text:
While the investigators have uncovered...
...2 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
...4 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +2 health.
...6 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 damage and gains retaliate.
06149.text:
调查员已经发现了……
……2个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到攻击值+1与躲避值+1。
……4个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到生命值+2。
……6个或更多的神迹时，千面祭司得到伤害值+1，并获得反击。

06150.name: 黑暗夜魇
06150.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Tenebrous Nightgaunt leaves play as a result of an act's setup: Set it aside (it keeps all tokens and attachments). After resolving the act's setup, put it back into play at any [[City]] location.
06150.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在黑暗夜魇因场景的设置而离场时：将其放在一边(保留其所有的标记和附属)。结算场景的设置后，将其放回场上任意一个[[城市]]地点。

06151.name: 一群乌尼斯
06151.real_text:
Swarming 1.
While the host Pack of Vooniths has no attached swarm cards, it gets +2 fight and +2 evade.
06151.text:
蜂拥1。
一群乌尼斯的头领卡牌没有附属蜂拥卡牌时，其得到攻击值+2和躲避值+2。

06152.name: 夜骑
06152.real_text: Swarming 1. While the host Nightriders has no attached swarm cards, it gets -3 evade. Forced - After you evade Nightriders: Discard it.
06152.text: 蜂拥1。 夜骑的头领卡牌没有附属蜂拥卡牌时，其得到躲避值-3。 强制 - 你躲避夜骑后：将其弃掉。

06153.name: 麦格鸟之歌
06153.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you move out of attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Song of the Magah Bird. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to resist the call or [combat] (4) to drive away the birds. If you succeed, discard Song of the Magah Bird.
06153.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 你移动离开其附属的地点后：受到1点恐惧，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，并弃掉麦格鸟之歌。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)来抵御呼唤，或者检定[combat](4)来赶走鸟群。如果你检定成功，弃掉麦格鸟之歌。

06154.name: 奇妙平原
06154.real_text: Revelation - If there are no clues on your location, discard Wondrous Lands, and it gains surge. Otherwise, attach Wondrous Lands to your location. Attached location gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you successfully investigate attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Wondrous Lands. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
06154.text: 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有线索，弃掉奇妙平原，其获得涌动。否则，将奇妙平原附属到你所在地点。附属地点的隐藏值-2。 强制 - 你成功调查附属的地点后：受到1点恐惧，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记，并弃掉奇妙平原。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。

06155.name: 森哲夫
06155.real_text:
Tetsuo Mori may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Tetsuo Mori is defeated: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches either their discard pile or the top 9 cards of their deck for an [[Item]] asset and adds it to their hand. Shuffle their deck if it is searched.
06155.text:
对你所在地点其他调查员造成的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给森哲夫。
[reaction]在森哲夫被击败时：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找自己牌库顶的9张卡牌或弃牌堆，找出一张[[道具]]支援，将其加入自己的手牌。如果查找过牌库，将其混洗。

06156.name: “吃一堑……”
06156.real_text:
Fast. Play when you would discard a treachery card after resolving any of its effects.
Put "Fool me once..." into play in your play area and attach that treachery to it.
[reaction] When any investigator draws a copy of the attached treachery card, discard "Fool me once...": Cancel that card's revelation effect.
06156.text:
快速。在你结算一张诡计卡牌的任何效果后，将要弃掉该卡牌时打出。
将“吃一堑……”放置入场，放到你的游戏区域，附属该诡计卡牌到“吃一堑……”上。
[reaction]在任意一位调查员抽取与附属的诡计卡牌同名的卡牌时，弃掉“吃一堑……”：取消该卡牌的显现效果。

06157.name: 自我牺牲
06157.real_text:
Commit only to a skill test (of any type) being performed by another investigator at your location.
If this test fails, you must resolve all effects from the failed test, instead of the performing investigator. Then, either you draw 2 cards, or the performing investigator draws 2 cards.
06157.text:
只能投入到你所在地点的另一位调查员执行的技能检定(任意类型)中。
如果本次检定失败，检定失败的所有效果不由执行检定的调查员结算，改为必须由你结算。然后，你抽取2张卡牌，或者执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌。

06158.name: 异界手稿
06158.real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Otherworld Codex and spend 1 secret: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck and choose a non-[[Elite]] card among them. Discard a copy of the chosen card from play. Shuffle all of the searched cards back into the encounter deck.
06158.text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置异界手稿并花费1秘密：查找遭遇牌库顶的9张卡牌，并从中选择一张非[[精英]]卡牌。弃掉场上一张与该所选卡牌同名的卡牌。将查找的所有卡牌混洗回遭遇牌库。

06159.name: 强梦血清
06159.real_text:
Only the first copy of each card in your hand counts toward your maximum hand size.
[reaction] After you draw a copy of a card that is already in your hand, reveal both copies and exhaust Dream-Enhancing Serum: Draw 1 card.
06159.text:
如果你手中有多张同名手牌，检查手牌上限时其只计作一张。
[reaction]你抽取与你手牌同名的卡牌后，揭示这两张卡牌并横置强梦血清：抽取1张卡牌。

06160.name: “让上帝分辨去吧……”
06160.real_text:
Play only during one of your turns in which you defeated enemies with a total of 6 or more health.
Add "Let God sort them out..." to the victory display and immediately end your turn. When earning experience during the resolution of this scenario, you earn 1 additional experience.
06160.text:
你在自己的一个回合期间，击败总计生命值至少为6点的敌人方可打出。
将“让上帝分辨去吧……”加入胜利区，立即结束你的回合。在本场冒险结局期间调查员取得经验值时，你取得额外1点经验值。

06161.name: 快速装填
06161.real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Firearm]] asset you control with fewer ammo tokens than its uses (X) value. Place ammo on that asset until it has ammo equal to its uses (X) value.
06161.text:
快速。只能在你回合期间中打出。
选择你控制的一个[[枪械]]支援(其子弹标记数量少于其“使用(X)”中的X的支援卡)。在该支援上放置子弹，直到子弹数量等于其“使用(X)”中的X。

06162.flavor: 这小子在拿到自己的第一张手牌之前，只靠打量就能猜出对方下注的理由。
06162.name: 格雷戈里·葛利
06162.real_text:
Uses (9 resources).
[reaction] When you initiate a skill test, spend up to 3 resources from Gregory Gry: If this test succeeds by at least that amount, gain that many resources.
06162.text:
使用(9资源)。
[reaction]在你发动一次技能检定时，花费格雷戈里·葛利的最多3资源：如果本次检定成功且至少超过该资源数量，获得相同数量的资源。
06162.traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 入梦者

06163.flavor: 你也不是非要相信这些咒语，只是你别无选择。
06163.name: 治愈真言
06163.real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at your location.
06163.text:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点伤害。

06164.name: 飘渺灵体
06164.real_text: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, disengage from each other enemy engaged with you, and for the remainder of the round, you are ethereal (enemies cannot engage or be engaged with you, and you cannot attack or deal damage to enemies).
06164.text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功，和其他每个与你交战的敌解除交战，且你视为无形(敌人不能与你交战，你不能攻击敌人也不能对敌人造成伤害)，直到本轮结束。

06165.flavor:
你掰开尸体的手把东西拿了下来。
反正他也不会发牢骚。
06165.name: 搜刮补给
06165.real_text: Choose a level 0 card in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.
06165.text: 选择你弃牌堆中一张等级0的卡牌。将所选卡牌加入你的手牌。

06166.name: 蛮力
06166.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Brute Force is committed during a basic fight action, it gains [combat][combat] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, this attack deals +2 damage."
06166.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将蛮力在基础攻击行动期间投入时，其获得[combat][combat]和以下文本：“如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+2伤害。”

06167.flavor: “不抢风头”不代表你没做好准备。
06167.name: 多才多艺
06167.real_text:
Permanent.
You get +5 Deck Size.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Options gain: "one other level 0 card from any class ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor])."
06167.text:
永久。
你的牌库卡牌张数+5。
你调查员的牌库构建选项获得：“1张任意职阶([guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或[survivor])的其它等级0卡牌。”

06168.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-2(如果你位于[[墓地]]地点，改为-4)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败并且不可名状之物在场上，其攻击你(无论其当前地点)。
[tablet]：+1。黑猫掩护你。如果本次检定成功，选择并躲避任意地点的一个攻击值不超过X的敌人，其中X为你超过难度的点数。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，你必须将你的1个线索放到你所在地点，或者受到1点伤害。
06168.name: 万千骇形
06168.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at a [[Graveyard]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and The Unnamable is in play, it attacks you (regardless of its current location).
[tablet]: +2. The black cat causes a distraction. If this test is successful, choose and evade an enemy at any location with a fight value of X or lower, where X is the amount you succeeded by.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or take 1 damage.
06168.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位于[[墓地]]地点，改为-3)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败并且不可名状之物在场上，其攻击你(无论其当前地点)。
[tablet]：+2。黑猫掩护你。如果本次检定成功，选择并躲避任意地点的一个攻击值不超过X的敌人，其中X为你超过难度的点数。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你检定失败，你必须将你的1个线索放到你所在地点，或者受到1点伤害。

06169a.flavor: 伦道夫口中“不可提及”的那座房屋并不起眼。这幢十七世纪的破败建筑已经荒废了数十年，年久失修。大门上布满了划痕，坑坑洼，大部分玻璃窗都破了，老鼠在裸露的地基上爬来爬去。

linked_card.name: The Unnamable
linked_card.real_text: Spawn - Attic or Upstairs Hallway. Aloof. Hunter. Cannot be defeated. For each of the following which are true, The Unnamable gets -1 fight and -1 evade (the investigators "found a cracked mirror," "studied a desecrated portrait," or "noticed the missing bones").
linked_card.text:
Spawn - Attic or Upstairs Hallway.

Aloof. Hunter. Cannot be defeated.

For each of the following which are true, The Unnamable gets -1 fight and -1 evade (the investigators "found a cracked mirror," "studied a desecrated portrait," or "noticed the missing bones").

06169a.name: 无名之屋

06169b.name: 不可名状之物
06169b.real_text: Spawn - Attic or Upstairs Hallway. Aloof. Hunter. Cannot be defeated. For each of the following which are true, The Unnamable gets -1 fight and -1 evade (the investigators "found a cracked mirror," "studied a desecrated portrait," or "noticed the missing bones").
06169b.text: 生成 - 阁楼或楼上的走廊。 冷漠。猎手。不能被击败。 以下每有一种情况属实，不可名状之物得到攻击值-1和躲避值-1(调查员“找到了破碎的镜子”，“研究了一幅亵渎的肖像画”，“发现了缺失的骨头”)。
06169b.traits: 怪物. 异形. 精英

06170.back_flavor: 时间所剩无几。这个实体之前似乎只是在不时出没，并且远远地观察你，但它现在凶残异常，无情地追赶着你。它身躯扭曲，猛烈摆动，似乎每个地方都会同时出现它的踪影。你必须加快速度并面对自己的恐惧，否则你永远也找不到进入幻梦境的道路。
06170.back_text: 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
06170.flavor: 你刚一来到，就感觉到有邪恶之物在此潜伏。任何言辞都无法描述这个实体。有时它似乎是无形的：而其他时候，它又表现出各种形态和特征。你不时能认出一些部位——一只眼晴、一只角、一道疤痕——但是，一旦你盯着那个部位，它就会迅速消失。
06170.name: 无名之物
06170.real_text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 1. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).
06170.text: 每张鼠群获得蜂拥1。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时，如果不可名状之物处于重整状态并且位于你所在地点：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，其攻击你(无论其是否交战)。

06171.back_flavor:
让你感到惊讶的是，最可怕的声音——会永远刻在你那晚的记忆里——不是不可名状之物沮丧哭喊的回响，也不是墓地里干尸被吞噬时发出的像纸张一样嘎吱嘎吱的声音。而是一扇花格窗发出的嘎吱声。
伦道夫脸色苍白，僵在原地。就在他记起这道声音之后，你明白了这意味着什么。这幢房子里的所有窗框早已脱落——唯有一扇窗例外。那就是阁楼的窗户，无名之物就藏在阁楼那被诅咒的邪恶黑暗之中。它来找你了。
06171.flavor: “一阵冰冷的刺骨寒风呼啸而来，接着是砖块与水泥剥落的咔嗒咔嗒声；幸好，我还没明白这意味着什么就昏厥过去。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
06171.name: 无名之死
06171.real_text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 2. The Unnamable loses aloof and gains massive. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).
06171.text: 每张鼠群获得蜂拥2。 不可名状之物失去冷漠并获得庞大。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时，如果不可名状之物处于重整状态并且位于你所在地点：检定[willpower](2)。如果你检定失败，其攻击你(无论其是否交战)。

06172.back_flavor: 墓穴通向一条楼梯，一直延伸到地下深处，尽头消失在黑暗中。
06172.back_text: 将不可名状之物放在一边。其保留所有标记和附属。 将所有地点从游戏中移除(或如果其有胜利X且没有线索，将其放入胜利区)。调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。(这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉。) 将放在一边的神秘阶梯地点混洗，并将其中5张放置入场，排成一条纵列。将剩余的神秘阶梯地点从游戏中移除。 将每位调查员和放在一边的不可名状之物敌人放在最上方的神秘阶梯地点，揭示该地点。 查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出两张上锁的门和两张阁楼的秘密，将其从游戏中移除。 将每张放在一边的无尽深入和遭遇弃牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌库。
06172.flavor: 你仍然不知道你要在这幢老房子里找些什么，但伦道夫坚持说你必须找到“钥匙”。看来你别无选择，只得搜寻这幢房子，看看能找到什么。
06172.name: 搜寻不可名状之物
06172.real_text: Objective - Explore the house to find a way into the Dreamlands. (Find and complete an objective on another scenario card to advance.)
06172.text: 目标 - 探索这幢房子，以找到进入幻梦境的方法。 (找到并完成另一张冒险卡牌上的目标以推进。)

06173.back_flavor:
那个无名生物——无论它是什么，或者它曾经是什么——它孤独的叫声从上方远远传来，回荡在这个诡异的洞穴里。“它没法下到这里来。”伦道夫说着，松了一口气。下降的过程十分痛苦，但你们终于逃离了那无法名状的怪物。但是，你们的安全感转瞬即逝。脚下盘旋的楼梯看不到尽头。这座尖塔的石墙上，一道道窗户俯瞰着无尽的岩石峭壁和光秃秃的山峰，朦胧地罩着昏暗的光芒。你距离这个地下世界的地面还有好几英里，到那儿的时候会遇上什么样的恐怖，又有谁会知道呢？
“这只是开始。”伦道夫提醒你，“现在已经没有回头路了。你准备好继续往前走了吗？”
06173.flavor: 阶梯仿佛无穷无尽地向下延伸。每当你以为接近底部，转过一处弯角，又会看到数百级台阶。
06173.name: 无尽阶梯
06173.real_text: While the bottommost Mysterious Stairs location is revealed, it gains: "[action]: Resign." Objective - Reach the bottom of the stairs. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
06173.text: 最下方的神秘阶梯地点被揭示时，其获得：“[action]：撤退。” 目标 - 到达阶梯底部。如果所有未被击败的调查员都已撤退，推进。

06174.back_flavor: “我望着墓地中央的一棵巨大的柳树，它的树干几乎陷在一块古老的、字迹模糊的石板上，我曾经说过一句荒唐的话，说那巨大的树根一定是在这片久远的、安葬死者的土地上，吸收幽灵的、难以言说的养分……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
06174.name: 坟地
06174.real_text:
Each [[Ghoul]] enemy drawn spawns at Burial Ground instead of at its normal location.
[fast] Investigators in the Burial Ground spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "noticed the missing bones."
06174.text:
抽取到的每个[[食尸鬼]]敌人不生成在在其通常的生成地点，改为生成在坟地。
[free]位于坟地的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“发现了缺失的骨头”。

06175.back_flavor: “我想看看那幢房子，卡特。它在哪里？不管那里有没有玻璃，我都想进去调查一下。还有你安放骸骨的墓穴，以及另一个没有碑文的坟墓——这整件事有点可怕。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
06175.name: 入口
06175.real_text:
[fast] Investigators in the Entryway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Reveal the Upstairs Hallway.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 1 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: Smoke trails off of the creature, leading to a tomb near the center of the cemetery outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.
06175.text:
[free]位于入口的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：揭示楼上的走廊。
[free]如果不可名状之物上有至少1[per_investigator]点伤害：那只怪物拖着一道烟雾，烟雾的尽头指向外头墓地中央的一座墓穴。将放在一边的无名坟墓地点放置入场。

06176.back_flavor: 这道门之前从未打开。你只是回头看了一眼，但你认为自己看到了些什么。但你究竟看到了什么呢？是个模糊的影子？还是看到了一个人影？
06176.name: 休息间
06176.real_text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate the Den, discard 1 card from your hand: Discover an additional clue at this location.
[fast] Investigators in the Den spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "studied a desecrated portrait."
06176.text:
[reaction]你成功调查休息间后，弃掉你的1张手牌：发现本地点的额外一个线索。
[free]位于休息间的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“研究了一幅亵渎的肖像画”。

06177.back_flavor: 这道门之前从未打开。你只是回头看了一眼，但你认为自己看到了些什么。但你究竟看到了什么呢？是个模糊的影子？还是看到了一个人影？
06177.name: 客厅
06177.real_text:
For each investigator at the Parlor, it gets +1 shroud.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 2 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: The mirror gleams unnaturally, revealing a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."
06177.text:
每有一位调查员位于客厅，其得到隐藏值+1。
[free]如果不可名状之物上有至少2[per_investigator]点伤害：镜子不自然地闪着光芒，露出一抹银光。记住调查员“发现了一把奇怪的钥匙”。

06178.back_flavor: “快过来！我刚刚正要记录我的进度，你来看这个。这些小小的光芒是一只只眼晴。一定是的！有什么东西在盯着我。“<cite>安妮·范德米尔·米特索达，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>
06178.back_text: 恶臭让你不敢上楼。你不能进入楼上的走廊。
06178.name: 楼上的走廊
06178.real_text: [fast] Investigators in the Upstairs Hallway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Attic location into play.
06178.text: [free]位于楼上的走廊的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将放在一边的阁楼地点放置入场。

06179.back_flavor: 有什么东西在另一边刮着木板。老鼠？还是说只是你的想象？不，一定是某些东西。某些怪异的东西。
06179.name: 藏书室
06179.real_text:
As an additional cost to investigate the Library, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
[fast] Investigators in the Library spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You read a strange journal entry regarding one of the graves in the burial ground outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.
06179.text:
作为调查藏书室的额外费用，你必须失去1个行动或受到1点恐惧。
[free]位于藏书室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：你翻阅了一篇古怪的日志，提到外面墓地里的一座坟墓。将放在一边的无名坟墓地点放置入场。

06180.back_flavor: 有什么东西在另一边刮着木板。老鼠？还是说只是你的想象？不，一定是某些东西。某些怪异的东西。
06180.name: 卧室
06180.real_text:
[action] [action]: Discard all non-weakness treachery cards from your threat area.
[fast] Investigators in the Bedroom spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a cracked mirror."
06180.text:
[action][action]：弃掉你威胁区域的所有非弱点诡计卡牌。
[free]位于卧室的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：记住调查员“找到了破碎的镜子”。

06181.back_flavor: “他们从不打开阁楼的门，让这整幢房子像原来一样，令人害怕，无人居住。当这里传出噪声，他们压低声音，浑身发抖；希望阁楼的门锁够结实。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
06181.name: 阁楼
06181.real_text: [fast] Investigators in the Attic spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deep within a pile of monstrous bones, you see a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."
06181.text: [free]位于阁楼的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：在一堆怪异的骨头底下，你看到了一抹银光。记住调查员“发现了一把奇怪的钥匙”。

06182.back_flavor: “……墓穴里传出一些声响，其中有沉闷的喘息声，飕飕的风声，令我不禁想象，米尔顿笔下那群畸形的坠入地狱的灵魂就居住在这无光的昏暗中。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《不可名状之物》</cite>
06182.name: 无名坟墓
06182.real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each undefeated investigator is at Unmarked Tomb and the investigators "recovered a strange key," advance the act.
06182.text: 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果每位未被击败的调查员都位于无名坟墓，并且调查员“发现了把奇怪的钥匙”，推进场景。

06183.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06183.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06183.name: 神秘阶梯
06183.real_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - After you enter this location: Lose 1 action.
06183.text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。 强制 - 你进入本地点后：失去1个行动。

06184.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06184.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06184.name: 神秘阶梯
06184.real_text:
Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
While there are clues on this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign.
06184.text:
神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
本地点上有线索时，位于本地点的调查员不能移动，也不能撤退。

06185.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06185.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06185.name: 神秘阶梯
06185.real_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. While there is a ready enemy at this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign. Forced - When this location is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghoul]] enemy and spawn it at this location. Shuffle the encounter deck.
06185.text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。 本地点上有重整状态的敌人时，位于本地点的调查员不能移动，也不能撤退。 强制 - 在本地点揭示时：查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[食尸鬼]]敌人并将其生成在本地点。混洗遭遇牌库。

06186.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06186.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06186.name: 神秘阶梯
06186.real_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - When this location is revealed: Place 1 [per_investigator] resources on it. While there are resources on this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign. [action]: Test your lowest skill (2). If successful, discard 1 resource from this location.
06186.text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。 强制 - 在本地点揭示时：在其上放置1[per_investigator]资源。本地点上有资源时，位于本地点的调查员不能移动，也不能撤退。 [action]：检定你技能值最低的技能(2)。如果你检定成功，弃掉本地点的1资源。

06187.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06187.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06187.name: 神秘阶梯
06187.real_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - When this location is revealed: Move The Unnamable to it. While The Unnamable is at this location and has fewer than 1 [per_investigator] damage on it, investigators at this location cannot move or resign.
06187.text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。 强制 - 在本地点揭示时：将不可名状之物移动到本地点。 不可名状之物位于本地点，且其上的伤害少于1[per_investigator]时，位于本地点的调查员不能移动，也不能撤退。

06188.back_flavor: “这些台阶破旧而狭窄，还因为地里渗出的液体而变得油滑，导致走在楼梯上的人根本不知道自己何时会突然摔倒，跌入无底的深坑……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06188.back_text: 神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
06188.name: 神秘阶梯
06188.real_text:
Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
As an additional cost for you to move or resign at this location, you must discard 1 or more cards from your hand with at least 2 instances of the same skill icon among them.
06188.text:
神秘阶梯与其上方和下方的地点连接。
作为你在本地点移动或撤退的额外费用，你必须弃掉你至少1张手牌，且弃掉的手牌中必须有至少2个相同的技能图标。

06189.flavor: “里面有一把失去了光泽的巨大钥匙，裹在一卷褪色的羊皮纸当中，钥匙上刻着神秘的阿拉伯式图案；却没有任何清晰可辨的文字说明。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《银钥匙》</cite>
06189.name: 银钥匙
06189.real_text: [reaction] When you would take horror, exhaust The Silver Key: Cancel 1 of that horror.
06189.text: [reaction]在你将要受到恐惧时，横置银钥匙：取消该恐惧中的1点。
06189.traits: 道具. 守护. 遗物

06190.name: 无尽深入
06190.real_text: Revelation - Move each investigator and enemy at the topmost location to the location below it. Flip the topmost location to its unrevealed side, discard all tokens and attachments from it, and place it below the bottommost location. Shuffle the positions of each unrevealed location so you cannot tell which is which. Add this card to the victory display.
06190.text: 显现 - 将位于最上方地点的所有调查员和敌人移动到其连接的下方地点。将最上方的地点翻至其未揭示面，弃掉其所有标记和附属，将其放到最下方的地点下方。将所有未揭示的地点混洗以打乱位置，使你无法辨认。将本卡牌加入胜利区。

06191.name: 难以描述的鬼魅
06191.real_text: Revelation - Put Indescribable Apparition into play in your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills while The Unnamable is at your location. [action] [action]: Discard Indescribable Apparition.
06191.text: 显现 - 将难以描述的鬼魅放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 不可名状之物位于你所在地点时，你得到每项技能值-1。 [action][action]：弃掉难以描述的鬼魅。

06192.name: 发光的眼睛
06192.real_text: Revelation - Put Glowing Eyes into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Take 1 horror for each card in your threat area, to a maximum of 3 horror. Discard Glowing Eyes.
06192.text: 显现 - 将发光的眼睛放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：你的威胁区域每有一张卡牌，受到1点恐惧，最多受到3点恐惧。弃掉发光的眼睛。

06193.name: 欺骗性记忆
06193.real_text: Revelation - Put Deceptive Memories into play in your threat area. Forced - After another card enters your threat area: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Deceptive Memories.
06193.text: 显现 - 将欺骗性记忆放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 另一张卡牌进入你的威胁区域后：选择并弃掉你1张手牌。 [action]：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉欺骗性记忆。

06194.name: 阁楼的秘密
06194.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror and put Secrets in the Attic into play next to the agenda deck. [fast] abilities on locations cannot be triggered. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Secrets in the Attic from play. (Max once per round.)
06194.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，受到1点恐惧并将阁楼的秘密放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 地点上的[free]能力不能触发。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张阁楼的秘密。(每轮最多一次。)

06195.name: .35温彻斯特步枪
06195.real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If a +1, 0, or [elder_sign] chaos token is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +2 damage.
06195.text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。(FAQ，v1.7)你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了+1、0或[elder_sign]混乱标记，本次攻击造成+2伤害。
06195.traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

06196.flavor:
她告诉我，当心别碰上麻烦。
我翻了个白眼。麻烦事可从没消停过。
06196.name: 安全护卫
06196.real_text: [reaction] During another investigator's turn, exhaust Safeguard: For the remainder of that investigator's turn, as they move from your location to a connecting location, you may move to that location as well.
06196.text: [reaction]在其他调查员的回合期间，横置安全护卫：在该调查员的回合结束前，当该调查员从你所在地点移动到连接地点时，你也可以移动到该地点。

06197.name: 熟能生巧
06197.real_text:
Fast. Play during a skill test at your location.
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Practiced]] skill and commit it to this skill test, if able. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your deck. After this test ends, if it was successful, add that skill to your hand instead of discarding it.
06197.text:
快速。在你所在地点的技能检定期间打出。
查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出一张[[精通]]技能并将其投入本次技能检定(如可能)。将其余卡牌混洗回你的牌库。本次检定结束后，如果检定成功，不将该技能弃掉，改为将该技能加入你的手牌中。

06198.flavor:
“这儿也没发现。我们还差多少没查？”
“……瞧瞧你背后这面墙？”
06198.name: 海量研究
06198.real_text:
Reduce the cost to play Extensive Research by 1 for each other card in your hand.
Discover 2 clues at your location.
06198.text:
你每有一张其它手牌，海量研究的打出费用减少1点。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。

06199.name: 三条A
06199.real_text: Myriad. If you commit 3 copies of Three Aces to a skill test, that test automatically succeeds (do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag). Then draw 3 cards and gain 3 resources (max once per test).
06199.text: 多重。 如果你将3张三条A投入到一次技能检定中，该检定自动成功(不要从混乱袋抽取混乱标记)。然后，抽取3张卡牌并获得3资源(本效果每次检定最多1次)。

06200.name: 夜盗
06200.real_text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 2 resources, +1 additional resource for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +3 resources).
06200.text: [action]横置夜盗：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为获得2资源，你检定成功且每超过难度1点，额外+1资源(最大+3)。

06201.name: 幽灵利刃
06201.real_text: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. Immediately before this attack, you may engage the attacked enemy. This attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]]).
06201.text: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。本次攻击前，你可以立即与被攻击敌人交战。本次攻击造成+1伤害(如果该敌人非[[精英]]，改为造成+2伤害)。

06202.flavor:
为明视野，要有光。
为暖体肤，要有热。
为救灵魂，要有火。
06202.name: 命令真言
06202.real_text: Name a [[Spell]] card. Search your deck for 1 copy of the named card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
06202.text: 指定一张[[法术]]卡牌。查找你的牌库，找出并抽取1张指定的卡牌。混洗你的牌库。

06203.name: 月石
06203.real_text: You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility]. You cannot play or commit Moonstone from your hand. [reaction] After you discard Moonstone from your hand: Play it (paying its cost).
06203.text: 你得到+1[willpower]和+1[agility]。 你不能从手牌中打出月石，也不能将其从手牌中投入检定。 [reaction]你从手牌中弃掉月石后：将其打出(支付其费用)。
06203.traits: 道具. 遗物. 幻梦境

06204.name: 目力敏锐
06204.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Sharp Vision is committed during a basic investigate action, it gains [intellect] [intellect] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, discover 1 additional clue at this location."
06204.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将目力敏锐在基础调查行动期间投入时，其获得[intellect][intellect]和以下文本：“如果这次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，发现本地点的额外1个线索。”

06205.flavor: “……所有生命都仅仅只是大脑中的一串图像，这些图像不管是来自真实，还是来自内在梦境，它们之间并无区别……”<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《银钥匙》</cite>
06205.name: 清醒梦
06205.real_text: Choose a card in your play area or reveal a card in your hand. Search your deck for another copy of that card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
06205.text: 选择你游戏区域的一张卡牌，或揭示你的一张手牌。查找你的牌库，找出并抽取另一张该卡牌的同名卡牌。混洗你的牌库。

06206.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X，X为你的警报等级。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，并且你的警报等级高于你修正后的技能值，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。
[elder_thing]：0。黑猫召唤了几只猫来帮你。如果在尝试躲避期间揭示本标记，并且你检定成功，对躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。
06206.name: 月之暗面
06206.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and your alarm level is higher than your modified skill value, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -1. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[elder_thing]: +1. The black cat summons several other cats to help. If this token is revealed during an evasion attempt and you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy.
06206.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X，X为你警报等级的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，并且你的警报等级高于你修正后的技能值，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：-1。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。
[elder_thing]：+1。黑猫召唤了几只猫来帮你。如果在尝试躲避期间揭示本标记，并且你检定成功，对躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。

06207.back_flavor:
一声尖叫打破了这寂静，你本能地躲了起来。你之前见过它们：飞在海盗的黑色帆船旁边的，可怕的无眼怪物。它们有着恐怖的骨骼，还有像皮革一样的膜状皮肤。
它们成群盘旋在你头顶上，发出尖叫。你被发现了吗？不管如何，你都得离开这里。
06207.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
06207.flavor: 这里的寂静振聋发聩。空气中没有一丝风的呼啸，没有鸟儿的啾鸣，没有任何声音。这是没有生命的世界。你听不见把这里当作家园的野兽和海盗的声音，但你知道危险无处不在。你必须更加安静，才能不被发现。
06207.name: 无声暗涌

06208.back_flavor: 一群体态轻盈的生物包围了你，堵住了你的逃跑路线。第一眼看去，你以为它们是猫，但它们的形态只是略微像猫。你误以为它们身上带有皮毛，细看发现更像是一种古怪的丝线图案。你无声地祈求救援……
06208.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
检查剧本日志。如果调查员强行进入神庙，阅读下列内容：
……但没人来救你。
调查员队长查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张土星猫并将其抽取。
否则，阅读下列内容：
……突然，一大群猫咪从虚空跃出，落在你身前，让你惊讶不已。你认出为首的猫咪正是你在数月之前见过的伤疤老灰猫。“快走，人类！”它大喊，“我们来对付它们！”
06208.flavor: 时间一分一秒地过去，你脚下的步伐也越来越快，而怪物也更加疯狂地追赶着你。之前被你咒骂的寂静已被不时传来的刺耳尖叫打破，情况变得更糟了。
06208.name: 警报响起

06209.back_text:
每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。
每位调查员受到等于其警报等级一半的恐惧(向上取整)。
将密谋牌库重置到密谋3a。然后，在该密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。
06209.flavor: 所有的月球住民倾巢而出向你袭来。不管走到哪里，不是一群海盗在等着你，就是潜伏起来的猫群，要把你赶到它们邪恶的主人面前。上方的天空满是长有翅膀的怪兽和黑色的帆船。要是找不到返回地球的方法，你必然会被它们抓走。
06209.name: 它们是冲着你来的！
06209.real_text: (Hint - The game will not end when this agenda advances... but the agents of Nyarlathotep will tighten their noose.)
06209.text: (提示：本密谋推进时本场游戏不会结束……但奈亚拉托提普的使徒们会收紧它们的圈套。)

06210.back_flavor: 经过几小时在布满鳞片的石塔周围到处寻找，你终于在码头上看到一群戴着镣铐的俘虏，他们排成一队，不知道要被带到什么地方去。还好，只有两个邪恶的海盗负责看守。你利用声响引开他们的注意力，然后偷偷溜过去解救俘虏。
06210.back_text: 选择位于月兽之城的一位调查员控制放在一边的维吉尔·格雷(文思泉涌))剧情支援。 检查剧本日志。如果伦道夫被俘，该卡牌的所有者将放在一边的伦道夫·卡特(梦境专家)剧情支援放入手牌。
06210.flavor: 在这座怪异而庞大的月兽之城，维吉尔·格雷就被关在其中的某个地方。如果你想不引人注目地找到他并逃走，那么你必须保持安静，多留心眼。
06210.name: 月兽腹地
06210.real_name: In the Belly of the Moon-Beast
06210.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the City of the Moon-Beasts may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
06210.text: 目标 - 只有位于月兽之城的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

06211.back_flavor:
这座神庙大部分都供奉着一种被称为“月蜥”的月球生物的雕像，你还发现有文字指向月球地下，距离表面不远的地方有着某种原始的黑色粘液形成的湖泊，其连接着月球的核心。“这些文字暗示着，整个月球表面都是透过这一‘核心’连接到不同世界的。或许我们可以利用它，去到月球的另一面。”伦道夫提议道。
“或者去到死后的世界。”维吉尔补充。
“是的，只有这两种结果。”伦道夫没好气地说道，“我们也没别的选择了。”
06211.back_text: 将放在一边的月下洞穴(暗面)和黑暗月核地点放置入场。 将放在一边的月蜥以横置状态生成在黑暗月核。 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。
06211.flavor: 你们已经重聚，该离开这座石塔了。伦道夫告诉你，月兽只住在这一面，所以月球的亮面应该是安全的，不受月兽的威胁。但是，距离那里实在太过遥远，无法徒步到达。你们需要寻找别的办法逃离。
06211.name: 月上探索
06211.real_text: Objective - Only investigators at the Temple of the Moon Lizard may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
06211.text: 目标 - 只有位于月蜥神庙的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

06212.back_flavor: 月球表面以下的黑水湖有几英里宽，里面充满了温热的有毒气体。绝大部分的湖床完全都是固态，有那么一瞬间，你觉得伦道夫的计划走进了死胡同。随后，你踏下一步，接着你的脚接触到的是……虚无。你还没反应过来，就被猛地拉到了湖面下方。你试图大喊，提醒你的同伴，但你的声音彷佛和你的身体一起，被这黑暗月核吞没。你肺部的空气几乎被完全挤出。一股猛烈的底流把你卷走，你拼命忍着不发出尖叫。当你终于浮出水面，你发现自己所在的地方和你来时的一样，除了能看到一束光刺穿上方的地壳。过了一会，你的其他同伴也出来了。“我们成功了吗？”维吉尔问，“啊？我还以为一切都结束了呢。这一段写出来肯定十分刺激！”
06212.back_text: 将放在一边的月下洞穴(亮面)、月之亮面、白船地点放置入场。
06212.flavor: 你打消内心的疑虑，来到月球的地壳之下。为了到月球的另一面去，你必须穿过月球的黑暗月核，那里的液体跨越维度，孕育着噩梦。
06212.name: 月之核心
06212.real_text: Clues cannot be discovered from The Black Core except as a result of a successful investigation. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at The Black Core and it has no clues on it, advance.
06212.text: 黑暗月核的线索只能通过调查成功来发现，其他方式均不能发现。 目标 -如果每位幸存的调查员都位于黑暗月核，且黑暗月核没有线索，推进。

06213.back_flavor: 你们一行人顺利登上了白船后，你恳求白船的船长马上驶离月球。如果可以，你一秒也不想再待在这个充满危险的地方。“现在还不行。”船长亲切地笑着说道。你一再苦苦哀求，但他举手示意你安静，同时眺望远方。你眯着眼睛迎着阳光望去，太阳就静静地悬挂在漆黑的天穹上。就在几英里以外，你看到是什么东西吸引了船长的目光：那是一只有着许多翅膀、色彩丰富的鸟，它身上的羽毛十分鲜亮。它停在一处残破的石质建筑上，整理着自己的羽毛。然后，就在你快要失去耐心的时候，它直直冲上了太空，船长也随之拉起了船锚。
06213.flavor: 在月球的亮面，许多船只在无风的空中航行，巡逻表面情况。但是，其中一艘船和其他船只不一样。它的船身光秃秃的，闪闪发亮，在黑夜里发出一道白光。“白船！”伦道夫惊叹道。
06213.name: 意外救援
06213.real_text: Objective - Find a way off the Moon. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
06213.text: 目标 - 设法离开月球。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)。

linked_card.name: Off the Galley
linked_card.real_text:
If there were no clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
Moving as stealthily as you can, you find a dinghy tied to the side of the ship, two oars left inside. If this galley can move through space using oars, surely this lifeboat can, too. Making sure to stay as quiet as possible, you hop inside the small boat and make your escape.
 Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Moon-Forest. Remove this card from the game.
If there were 1 or more clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
The ship docks at a great city of stone towers, and you slip away as the guards search for you.
Each investigator here raises their alarm level by 1. Move each investigator here to the City of the Moon-Beasts, along with each enemy here. Remove this card from the game.
linked_card.text:
If there were no clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:

Moving as stealthily as you can, you find a dinghy tied to the side of the ship, two oars left inside. If this galley can move through space using oars, surely this lifeboat can, too. Making sure to stay as quiet as possible, you hop inside the small boat and make your escape.

Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Moon-Forest. Remove this card from the game.

If there were 1 or more clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:

The ship docks at a great city of stone towers, and you slip away as the guards search for you.
Each investigator here raises their alarm level by 1.

Move each investigator here to the City of the Moon-Beasts, along with each enemy here.

Remove this card from the game.

06214.name: 月兽帆船
06214.real_text: Investigators cannot enter or leave Moon-Beast Galley via player card effects. [fast] If there are no clues remaining on Moon-Beast Galley: Flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play: Flip Moon-Beast Galley over.
06214.text: 调查员不能通过玩家卡的效果进入或离开月兽帆船。 [free]如果月兽帆船上没有线索：将其翻面。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果场上有至少3个毁灭标记：将月兽帆船翻面。

06214b.name: 下船
06214b.real_text:
If there were no clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
Moving as stealthily as you can, you find a dinghy tied to the side of the ship, two oars left inside. If this galley can move through space using oars, surely this lifeboat can, too. Making sure to stay as quiet as possible, you hop inside the small boat and make your escape.
 Discard each enemy here. Move each investigator here to the Moon-Forest. Remove this card from the game.
If there were 1 or more clues on this card when it was flipped, read the following:
The ship docks at a great city of stone towers, and you slip away as the guards search for you.
Each investigator here raises their alarm level by 1. Move each investigator here to the City of the Moon-Beasts, along with each enemy here. Remove this card from the game.
06214b.text:
如果本卡牌翻面时已没有线索，阅读以下内容：
你尽量轻声走动，找到拴在船侧的一艘小艇，艇里还留了两把船桨。如果帆船能够靠桨穿越太空，那么这艘救生艇也一定可以。你确保不发出声响，轻轻地跳进救生艇里逃走。
将本地点的每位调查员移动到月之森林。 将本卡牌从游戏中移除，弃掉位于本地点的所有敌人。
如果本卡牌翻面时有至少1个线索，阅读以下内容：
这艘船在一座由无数石塔形成的巨大城市靠岸，你趁着守卫还在搜寻你的时候溜走了。
本地点的每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。 将本地点的每位调查员和每个敌人移动到月兽之城。 将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

06215.back_flavor: “前方逐渐升起了一片嶙峋的海岸，上面有着高低参差的群山，卡特看到了一座城市，那里有着令人不安的灰色高塔。它们倾斜而弯曲，林立丛聚，每座塔上都没有窗户，这让即将被关押的囚徒感到十分不安……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06215.name: 月兽之城
06215.real_text: X is the highest alarm level among all investigators. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the City of the Moon-Beasts tests [agility] (2). Each investigator who fails must raise their alarm level by 1.
06215.text: X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：位于月兽之城每位调查员检定[agility](2)。检定失败的每位调查员必须将自己的警报等级提高1级。

06216.back_flavor: “船逐渐向月球的边缘驶去，卡特很快就明白目的地正是月球总是背向地球的那一面，它无比神秘，除了入梦者斯尼瑞斯·寇，从来没有人类见过。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06216.name: 漆黑深坑
06216.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (5) to hide within the crater. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at The Dark Crater and have discovered 1 or more of its clues this turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
06216.text: [action]：检定[intellect](5)以躲在坑里。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) 强制 - 当你回合结束时，如果你位于漆黑深坑，并且你在本回合发现了其上的至少1个线索：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。

06217.back_flavor: “群山之上的神庙遗迹矗立在特定的位置，使得它们只能用来供奉邪神，或者德不配位之神，而在那些破碎立柱呈现的对称性中，似乎也隐含着某些不希望被人解明的深层黑暗含义。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06217.name: 月蜥神庙
06217.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (5) to hide inside the forbidden temple. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - After you discover any number of clues at the Temple of the Moon Lizard: You must either take that much horror or discard that many cards from your hand.
06217.text: [action]：检定[willpower](5)以躲在禁闭的神庙里。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) 强制 - 在你发现月蜥神庙的任意数量的线索后：你必须受到相同数量的恐惧，或弃掉相同数量的手牌。

06218.back_flavor: “当靠近海岸线时，那座城市散发出的可怕恶臭变得愈发强烈。同时，他还看到高低参差的群山上的大片森林，其中一些树木与地球上的魔幻森林里孤零零的月树显然有着相同的渊源，棕色的小祖格鼠正是用这种树木的汁液来酿造它们那奇特的美酒。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06218.name: 月之森林
06218.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to hide among the strange trees. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) [fast] During your turn, except during another action: Evade. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. (Limit once per round.)
06218.text: [action]：检定[agility](5)以藏身在怪异的森林中。如果你检定成功，你的警报等级下降1级。(每场游戏仅限1次成功。) [free]在你回合期间(行动外)：躲避。如果你检定失败，你的警报等级提高1级。(每轮仅限一次。)

06219.back_flavor: “……而在月球山脉上遥远的某座不洁的尖峰之上，蠕行混沌奈亚拉托提普正在那里的洞穴徒劳地等待着。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06219.name: 月下洞穴
06219.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.
06219.text: 强制 - 你调查月下洞穴时技能检定失败后：其隐藏值-2，直到你回合结束。

06220.back_flavor: 当你越来越接近月球的黑暗核心，厚厚的黑色淤泥开始阻碍你前进……
06220.back_text: 通往月球核心的道路漫长而曲折。月下洞穴 (暗面)上有线索时，你不能进入黑暗月核。
06220.name: 黑暗月核
06220.real_text: X is the number of depth tokens on The Black Core. Forced - After The Black Core is revealed: Place 3 resources on it, as depth tokens, plus an additional 3 [per_investigator] depth tokens. [action]: Test [willpower] (2) or [combat] (2) to swim through the dark lake at the Moon's core. For each point you succeed by, remove 1 depth token from The Black Core.
06220.text: X为黑暗月核上的深度标记数量。 强制 - 黑暗月核揭示后：在其上放置3资源作为深度标记，再加上额外3[per_investigator]个深度标记。 [action]：检定[willpower](2)或[combat](2)来游过月核的黑水湖。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，移除黑暗月核的1个深度标记。

06221.back_flavor: “群山之上的神庙遗迹矗立在特定的位置，使得它们只能用来供奉邪神，或者德不配位之神……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06221.name: 月下洞穴
06221.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.
06221.text: 强制 - 你调查月下洞穴时技能检定失败后：其隐藏值-2，直到你回合结束。

06222.back_text: 通往月球表面的道路漫长而曲折。月下洞穴(亮面)上有线索时，你不能进入月之亮面。
06222.flavor: “……而在那些破碎立柱呈现的对称性中，似乎也隐含着某些不希望被人解明的深层黑暗含义。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06222.name: 月之亮面
06222.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (1) or [agility] (1) to attempt to hide among the ruins. For every 3 points you succeed by, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit one success per round.)
06222.text: [action]：检定[intellect](1)或[agility](1)，尝试藏身于废墟之中。你每超过难度3点，使你的警报等级降低1级。(每轮仅限一次成功。)

06223.back_flavor: “……它总是平稳而无声地滑行着，远远就能看到它的船帆，还有那规律地摆动着的奇怪长桨。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《白船》</cite>
06223.back_text: 这艘神秘帆船的船长不允许你登船，除非追赶你的月兽均已撤退。你的警报等级至少为5时，你不能进入白船。
06223.name: 白船
06223.real_text: You cannot enter The White Ship while your alarm level is 5 or higher. Forced - After The White Ship is revealed: Put the set-aside The Captain story asset into play at The White Ship.
06223.text: 你的警报等级至少为5时，你不能进入白船。 强制 - 白船揭示后：将放在一边的船长剧情支援放置入场，位于白船。

06224.name: 维吉尔·格雷
06224.real_text: [reaction] After your alarm level is raised: Either draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, or heal 1 horror from Virgil Gray. If there is more than 1 investigator in the game, give control of Virgil Gray to another investigator. Forced - If Virgil Gray leaves play: Remove him from the game.
06224.text: [reaction]你的警报等级提高后：抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，或治愈维吉尔·格雷的1点恐惧。如果游戏中有超过1位调查员，将维吉尔·格雷的控制权交给另一位调查员。 强制 - 如果维吉尔·格雷离场：将他从游戏中移除。(FAQ，v2.0)

06225.name: 船长
06225.real_text: [action] If each undefeated investigator is at The White Ship: Parley. Test [willpower] (X) or [intellect] (X) to convince the captain to set sail. X is the highest alarm level among the investigators. If you succeed, advance the act. Any investigator at The White Ship may activate this ability.
06225.text: [action]如果每位未被击败的调查员都位于白船：谈判。检定[willpower](X)或[intellect](X)以说服船长启航，X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级。如果你检定成功，推进场景。位于白船的任意调查员都可以激活此能力。

06226.name: 月蜥
06226.real_text:
Hunter.
Moon Lizard can only enter [[Cave]] locations.
While Moon Lizard is engaged with an investigator, X is that investigator's alarm level. Otherwise, X is 5.
06226.text:
猎手。
月蜥只能进入[[洞穴]]地点。
月蜥与调查员交战时，X为该调查员的警报等级。否则，X为5。

06227.name: 月之拜亚基
06227.real_text: Spawn - Nearest [[Surface]] location. Prey - Highest alarm level (3 or more only). Alert. Hunter. While moving or engaging, Moonbound Byakhee ignores investigators with an alarm level of 2 or less.
06227.text: 生成 - 最近的[[月面]]地点。 猎物 - 警报等级最高(并且至少为3)。 警戒。猎手。 月之拜亚基移动或交战时，其忽略警报等级小于等于2的调查员。

06228.name: 土星猫
06228.real_text: Hunter. Swarming X. X is your alarm level (or the highest alarm level among investigators if there is no active investigator). Forced - After the host Cats from Saturn moves or is evaded: Discard 1 of its swarm cards.
06228.text: 猎手。蜂拥X。 X为你的警报等级。(如果此时非调查阶段，则X为所有调查员之中最高的警报等级)。 强制 - 土星猫的头领移动或被躲避后：弃掉其1张蜂拥卡牌。

06229.name: 月兽
06229.real_text: Retaliate. Forced - After Moon-Beast enters play: Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1. Forced - After you defeat Moon-Beast: Reduce each investigator's alarm level by 1.
06229.text: 反击。 强制 - 月兽入场后：每位调查员的警报等级提高1级。 强制 - 你击败月兽后：每位调查员的警报等级下降1级。

06230.flavor: 你的心脏在胸口里砰砰直跳。你摒住呼吸，一动不动，祈祷自已不被人发现。
06230.name: 严密监视
06230.real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must either discard the asset you control with the highest printed cost, or raise your alarm level by 1.
06230.text: 显现 - 检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，你必须弃掉你控制的印刷费用最高的支援，或将你的警报等级提高1级。

06231.name: 被迫藏身
06231.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your alarm level. - If you fail, lose 1 action. - If you fail by 3 or more, lose 2 actions instead. - If you fail by 5 or more, lose 3 actions instead.
06231.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](X)，其中X为你的警报等级。 - 如果你检定失败，失去1个行动。 - 如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，改为失去2个行动。 - 如果你检定失败且低于难度至少5点，改为失去3个行动。

06232.name: 月球巡逻
06232.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. [action]: Test [agility] (3) to lose the patrol. If you succeed, discard Lunar Patrol. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
06232.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 [action]：检定[agility](3)以避开巡逻。如果你检定成功，弃掉月球巡逻。 强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：该调查员的警报等级提高1级。

06233.name: 卡达斯
06233.real_text:
False Awakening begins each game next to the agenda deck, with 1 doom on it.
[action]: Test any skill (2). This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, remove False Awakening from the game. Any investigator may trigger this ability.
06233.text:
每场游戏开始时，将卡达斯放在密谋牌库旁边，并在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
[action]：检定任意技能(2)。本次检定难度+1[per_investigator]。将梦中卡达斯戏中移除。任意调查员均可以触发本能力。

06234.name: 英勇救援
06234.real_text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack another investigator at your location or a connecting location.
Move to that location if you are not already there. Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage.
06234.text:
快速。在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你所在地点或连接地点的另一位调查员时打出。
如果你此时不在该地点，你移动到该地点。改为你与该敌人交战并对你结算它的攻击。然后，对其造成1点伤害。

06235.name: 领导力
06235.real_text:
While Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, Leadership gains [willpower] [wild].
If this test is successful, gain 2 resources. If Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, that investigator also gains 2 resources.
06235.text:
领导力投入到另一位调查员执行的技能检定中时，领导力获得[willpower][wild]。
如果本次检定成功，获得2资源。如果领导力投入到另一位调查员执行的技能检定，该调查员也获得2资源。

06236.name: 梦境日记
06236.real_text:
Researched.
While you are at a location with at least 4 shroud, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.
06236.text: 研究完成。(FAQ，v2.0) 你在隐藏值至少为4的地点时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
06236.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护

06237.name: 梦境日记
06237.real_text:
Researched.
While you are engaged with an enemy, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.
06237.text: 研究完成。(FAQ，v2.0) 你与敌人交战时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
06237.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护

06238.name: 梦境日记
06238.real_text:
Researched.
While you have at least 8 cards in hand, your Essence of the Dream gains [wild][wild].
[reaction] When your turn begins: Search your bonded cards for Essence of the Dream and add it to your hand.
06238.text: 研究完成。(FAQ，v2.0) 你有至少8张手牌时，你的梦的本质获得[wild][wild]。 [reaction]在你回合开始时：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出梦的本质，将其加入你的手牌。
06238.traits: 道具. 书籍. 守护

06239.name: 快手
06239.real_text: Limit 1 per investigator. [reaction] After you perform the same type of action twice in a row, exhaust Haste: Take another action of that type again (types include activate, engage, evade, fight, investigate, move, play, resource, and draw).
06239.text: 每位调查员仅限1张。 [reaction]你连续执行同一种行动两次后，横置快手：再执行一次该种行动(行动种类包括激活、交战、躲避、攻击、调查、移动、打出、资源和抽取)。

06240.flavor:
“你是个疯子，温妮！”
“我知道！这难道不是件好事吗？”
06240.name: 虎口拔牙
06240.real_text: After you commit Daredevil to a skill test, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a [rogue] skill you can commit to this test. Commit it. Shuffle each other revealed card back into your deck.
06240.text: 你将虎口拔牙投入到一次技能检定后，从你牌库顶揭示卡牌，直到揭示一张能够投入本次检定的[rogue]技能卡牌。将其投入。将其他每张已揭示的卡牌混洗回你的牌库。

06241.name: 增强自我
06241.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Stamina) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [combat], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [combat] for this test.
06241.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(毅力)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[combat]。

06242.name: 增强自我
06242.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Alacrity) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [agility], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [agility] for this test.
06242.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(迅捷)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[agility]。

06243.name: 增强自我
06243.real_text: Myriad. Limit 1 Empower Self (Acuity) per deck. Up to 3 Empower Self cards take up a single arcane slot. Anytime a card effect requires you to use [willpower] instead of [intellect], you may ignore that aspect of the effect. [fast] Exhaust Empower Self: You get +2 [intellect] for this test.
06243.text: 多重。每套牌库仅限1张增强自我(敏锐)。 最多3张增强自我卡牌共占1个法术槽位。 每当有卡牌效果要求你不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]，你可以忽略这类效果。 [free]横置增强自我：你本次检定得到+2[intellect]。

06244.flavor: “有时……我会希望我永远都不要回到这个世界来。”
06244.name: 特薇拉·凯瑟琳·普莱斯
06244.real_text: [reaction] After you spend 1 or more charges from a [[Spell]] asset, exhaust Twila Katherine Price: Place 1 charge on that asset.
06244.text: [reaction]你花费[[法术]]支援的至少1充能后，横置特薇拉·凯瑟琳·普莱斯：在该支援上放置1充能。
06244.traits: 盟友. 艺术家. 入梦者

06245.name: 希望微光
06245.real_text: Myriad. A Glimmer of Hope can only be played from your discard pile. Add all copies of A Glimmer of Hope in your discard pile to your hand (including this copy).
06245.text: 多重。 希望微光只能从你的弃牌堆打出。 将你弃牌堆中的所有希望微光加入你的手牌(包括本卡牌)。

06246.name: 迅速撤退
06246.real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Expeditious Retreat is committed during a basic evade action, it gains [agility][agility] and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location."
06246.text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
将迅速撤退在基础躲避行动期间投入时，其获得[agility][agility]和以下文本：“如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以自动躲避你所在地点的另一个敌人。”

06247.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的伤害数量+1。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：0。黑猫带你走出了死亡之火。如果调查期间揭示本标记且你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个重整状态的敌人。该敌人移动到你的地点，与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。
06247.name: 无归之地
06247.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the amount of damage on this card.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: +1. The black cat helps you navigate through the death-fire. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, draw 1 card.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail by 2 or more, choose a ready enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy moves to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
06247.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为本卡牌上的伤害数量。
[cultist]：再揭示一个标记。如果你检定失败，本次技能检定结束后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[tablet]：+1。黑猫带你走出了死亡之火。如果调查期间揭示本标记且你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少2点，选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个重整状态的敌人。该敌人移动到你的地点，与你交战并立即进行一次攻击。

06248.back_flavor: 你突然感到一阵疼痛和反胃，在那一瞬间，彷佛现实的结构分崩离析。这感觉很快消失，但显然有些不对劲。
06248.back_text:
将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。
在冒险参考卡牌上放置1个伤害标记。
06248.flavor: 地下世界是个如同洞穴般的国度，和地上的世界相比截然不同。这里的顶部是那么的遥远，像是乌云密布的天空。每个洞穴的墙壁被看不到光源的灰色闪光朦朦胧胧地照亮。你漫步在扭曲的地下墓穴中，寻找着前进的方向，但也一直觉得有什么东西正在跟踪自己。
06248.name: 邪恶国度

06249.back_flavor: 当你周围的一切都在移动和扭曲，你再次被一股不安的感觉所动摇。这次的能量比之前的更为强烈，似乎是从地下世界至深处的漆黑之海传来的。
06249.back_text: 每位调查员必须随机弃掉其1张手牌，或失去2资源。 将遭遇弃牌堆混洗入遭遇牌库。 在冒险参考卡牌上放置1个伤害标记。然后： - 如果冒险参考卡牌上的伤害数大于等于5，进入(→结局2)。 - 否则，将本密谋翻面。
06249.flavor: 随着你继续探索，地下世界的生物彷佛受到某些无形力量的驱使，它们变得不安，开始追猎你。
06249.name: 怪物围困
06249.real_text: (Hint - The game will not necessarily end when this agenda advances... but the stability of reality will continue to unravel.)
06249.text: (提示：本密谋推进时本场游戏不会结束……但现实的结构会进一步崩解。)

06250.back_flavor: 你惊慌失措地向食尸鬼讲述你们的遭遇。它一听到“伦道夫·卡特”的名字，态度便发生了变化。它连忙问伦道夫发生了什么事，你便把这位朋友的凄惨命运说与它听。听后，它陷入了悲伤的情绪。它说自己名叫理查德·皮克曼，从前与伦道夫是朋友。它答应放你过去，但在那之前它提醒你：地下世界正发生许多异象。它说，有黑暗力量正通过食尸鬼平原下方的山谷扩散，阴险的织网者正沿着洞穴墙壁爬行，还有可怕的嚎叫声穿透这整个地下世界。它语无伦次地解释着，所有这些异象都源于一个地方：地下世界最深处的漆黑之海。
06250.back_text: 将放在一边的每张[[山谷]]地点放置入场。 找出食尸鬼遭遇组和恐惧打击遭遇组的每张卡牌(即便它们位于场外)。将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的恐怖谷与夜魇遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。
06250.flavor: 你已经顺利来到幻梦境，但眼前的情景却和你预想的完全不同。你处在地下世界，你需要花些功夫，弄明白自己在这险境之中所处的方位。
06250.name: 进入地下世界(版本一)
06250.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Explore this region. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
06250.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 探索这片区域。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示。)

06251.back_flavor: 那食尸鬼走近时，伦道夫认出了它，叫了一声。他和那食尸鬼握了握手，聊了一会儿，然后把它介绍给你：“这是我之前跟你说过的食尸鬼。它是我的老朋友，它答应做我们在地下世界的向导了。但它带来了一些可怕的消息……”伦道夫继续说明：地下世界里发生了许多异象。它说，有黑暗力量正通过食尸鬼平原下方的山谷扩散，阴险的织网者正沿着洞穴墙壁爬行，还有可怕的嚎叫声穿透这整个地下世界。他说，所有这些异象都源于一个地方：地下世界最深处的漆黑之海。
06251.back_text: 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼剧情支援。本场冒险剩余时间内，如果理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼离场，将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的每张[[山谷]]地点放置入场。 找出恐惧打击遭遇组的每张卡牌(即便它们位于场外)。将其从游戏中移除。 将放在一边的恐怖谷与夜魇遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。
06251.flavor: 你已经顺利来到幻梦境，但眼前的情景却和你预想的完全不同。你处在地下世界，你需要花些功夫，弄明白自己在这险境之中所处的方位。
06251.name: 进入地下世界(版本二)
06251.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find Richard Upton Pickman. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
06251.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 找到理查德·厄普顿·皮克曼。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)

06252.back_flavor: 你走到石墙的另一边的过程中，洞变得越来越窄。当你终于从洞口出来时，你发现自己来到了海岸上，前方是柏油般漆黑的宽广大海。发光的紫色能量网在海面蔓延，让你心中充满恐惧，忐忑不安。这和你在圣玛丽医院里目睹的恐怖景象有关吗？正当你思考下一步该怎么做的时候，你发现有几艘黑色的小木艇停泊在附近的一处小湾。每艘小艇的船身上都刻着一个怪异的标志。这些小艇的出现是上天的旨意，还是巧合？不管是前者还是后者，你都决定要越过这片大海，追寻这疯狂的来源。
06252.back_text: 将放在一边的每张[[深海]]地点放置入场。 将放在一边的深入漆黑之海与阿特拉克·纳克亚的使徒遭遇组和遭遇弃牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌库。
06252.flavor: 前往山谷下方的道路充满了危险。你需要从皮克曼口中的“食尸鬼峭壁”往下爬，那里是食尸鬼丢弃它们骇人的食物残渣的地方。你只能想象那里有多深。
06252.name: 深入
06252.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the way to the Sea of Pitch. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
06252.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。 目标 - 找到前往漆黑之海的道路。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)

06253.back_flavor: 当你凝视这片浓稠而黑暗的水域，你心中泛起一股恐惧。这里就是扭曲的根源。不管海面下究竟有些什么，在这里一定能找到答案，解释至今为止现实世界所发生的一切。或许你还能找到拯救伙伴的办法。又或者这片海会直接活生生地把你吞噬。你无法得知等待你的命运究竟是什么。你站起身来，握紧拳头，吸进最后一口气。然后，你面朝大海，来了一次信仰之跃。
06253.flavor: 当你穿越这柏油般的漆黑之海，你开始隐约看清海面底下，那发光的神秘之网的图案。
06253.name: 无边黑暗
06253.real_text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the source of the distortion. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
06253.text: 强制 - 击败带有线索的敌人后：控制该敌人的所有线索。(FAQ，v1.9) 目标 - 找到地下世界扭曲的根源。(要推进场景时，你会收到指示)

06254.flavor: “……因为这里是辛之墓穴的入口，意图复仇的恶鬼总会在此凶狠地盯着上方深渊的住民，那些曾经猎杀它们的仇敌。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

linked_card.flavor: Hisses and uncanny voices pursue you throughout this web of darkened, intersecting tunnels. You believe the myriad paths might lead all the way to the surface of the Dreamlands, considering the vastness of this network of caverns. It is a wonder you can even find your way back to where you started. However, you are not alone when you emerge...
linked_card.name: Ghastly Tunnels
linked_card.real_text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghast]] enemy and spawn it here exhausted and with 1 clue on it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Ghast enemy and spawn it here exhausted and with 1 clue on it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

Flip this card back over.

06254.name: 辛之墓穴

06254b.flavor: 在这错综复杂、漆黑的隧道网络中，低吼和可怕的声音追赶着你。你相信在这个巨大的洞穴网络之中，这无数的通路或许会通向幻梦境的地面。你已无可能返回这迷宫起点。然而，当你走出这迷宫时，一起出来的还有……
06254b.name: 阴森隧道
06254b.real_text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghast]] enemy and spawn it here exhausted and with 1 clue on it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Flip this card back over.
06254b.text:
查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张[[噩妖]]敌人并将其以横置状态生成在此，并带有1个线索。混洗遭遇牌库。
将本卡牌翻面。

06255.flavor: “……卡特跟着那三只食尸鬼大步走出林立的巨石丛，来到这座被高耸石塔所包围的可怕城市，走在黑暗而散发着恶臭的街道上。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

linked_card.flavor: The kingdom of the Gugs is surrounded by a colossal wall. Inside, cylindrical towers rise high into the mist, each one windowless and made of grey stone, with large looming doorways at the bottom. One black tower stands paramount among the others, rising into the very ceiling of the Underworld. You do not make it very far before you spot the sentry standing guard outside the city's walls: a tremendous creature with huge furry arms and an obscene toothy maw extending vertically through its head.
linked_card.name: The Sentry
linked_card.real_text:
Spawn the set-aside Gug Sentinel enemy at this location, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on it. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, Gug Sentinel enters play exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it enters play engaged with you.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Spawn the set-aside Gug Sentinel enemy at this location, with 1 clues on it. Test (3). If you succeed, Gug Sentinel enters play exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it enters play engaged with you.

Flip this card back over.

06255.name: 古革巨人之城
06255.real_text: Forced - After you enter City of Gugs: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
06255.text: 强制 - 你进入古革巨人之城后：将其翻面并结算另一面的文本。

06255b.flavor: 古革巨人的国境被高大的围墙所包围。高墙之内，柱状的塔群高耸入云，每座塔都以灰色石材建成，没有窗户，塔底部隐约有着一道大门。其中一座黑塔最为高耸，彷佛刺入了地下世界的顶部。你走了没几步，就发现有哨兵在守卫城墙外围：那怪物身形庞大，硕大的手臂布满茸毛，长满牙齿的肮脏大嘴竖着长在头上。
06255b.name: 岗哨
06255b.real_text:
Spawn the set-aside Gug Sentinel enemy at this location, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on it. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, Gug Sentinel enters play exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it enters play engaged with you.
Flip this card back over.
06255b.text:
将放在一边的古革哨兵敌人生成在本地点，其带有1[per_investigator]个线索。检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，古革哨兵以横置状态入场，不与调查员交战。否则，其入场并与你交战。
将本卡牌翻面。

06256.flavor: 你惊讶地发现，这座位于城市中心的巨大建筑里竟没有生物居住。这座塔空荡荡的，除了塔门上的奇怪标志之外再无任何装饰，也看不出任何用途。

linked_card.flavor: Step after step, you scale the tower until you reach the heavy trapdoor at the top. When you push the stone aside, a column of bright light pierces through the shaft, blinding you. The surface! You emerge in an area thick with trees and mystical fog. After so many hours spent underground, the cool breeze feels wonderful. Many curious eyes watch you from the surrounding woods. Though you long to stay and explore more of these wilds, you know your true goal lies back down in the caverns below the surface.
linked_card.name: Another Path
linked_card.real_text: Put the set-aside Enchanted Woods (Stone Trapdoor) into play, revealed. Record in your Campaign Log the investigators found a way out of the Underworld. Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Put the set-aside Enchanted Woods (Stone Trapdoor) into play, revealed.

Record in your Campaign Log the investigators found a way out of the Underworld.

Flip this card back over.

06256.name: 卡斯之塔
06256.real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (5) to lift the heavy stone trapdoor at the top of the tower. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.
06256.text: [action]：检定[combat](5)以移开塔顶沉重的石板暗门。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。

06256b.flavor: 你一步一步地爬上塔顶，来到塔顶的一扇沉重的石板暗门前。你把石板推开到一边后，一道明亮的光柱照进塔内，让你睁不开眼。是地面！你爬出这道门，来到了一片笼罩着神秘迷雾的树林。一阵凉爽的微风吹来，在地下度过如此漫长的数小时后，这风简直沁人心脾。周围的树木之间有许多双好奇的眼睛在盯着你。虽然你还想在此停留，探索这片荒林，但是你知道，你真正的目标还在地下的洞穴。
06256b.name: 另一条路
06256b.real_text: Put the set-aside Enchanted Woods (Stone Trapdoor) into play, revealed. Record in your Campaign Log the investigators found a way out of the Underworld. Flip this card back over.
06256b.text: 将放在一边的魔幻森林(石板暗门)放置入场，呈已揭示状态。 在剧本日志中，记录调查员找到了离开地下世界的路。 将本卡牌翻面。

06257.flavor: “尽管有几只食尸鬼若有所思地盯着他瘦弱的身躯，还有一只食尸鬼试着捏了他一把，但食尸鬼总的来说还算礼貌。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

linked_card.name: A Strange Ghoul
linked_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot make any headway with the creatures that dwell i this region.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Having spent considerable time exploring the upper layer, you understand the ghouls' nature a bit more. They are more welcoming than their kin have been in the past, speaking to you in grunting, monosyllabic English. As you consider your options, you are approached by one of their kind who still wears human clothing. Unlike the rest, he is able to communicate with you perfectly. With an air of authority and wisdom about him, he demands to know why you have come to this place.
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Advance the current act. Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 clues:

Try as you might, you cannot make any headway with the creatures that dwell i this region.

Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.

If the investigators possess at least 3 clues:

Having spent considerable time exploring the upper layer, you understand the ghouls' nature a bit more. They are more welcoming than their kin have been in the past, speaking to you in grunting, monosyllabic English. As you consider your options, you are approached by one of their kind who still wears human clothing. Unlike the rest, he is able to communicate with you perfectly. With an air of authority and wisdom about him, he demands to know why you have come to this place.

The investigators must spend 3 clues, as a group.

Advance the current act.

Flip this card back over.

06257.name: 食尸鬼平原
06257.real_text:
Veiled.
[[Gug]] enemies cannot enter the Plain of the Ghouls. If a [[Gug]] enemy would spawn at the Plain of the Ghouls, spawn it at the City of Gugs instead.
06257.text:
掩藏。
[[古革巨人]]敌人不能进入食尸鬼平原。如果[[古革巨人]]敌人将要生成在食尸鬼平原，改为将其生成在古革巨人之城。

06257b.name: 诡异食尸鬼
06257b.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot make any headway with the creatures that dwell i this region.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Having spent considerable time exploring the upper layer, you understand the ghouls' nature a bit more. They are more welcoming than their kin have been in the past, speaking to you in grunting, monosyllabic English. As you consider your options, you are approached by one of their kind who still wears human clothing. Unlike the rest, he is able to communicate with you perfectly. With an air of authority and wisdom about him, he demands to know why you have come to this place.
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Advance the current act. Flip this card back over.
06257b.text:
如果调查员拥有少于3[per_investigator]个线索：
不管如何尝试，你都无法从这里居住的生物取得任何进展。
将本卡牌翻面。等你更好地了解了这片区域，再回到此处。在你准备好时可以将本卡牌再次翻面。
如果调查员拥有至少3[per_investigator]个线索：
在花了大把时间来探索上层之后，你稍微明白了食尸鬼的本性。它们比从前的同胞更加热情好客，一字一句地说着含糊不清的英语与你交流。当你仍在思考该作何选择时，有一只穿着人类装束的食尸鬼接近你。不同于其他的食尸鬼，它能够和你顺畅地沟通。它要求你说出来意，言辞中透露出权威与智慧。
调查员必须以共同花费3[per_investigator]个线索。 推进当前场景。 将本卡牌翻面。

06258.flavor: “最后，他隐约看见了上方食尸鬼巨岩突出的边缘，在这之前他从未见过这块巨岩的顶面……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

linked_card.flavor: Looking out over the barren vale, you get a sense for the threats that dwell below. Underneath the plateau upon which you stand, a forest of obscene, pale fungi extends for miles. Beyond that is a great heap of bones, like an ocean pouring forth in all directions. You swear you can see something crawling or worming its way along the surface of the bones, but perhaps it's just your imagination. In the distance, great sharp peaks of stone loom over the vale. Black, winged creatures fly around the summits, searching for prey. You see no sign of this "ocean of pitch" Pickman described, though you do notice a wide cavern opening along a wall of stone to the right of the vale below...
linked_card.name: Scouting the Vale
linked_card.real_text:
Look at the top 2 [per_investigator] cards of the encounter deck. You may discard up to half of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck, in any order.
For the remainder of the game, ignore the text on Crag of the Ghouls.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
Look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. You may discard up to half of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck, in any order.

For the remainder of the game, ignore the text on Crag of the Ghouls.

Flip this card back over.

06258.name: 食尸鬼峭壁
06258.real_text:
Veiled.
The first treachery drawn during the mythos phase by an investigator at this location gains surge.
06258.text:
掩藏。
本地点的调查员在神话阶段期间抽取的第一张诡计卡牌获得涌动。

06258b.flavor: 你望着荒芜的山谷，感觉到下方的威胁。在你脚下的平原底下，连绵数英里的是一片可憎的苍白真菌。在那之外是堆成山的骸骨，就像朝四面八方涌流的大海一般。你发誓自己看到了那些骸骨的表面爬着某些东西，但或许这只是你的想象。远处陡峭的石峰屹立在山谷之上。长有翅膀的黑色生物在峰顶周围飞翔，寻找着猎物。你并没有看到皮克曼口中的“漆黑之海”，但你发现在下方山谷右边的石壁上有着巨大的洞穴……
06258b.name: 探查山谷
06258b.real_text:
Look at the top 2 [per_investigator] cards of the encounter deck. You may discard up to half of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck, in any order.
For the remainder of the game, ignore the text on Crag of the Ghouls.
Flip this card back over.
06258b.text:
查看遭遇牌库顶的2[per_investigator]张卡牌。你可以最多弃掉这些卡牌的一半。将其余卡牌以任意顺序放回遭遇牌库顶。
直到本场游戏结束，忽略食尸鬼峭壁的文本。
将本卡牌翻面。

06259.flavor: “除了黑暗、恐怖、寂静和无数的骸骨之外，这里什么都没有。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

linked_card.flavor: Traversing this canyon of cadavers and monstrous remains is laborious enough, but it is the churning and digging below the surface that causes you to hate this awful place. What sort of monstrosity could span the entirety of this ocean of bones? Your answer presents itself as you come across a great pit in the ravine. It is swallowing the bones and scraps of rotten meat like a whirlpool. When you reach the base of the tunnel and realize its true purpose, a shudder courses through you. It was made by an enormous creature: the thing that dwells below the sea of bones.
linked_card.name: Something Below
linked_card.real_text:
If there is no Dhole Tunnel at this location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Dhole Tunnel and attach it to this location, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.
If Slithering Dhole is in play, move it to this location and add 2 clues to it. Otherwise, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for Slithering Dhole, and spawn it at this location, exhausted and with 2 clues on it.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:
If there is no Dhole Tunnel at this location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Dhole Tunnel and attach it to this location, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.

If Slithering Dhole is in play, move it to this location and add 2 clues to it. Otherwise, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for Slithering Dhole, and spawn it at this location, exhausted and with 2 clues on it.

Flip this card back over.

06259.name: 骸骨之海
06259.real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Sea of Bones: Flip it over.
06259.text: 强制 - 你发现骸骨之海的线索后：将其翻面。

06259b.flavor: 光是穿越这片满是尸体和怪物遗骸的山谷已非易事，但你对这个可怕地方的憎恨来自于地面以下的搅动与挖掘。什么样的怪物能跨越这片骸骨之海呢？当你看到峡谷中的一个巨坑时，你心中有了答案。它就像漩涡一样吞噬骸骨和带有腐肉的骨头。当你到达隧道底部，意识到它的真实用意时，一股颤栗传遍你的全身。这是由居住在骸骨之海底下的一种巨大生物引起的。
06259b.name: 下方之物
06259b.real_text:
If there is no Dhole Tunnel at this location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Dhole Tunnel and attach it to this location, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.
If Slithering Dhole is in play, move it to this location and add 2 clues to it. Otherwise, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for Slithering Dhole, and spawn it at this location, exhausted and with 2 clues on it.
Flip this card back over.
06259b.text:
如果本地点没有巨噬蠕虫隧道，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一张巨噬蠕虫隧道并将其附属到本地点(如可能)。混洗遭遇牌库。
如果滑行的巨噬蠕虫在场上，将其移动到本地点，在其上放置2个线索。否则，查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和胜利区，找出滑行的巨噬蠕虫，将其以横置状态生成在本地点，并带有2个线索。
将本卡牌翻面。

linked_card.flavor: You climb to the top of the hazardous peaks to survey the lands below. From this vantage point, you are able to see the movements of the various creatures that live in the vale. Soaring all around the peaks are black, winged things that somehow scowl at you with empty, expressionless faces. Upon the cliff that hangs over the vale, ghoul eyes watch your progress with morbid curiosity. The mound of bones and detritus below the precipice is home to nothing but the churning and dredging of something massive under the surface. To your left, the misty vale extends for miles until it reaches an enormous stone wall. Opposite the wall, far in the distance, you barely make out the shape of a city in the darkness. Incomprehensible whispers and mocking laughter seep into your ears. You dare no further study.
linked_card.name: Inhabitants of the Vale
linked_card.real_text:
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Hunting Nightgaunt and spawn it at Vale of Pnath, exhausted.

Choose any enemy in play and place 2 clues on it.
Flip this card back over.
linked_card.text:

06260.name: 撒克山峰
06260.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to attempt to scale the treacherous peaks. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When you leave Peaks of Thok: You must test [agility] (2) to climb down safely. If you fail, take 1 damage.
06260.text: [action]：检定[agility](5)以尝试攀登危险的山峰。如果你检定成功，将本卡牌翻面并结算另一面的文本。 强制 - 在你离开撒克山峰时：你必须检定[agility](2)以安全地爬下山峰。如果你检定失败，受到1点伤害。

06260b.flavor: 你爬上危险的峰顶，观察下方。从这个位置，山谷里居住的各种生物的一举一动都被你看在眼内。黑色的有翼生物在山峰周围翱翔，它们没有表情的空白面庞对你怒目而视。在山谷上方的悬崖之上，食尸鬼们的一双双眼睛带着病态的好奇心，注视着你的进展。悬崖底下的一堆骸骨和碎石正是地下搅动和挖掘的巨大生物居住的地方。在你的左手边，雾蒙蒙的山谷绵延数英里，一直延伸到一堵巨大的石墙前。墙壁另一面的遥远处，你只能勉强看到黑暗中一座城市的轮廓。难以理解的低语声和嘲笑声钻进你的耳朵。你不敢细想。

06260b.real_text:

linked_card.name: The Way Out
linked_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot find any way out of the dark, barren vale.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
You venture out into the dark vale and attempt to map out your surroundings. With the knowledge you have accumulated, you know that the source of the disturbances within the Underworld cannot be in this region. There must be another pathway - perhaps a cavern or tunnel - that leads from the vale to a place even deeper beneath the surface of the Dreamlands. As you approach the great stone wall at the far end of the vale, you pick up a foul scent, like sulfur and tar. You follow the stench until it leads you to a wide hole in the wall.
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Advance the current act. Flip this card back over.

你冒险进入这片黑暗的山谷，试图摸清周围的地形。根据至今为止取得的所有信息，你知道扰乱地下世界的根源不会在这片地区。一定有别的道路——或许是洞穴或隧道——从山谷通向幻梦境地下更深处的地点。当你走近山谷尽头的巨石壁时，你闻到了一股难闻的气味，像是硫磺与柏油。你循着这股恶臭，找到了石壁上的一个大洞。

linked_card.flavor: From the depths of the pitch-black ocean, the creatures suddenly emerge. They are similar to spiders in shape, but that is where the similarities end. Their bodies appear to be made from the same tarry substance as the ocean itself, and their eyes glow crimson red in the dark fog over the sea. The spiders surround your vessel and attempt to pull it - and you - into the depths.

linked_card.real_text:

linked_card.real_text:
If the investigators possess fewer than 3 [per_investigator] clues:
Try as you might, you cannot find the way to the other side of this ocean of tar.
Flip this card back over. Come back when you have a greater understanding of this region. This card may be flipped over again when you are ready.
If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues:
You row farther out, into deeper, darker waters, but there is still no sign of any other shore. Under the surface of the black, tarry liquid, you can see a series of glittering stars, like an unknown constellation beckoning you forward. If you didn't know any better, you would think it was a reflection of the sky above, but there is no sky in this dark realm. You lean over the edge of your boat and nearly vomit from the sensation of vertigo that assaults you. It must be hundreds of miles deep, and filled with horrors beyond your imagining. And yet, you know what you must do...
The investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Flip this card back over and advance the current act.

你想尽一切办法，也不知道如何去往这片漆黑之海的另一边。

你将船只驶向更遥远的地方，进入了更为黑暗也更深的水域，但是仍然看不到其他海岸。在这如同柏油的黑海之下，你看到一串发光的星星，如同一个未知的星座，呼唤你靠近。你可能会以为那是天空的倒影，但你知道在这个黑暗的区域里根本没有天空。你趴在船边，眩晕的感觉让你几乎要吐出来。那一定是数百英里深的地方，充满了无法想象的恐怖。然而，你知道你必须要做的是什么……

06267.flavor: “接着亮起了一双粉红色的眼睛，再是苏醒的古革哨兵那硕如木桶一般的巨大头颅摇晃着出现在视野中。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>

06268.flavor: “卡特一看到那怪物污秽而丑陋的模样就感到恶心……”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
06268.name: 鲜血的滋味
06268.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must (choose one): Place 1 of your clues on your location, place 1 of your clues on the nearest enemy, or take 1 damage.

06269.name: 夺命猛火

06269.text: 显现 - 每位调查员失去1资源。位于[[山谷]]或[[深海]]地点的每位调查员选择并弃掉其1张手牌。位于[[深海]]地点的每位调查员失去1个行动。

06270.name: 意外伏击
06270.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, take 1 damage and 1 horror. Otherwise, test [intellect] (4) or [agility] (4). If you fail, the nearest enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, and engages you. Then, if you failed by 3 or more, it makes an immediate attack.
06270.text: 显现 -如果场上没有敌人，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。否则，检定[intellect](4)或[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，最近的敌人重整并移动(每次一个地点)，直到它到达你所在地点并与你交战。然后，如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，其立即进行一次攻击。

While Slithering Dhole is moving, all locations with an attached Dhole Tunnel are considered to be connected to one another.
