[tablet]：-X。X为放在一边的空洞中归你所有的数量(最多为5)。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你检定失败，选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，作为一个空洞。

09682.back_flavor: 异星的天空中刮过洪荒星尘的漩涡。星光辐射条条成线，石砾风暴违背了重力的法则。这一切都在变换、搅动、重组。这里每寸地方都是刻意的疯狂，预谋要操纵你的思想，让你失去自己的感知。
09682.back_text:
将放在一边的天启噩兆和原生质重组者敌人洗入遭遇牌库。
调查员必须共同选择两项：
- 每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
- 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
- 混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其正面朝下随机放到先前位置。
09682.flavor: 在我们的现实之外，只有遗忘失落之物所知的维度，是荒谬的残骸之城——也就是域外来客的本界。
09682.name: 异界恐惧
09682.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
09682.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。

09683.back_flavor: 无维无尽的宇宙之重，压得你跪下。你想到泰勒的“多层蛋糕”，一层上面还有一层，世界上面还有世界，而你的却是最薄一层。你穿行于人类绝不该跨越的边界。要是你再待一会儿，甚至都不会记得自己从何而来。
09683.back_text:
调查员必须共同选择两项：
- 每位调查员受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
- 每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
- 混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其正面朝下随机放到先前位置。
09683.flavor: 你在这里待得越久，就越觉得原本的世界正从记忆中溜走。面庞、名字、地方，从你记忆的空隙中落走了。你惊恐地意识到异界之力是一面双刃剑。哪怕你仍有自己的意志，待在这里也会让你迷失自己。
09683.name: 异界的羔羊
09683.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
09683.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。

09684.back_text:
每位没有撤退的调查员发疯，从此音讯全无。有关这些调查员的所有记忆都从现实中清除。
如果有调查员撤退，那些调查员可以立即推进到场景3b。
09684.name: 异界的屠杀
09684.real_text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location). [fast] Take 1 direct damage or 1 direct horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)
09684.text: 作为进入未揭示地点的额外费用，你所在地点的调查员必须共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索。 [reaction]你揭露地点后：(从相邻地点)移动到该地点。 [free]受到1点直接伤害或1点直接恐惧：查看任意一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每轮仅限一次。)

09685.back_flavor: 在残骸之城跃动的黑暗中枢，是纠结在一起的巨大构造物，全由黑色的缟玛瑙和犬牙参差、扭曲歪斜的玻璃组成。恐怖的巢穴正中悬着一张由异界的锁链、丝线和绳索纠缠在一起的巨网。漂浮在空间正中的是扭曲空间形成的巨大球体，伸出的两根触手散发着原生质的光芒。触手伸向一个衣衫褴褛、失去意识的人形生物，抽走了什么。你靠近一步，惊恐地意识到自己认识祭坛上这个被重重包裹的身影——或者说，你至少认出了红色的手套。
09685.back_text: 将放在一边的拟态克星敌人以横置状态生成在域外来客之巢。 每位调查员选择自己弃牌堆2张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 找出放在一边的戴红手套的男子剧情支援，将其与放在一边的空洞放在一起，也作为一个空洞。他视为归所有调查员所有。如果他拥有任何钥匙，不要将这些钥匙附属到他。
09685.flavor: 这片诡异的域外之地潜藏着至关重要的秘密。红色结社一位资深成员与你独自联络，想让你帮她找到这个地方——所有记忆中遭窃的事物都藏在那个世界。如果还有哪里能找到真相，就是那儿了。
09685.name: 穿越域外之地
09685.real_text: Objective - Find the heart of the Outsiders' domain. When the Outsiders' Lair is revealed, advance.
09685.text: 目标 - 找到域外来客领域的中心。 在域外来客之巢被揭示时，推进。

09686.back_flavor:
你终于将戴红手套的男子从怪物发光的触手中扯下，将他拖离祭坛。你将他拖离这怪物的老巢，他一路上都身软无力，失去意识，只会用一种异界的语言吐出几个没有意义的词。他终于睁眼看了域外的诡异天空，痛苦地颤抖着醒来，气喘吁吁，惨不忍睹，捂住自己头上被怪物抓住的位置。
你让他恢复了一会儿，才问起他是怎么来的，又到底发生了什么。他没花多久就恢复了自己原本镇定的样子，也是令人佩服。他理理西装的袖口，压低帽沿，遮住自己前额滴下的汗水。“这儿不行。”他说。恰巧就在这时候，玻璃和玛瑙的构造体在废墟中颤抖跃出，触手围拢扭曲在一起，形成一团巨大诡异的发光物质。“我想你应该知道怎么出去吧？”男人问道。
09686.flavor: 你不知道这里究竟发生了什么，但肯定不是好事。你必须阻止此处发生的一切——只有这样你才能从戴红手套的男子那里得到真相。
09686.name: 红色废墟
09686.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man cannot be discarded or drawn. [action] If Mimetic Nemesis is at your location, spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to it. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Mimetic Nemesis. Objective - When The Red-Gloved man enters play, advance.
09686.text: 戴红手套的男子不能被弃掉或抽取。 [action]如果拟态克星在你的地点，花费1个线索：对它造成2点伤害。本行动不会触发拟态克星的趁乱攻击。 目标 - 在戴红手套的男子入场时，推进。

09687.back_flavor: 你站在刚到这片领域时抵达的平面边缘，还是不知道该怎么返回自己的世界。掉进下方坑洞的船只去了哪里，毫无迹象。也许它已经回头。又或者还在继续下落。你并不确定，但也没什么选择。你屏息不看无底的深渊，纵身信仰之跃……
09687.back_text: 检查胜利区有什么[[同谋]]支援。 - 如果戴红手套的男子和艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚都在胜利区，进入(→结局1)(第57页)。 - 如果只有戴红手套的男子在胜利区，进入(→结局2)(第58页)。 - 如果只有艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚在胜利区，进入(→结局3)(第58页)。 - 如果戴红手套的男子和艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚都不在胜利区，进入(→结局4)(第58页)。
09687.flavor: 戴红手套的男子目前在你一边，最终的答案已经近在咫尺。但你首先要找到回家的路……不然，这里可能就会成为你的新家。
09687.name: 逃出异界
09687.real_text: Each [[Outsider]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - If The Red-Gloved Man is defeated: Remove him from the game. Objective - Time to get the hell out of here! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
09687.text: 每个[[域外]]敌人失去冷漠。 强制 - 如果戴红手套的男子被击败：将他从游戏中移除。 目标 - 逃出这个鬼地方！如果所有幸存的调查员都撤退，推进。

09688.back_flavor: 你眼前的异界景象前所未见——扭曲纠缠的构造、外星植物和奇异的仿体，这一切都是在古今熟见的建筑和器物基础上模仿而来的。载你来此的船只在这个骇人平面的边缘摇晃片刻，就在震耳欲聋的混乱中摔下了无尽的虚空。
09688.name: 域外来客之廷
09688.real_text: [action]: Resign. Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, you resign, adding each [[Conspirator]] asset you control to the victory display. If you fail, you remain trapped here, and this test gets -1 difficulty until the end of your turn. If each surviving investigator has resigned, immediately advance to act 3b.
09688.text: [action]：撤退。检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，你撤退，将你控制的每个[[同谋]]支援加入胜利区。如果你检定失败，你依然困在此处，此检定得到-1难度值，直到你回合结束。如果每位存活的调查员均撤退，立即推进到场景3b。(FAQ v2.1)

09689.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，受到1点伤害。 - 如果它在阴影中间，选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 - 如果它在阴影右边，受到1点恐惧。
09689.name: 域外来客之巢
09689.real_text:
Each [[Outsider]] enemy at this location loses aloof and gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[fast] If The Red-Gloved Man is the only set-aside hollow: Put him into play under the control of any investigator at Outsiders' Lair.
09689.text:
本地点的每个[[域外]]敌人失去冷漠并得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。
[free]如果戴红手套的男子是唯一放在一边的空洞：将他放置入场，置于域外来客之巢的任意调查员控制下。

09690.name: 拟态克星
09690.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal damage to this enemy: Instead, choose and discard that many set-aside hollows. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at this enemy's location must either choose a non-weakness card in their hand and set it aside, as a hollow, or this enemy attacks them.
09690.text: 警戒。猎手。庞大。反击。 强制 - 在你将要对本敌人造成伤害时，改为选择并弃掉相同数量的放在一边的空洞。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：本敌人所在地点的每位调查员必须选择自己手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，作为一个空洞；或本敌人攻击自己。
09690.traits: 怪物. 域外. 精英

09691.name: 原生质重组者
09691.real_text: Massive. Spawn - Location farthest from all investigators. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if this enemy is ready: Spawn the top card of the nearest investigator's deck facedown at its location as a Golem enemy. Golems have: "[[Monster. Outsider.]] Hunter. 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage value. If Golem is defeated, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow."
09691.text: 庞大。 生成 - 离所有调查员最远的地点。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果本敌人处于重整状态：将最近的调查员牌库顶的卡牌正面朝下生成在本敌人的地点，作为一个魔像敌人。魔像拥有：“[[怪物]]，[[域外]] 猎手。1攻击值、1生命值、1躲避值、1伤害值。如果魔像被击败，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。”

09692.flavor: “最后的变换——它告诉你这意味着什么了吗？”
09692.name: 戴红手套的男子
09692.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an [[Outsider]] enemy by 2 or more, exhaust The Red-Gloved Man: Deal 1 damage to that enemy and discover 1 clue at your location.
09692.text: [reaction]在你成功攻击或躲避[[域外]]敌人且超过难度至少2点后，横置戴红手套的男子：对该敌人造成1点伤害并发现你所在地点的1个线索。

09693.name: 艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚
09693.real_text: [reaction] After a concealed mini-card is exposed, exhaust Aliki Zoni Uperetria: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it.
09693.text: [reaction]在隐匿迷你卡牌揭露后，横置艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚：选择一个放在一边的空洞。其所有者将其抽取。

09694.back_text:
困难/专家
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号+1。
[cultist]：-7。你可以将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面，以改为将本标记的修正值视为-4。
[tablet]：-2。如果你所在地点有重整的[[域外]]敌人，改为你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-4。取消投入本次检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标，将它们放到一边，位于场外，作为空洞。
09694.name: 钥匙议会
09694.real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current act number.
[cultist]: -5. You may flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side to treat this token's modifier as -2, instead.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against a ready [[Outsider]] enemy, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.
09694.text:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X为当前场景编号。
[cultist]：-5。你可以将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面，以改为将本标记的修正值视为-2。
[tablet]：-2。如果这是对重整的[[域外]]敌人的攻击，改为你自动失败。
[elder_thing]：-3。取消投入本次检定的每张卡牌上的效果和图标，将它们放到一边，位于场外，作为空洞。

09695.back_text:
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本一)：
超维能量的脉络包围了你，似要将你撕成碎片。
每个敌人变换身上附属的每个钥匙。立即结算额外一个敌军阶段(然后继续当前阶段)。
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本二)：
戴红手套的男子打开的次元门就要关上了！你没时间准备了，纵身跃了进去。
在密谋2a上放置4个毁灭标记。推进场景。
如果当前场景是秘密与谎言(版本三)：
异次元的实体围绕着你，似要将你的存在抹除。
将1[per_investigator]个钥匙从其[[稳定]]面翻至[[动荡]]面。立即结算额外一个敌军阶段(然后继续当前阶段)。
09695.name: 因果汇流
09695.real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances, if it is act 2, 3, or 4: Skip the "b" side of this agenda and proceed directly to agenda 2a.
09695.text: 强制 - 在本密谋推进时，如果是场景2、3或4：跳过本密谋的“b”面，直接推进到密谋2a。

09696.back_flavor: 维度之间雷声隆隆。无数被遗忘的世界重压累积，在你脑海深处冲击着你的每一寸感官。你手中的钥匙吱嘎嗡响，涌现着超维能量。要是没有它们，你在这片领域的重压下可没法存活。
09696.back_text:
将每张诱饵翻回。混洗场上所有隐匿迷你卡牌，然后将其随机放到先前位置。
每位调查员受到2点伤害和2点恐惧但可以选择(选择一项或都不选)：
- 变换一个其控制的[[动荡]]钥匙而不翻至[[稳定]]面，以取消上述效果造成的所有伤害和恐惧。
- 将其控制的任意数量的[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面，以取消相同数量的上述效果造成的伤害/恐惧。
09696.name: 不速之界

09698.back_flavor: 你终于找到了戴红手套的男子，他迅速溜进了一个闪闪发光的次元门。没有时间可以浪费了——机不可失，时不再来！你赶在次元门关闭时快速跟了上去……
09698.back_text: 将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌，正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下摆放。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。将遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆从游戏中移除，替换为第二个遭遇牌库。
09698.flavor: 你得找到戴红手套的男子，搞清他真正的计划。但红色结社的其他人还在挡你的路。他们难道意识不到真正的威胁吗？
09698.name: 秘密与谎言(版本一)
09698.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
09698.text: 戴红手套的男子获得隐匿1[per_investigator]且不能受到伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都与戴红手套的男子在同一地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

09699.back_flavor: 你踏入次元门，不确定自己是否还能回来……
09699.back_text: 将密谋1a从游戏中移除，将上面所有的毁灭标记移动到密谋2a上。将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌和X张诱饵，其中X等于密谋2a上的毁灭标记数。正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下，尽可能平均地分发。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。将放一边的其他每张[[结社]]敌人洗入遭遇牌库。(注意：从现在起，神话阶段期间如常从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。)
09699.flavor: 你在离开前，还有最后一次机会探索红色结社的藏身处。但时间不等人！
09699.name: 秘密与谎言(版本二)
09699.real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - Prepare for your journey into the Outside, and proceed when you are ready. At the end of any round, if each investigator is at the same location, they may advance. The sooner, the better. (Hint - You will also be forced to advance automatically when the agenda advances.)
09699.text: 神话阶段期间，不从遭遇牌库抽取卡牌。 目标 - 等你准备好域外之行的时候就出发。当任意一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都在同一地点，则可以推进。越快越好。(提示——在密谋推进时，你会被强制自动推进。)

09700.back_flavor: 你终于找到了戴红手套的男子，他迅速溜进了一个闪闪发光的次元门。没有时间可以浪费了——机不可失，时不再来！你赶在次元门关闭时快速跟了上去……
09700.back_text: 将所有地点从游戏中移除。(调查员在此过程期间没有被击败。这些地点的其他敌人和附属都被弃掉，隐匿迷你卡牌则放到一边。) 将万千纠结之塔、悖逆重力之阶、睥睨众生之巅地点放置入场，成一竖列，其中睥睨众生之巅在顶部，而万千纠结之塔在底部。 拿取异界牌库顶的3张卡牌，放入阴影中，从左到右排成一行。 拿取3张残骸之城迷你卡牌，正面朝下混洗，环绕万千纠结之塔左、右、下摆放。 将每位调查员放到万千纠结之塔，将戴红手套的男子敌人放到睥睨众生之巅。
09700.flavor: 域外来客攻击了红色结社的老巢！只有一人能告诉你答案。你必须找到“戴红手套的男子”——或者他皮下的实体——跟回他来的世界。
09700.name: 秘密与谎言(版本三)
09700.real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
09700.text: 戴红手套的男子获得隐匿1[per_investigator]且不能受到伤害。 目标 - 当一轮结束时，如果所有调查员都与戴红手套的男子在同一地点，则可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

09701.back_flavor: 塔的入口处有七把遗忘之锁，每一把都是一段属于久遭遗忘国度的历史。门打开的时刻，你已经忘了它们存在过。另一端旋转阶梯的长度叫人望而生怯。它是个扭曲了无数次的难解之结，盘旋向上，通往塔顶，似乎无尽，令人茫然，将整个世界包裹起来，不可思议。即便你能上到顶端，你都怀疑自己能不能找到路回来。
09701.back_text:
将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。将阴影中的每张残骸之城和剩余的异界牌库从游戏中移除。
拿取3张残骸之城的隐匿迷你卡牌和1[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，以随机顺序环绕悖逆重力之阶摆放。
09701.flavor: 在一切已知的现实之外，只有遗忘失落之物所知的维度，是荒谬的残骸之城——也就是域外来客的本界。你眼前赫然出现了一座惊骇扭曲的高塔，异星天空中翻滚的云雾在塔顶交汇。
09701.name: 登塔
09701.real_text: Locations and concealed mini-cards cannot be placed adjacent to [[Tower]] locations. Objective - Find a way into the tower where the infiltrator lies in wait. If an investigator enters the Gravity-Defying Climb, advance.
09701.text: 地点和隐匿迷你卡牌不能放置与[[高塔]]地点相邻。 目标 - 找到方法进入渗透者静候的高塔。如果有调查员进入了悖逆重力之阶，推进。

09702.back_flavor: 你费尽千辛万苦，终于从最后一阶切实爬上了高塔顶端。多维的天空中猩红的云层扭曲出紫色的裂口，是通往无穷世界的无穷门扉。个个痴愚、个个盲目，个个任凭宰割。你带着敬畏和怜悯仰望着域外来客的世界，看着它们敛集的无数世界的遗迹，都已被遗弃、遗忘，失落于永恒。这里就是宇宙万物的垃圾堆。你的敌人，主宰人类消失的罪魁祸首，就在正中央。它的身形已经一点都不像那个戴红手套的男子了。它已经没有人类的面庞，眼神空洞，表情未知。
09702.back_text:
将每张隐匿迷你卡牌放在一边，位于场外。
将放在一边的拟态克星敌人与睥睨众生之巅的戴红手套的男子敌人交换。
拿取拟态克星的隐匿迷你卡牌和2[per_investigator]张诱饵，正面朝下混洗，以随机顺序环绕睥睨众生之巅摆放。
09702.flavor:
你面前的无穷阶梯仿佛埃舍尔笔下的虚幻场景。你向上攀爬，只感到一阵骇人的头晕目眩。

只有一条路可走。
09702.name: 登顶
09702.real_text: Objective - Ascend. If an investigator enters The Towering Vertex, advance.
09702.text: 目标 - 向上爬。如果有调查员进入睥睨众生之巅，推进。

09703.back_flavor:
实体倒下了，它无言的尖叫在世界和彼端回荡，在你的脑中回响，要将你撕成一个个原子。你还能留存至今，完全是因为钥匙的能量。你身边的一切早已爆裂。你脑后突然一阵拖拽的感觉，就好像你在这片凌乱的水域中上了钩。
然后，一片黑暗。
09703.flavor: 你亮出自己一路收集的钥匙，做好准备。要是你不能驱逐这个实体，令这个维度崩塌，你们都将永远地消失不见。胜败在此一举。这是你在一切都被抹去前的最后机会。什么都不会留下。什么都不会留下，什么都不会。
09703.name: 最后的疏忽
09703.real_text: [action] Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side: Remove an exposed decoy from the game. Objective - If Mimetic Nemesis is defeated, advance.
09703.text: [action]将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面：将一个已揭露的诱饵从游戏中移除。 目标 - 如果拟态克星被击败，推进。

09704.back_flavor: 红色结社秘密窝点的长廊大大方方地陈列了他们干涉人类的历史，墙上装饰着过去文明的古代遗物、猩红的织毯，还有不计其数的肖像，上面画的人看上去都举足轻重，个个穿着红衣。
09704.flavor: 要是有人引导，这迷宫般的长廊可能就没那么绕。
09704.name: 猩红走廊
09704.real_text: [fast] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Move (to a connecting location).
09704.text: [free]横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援：移动(到一个连接地点)。

09705.back_flavor: 红色结社秘密窝点的长廊大大方方地陈列了他们干涉人类的历史，墙上装饰着过去文明的古代遗物、猩红的织毯，还有不计其数的肖像，上面画的人看上去都举足轻重，个个穿着红衣。
09705.name: 猩红走廊
09705.real_text: Forced - After you enter Scarlet Halls: For the remainder of your turn, as an additional cost for you to move from Scarlet Halls to a connecting location, you must either exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control or spend an additional action.
09705.text: 强制 - 你进入猩红走廊后：你回合剩余时间内，作为你从猩红走廊移动到连接地点的额外费用，你必须横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援，或花费额外一个行动。

09706.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09706.flavor: 审判你的仪式室中间有一张巨桌，上面点着蜡烛。墙上豪奢的装饰个个是深红的颜色。
09706.name: 议会室
09706.real_text: [action] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an asset, draw it, and shuffle the rest into your deck.
09706.text: [action]横置一个你控制的[[同谋]]支援：查找你牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张支援，将其抽取，将其余卡牌洗入你的牌库。

09707.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09707.flavor: 审判你的仪式室中间有一张巨桌，上面点着蜡烛。墙上豪奢的装饰个个是深红的颜色。
09707.name: 议会室
09707.real_text: While there is a ready [[Coterie]] enemy at Congress Chamber, increase the cost of each asset played by each investigator at Congress Chamber by 2.
09707.text: 议会室有重整的[[结社]]敌人时，议会室的每位调查员打出的每张支援费用提升2点。

09708.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09708.flavor: 这间古老的厅堂里藏着大量古代书本、保存完好的卷轴和落满灰尘的典籍。世世代代的知识隐匿起来，只有结社的人才能知晓。
09708.name: 结社藏书室
09708.real_text: [action]: Reduce the cost of the next asset you play this round by 2. You may exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset to treat this ability as a [fast] ability instead of an [action] ability for this activation.
09708.text: [action]:你本轮打出的下一张支援费用减少2点。你可以横置一个[[同谋]]支援，以使本次能力激活改为[free]能力，而非[action]能力。

09709.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09709.flavor: 这间古老的厅堂里藏着大量古代书本、保存完好的卷轴和落满灰尘的典籍。世世代代的知识隐匿起来，只有结社的人才能知晓。
09709.name: 结社藏书室
09709.real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Coterie Library: The nearest [[Coterie]] enemy with an attached key shifts each of their attached keys.
09709.text: 强制 - 你调查结社藏书室时技能检定失败后：最近的有钥匙附属的[[结社]]敌人变换身上附属的每个钥匙。

09710.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09710.name: 藏钥馆
09710.real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate The Key Reliquary: Instead of discovering clues, choose an unempowered key attached to an investigator at your location. Place a resource (from the token pool) on that key, as an empowerment; that key is empowered (if it is shifted, its controller may spend the empowerment instead of flipping it to its [[Unstable]] side).
09710.text: [reaction]你成功调查藏钥馆后：不发现线索，改为选择附属到你所在地点调查员的一个未注能的钥匙。将一个资源(从供应堆拿取)放到该钥匙上，作为注能，该钥匙即被注能(如果要变换该钥匙，其控制者可以不将其翻至[[动荡]]面，改为花费该注能)。

09711.back_flavor: 红色结社的内部圣堂浸淫了古代的传统和仪式，既引人入胜，又邪恶无比。
09711.flavor: 有多少钥匙藏于此处，经年累月，不见天日？又有多少用作了压迫的工具？
09711.name: 藏钥馆
09711.real_text: The Key Reliquary gets +2 shroud for each [[Unstable]] key in play.
09711.text: 场上每有一个[[动荡]]钥匙，藏钥馆得到+2隐藏值。

09712.back_flavor: 在这个纠结世界的核心升起了一座巨塔：扭曲的材料在错综之城上盘旋成一幢不祥的高楼，你面前仿佛竖立起一座失落的摩天大楼，有无数层。一旁围绕着参差的不毛诸峰，中间异界的迷雾盘绕向上。
09712.flavor: 这座亵渎的巨像，证明被征服的世界遭到了毁灭。<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
09712.name: 万千纠结之塔
09712.real_text: [reaction] After a location is placed adjacent to The Knotted Tower: Move to that location (from The Knotted Tower).
09712.text: [reaction]在有地点放置与万千纠结之塔相邻后：移动到该地点(从万千纠结之塔)。

09713.back_flavor: 通往悖逆重力之阶的大门已经封印、失落。作为进入悖逆重力之阶的额外费用，万千纠结之塔的调查员必须共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
09713.back_text: 通往悖逆重力之阶的大门被封印且遗忘。作为进入悖逆重力之阶的额外费用，万千纠结之塔的调查员必须共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
09713.name: 悖逆重力之阶
09713.real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around Gravity-Defying Climb is exposed: If it is... - ...the next in the sequence listed on The Towering Vertex, it remains in play and exposed, and you may expose another concealed mini-card. - ...any other mini-card, flip it and each other concealed mini-card facedown (without shuffling them).
09713.text: 强制 - 在环绕悖逆重力之阶的隐匿迷你卡牌被揭露时：如果它是…… - ……睥睨众生之巅上所列顺序的下一位，则它留在场上，保持揭露，且你可以揭露另一张隐匿迷你卡牌。 - ……其他任意迷你卡牌，将其与其他每张隐匿迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下(不要混洗)。

09714.back_text: 戴红手套的男子不能被击败。 通往睥睨众生之巅的道路错综复杂，不可思议。调查员要想进入睥睨众生之巅，必须按如下顺序揭露环绕悖逆重力之阶的隐匿迷你卡牌：首先，残骸之城(左)；其次，残骸之城(中)；最后，残骸之城(右)。
09714.name: 睥睨众生之巅
09714.real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around The Towering Vertex is exposed: If it is... - ...the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card, deal the Mimetic Nemesis 3 damage, then flip all concealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them facedown. - ...a decoy, it remains in play and exposed.
09714.text: 强制 - 在环绕睥睨众生之巅的隐匿迷你卡牌被揭露时：如果它是…… ……拟态克星的迷你卡牌，对拟态克星造成3点伤害，然后将所有隐匿迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下并混洗。 ……诱饵，则它留在场上，保持揭露。

09715.name: 拟态克星
09715.real_text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Mimetic Nemesis gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Mimetic Nemesis would take 1 or more damage from an attack or player card: Choose and reveal a concealed mini-card. If it is a decoy, cancel all damage just dealt (the decoy remains in play and faceup). Otherwise, the damage is dealt as normal, then flip all revealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them.
09715.text: 庞大。不能进行趁乱攻击。 拟态克星得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 在拟态克星将要从攻击或玩家卡牌受到伤害时：选择并揭示一张隐匿迷你卡牌。如果是诱饵，取消刚才造成的所有伤害(诱饵依然留在场上，正面朝上)。否则，如常造成伤害，然后将所有已揭示的迷你卡牌翻至正面朝下并混洗。
09715.traits: 古神. 域外. 精英

09716a.flavor: 一抹红色，一闪而过的身影。
09716a.name: 结社特工(A)
09716a.real_text: Concealed 2. Forced - After Coterie Agent enters the shadows: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] When Coterie Agent is exposed: Discard it.
09716a.text: 隐匿2。 强制 - 在结社特工进入阴影后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在结社特工揭露时：将其弃掉。

09716b.flavor: 一抹红色，一闪而过的身影。
09716b.name: 结社特工(B)
09716b.real_text: Concealed 2. Forced - After Coterie Agent enters the shadows: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] When Coterie Agent is exposed: Discard it.
09716b.text: 隐匿2。 强制 - 在结社特工进入阴影后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在结社特工揭露时：将其弃掉。

09716c.flavor: 一抹红色，一闪而过的身影。
09716c.name: 结社特工(C)
09716c.real_text: Concealed 2. Forced - After Coterie Agent enters the shadows: Place 1 doom on it. [reaction] When Coterie Agent is exposed: Discard it.
09716c.text: 隐匿2。 强制 - 在结社特工进入阴影后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [reaction]在结社特工揭露时：将其弃掉。

09717.flavor: 就在她描述对方穿着的时候，通话断线了。
09717.name: 红色阴谋
09717.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows. If there are no enemies in the shadows, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
09717.text: 显现 - 在阴影中的一个敌人上放置1个毁灭标记。如果阴影中没有敌人，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个带有隐匿关键词的敌人，将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。

09718.flavor: “福林，你瞧见我看到的东西了吗？”
09718.name: 现实塌缩
09718.real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Spend 1 clue or choose and discard half of the non-weakness cards in your hand (rounded up).
09718.text: 险境。 显现 - 你必须(选择一项)：花费1个线索，或选择并弃掉你一半的非弱点手牌(向上取整)。

09719.flavor: 他们大多在下雨时现身。大多。
09719.name: 瓢泼大雨
09719.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror, or place 1 of your clues on your location.
09719.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。

09720.name: 结社代表
09720.real_text:
Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a concealed mini-card and no Coterie Envoy)
While Coterie Envoy is ready, concealed mini-cards at its location cannot be exposed via player card effects.
[reaction] After you defeat Coterie Envoy: Look at the revealed side of any concealed mini-card in play.
09720.text: 冷漠。巡逻(有隐匿迷你卡牌，而无结社代表的最近地点)。 结社代表处于重整状态时，其所在地点的隐匿迷你卡牌不能通过玩家卡牌效果揭露。(FAQ v2.3) [reaction]你击败结社代表后：查看场上任意一张隐匿迷你卡牌的已揭示面。

09721.name: 就在眼前
09721.real_text: Revelation - Attach to an enemy in the shadows without a copy of In Plain Sight attached. If you cannot, In Plain Sight gains surge. Forced - After you expose attached enemy: That enemy attacks you and gets +2 fight until the end of the round. Discard In Plain Sight.
09721.text: 显现 - 附属到阴影中一个没有附属就在眼前的敌人上。如果你不能，就在眼前获得涌动。 强制 - 在你揭露附属的敌人后：该敌人攻击你，且直到本轮结束得到+2攻击。弃掉就在眼前。

09722.name: 暗中一刀
09722.real_text: Revelation - Put Knives in the Dark into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced - After you expose a decoy: Take 2 damage. (Limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Knives in the Dark.
09722.text: 显现 - 如果你的威胁区域没有暗中一刀，将暗中一刀放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。否则，本卡牌获得涌动。 强制 - 你揭露诱饵后：受到2点伤害。(每轮仅限一次。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉暗中一刀。

09723.name: 乔装卧底
09723.real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Undercover gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] or [agility] (4). If you fail, place a decoy at the location with the most concealed mini-cards, flip it facedown, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at that location.
09723.text: 显现 - 如果阴影中没有敌人，乔装卧底获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect]或[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，将一张诱饵放到隐匿迷你卡牌最多的地点，将其翻至正面朝下，并混洗该地点的每张隐匿迷你卡牌。

09724.name: 误见阴影
09724.real_text: Revelation - Put Seeing Shadows into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test while at a location with a concealed mini-card: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Seeing Shadows.
09724.text: 显现 - 将误见阴影放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你在有隐匿迷你卡牌的地点时，技能检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]:弃掉误见阴影。

09725.name: 黑暗中的身影
09725.real_text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Figures in the Dark gains surge. Otherwise, you must decide (choose one): - Each enemy in the shadows attacks you. - Each investigator loses an action.
09725.text: 险境。 显现 － 如果阴影中没有敌人，黑暗中的身影获得涌动。否则，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 阴影中的每个敌人攻击你。 - 每位调查员失去一个行动。

09726a.name: 结社打手(A)
09726a.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.
09726a.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 你揭露阴影中其他名称的敌人后，如果结社打手在阴影中：其攻击你。

09726b.name: 结社打手(B)
09726b.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.
09726b.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 你揭露阴影中其他名称的敌人后，如果结社打手在阴影中：其攻击你。

09727a.name: 结社刺客(A)
09727a.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.
09727a.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果结社刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌的调查员。

09727b.name: 结社刺客(B)
09727b.real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.
09727b.text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果结社刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐匿迷你卡牌的调查员。

09728.name: 溜之大吉
09728.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Swift Retreat gains surge. Otherwise, find the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy and test [agility] (3). If you fail, that enemy attacks you. If you fail and that enemy is not in the shadows, resolve its concealed keyword (if able).
09728.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[结社]]敌人，溜之大吉获得涌动。否则，找到最近的[[结社]]敌人并检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你。如果你检定失败且该敌人不在阴影中，结算其隐匿关键词(如可能)。

09729.name: 身染猩红
09729.real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Bound in Red gains surge. Otherwise, attach it to the [[Coterie]] enemy with the highest printed health. Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror. [action]: Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side. Then, discard Bound in Red. An investigator at any location may trigger this ability.
09729.text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[结社]]敌人，身染猩红获得涌动。否则，将其附属到印刷生命值最高的[[结社]]敌人。 附属的敌人得到+1攻击、+1躲避、+1伤害和+1恐惧。 [action]:将你控制的一个[[稳定]]钥匙翻至[[动荡]]面。然后，弃掉身染猩红。任意地点的调查员均可以触发此能力。

09730.flavor: 他们带着魔鬼的恶意操纵那个工具，我的视线已经模糊……<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
09730.name: 钥匙充能
09730.real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each [[Coterie]] enemy shifts each key attached to it.
09730.text: 涌动。 显现 - 每个[[结社]]敌人变换附属到自己的钥匙。

09731.flavor: 档案#AT - 151/客体表现为一种非物质的超自然扭曲。可使接触的物质变得“空洞”(见档案#AV - 245)。无法收容。
09731.name: 无端存在
09731.real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Paracausal Entity engages you: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
09731.text: 猎手。 强制 - 在无端存在与你交战时：查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。

09732.name: 天启噩兆
09732.real_text: Forced - When Apocalyptic Presage enters play: Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [reaction] When Apocalyptic Presage is defeated: Instead of adding it to the victory display, discard it and choose up to 3 set-aside hollows. Add them to their owners' hands.
09732.text: 强制 - 在天启噩兆入场时：每位调查员选择自己手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 [reaction]在天启噩兆被击败时：不将其加入胜利区，改为将其弃掉并选择至多3张放在一边的空洞，将这些空洞加入所有者手牌。

09733.flavor: 档案#AV-245，补充/未观测到能量转换。变为空洞的物质究竟发生了什么？
09733.name: 物质伪饰
09733.real_text: Revelation - For each set-aside hollow you own, if there are 1 or more copies of that hollow in your play area and/or hand, discard those copies and take 1 damage and 1 horror. If no cards are discarded by this effect, choose a non-weakness card you control in your hand or play area and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
09733.text: 显现 - 每有一个放在一边的空洞归你所有，如果你的游戏区域和/或手牌中有其同名卡牌，弃掉这些卡牌并受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果没有因本效果弃掉的卡牌，选择你手中或游戏区域内控制的一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。

09734.flavor: 档案#AV-261，补充/客体似乎回到了正常的物质状态。
09734.name: 异界仿体
09734.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - If Otherworldly Mimic is ready, when an investigator at its location plays, commits, or triggers an ability on a copy of a set-aside hollow: It attacks that investigator.
09734.text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 如果异界仿体处于重整状态，其所在地点的调查员在将放在一边的空洞的同名卡牌打出、投入，或触发其能力时：它攻击该调查员。

09735.name: 记忆变体
09735.real_text: Revelation - Put Memory Variant into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - After an event is played: Instead of discarding it, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard Memory Variant. Any investigator may trigger this ability.
09735.text: 显现 - 将记忆变体放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 强制 - 事件被打出后：不将其弃掉，改为放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 [action]:检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，弃掉记忆变体。任意调查员均可以触发本能力。

09736.name: 失落的秘密
09736.real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may take 1 horror to choose a set-aside hollow and add it to its owner's hand.
09736.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，选择自己手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以受到1点恐惧，以选择一个放在一边的空洞，将其加入所有者手牌。

09737.name: 常态颠扑者
09737.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After you end your turn at Paradigm Effacer's location: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if you own 3 or more set-aside hollows, Paradigm Effacer attacks you.
09737.text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 你在常态颠扑者的地点结束回合后：查看你牌库顶的卡牌。如果不是弱点，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。然后，如果有至少3张放在一边的空洞归你所有，常态颠扑者攻击你。

09738.name: 物质颠倒
09738.real_text: Revelation - Attach to an [[Outsider]] enemy without a copy of Matter Inversion attached. If you cannot, Matter Inversion gains surge. Attached enemy loses aloof, gains retaliate, and gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - After attached enemy is successfully evaded: Discard Matter Inversion and draw 1 of your set-aside hollows.
09738.text: 显现 - 附属到一个没有附属物质颠倒的[[域外]]敌人上。如果你不能，物质颠倒获得涌动。 附属的敌人失去冷漠，获得反击，得到+1攻击和+1躲避。 强制 - 成功躲避附属的敌人后：弃掉物质颠倒，并抽取1张你放在一边的空洞。

09739.name: 犹格斯星的密使
09739.real_text: Concealed 2. Hunter. Massive. Forced - After you discover a clue at a location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards, if Emissary from Yuggoth is in the shadows: It attacks you.
09739.text: 隐匿2。猎手。庞大。 强制 - 你在有隐匿迷你卡牌的地点发现线索后，如果犹格斯星的密使在阴影中：其攻击你。

09740.name: 阴晦日食
09740.real_text: Revelation - Put Tenebrous Eclipse into play next to the agenda deck. No more than 1 concealed mini-card can be exposed by each investigator each round. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Tenebrous Eclipse from play. (Max once per round.)
09740.text: 显现 - 将阴晦日食放置入场，放在密谋牌库旁。 每位调查员每轮不能揭露超过1张隐匿迷你卡牌。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：从场上弃掉1张阴晦日食。(每轮最多一次。)

09741.name: 裂隙空间
09741.real_text: Revelation - Attach Splintered Space to your location and test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Splintered Space in play, discard them.
09741.text: 显现 - 将裂隙空间附属到你所在地点并检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点每附属一张[[巫术]]诡计，受到1点伤害。本次检定结束后，如果场上正好有3张裂隙空间，将它们弃掉。

09742.name: 越界
09742.real_text: Revelation - Attach Beyond the Pale to your location and test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Beyond the Pale in play, discard them.
09742.text: 显现 - 将越界附属到你所在地点并检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点每附属一张[[巫术]]诡计，受到1点恐惧。本次检定结束后，如果场上正好有3张越界，将它们弃掉。

09743.name: 现实扭曲
09743.real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you end your turn at attached location: Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [action][action]: Discard Warped Reality.
09743.text: 显现 - 附属到你所在地点。 强制 - 你在所附属地点结束回合后：选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 [action][action]:弃掉现实扭曲。

09744.flavor: 我感到自己深处传来一阵奇异的嗡鸣，仿佛是有什么在呼唤。<cite>维吉尔·格雷，《身临域外之廷》</cite>
09744.name: 异世界之触
09744.real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the asset you control with the highest printed resource cost. If no doom was placed by this effect, Touch of the Beyond gains surge.
09744.text: 显现 - 在你控制的印刷资源费用最高的支援上放置1个毁灭标记。如果未因本效果放置毁灭标记，异世界之触获得涌动。

09745.name: 突来冲动
09745.real_text: Revelation - Put Compulsion into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If it is a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token, the first action you perform during this turn must be the below ability, if able. [action][action]: Discard Compulsion.
09745.text: 显现 - 将突来冲动放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：从混乱袋中随机揭示1个混乱标记。如果这是一个[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]标记，如可能，你本回合期间执行的第一个行动必须是下列能力： [action][action]:弃掉突来冲动。

09746.name: 理智扭曲
09746.real_text: Revelation - Put Distorted Reasoning into play in your threat area. You cannot perform the same type of action twice in a row. (Types include activate, engage, evade, fight, investigate, move, play, resource, and draw.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Distorted Reasoning.
09746.text: 显现 - 将理智扭曲放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能连续执行同一类型的行动。(类型包括激活、交战、躲避、攻击、调查、移动、打出、资源和抽取。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，弃掉理智扭曲。

09747a.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，受到1点伤害。 - 如果它在阴影右边，受到1点恐惧。
09747a.name: 凌乱道路
09747a.real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)
09747a.text: 攻击或躲避在凌乱道路的每张隐匿迷你卡牌的难度提升2点。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张隐匿迷你卡牌，其相邻地点与你的地点连接次数为X。查看其已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

09747b.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，失去2资源。 - 如果它在阴影中间，失去1行动。
09747b.name: 凌乱道路
09747b.real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)
09747b.text: 攻击或躲避在凌乱道路的每张隐匿迷你卡牌的难度提升2点。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张隐匿迷你卡牌，其相邻地点与你的地点连接次数为X。查看其已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

09747c.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影中间，选择你手中一张非弱点卡牌，将其放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。 - 如果它在阴影右边，将一个你控制的支援放在一边，位于场外，作为一个空洞。
09747c.name: 凌乱道路
09747c.real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)
09747c.text: 攻击或躲避在凌乱道路的每张隐匿迷你卡牌的难度提升2点。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张隐匿迷你卡牌，其相邻地点与你的地点连接次数为X。查看其已揭示面(不将其揭露)。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

09748a.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，受到1点伤害。 - 如果它在阴影右边，受到1点恐惧。
09748a.name: 异星边境
09748a.real_text: Forced - When you move from Alien Frontier to a connecting location to its left or right, test [agility] (5). If you fail, take 2 damage. [action] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of either a location in the shadows, or the top card of the Otherworld deck. (Group limit once per game.)
09748a.text: 强制 - 在你从异星边境移动到它左边或右边的连接地点时，检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 [action]受到1点恐惧：查看阴影中一个地点的，或异界牌库顶卡牌的已揭示面。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

09748b.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，失去2资源。 - 如果它在阴影中间，失去1行动。
09748b.name: 异星边境
09748b.real_text: Forced - When you move from Alien Frontier to a connecting location above or below it, test [agility] (5). If you fail, take 2 damage. [action] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of either a location in the shadows, or the top card of the Otherworld deck. (Group limit once per game.)
09748b.text: 强制 - 在你从异星边境移动到它左边或右边的连接地点时，检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 [action]受到1点恐惧：查看阴影中一个地点的，或异界牌库顶卡牌的已揭示面。(团队每场游戏仅限一次。)

09749a.back_text: 隐匿1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果它在阴影左边，失去2资源。 - 如果它在阴影中间，失去1行动。
09749a.name: 拟像旷野
09749a.real_text: Forced - After you reveal Weald of Effigies: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [fast] If there are no clues on Weald of Effigies: Either swap the positions of 2 concealed mini-cards adjacent to locations, or swap the positions of 2 locations in the shadows. 10670b.name: 深渊
10670b.real_text: This card must always cover the top of The Abyss. Cards are always drawn and revealed from the bottom of The Abyss. When a non-weakness encounter card is discarded, it is always placed on top of The Abyss. Forced - When you draw a card from The Abyss, if that card is ... - ...a treachery or an enemy: Draw it. - ...a [[Resident]] card: Flip it to its enemy side. It gains "Revelation - This enemy attacks you (without engaging you). Discard this enemy." - ...a player card: Add it to its owner's hand. - ...a location: Put it into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the nearest Mirror Nest (that is not already connected to a [[Cave]] location, if able). For the remainder of this scenario, the two locations are connected to one another. - ...any investigator's "true" investigator card: Its owner heals all damage and horror and takes control of it. Then, they flip their Shattered Self investigator card to its Old Memory side and put it into play under their control.
10670b.text: 这张卡牌必须一直盖在深渊顶。 卡牌总是从深渊底抽取、揭示。在弃掉非弱点遭遇卡牌时，总是将其放在深渊顶。 强制 - 在你从深渊抽取卡牌时，如果该卡牌是…… - ……诡计或敌人：将其抽取。 - ……[[居民]]卡牌：将其翻至敌人面，该卡牌获得“显现 - 本敌人攻击你(不与你交战)。弃掉本敌人。” - ……玩家卡牌：将其加入所有者的手牌。 - ……地点：将其放置入场，未揭示面朝上，与最近的镜巢相邻(如可能，与尚未和[[洞穴]]地点连接的最近的镜巢相邻)。本场冒险剩余时间内，这两个地点互相连接。 - ……任意调查员“真正的”调查员卡牌：其所有者治愈全部的伤害和恐惧，并控制该卡牌。然后，该调查员将其破碎自我调查员卡牌翻至旧时记忆面，放置入场，由自己控制。

11531b.name: 海底壁画[tdc_rune_w]
11531b.real_text:
Below the frieze is a triptych of three distinct scenes. The first panel depicts a comet falling from the sky. The center panel, while highly abstract, shows legions of nightmarish alien shapes pouring out of fallen rocks. Their faces are covered in thick, ropy appendages. The frieze depicts the alien creatures trampling a forest of what looks like thick, boxy flowering trees. The final frieze depicts a wave of sinewy, wormlike creatures spilling out from the celestial rocks like a flood.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_w] In your Campaign Log, record "Parasite" under [tdc_rune_w] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11531b.text:
壁画下方是一幅由三个不同场景组成的三联画。第一幅描绘一颗彗星从天而降。中央一幅虽然极为抽象，却展现出大群噩梦般的外星形体从坠落的岩石中涌出。它们的脸上覆满粗厚、索状的附肢。壁画描绘了这些外星生物践踏一片森林，树木看似粗壮、方正且开满花朵。最后一幅壁画描绘了如洪水般从天体岩石中涌出的波浪状、蠕虫般生物。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_w] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_w]下记录“寄生虫”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11532b.name: 水下秘库[tdc_rune_z]
11532b.real_text:
You press three small hidden nodes inset into the vault door and it slides open with a satisfying hiss. Inside is a desiccated corpse of an alien creature, its octopoid face and leathery wings reduced to dust. It holds an obsidian slate in one bony hand; you identify it as a kind of city map, likely of R'lyeh itself.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_z] In your Campaign Log, record "City" under [tdc_rune_z] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.
11532b.text:
你按下秘库门上嵌入的三个小型隐藏节点，门伴随着令人满意的嘶声滑开。里面是一具外星生物的干尸，它的章鱼状面孔和皮革般的翅膀都已化为尘土。它的一只骨手中握着一块黑曜石石板；你辨认出那是一种城市地图，或许正是拉莱耶的地图。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_z] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_z]下记录“城市”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌翻回地点面。其不能再次被翻面。

11550b.name: 黑曜石遗物[tdc_rune_y]
11550b.real_text:
Pressing a small inset in the relic's base opens the statue's center with a strange hiss, unfolding like an obsidian blossom. A light projection extends over the relic's open core, showing hazy scenes of a crashing alien shoreline and nameless horrors silhouetted against the sky. A cnidarian creature looms over a crowd of squamous larvae, grasping a glowing tablet in a tangle of viscous tentacles. Was this some kind of otherworldly sage? An alien leader, perhaps?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_y] In your Campaign Log, record "Knowledge" under [tdc_rune_y] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11550b.text:
按下遗物底座上的一个小凹槽，雕像中央伴随着奇异的嘶声打开，如同一朵黑曜石花朵般展开。一道光影投射在遗物敞开的核心上，显示出外星海岸崩毁的模糊景象，以及天空映衬下无名恐怖的剪影。一头刺胞动物般的生物耸立在一群带鳞幼虫上方，以黏稠触手的缠结握着一块发光石板。这是某种异界贤者吗？或许是一名外星首领？
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_y] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_y]下记录“知识”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11579b.name: 隐藏秘库[tdc_rune_u]
11579b.real_text:
You find an alien panel hidden behind a fold of fleshy wall. Grimacing, you press it and reveal a round alcove untouched by the alien growths. Sharp glowing symbols connected by curling lines appear on a black slate in the center of the alcove. After some study, you recognize it as some kind of ancestral tree. There are hundreds upon hundreds of names: how many creatures lived in this city aeons ago?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_u] In your Campaign Log, record "Daughters" under [tdc_rune_u] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.
11579b.text:
你在肉质墙壁的一处褶皱后发现一块外星面板。你皱着脸按下它，露出一个未受外星增生物触碰的圆形壁龛。壁龛中央的黑色石板上浮现出由蜿蜒线条连接的尖锐发光符号。研究一番后，你认出它是某种族谱。上面有成百上千个名字：亿万年前有多少生物曾生活在这座城市？
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_u] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_u]下记录“女儿们”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌翻回地点面。其不能再次被翻面。

11580b.name: 带鳞寄生虫[tdc_rune_t]
11580b.real_text:
The alien creature's hard carapace crumbles to reveal a shining black sigil. It must have devoured this piece of technology... or was it assembled from it? Pressing the sigil projects an image of a cloudy golden sky. Somewhere not of this world. A series of glyphs and descending lines overlay the scene. Eventually, their meaning becomes clear.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_t] In your Campaign Log, record "Air" under [tdc_rune_t] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11580b.text:
外星生物坚硬的甲壳崩裂，露出一个闪亮的黑色印记。它一定吞下了这件科技造物……还是由它组装而成？按下印记后，投射出一片多云的金色天空图像。那是某处不属于这个世界的地方。一系列符文与向下的线条覆盖在景象上。最终，它们的含义变得清晰。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_t] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_t]下记录“空气”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11581b.name: 古代遗物[tdc_rune_s]
11581b.real_text:
Twisting portions of the relic unlocks a small cylinder in the center. Inside the cylinder is an even smaller version of the same relic, and within the smaller relic is a glittering gem. Holding it up to the light projects a series of small dots that form some kind of code. One of the expedition members identifies it as a blueprint of sorts: the symbols appear to be instructions for repairing some kind of machine.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_s] In your Campaign Log, record "Machine" under [tdc_rune_s] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11581b.text:
扭转遗物的部分构造，打开中央的一个小圆柱。圆柱内还有一个更小的同样遗物，较小的遗物中则嵌着一颗闪耀的宝石。将它举向光线时，投射出一系列小点，组成某种代码。一名远征队成员辨认出那像是一张蓝图：这些符号似乎是修复某种机器的指令。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_s] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_s]下记录“机器”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11608b.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_o]
11608b.real_text:
A small switch at the base of the wall opens into a cramped musty room. As you enter, a small glyph in the floor begins to glow a dim green. The light intensifies until it is blindingly bright, and the air in the room begins to crackle with energy. The glyph flares even brighter, then goes dark. The symbol's meaning will forever be burned into your memory.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_o] In your Campaign Log, record "Power" under [tdc_rune_o] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11608b.text:
墙壁底部的一处小开关打开了一间狭窄、发霉的房间。你进入时，地板上的一个小符文开始泛起暗绿色光芒。光线愈发强烈，直至令人目眩，房间里的空气开始迸发能量。符文闪耀得更亮，随即熄灭。该符号的含义将永远烙印在你的记忆中。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_o] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_o]下记录“力量”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11609b.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_n]
11609b.real_text:
Within the ancient vault is a large octagonal room that resembles a kind of laboratory. A central console resembles a clawed hand, with two of its "fingers" raised. Nodes in the console project a glowing translucent letter. Curious, you press one hand to a central node. A vision overwhelmes your mind: a torrential wave, a sundered mountain, burning forests and atmosphere. You pull one hand away, uncertain of what you just experienced. A record? A vision?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_n] In your Campaign Log, record "Doom" under [tdc_rune_n] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11609b.text:
古代秘库中有一间像实验室的大型八角形房间。中央控制台如同一只利爪之手，其中两根“手指”高高竖起。控制台中的节点投射出一个发光的半透明字母。你出于好奇，将一只手按在中央节点上。一幅幻象淹没你的意识：滔天巨浪、断裂山脉、燃烧的森林与大气。你抽回手，不确定刚才经历了什么。记录？幻象？
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_n] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_n]下记录“毁灭”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

11610b.name: 古代秘库[tdc_rune_p]
11610b.real_text:
The room within the vault is dark and featureless, save for an incandescent, smoky orb suspended in the center. Inspecting it closer, you find a full-scale model of an alien planet. Small storm systems move along the surface at an accelerated rate, swirling and dissipating in seconds. When you touch it, your senses are assailed by invisible gales, torrential rain, and a crack of thunder. Lines of swirling alien writing appear on the globe, conveying a record of an ancient storm.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_p] In your Campaign Log, record "Weather" under [tdc_rune_p] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.
11610b.text:
秘库内的房间黑暗而空无一物，只有一颗炽亮、冒着烟雾的球体悬浮在中央。仔细观察后，你发现那是一颗外星行星的等比例模型。小型风暴系统以加快的速度沿表面移动，数秒内盘旋又消散。触碰它时，无形的狂风、暴雨和雷鸣猛然冲击你的感官。球体上浮现蜿蜒的外星文字，传达着一场远古风暴的记录。
你发现了这个符文： [tdc_rune_p] 在剧本日志的符文记录中，于[tdc_rune_p]下记录“天气”。该符文已被翻译。 将本卡牌加入胜利区。

Great Lift is connected to the locations to the right and left of it, and vice versa.

[reaction]你成功调查本地点时，改为不发现线索：将大升降机向上或向下滑动一次。你可以花费1[per_investigator]个线索，以将大升降机额外向上或向下滑动一次。

11640b.flavor: 死灵之风自东面的天空吹来。
11640b.name: 东风
11640b.real_text: Forced - When the round ends, reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the storm intensity. If a non-[elder_sign] symbol token is revealed: - Shuffle the leftmost open sky/[[Summit]] locations in rows 1 and 3 and place them on top of the Summit deck (or place them in the victory display instead if they have Victory X and no clues on them). 11662b.flavor: 一张璀璨的遥远星云地图充满房间，爆发出色彩与光芒。边缘附近一颗天蓝色球体吸引了你的注意。凝视它，尖锐的啁啾外星语言与海浪拍击声充满你的心智。你开始念出这门奇异语言时，一个符号在天蓝色球体中闪烁。看着它，你心中涌起强烈渴望，本能地想潜入深海巢穴。这是你学会的一个词，还是被唤起的远古原始记忆？

11663b.flavor: 扭动遗物底座的隐藏旋钮，释放出一阵火花。你惊得差点丢下遗物，但那些“火花”只是零星光点与如水上油污般变换的浓雾。你看得越久，它们越像星座，像遥远星辰的图案。但这片投影与您从前见过的所有星座截然不同。

11664b.flavor: 壁画的部分因岁月而磨平，但你最终还是辨认出山脉、云朵和雾气的形状。雾中，噩梦般的形体似乎正陷入某种挣扎。惊恐的生物从下方仰望。最底层，一只独眼正凝视地表深处的地下城市。浓重笔触描绘出填满城市街道的翻涌雾气。每位居民都带着可怖的安眠姿态躺卧。

11691a.back_flavor: 这名古老威胁继续肆虐。你吸引他注意的尝试似乎正在奏效。希望你为安迪争取到足够时间，让他找到封印古神的办法。

11691b.back_flavor:
一阵越发猛烈的狂风搅动克苏鲁松垮双腿旁的黑水。当发光绿色印记亮起在这尊可怖死神的手臂和腿上时，他发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，震碎窗户，撼动城市的地基。附近安迪弯着身子，手悬在一件发光神器上方，吟诵一连串喉音词语。“成功了！”露比喊道。
又一声咆哮。阿卡姆警察徒劳地试图吸引他注意，枪声在水面回荡。你抬头看见古神本尊凝视着你，双眼闪烁鲜红光芒。这头巨兽举起一只利爪之手，准备如碾虫般压碎你。

linked_card.encounter_name: Return to The Essex County Express
linked_card.flavor: As the train to Dunwich comes to a jarring stop, you look out the window behind you and see an immense tear in the sky, like a rip in a piece of cloth. From this tear, a winged beast emerges. It lets out a painful screech and descends upon the train.

52023b.flavor: “真高兴再次见到你。”身穿黄裙的女子温柔轻声地对另一名贵宾说道，仿佛多年未见的老友重逢。黛安娜的声音起初令人放松，深处却潜藏着某种原始而险恶的暗流。“我相信你遵守了我们的承诺？”你没听清对方回答，黛安娜的微笑却扩展为狂乱狞笑。她的皮肤开始鼓泡翻腾，仿佛表皮下有东西正要挣脱。“噢，是这样吗？”她直直转向你，双眼燃着怒火。“这。样。吗。”
52023b.name: 黛安娜·迪瓦恩

52024b.name: 疯狂的宾客
52024b.real_text:
If there are no Party Guests in play, place this card back underneath the scenario reference card and randomly choose a new Sickening Reality card to resolve. Otherwise, read the following:
A chorus of laughter erupts nearby as one of the guests dances to the bizarre music. You head over to discover what is so funny, but what you find is no laughing matter at all. The guest’s dance partner lies sprawled on the floor, limp and bloodied, a gaping, gory hole in their chest. The guest turns to you with a disturbing look in their eye and a wicked grin spreading on their lips.
Choose a Party Guest in play. Each investigator at that Party Guest's location takes 1 damage. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the chosen version of Party Guest, removing that version from the game.
52024b.text:
如果场上没有宴会宾客，将本卡牌放回冒险参考卡牌下方，然后随机选择一张新的令人作呕的现实卡牌结算。否则，阅读下列内容：
在一位宾客随着怪异的音乐起舞时，近旁爆发出哄堂大笑。你走过去想看看是什么这么好笑，但眼前的景象绝非玩笑。那名宾客的舞伴瘫倒在地，四肢无力，浑身是血，胸口有一个血淋淋的大洞。宾客转过身来，望着你的眼神叫人不安，嘴角缓缓咧开一个邪恶的笑容。
选择场上一个宴会宾客。 位于该宴会宾客所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害。 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 将本卡牌翻至敌人面，并将其与所选版本的宴会宾客切换，将该版本从游戏中移除。
52024b.traits: 类人. 怪物. 附身

52060b.flavor:
你站在王的宫殿前。哈斯塔无休止的低语充斥着你的头脑，你无法将他荼毒的话语从你脑中赶走。看着眼前壮观而荣耀的宫殿，你意识到了它真正的本质。你知道自己必须要做什么了。
王宫的大门打开了。
52060b.name: 哈斯塔的终局
52060b.real_text: Check Campaign Log: - If Hastur (The King in Yellow) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Recesses of Your Own Mind location into play. - If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside The Throne Room location into play. Move Hastur to The Throne Room. - If Hastur (The Tattered King) is the version of Hastur that is in play: Put the set-aside Stage of the Ward Theatre location into play. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

53030b.real_text: Revelation - Put Merle Garvin into play at Miskatonic University. [action]: Parley. Mr. Garvin tries to give you the slip. Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Merle Garvin (from the token pool) and move him 1 location away from you. If you fail, move him 2 locations away from you.
53030b.text: 显现 - 将默尔·加文放置入场，放到米斯卡塔尼克大学上。 [action]：谈判。加文先生试图溜走。检定[agility](2)。如果你检定成功，在默尔·加文上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)并将其向远离你的方向移动1个地点。如果你检定失败，将其向远离你的方向移动2个地点。

53032b.name: 克林顿·弗里曼
53032b.real_text: Revelation - Put Clinton Freeman into play at Velma's Diner. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 clue on Clinton Freeman (from the token pool) and take 1 horror. If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you failed by.
53032b.text: 显现 - 将克林顿·弗里曼放置入场，放到维尔玛小餐馆上。推进到场景3g——“探寻真相”。 [action]：谈判。检定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，在克林顿·弗里曼上放置1个线索(从供应堆拿取)并受到1点恐惧。如果你检定失败，每低于难度1点，受到1点恐惧。

53034b.name: 装货码头
53034b.real_text: Revelation - Put Loading Docks into play with 4 resources on it. Advance to Act 3g - "Discover the Truth." While there are no resources on Loading Docks, clues on it cannot be discovered by any means. Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 resource from Loading Docks.
53034b.text: 显现 - 将装货码头放置入场，其入场时带有4个资源标记。推进到场景3g——“探寻真相”。 装货码头上没有资源时，其上的线索不能以任何方式被发现。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：移除装货码头上的1资源。

53046b.name: 羽翼蛇族
53046b.real_text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - If there are 5 or more damage on this enemy, or after a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Heal all damage from this enemy and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.
53046b.text: 生成 - 昆扬之口。 猎手。庞大。 不能被击败。不能进行趁乱攻击。 强制 - 如果本敌人上有5点或更多伤害，或在一个石柱标记被放置在昆扬之口上后：治愈其所有伤害并将其横置。其在本轮补给阶段期间不重整。
53046b.traits: 怪物. 蛇族. 精英

54037b.name: 绞刑者河
54037b.real_text: [action]: Resign. "Whose bright idea was this, anyway?" Haunted - Place 1 clue from the supply on Hangman's Brook.
54037b.text: [action]：撤退。“这个好主意是谁想出来的？” 闹鬼 - 从供应堆将1个线索放到绞刑者河上。

54038b.flavor: 空气……求求你，我需要空气……
54038b.name: 未了之事
54038b.real_text:
The drowned spirit lunges for you, croaking with the garbled sounds of torment. Sodden weeds are tangled through its hair.
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round: You must either discard an asset you control or flip this card back to its enemy side. [action] If you are at Hangman's Brook and it has no clues on it: Test a skill of your choice (5). If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
At the bottom of the riverbank, you find the spirit's remains. You dig a shallow grave beside the brook and there you lay its body to rest, dry and safe at long last.
Add this card to the victory display.
54038b.text:
溺亡的灵魂向你扑来，喉咙里挤出饱含折磨的咯咯声响，湿沉的水草缠结在它发间。
将该卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：你必须弃掉1张你控制的支援或将本卡牌翻回敌人面。 [action]如果你位于绞刑者河，且其上没有线索：检定任意技能(5)。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
在河岸底部，你找到了亡魂的遗骸。你在溪边挖了一个浅浅的墓穴，将它的遗体安葬其中，它终于得以干燥、安全的长眠了。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。

54039b.name: 未了之事
54039b.real_text:
The wraith is in a panic, casting its gaze into the dark woods in search of some enigmatic predator. What could something that is dead possibly fear?
Keep this card in your threat area (this side faceup). If you are eliminated, flip it over. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: If The Spectral Watcher is in play, ready it. [action]: Evade. Use only on The Spectral Watcher. Use your lowest skill for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, the ghost is "banished" (resolve the text below) (in addition to evading The Spectral Watcher).
Do not read until this ghost is "banished."
You force the spectral horror back, buying enough time to calm the spirit down. As it dissolves into the night, its gaze never wanders from the watcher's form.
Add this card to the victory display.
54039b.text:
这个怨灵惊慌失措，目光不断扫视着漆黑的树林，仿佛在寻找某个隐匿的掠食者。是什么能让死者都如此惧怕？
将该卡牌保留在你的威胁区域(以本面朝上)。如果你退场，将其翻面。 强制 - 在敌军阶段开始时：如果幽灵看守人在场，将其重整。 [action]：躲避。仅能对幽灵看守人执行。本次躲避尝试检定你技能值最低的技能。如果你检定成功，本幽灵被“驱除”(结算以下文本)。(作为躲避了幽灵看守人的额外效果。)
本幽灵被“驱除”之前，请勿阅读下文。
你奋力击退了这可怖的幽影，趁此间隙安抚了躁动的魂灵。当它逐渐消散于夜色时，视线却始终紧盯着看守人的身影。
将本卡牌加入胜利牌区。

70033b.name: 深入迷宫……
70033b.real_text:
If you are in Group B:
Etched upon the glass of the capsule slowly filling with water, you can see a blueprint begin to glow.
Each investigator in this group may immediately trade clues among one another. Move any number of clues from Chamber of Rain to Chamber of Sorrows, or vice-versa. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group A:
The runes glow, and a piece of the wall slides to reveal a secret compartment, filled with trinkets.
Put the Key of Mysteries into play at the Chamber of Secrets. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group C:
The runes in your chamber shift to form a word.
The word you see is the same word inscribed upon the wall of the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area (you may examine Group A's play area) Flip this card back over.
70033b.text:
如果你在B组：
逐渐被水灌满的舱室玻璃上刻着图样，你看见它开始发光。
本组每位调查员可以立刻互相交换线索。将任意数量的线索从雨之密室移动到悲伤密室，或反之亦然。将本卡牌翻回正面。
如果你在A组：
符文发出光芒，一块墙壁滑开，露出装满小饰物的秘密隔间。
将奥秘之钥放置入场，放在密藏密室。将本卡牌翻回正面。
如果你在C组：
你所在密室中的符文移动，组成一个单词。
你看见的单词与A组游戏区域内密藏密室墙上刻的单词相同（你可以查看A组游戏区域）。将本卡牌翻回正面。

70034b.name: 迷宫深处……
70034b.real_text:
You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.
70034b.text:
你发现自己置身于某种枢纽——以太中的一条通道。其他囚徒也找到了这里。或许你们可以合作寻找逃脱的办法。
每位进入裂隙的调查员拿取本剧情卡牌，并远离各组私下会面。裂隙中的调查员可以自由交谈，也可以交换任意数量的线索、资源、手牌或其控制的剧情支援。调查员满意后，每位调查员回到原来的组别。将本卡牌翻回。

70035b.name: 迷宫深处……
70035b.real_text:
The objects tumble down through the shaft, making loud banging noises behind the walls and underneath the floor. Hopefully another group can find them...
Take the cards, tokens, and notes on or underneath this card and place them on or underneath another group's copy of The Vent. Flip this card back over.
70035b.text:
物件沿井道滚落，撞在墙后和地板下，发出巨响。希望另一组能找到它们……
将本卡牌上或下方的卡牌、标记和记录放到另一组的通风口卡牌上或下方。 将本卡牌翻回。

70036b.name: 深入迷宫……
70036b.real_text:
You write "I choose death" on the note. Words appear just below yours, spelling out a sentence in reply. "Did you really think I would let you die that easily?"
You must choose and discard all but X cards from your hand, and remove all but X resources from your resource pool. X is the amount of doom on the current agenda.
Read the following to each group aloud:
The words and letters on the note shift and change to form a strange diagram.
The lead investigator of Group A takes control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. The lead investigator of Group B takes control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. The lead investigator of Group C takes control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove each group's copy of The Dilemma from the game.
70036b.text:
你在便笺上写下“我选择死亡”。你的文字下方出现更多文字，拼成一句回应：“你真的以为我会让你这么轻易地死去吗？”
你必须选择并弃掉你手牌中除X张外的所有卡牌，并移除你资源池中除X个外的所有资源。X为当前密谋上的毁灭标记数量。
向每组大声读出下列文字：
便笺上的文字和字母移动、变化，组成一幅奇怪的图样。
A组的调查员队长控制放在一边的腐烂图样。 B组的调查员队长控制放在一边的饥饿图样。 C组的调查员队长控制放在一边的腐朽图样。 将每组的两难抉择副本从游戏中移除。

70037b.name: 深入迷宫……
70037b.real_text:
As soon as you step through the gate, it vanishes behind you. You are on your own, for now...
Depending on which group you are in, put a different location into play, as follows: - If you are in Group A, put the Chamber of Rot into play. - If you are in Group B, put the Chamber of Hunger into play. - If you are in Group C, put the Chamber of Decay into play. Disengage from each enemy and move to the location just put into play. Until there is at least 5 doom on the current agenda, that location is not considered to be connected to any other location. Remove this card from the game.
70037b.text:
你一穿过闸门，它就消失在身后。暂时只能靠你自己了……
根据你所在的组，将一个不同地点放置入场，如下： - 如果你在A组，将腐烂密室放置入场。 - 如果你在B组，将饥饿密室放置入场。 - 如果你在C组，将腐朽密室放置入场。 与每个敌人脱离交战，并移动到刚放置入场的地点。 当前密谋上至少有5个毁灭标记前，该地点不视为与任何其他地点连接。 将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

70038b.name: 深入迷宫……
70038b.real_text:
The runes in the chamber glow, and a strange message is spelled out across the wall.
If you are in Group A: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group B: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group C: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
70038b.text:
密室中的符文发光，墙上拼出一则奇怪的信息。
如果你在A组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的腐烂图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
如果你在B组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的饥饿图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
如果你在C组： 选择一位调查员控制放在一边的腐朽图样。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。

71015b.flavor: 基金会并不乐见你对宝石感兴趣。如果你展示武力，也许能说服他们退让。
71015b.name: 基金会[guardian]
71015b.real_text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Rookie Cop enemy into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Valeriya Antonova card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Valeriya Antonova is at your location: Parley. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Valeriya Antonova to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Rookie Cop and remove it from the game. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.
71015b.text: 冒险设置：将放在一边的新手警员敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。将放在一边的瓦莱里娅·安东诺娃卡牌放置入场，放在调查员队长所在地点，敌人面朝上。 [action]如果瓦莱里娅·安东诺娃在你所在地点：谈判。检定[combat](3)。如果你成功，将你的1个线索放在本剧情卡牌上。 强制 - 本剧情卡牌上有1加1[per_investigator]个线索时：将本卡牌和瓦莱里娅·安东诺娃加入胜利区。查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出新手警员并将其从游戏中移除。如果查找了遭遇牌库，将其混洗。

71016b.name: 瓦莱里娅·安东诺娃
71016b.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Valeriya Antonova cannot be damaged. Each investigator at this location gets -1 to each of their skills if they control an exhausted [[Guest]] asset. Forced - When the round ends: Exhaust each [[Guest]] asset at this location.
71016b.text: 冷漠。猎手。 瓦莱里娅·安东诺娃不能受到伤害。 本地点每位控制一个横置[[宾客]]支援的调查员，其每项技能得到-1。 强制 - 在本轮结束时：横置本地点的每个[[宾客]]支援。
71016b.traits: 类人. 首领. 对手. 精英

71021b.flavor: 密斯卡托尼克大学的书呆子似乎认为这颗宝石应当归入他们的博物馆。或许你能帮他们明白道理。
71021b.name: 密斯卡托尼克大学[seeker]
71021b.real_text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Confusion treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Caldwell Philips card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Caldwell Philips is at your location: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Caldwell Philips to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Confusion and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
71021b.text: 冒险设置：将放在一边的困惑诡计混洗入遭遇牌库。将放在一边的考德威尔·菲利普斯卡牌放置入场，放在调查员队长所在地点，敌人面朝上。 [action]如果考德威尔·菲利普斯在你所在地点：谈判。检定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，将你的1个线索放在本剧情卡牌上。 强制 - 本剧情卡牌上有1加1[per_investigator]个线索时：将本卡牌和考德威尔·菲利普斯加入胜利区。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出困惑并将其从游戏中移除。混洗遭遇牌库。

71022b.name: 考德威尔·菲利普斯
71022b.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Caldwell Philips cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Choose and discard a non-weakness card from your hand.
71022b.text: 冷漠。猎手。 考德威尔·菲利普斯不能受到伤害。 强制 - 你在本地点结束回合时：选择并弃掉你手牌中的一张非缺陷卡牌。
71022b.traits: 类人. 首领. 对手. 精英

71027b.flavor: 黑帮很容易发怒，但或许你能说服约翰尼·瓦隆，交出宝石才符合他的最大利益……
71027b.name: 辛迪加[rogue]
71027b.real_text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Cold Streak treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Johnny Valone card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Johnny Valone is at your location: Parley. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Johnny Valone to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Cold Streak and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
71027b.text: 冒险设置：将放在一边的倒霉透顶诡计混洗入遭遇牌库。将放在一边的约翰尼·瓦隆卡牌放置入场，放在调查员队长所在地点，敌人面朝上。 [action]如果约翰尼·瓦隆在你所在地点：谈判。检定[agility](3)。如果你成功，将你的1个线索放在本剧情卡牌上。 强制 - 本剧情卡牌上有1加1[per_investigator]个线索时：将本卡牌和约翰尼·瓦隆加入胜利区。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出倒霉透顶并将其从游戏中移除。混洗遭遇牌库。

71028b.name: 约翰尼·瓦隆
71028b.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Johnny Valone cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at Johnny Valone's location: Lose 2 resources.
71028b.text: 冷漠。猎手。 约翰尼·瓦隆不能受到伤害。 强制 - 你在约翰尼·瓦隆所在地点结束回合时：失去2资源。
71028b.traits: 类人. 首领. 对手. 精英

71033b.flavor: 或许你能温和地劝说桑福德和秘社不要多管闲事。
71033b.name: 银暮秘社[mystic]
71033b.real_text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Ward of Preservation treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Carl Sanford card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Carl Sanford is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Carl Sanford to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Ward of Preservation and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
71033b.text: 冒险设置：将放在一边的守护结界诡计混洗入遭遇牌库。将放在一边的卡尔·桑福德卡牌放置入场，放在调查员队长所在地点，敌人面朝上。 [action]如果卡尔·桑福德在你所在地点：谈判。检定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，将你的1个线索放在本剧情卡牌上。 强制 - 本剧情卡牌上有1加1[per_investigator]个线索时：将本卡牌和卡尔·桑福德加入胜利区。查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出守护结界并将其从游戏中移除。混洗遭遇牌库。

71034b.name: 卡尔·桑福德
71034b.real_text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Carl Sanford cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location gets -1 [willpower].
71034b.text:
冷漠。猎手。
卡尔·桑福德不能受到伤害。
本地点每位调查员得到-1[willpower]。
71034b.traits: 类人. 首领. 对手. 精英

71039b.flavor: 当地人似乎并不欢迎你的介入。或许你能向他们证明你没有恶意。
71039b.name: 金斯波特居民[survivor]
71039b.real_text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Unlucky treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside William Bain card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If William Bain is at your location: Parley. Test any skill (4). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and William Bain to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Unlucky and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
71039b.text: 冒险设置：将放在一边的倒霉透顶诡计混洗入遭遇牌库。将放在一边的威廉·班恩卡牌放置入场，放在调查员队长所在地点，敌人面朝上。 [action]如果威廉·班恩在你所在地点：谈判。检定任意技能(4)。如果你成功，将你的1个线索放在本剧情卡牌上。 强制 - 本剧情卡牌上有1加1[per_investigator]个线索时：将本卡牌和威廉·班恩加入胜利区。查找遭遇牌库、遭遇弃牌堆和所有游戏区域，找出倒霉透顶并将其从游戏中移除。混洗遭遇牌库。

71040b.flavor: “福努斯·巴洛努斯；我知道你们和他们是一伙的。”
71040b.name: 威廉·班恩
71040b.real_text:
Aloof. Hunter.
William Bain cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location cannot commit cards to skill tests.
71040b.text:
冷漠。猎手。
威廉·班恩不能受到伤害。
本地点每位调查员不能向技能检定投入卡牌。
71040b.traits: 类人. 首领. 对手. 精英

71045b.name: 无血者
71045b.real_text: Hunter. Massive. Forced - After this enemy attacks you: Remove a [[Guest]] asset you control from the game, ignoring the agenda's Forced effect.
71045b.text: 猎手。庞大。 强制 - 本敌人攻击你后：无视密谋的强制效果，将一个你控制的[[宾客]]支援从游戏中移除。
71045b.traits: 怪物. 异形. 精英

71046b.name: 苍白灯笼
71046b.real_text: [action]: Flip over a spellbound card at your location. [action] Exhaust The Pale Lantern: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 damage on it. Then, if there is 4 damage on it, you break it; add it to the victory display (ignoring its Forced effect) and flip over each spellbound card. Forced - When The Pale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and attach it to its location instead.
71046b.text: [action]：将你所在地点一张被咒缚的卡牌翻面。 [action]横置苍白灯笼：检定[combat]或[agility](2)。如果你成功，在其上放置1点伤害。然后，如果其上有4点伤害，你将其打碎；将其加入胜利区(无视其强制效果)，并将每张被咒缚的卡牌翻面。 强制 - 苍白灯笼将要离场时：改为将其翻面并附属到其所在地点。

72008b.flavor: 土星人、狼人和恐龙，天哪！
72008b.name: 中央片场
72008b.real_text: Forced - When the round ends, if there are no clues on Central Lot: Place clues on Central Lot up to its clue value.
72008b.text: 强制 - 一轮结束时，如果中央片场上没有线索：在中央片场上放置线索，直到其线索值。
72008b.traits: 布景. 中心. 异次元

72032b.name: 土星人君主
72032b.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Saturnite Monarch gets +1 fight for each other enemy in play (to a max of +3). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Saturnite Monarch is at the same location as Helios Telescope, remove 1 shard from Helios Telescope.
72032b.text: 警戒。猎手。巨型。 土星人君主每有一名其他场上敌人，得到+1战斗值(最多+3)。 强制 - 敌军阶段结束时，如果土星人君主与赫利俄斯望远镜位于同一地点：从赫利俄斯望远镜上移除1个碎片。
72032b.traits: 怪物. 土星人. 精英

72036b.flavor: 你鲁莽的飞行引来了不必要的注意。在解决这颗讨厌的小行星之前，你不能冒险飞行。
72036b.name: 好奇之月
72036b.real_text: Massive. Forced - If Curious Moon is successfully attacked or evaded, flip this card over.
72036b.text: 巨型。 强制 - 好奇之月被成功攻击或躲避时：将本卡牌翻面。
72036b.traits: 卫星. 宇宙. 精英

72044b.name: 异特龙
72044b.real_text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Allosaurus enters your location: You must either take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror, or Allosaurus defeats an [[Ally]] asset at your location.
72044b.text: 警戒。猎手。巨型。反击。 异特龙得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 异特龙进入你所在地点后：你必须受到1点直接伤害和1点直接恐惧，或异特龙击败你所在地点的一张[[盟友]]支援。
72044b.traits: 生物. 恐龙. 精英

72055b.name: 伯爵夫人
72055b.real_text:
Elusive.
While the Accursed Cape is attached to The Contessa, she gets +1 damage and gains hunter and retaliate.
72055b.text:
逃逸。
受诅咒斗篷附属到伯爵夫人时，她得到+1伤害值，并获得猎手和反击。
72055b.traits: 类人. 怪物. 精英

82002b.name: 恶意狂欢者
82002b.real_text: Spawn - The nearest location with no investigators counter-clockwise from the lead investigator. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Baleful Reveler moves from the hunter keyword, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)
82002b.text: 生成 - 首席调查员逆时针方向最近的、没有调查员的地点。 猎手。反击。 强制 - 恶意狂欢者因猎手关键词移动后：从混乱袋随机揭示1个混乱标记。如果揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]标记，再次结算其猎手关键词。(每轮限一次。)
82002b.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 精英

82006b.name: 贡多拉
82006b.real_text: Revelation - Put Gondola into play and move each investigator to it. Then, remove all other locations from the game. Remove from the game each enemy and asset at those locations, as well. [action]: Test [combat] or [agility] (2) to row as hard as you can. If you succeed, place 1 resource from the token bank on this location.
82006b.text: 显现 - 将贡多拉放置入场，并将每位调查员移动到此处。然后，将所有其他地点从游戏中移除。也将这些地点上的每名敌人和每张支援从游戏中移除。 [action]：检定[combat]或[agility](2)，尽力划船。如果你成功，从标记池在本地点放置1资源。

82017b.name: 戴面具的狂欢节行人
82017b.real_text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Flip Masked Carnevale-Goer. If its other side is an enemy, it attacks each investigator in its location.
82017b.text: [action]花费1个线索：将戴面具的狂欢节行人翻面。如果另一面是敌人，该敌人攻击其所在地点的每位调查员。

83022a.name: 梦境之间
83022a.real_text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. [reaction] After you successfully investigate A Dream Betwixt: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
83022a.text: 强制 - 如果深渊之力的强度为0：将深渊之力的强度设为1。 [reaction]在你成功调查梦境之间后：将其翻面，结算其另一面的文本。

83022b.flavor:
长廊尽头的门通往一个超越物质世界的地方，一个梦境与现实交汇的地方。
你稳住思绪，凝视深渊。深渊拥抱了你。

linked_card.name: A Dream Betwixt
linked_card.real_text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. [reaction] After you successfully investigate A Dream Betwixt: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
linked_card.text:
Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1.

After you successfully investigate A Dream Betwixt: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

83022b.name: 前往幻梦境
83022b.real_text: Put each of the remaining set-aside locations into play, revealed location side faceup - The Great Abyss, Tunnels under Ngranek, Stairway to Sarkomand, and Mist-Filled Caverns. (Place clues on each of those locations equal to their clue value.) The investigator resolving this text disengages from each engaged enemy and moves to The Great Abyss. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
83022b.text: 将所有其余放在一边的地点以已揭示地点面朝上放置入场——大深渊、恩格拉内克山下的隧道、通往萨尔科曼德的阶梯和迷雾洞穴。(在每个地点上放置等同于其线索值数量的线索。) 结算此文本的调查员与其交战的所有敌人解除交战，并移动到大深渊。 将本卡牌翻面。在本局游戏剩余时间内，本卡牌不能再次翻面。

83023a.flavor:
……他确实抵达了那道张开的深壑，覆着硬壳和霉斑的石阶从这里向下延伸，通往噩梦的地穴。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
83023a.name: 大深渊
83023a.real_text: [reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue from The Great Abyss: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
83023a.text: [reaction]在你成功发现大深渊最后的线索后：将其翻面，结算其另一面的文本。

83023b.flavor: 穿越广袤的深渊时，你惊讶地发现还有其他人在洞穴般的迷雾中徘徊，他们如遭催眠，既困惑又迷失。你认不出他们，他们并非开罗事件中的病人。兄弟会最近肯定将这些受害者送到了这里。凭借现在掌握的知识，你可以尝试唤醒他们，或把他们作为祭品带给伊扎法拉。

linked_card.flavor: …he had indeed reached the yawning gulf whose crusted and mouldy stone steps lead down to the crypts of nightmare. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
linked_card.name: The Great Abyss
linked_card.real_text: [reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue from The Great Abyss: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
linked_card.text: After you discover the last remaining clue from The Great Abyss: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

83023b.name: 沉梦者的命运
83023b.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Remove 2 strength from the abyss.
- Add 2 strength to the abyss.
Regardless of your choice, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
83023b.text:
你必须作出决定(选择以下一项)：
- 深渊之力减弱2点。
- 深渊之力增强2点。
无论你选择哪一项，都将本卡牌翻面。在本局游戏剩余时间内，本卡牌不能再次翻面。

83024a.flavor:
……恩格拉内克山极难攀登，贫瘠而阴森；传言山顶附近的洞穴中栖居着夜魇。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
83024a.name: 恩格拉内克山下的隧道
83024a.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search for signs of life within these jagged tunnels. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
83024a.text: [action]：进行一次[intellect](2)检定，以在这些犬牙交错的隧道中寻找生命的迹象。如果你成功，将本卡牌翻面，结算其另一面的文本。

83024b.flavor: 探索火山隧道时，你发现数十具遭残酷虐待的有翼生物尸体：有些通体漆黑、没有面容，长着膜翼和黑角；另一些体型巨大、满身鳞片，有蝙蝠般的翅膀和马一样的头颅。继续深入隧道，你发现更多无面生物被粗大的铁链束缚。你猜想，它们是伊扎法拉的囚徒。你靠近时，它们诡异的头颅转向你，却没有发出任何声响。

linked_card.flavor: …Ngranek is very difficult and barren and sinister, and there are rumours of caves near the peak wherein dwell the night-gaunts. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
linked_card.name: Tunnels under Ngranek
linked_card.real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search for signs of life within these jagged tunnels. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
linked_card.text: : Test (2) to search for signs of life within these jagged tunnels. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

83024b.name: 征服者的囚徒
83024b.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [agility] (4) to free the creatures. If you succeed, one of them hands you 3 black whistles before they fly off toward their master; take control of the set-aside Summoned Nightgaunt asset and remember that you "freed the nightgaunts."
- Test [combat] (4) to slay the creatures. If you succeed, remember that you "executed the nightgaunts."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.
83024b.text:
你必须作出决定(选择以下一项)：
- 进行一次[agility](4)检定以解救这些生物。如果你成功，其中一只将3只黑哨交给你，然后它们飞向自己的主人；控制放在一边的召来的夜魇支援，并记住你"解救了夜魇"。
- 进行一次[combat](4)检定以杀死这些生物。如果你成功，记住你"处决了夜魇"。
无论你选择哪一项，也无论你是否成功通过指定的技能检定，都将本卡牌翻面。

83025a.flavor:
那段黑暗下行的记忆极为可怕：数小时悄然流逝，卡特在陡峭湿滑、深不见底的螺旋阶梯上摸黑一圈圈向下走。
<cite>H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《梦寻秘境卡达斯》</cite>
83025a.name: 通往萨尔科曼德的阶梯
83025a.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to navigate the bewildering and gravity-defying staircase. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
83025a.text: [action]：进行一次[willpower](3)检定，以穿越令人迷惑且无视重力的阶梯。如果你成功，将本卡牌翻面，结算其另一面的文本。

83025b.flavor: 仿佛经过永恒，你终于抵达地下阶梯的顶端，一扇活板门通向地面。你发现自己身处一座废城宏大的中央广场，城池坐落在天蓝色美丽海洋的岸边。一对巨大的有翼狮像守卫着阶梯入口。

linked_card.flavor: Terrible is the memory of that dark descent in which hours wore themselves away whilst Carter wound sightlessly round and round down a fathomless spiral of steep and slippery stairs. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
linked_card.name: Stairway to Sarkomand
linked_card.real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to navigate the bewildering and gravity-defying staircase. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
linked_card.text: : Test (3) to navigate the bewildering and gravity-defying staircase. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

83025b.name: 萨尔科曼德遗迹
83025b.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [intellect] (3) to speak to the almost-humanoid creatures that dwell in these ruins. If you succeed, you warn them of the battle below and they flee; remember that you "warned the denizens of Sarkomand."
- Test [combat] (3) to block the trapdoor. If you succeed, you topple the lion statues and use them to block the entrance to the stairway as you descend back into the depths; remember that you "cut off all escape."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.
83025b.text:
你必须作出决定(选择以下一项)：
- 进行一次[intellect](3)检定，以和居住在这片遗迹、近似人形的生物交谈。如果你成功，你警告它们下方的战斗，它们随即逃离；记住你"警告了萨尔科曼德的居民"。
- 进行一次[combat](3)检定以封住活板门。如果你成功，你推倒狮像，并在退回深处时用它们封住通往阶梯的入口；记住你"切断了一切退路"。
无论你选择哪一项，也无论你是否成功通过指定的技能检定，都将本卡牌翻面。

83026a.name: 迷雾洞穴
83026a.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (4) to traverse through the mist. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
83026a.text: [action]：进行一次[agility](4)检定以穿过迷雾。如果你成功，将本卡牌翻面，结算其另一面的文本。

83026b.flavor: 你越深入深渊，迷雾便越浓。终于，你来到一间迷雾退散的开阔厅室，一尊高大的雕像迎接了你。那是一名留有浓密胡须与长发的老者，驾着由巨大海螺构成的战车，奇异而惊人的野兽正牵引着它。

linked_card.name: Mist-Filled Caverns
linked_card.real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (4) to traverse through the mist. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.
linked_card.text: : Test (4) to traverse through the mist. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

83026b.name: 诺登斯的雕像
83026b.real_text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [willpower] (2) to entreat the entity depicted in this statue for aid. If you succeed, remember that you "pled for help."
- Test [combat] (2) to overthrow the statue. If you succeed, it topples over and shatters into pieces on the jagged cavern floor; remember that you "affronted the ruler of this realm."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.
83026b.text:
你必须作出决定(选择以下一项)：
- 进行一次[willpower](2)检定，以向雕像所描绘的存在祈求帮助。如果你成功，记住你"寻求了帮助"。
- 进行一次[combat](2)检定以推翻雕像。如果你成功，雕像翻倒，在犬牙交错的洞穴地面上摔成碎片；记住你"触怒了这片领域的主人"。
无论你选择哪一项，也无论你是否成功通过指定的技能检定，都将本卡牌翻面。

linked_card.flavor: The Chosen One's words are grim whispers that worm their way into your ears. "The Day of Nephren-Ka shall come, and the road shall be paved with blood," he promises. "Prove your loyalty and you shall be rewarded. When the Day arrives, you alone shall be spared. Refuse, and be consumed. Then I alone shall rule this place."
linked_card.name: Usurp the Night
linked_card.real_text: If each of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R3). - The strength of the abyss must be 5 or higher. - The investigators must have "executed the nightgaunts," "cut off all escape," and "affronted the ruler of this realm." If the above requirements are not met, each investigator may choose whether or not to accept Xzharah's mercy and immediately resign. If any investigators remain, flip this card back to its enemy side.
linked_card.text:
If each of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R3).

- The strength of the abyss must be 5 or higher.

- The investigators must have "executed the nightgaunts," "cut off all escape," and "affronted the ruler of this realm."

If the above requirements are not met, each investigator may choose whether or not to accept Xzharah's mercy and immediately resign. If any investigators remain, flip this card back to its enemy side.

83027a.name: 伊扎法拉
83027a.real_text: Hunter. Retaliate Xzharah gets +5 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the strength of the abyss. If you succeed, flip this enemy over and resolve the text on its other side. If you fail, Xzharah attacks you.
83027a.text: 猎手。反击。 伊扎法拉得到+5[per_investigator]生命值，且不能因伤害被击败。 [action]：谈判。进行一次[willpower]或[intellect](X)检定，其中X为深渊之力的强度。如果你成功，将本敌人翻面，结算其另一面的文本。如果你失败，伊扎法拉攻击你。
83027a.traits: 仆从. 幻梦境. 同谋. 精英

83027b.flavor: 天选的话语如阴冷的耳语钻入你的耳中。"涅弗伦·卡之日必将到来，道路将由鲜血铺就。"他承诺道，"证明你的忠诚，你将得到奖赏。那一天到来时，唯有你能获赦免。拒绝，便被吞噬。届时只有我能统治这片领域。"
83027b.name: 篡夺黑夜
83027b.real_text: If each of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R3). - The strength of the abyss must be 5 or higher. - The investigators must have "executed the nightgaunts," "cut off all escape," and "affronted the ruler of this realm." If the above requirements are not met, each investigator may choose whether or not to accept Xzharah's mercy and immediately resign. If any investigators remain, flip this card back to its enemy side.
83027b.text: 如果以下要求均已满足，你可以选择推进(→结局3)。 - 深渊之力的强度必须为5或更高。 - 调查员已经"处决了夜魇"、"切断了一切退路"、"触怒了这片领域的主人"。 如果上述要求未全部满足，每位调查员可以选择是否接受伊扎法拉的仁慈，并立刻撤退。如果仍有调查员在游戏中，将本卡牌翻回敌人面。

linked_card.flavor: "I didn't have a choice!" Layla cries. "The things I've read… The records I've translated… They all point to one thing," she claims. "Destruction. Ruin. We can't stop it. All we can do is forge a place for our loved ones in the rubble." You tell her that you will do everything in your power to stop this 'destruction', but she shakes her head, tears in her eyes. "It's a fool's errand. But… " Layla takes a deep breath as she considers her options. "Promise you'll keep my daughter and my son safe, and I'll help you in any way I can."
linked_card.name: The Translator's Evidence
linked_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "discovered an ancient tablet," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You bring the tablet to Dr. El Masri, and she translates it to the best of her ability. "When the Choice is made, He shall be empowered by a thousand sacrifices from the sacred land." She blinks a few times, trying to process what it means. "How many coma patients are there right now?" she asks, wide-eyed.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

83031a.real_text: Spawn - Expedition Camp. [action] As a group, investigators at Dr. Layla El Masri's location discard cards from hand with a total of at least 4 [willpower] icons among them: Parley. Add Dr. Layla El Masri to the victory display.
83031a.text: 生成 - 探险营地。 [action]莱拉·艾尔·马斯里博士所在地点的调查员作为团队，从手牌中弃掉合计至少具有4个[willpower]图标的卡牌：谈判。将莱拉·艾尔·马斯里博士加入胜利牌区。

83031b.flavor: "我别无选择！"莱拉喊道，"我读过的东西……我翻译的记录……它们全都指向一件事。"她断言，"毁灭。破灭。我们无法阻止。我们能做的，只是在废墟中为所爱之人开辟一处容身之地。"你告诉她会竭尽全力阻止这场"毁灭"，但她摇头，眼中含泪。"这是一件徒劳无功的事。不过……"莱拉深吸一口气，思考着自己的选择。"答应我保护好我的女儿和儿子，我就会尽我所能帮助你。"

你将石板带给艾尔·马斯里博士，她尽自己所能将其翻译出来。"抉择一旦作出，祂将从圣地的一千名祭品中获得力量。"她眨了几下眼睛，试图理解其中的含义。"现在有多少昏迷病人？"她睁大眼睛问道。
将深渊之力减弱1点。(每局游戏团队限一次。)

linked_card.flavor: Despite your best efforts, Dr. Moore slips away while you are occupied by his 'bodyguard'. With the creature defeated, and you hot on his trail, you suspect he will try to escape the city while he has the chance.
linked_card.name: The Supplicant's Evidence
linked_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "sabotaged the train," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You manage to corner Dr. Moore as he tries to escape the city on foot. "Very clever," he admits. "But you're already out of time. Lock me up, it doesn't matter. The dreamers will be sacrificed, and our Chosen will lead us to a new age." But after several hours, he is begging to be let out of the city. "Please, the reaper is coming! Neith is coming for us all. We'll all be sacrificed, don't you understand? You and me both! All of us need to flee the city while we still can!"
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)
