摩尔博士试图徒步逃离城市时，你成功将他逼入绝境。"非常聪明。"他承认道，"但你们已经没有时间了。把我关起来也无所谓。沉梦者将被献祭，我们的天选将带领我们进入新时代。"然而几个小时后，他却乞求你让他离开城市。"求求你，死神要来了！奈斯要来找我们所有人了。我们都会被献祭，你不明白吗？你和我都会！趁现在还来得及，我们都得逃离这座城市！"
将深渊之力减弱1点。(每局游戏团队限一次。)

linked_card.flavor: Nadia's faith is shaken. Scared and confused, she finally gives in. "There is only one residence in Cairo they told us to spare," she explains. "None of us know why, or what their connection is to the Brotherhood. All we know is they were not to be disturbed." She hesitantly gives you a small brass key. "… So maybe it's time to disturb them. The building's door is marked with lamb's blood."
linked_card.name: The Priestess's Evidence
linked_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "found a door marked with blood," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Using the key Nadia gave you, you enter the marked residence. To your surprise, there is nobody inside - only the faint stench of rot and aged leather. The basement of the residence is littered with old books, records kept by the Brotherhood and its many agents. They will take some time to peruse, but a lead is a lead.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

83033a.text: 生成 - 神庙庭院。 [action]：谈判。进行一次[willpower](7)检定。你可以受到至多3点恐惧；以此方式每受到1点恐惧，本次检定难度-2。如果你成功，将纳迪娅·尼姆尔加入胜利牌区。如果你失败，纳迪娅·尼姆尔攻击你。

83033b.flavor: 纳迪娅的信仰动摇了。她惊慌失措、困惑不已，最终屈服。"他们只让我们放过开罗城中的一个地方。"她解释道，"没人知道为什么，也没人知道那里与兄弟会有何联系。我们只知道不能打扰他们。"她犹豫着交给你一把小巧的黄铜钥匙。"也许现在该去打扰他们了。那地方的门上有羔羊之血留下的标记。"

你用纳迪娅给你的钥匙进入标记的住所。令你惊讶的是，里面空无一人，只有淡淡的腐臭与陈年皮革气味。住所的地下室散落着旧书，以及兄弟会和其众多特工留下的记录。要仔细查阅它们需要一些时间，但线索总归是线索。
将深渊之力减弱1点。(每局游戏团队限一次。)

linked_card.flavor: "All right, all right," Farid relents, " I'm a businessman, not a soldier. Strike a deal with me, and I'll tell you what I know. Then I'll skip out of town and be out of your hair." You ask what he wants. "There's a vault in the abandoned temple to the east. Word is, there are a lot of old, valuable artifacts in there. The kind that would fetch a high price on the black market." He grins toothily. "Get me into that temple, and I'm all yours. Deal?"
linked_card.name: The Salesman's Evidence
linked_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "broken into a deserted temple," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Farid grins wide as he scoops golden idols into his rucksack. You press him for information before he gets too excited. "Look, they promised me wealth beyond my wildest dreams. Even I have my price, you know?" He throws up his hands, resigned. "Let me show you my records. I've done a lot of 'business' in the last few months. That'll point you in the right direction."
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

83034b.flavor: "好吧，好吧。"法里德的态度软化下来，"我是商人，不是战士。我们做个交易，我就把知道的一切告诉你，然后逃出这座城市，不再烦你。"你问他想要什么。"东边一座废弃的神庙里有间地穴。传言里面满是珍奇古物，就是那种能在黑市卖大价钱的东西。"他咧嘴一笑，露出一口牙齿。"带我进入神庙，我就听你的。成交吗？"

一位调查员"闯入一间废弃的神庙"后，阅读以下内容(如果此任务已完成，立即阅读以下内容)：
法里德将黄金偶像塞进背包，笑得合不拢嘴。趁他还没有兴奋得忘乎所以，你向他追问情报。"听着，他们答应给我超乎想象的财富。你知道的，就连我也有自己的价码。"他认命地举起双手。"让我给你看看我的记录。过去几个月我做了很多'生意'。它们会给你指明正确的方向。"
将深渊之力减弱1点。(每局游戏团队限一次。)

linked_card.flavor:
Despite his mortal wounds, the assassin grins wickedly. "The Day is coming," he says between a fit of coughs. "You think killing me will stop it? Fools! The Beast will devour you all!" He cackles with his final breath, then falls silent.
You are quick to search his belongings before any bystanders spot the body. Among the many strange curios on his person, you find a small leather-bound journal with a cryptic inscription:
Our tribute soaks the abyssal blade
A thousand souls never to wake
With this our Chosen shall arise
And the day is ever nigh!
linked_card.name: The Assassin's Evidence
linked_card.real_text: Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)
linked_card.text: Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

83035a.real_text: Spawn - Streets of Cairo. Retaliate. Forced - When Nassor attacks: Either add 1 strength to the abyss, or Nassor deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack (+2 damage and +2 horror instead if it is the enemy phase).
83035a.text: 生成 - 开罗街道。 反击。 强制 - 纳索尔攻击时：选择一项：将深渊之力增强1点；或纳索尔本次攻击造成伤害+1、恐惧+1(如果处于敌军阶段，改为伤害+2、恐惧+2)。
83035a.traits: 类人. 异教徒. 兄弟会

83035b.flavor:
尽管身受致命伤，刺客仍阴笑一声。"时候快到了。"他咳嗽着挤出一句话，"你以为杀了我就能阻止这一切？蠢货！恶兽会吞噬你们所有人！"他吐出最后一口气，再无声息。
趁路人还没注意到尸体，你迅速翻找他的随身物品。在他收藏的一堆奇怪古董中，你发现一本皮革封面的日志，上面写着晦涩的话语：
深渊之刃，食我祭献。
千魂汇聚，尽然长眠。
其势将起，恶兽天选。
其日将至，末世吞天！
83035b.name: 刺客的证据
83035b.real_text: Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)
83035b.text: 将深渊之力减弱1点。(每局游戏团队限一次。)

linked_card.flavor: "I'll be dead soon anyway," Professor Taylor admits with a deep sigh. "If it's not you, or the Brotherhood, it'll be the tumor in my lung." He dumps the ashes in his pipe and sets it on his table before turning back towards you. "Fine. I'm certain it'll be the death of both of us, but I'll help you out. Don't know what you expect of me, exactly. I suppose if you found one of the Brotherhood's artifacts, I could study it for you."
linked_card.name: The Professor's Evidence
linked_card.real_text:
After an investigator has "bought an odd trinket," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You set the trinket down on the professor's desk. He puts on his monocle and examines it carefully. "Intriguing!" he exclaims. "This could only have come from a particular tomb in the royal crypts. Most scholars don't believe it exists." He rises to his feet and shakes your hand. "Give me some time to study this further. Perhaps if we both make it out of this alive, I can resubmit my thesis," he says with a morbid chuckle.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

83036b.flavor: "我时日无多了。"泰勒教授叹息着承认，"就算没有你和兄弟会，肺里的肿瘤也会要了我的命。"他倒掉烟斗里的烟灰，把烟斗放在桌上，转身面对你。"好吧。尽管我确信咱俩都被死神盯上了，我还是会帮你逃出去，哪怕还不知道你究竟想从我这里得到什么。要是你找到兄弟会的古物，我还能为你研究它。"

你将饰品放在教授的书桌上。他戴上单片眼镜，仔细检查它。"真有意思！"他惊呼道，"这只能来自皇家墓室中的一座特定墓穴。大多数学者都不相信它存在。"他站起身来，和你握手。"给我些时间进一步研究。也许要是我们都能活着离开这里，我还能重新提交我的论文。"他说着发出一声阴郁的轻笑。

86024b.back_flavor: 庞大的宇宙隧道网络，扭曲的重力在星界维度间织成超现实的罗网。
86024b.back_text: 只要次元枢纽周围有6[per_investigator]或更多线索，你的组就“封印了次元枢纽”。
86024b.name: 次元枢纽
86024b.real_text:
Hub Dimension cannot have attachments.
Hub Dimension is connected to each [[Ritual Site]], and vice versa.
[action]: Test [willpower] (2) or [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 clues or remove 2 clues from around Hub Dimension to deal 2 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy (if you succeed by 3 or more, instead deal 3 damage).
86024b.text:
次元枢纽不能有附属。
次元枢纽与每个[[仪式地]]连接，反之亦然。
[action]：进行一次[willpower](2)或[intellect](2)检定。如果你成功，花费3个线索或从次元枢纽周围移除2个线索，对一名[[古神]]敌人造成2点伤害(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为造成3点伤害)。

86038a.name: 缥缈存在
86038a.real_text: Warring. Spawn - Athenaeum of the Empty Sky. Forced - After Ethereal Entity engages you: You must decide (choose one) - - Place 1 doom on the blue agenda. - Place 1 of your clues on your location. - Take 2 horror.
86038a.text: 交兵。 生成 - 空天图书馆。 强制 - 缥缈存在与你交战后：你必须决定(选择一项)： - 在蓝色密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。 - 将你的1个线索放在你所在地点。 - 受到2点恐惧。

86044a.name: 乐园使者
86044a.real_text: Aloof. Retaliate. Warring. Spawn - Shrine of Magh'an Ark'at. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 resource on Bringer of Paradise, as a mutation. Then, if there are 3 or more mutations on it, remove 2 of them and place 2 doom on the green agenda.
86044a.text: 冷漠。反击。交兵。 生成 - 梅根-阿卡特圣地。 强制 - 一轮结束时：在乐园使者上放置1个资源，作为突变。然后，如果其上有3个或更多突变，移除其中2个，并在绿色密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。

86049a.flavor: 即使相隔数英里，也能听见虫群令人恼火、持续不断的嗡嗡声。
86049a.name: 三重蝗
86049a.real_text: Swarming 2. Warring. Spawn - Burning Pit. Forced - When Trylogog attacks: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.
86049a.text: 蜂拥2。交兵。 生成 - 火坑。 强制 - 三重蝗攻击时：其改为造成伤害或恐惧中的一项，而非两项。

linked_card.name: Tindalos
linked_card.real_text:
Tindalos is connected to each [[Portal]] location, and vice versa.
[fast]: Place 1 of your clues on Tindalos, or take control of 1 clue on a Tindalos location in any era.
[action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, rescue an abducted [[Scientist]] asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.
linked_card.text:
Tindalos is connected to each Portal location, and vice versa.

: Place 1 of your clues on Tindalos, or take control of 1 clue on a Tindalos location in any era.

: Test (3) or (3). If you succeed, rescue an abducted Scientist asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.

87005a.name: 廷达洛斯
87005a.real_text:
Tindalos is connected to each [[Portal]] location, and vice versa.
[fast] If it is your turn: Move to a [[Portal]] location.
[action]: Test [combat] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, rescue an abducted [[Scientist]] asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.
87005a.text:
廷达洛斯与每个[[传送门]]地点连接，反之亦然。
[fast]如果现在是你的回合：移动到一个[[传送门]]地点。
[action]：进行一次[combat](2)或[agility](2)检定。如果你成功，解救一张被绑架的[[科学家]]支援，将其以横置状态放置入场，位于廷达洛斯。
87005a.traits: 过去. 现在. 未来

87005b.name: 廷达洛斯
87005b.real_text:
Tindalos is connected to each [[Portal]] location, and vice versa.
[fast]: Place 1 of your clues on Tindalos, or take control of 1 clue on a Tindalos location in any era.
[action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, rescue an abducted [[Scientist]] asset and put it into play at Tindalos, exhausted.
87005b.text:
廷达洛斯与每个[[传送门]]地点连接，反之亦然。
[fast]：将你的1个线索放置在廷达洛斯上，或控制任意时代中廷达洛斯地点上的1个线索。
[action]：进行一次[combat](3)或[agility](3)检定。如果你成功，解救一张被绑架的[[科学家]]支援，将其以横置状态放置入场，位于廷达洛斯。
87005b.traits: 过去. 现在. 未来

87006b.name: 伟大遗产(过去)
87006b.real_text: [action] If you, Thomas Corrigan, and Mary Zielinski are all at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University: Announce "Thomas and Mary have met." [action] If Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and Nikola Tesla are all at the same location, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Announce "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla." [fast] If you are at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "funding for an observatory has begun." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (Place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).
87006b.text: [action]如果你、托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基都位于[[过去]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学：宣告"托马斯和玛丽相识了。" [action]如果托马斯·科里根、玛丽·杰林斯基和尼古拉·特斯拉都位于同一地点，作为团队花费2[per_investigator]个线索：宣告"托马斯和玛丽受尼古拉·特斯拉启发。" [fast]如果你位于[[过去]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学，花费2[per_investigator]个资源：宣告"天文台开始筹建。" 目标 - 如果本剧情卡牌上的全部3个能力均已触发，将其加入胜利牌区(每个能力触发时，在该能力上放置一个资源标记)。

87015b.name: 伟大遗产(现在)
87015b.real_text: [action] If you are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University and "funding for an observatory has begun:" Announce "the observatory is built." [action] If "the observatory is built," "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla," and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski and Ezra Graves are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode): Announce "teleportation research has begun." [fast] If "Thomas and Mary have met" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Ye Olde Magick Shoppe, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "Corrigan Industries has been founded" and put the set-aside Corrigan Industries location into play in the future era. Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).
87015b.text: [action]如果你位于[[现在]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学，且"天文台开始筹建"：宣告"天文台建成了。" [action]如果"天文台建成了"、"托马斯和玛丽受尼古拉·特斯拉启发"，且托马斯·科里根、玛丽·杰林斯基和埃兹拉·格雷夫斯位于[[现在]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学，作为团队花费2[per_investigator]个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为作为团队花费4[per_investigator]个线索)：宣告"传送研究开始了。" [fast]如果"托马斯和玛丽相识了"，且托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于古老魔法商店，花费1[per_investigator]个资源：宣告"科里根工业成立"，并将放在一边的科里根工业地点放置入场，位于未来时代。 目标 - 如果本剧情卡牌上的全部3个能力均已触发，将其加入胜利牌区(每个能力触发时，在该能力上放置一个资源标记)。

87024b.name: 伟大遗产(未来)
87024b.real_text: [action] If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Corrigan Industries: Put the set-aside Dimensional Beam Machine asset into play under your control (if you are eliminated, set it aside, out of play). [action] If "teleportation research has begun" and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and the Dimensional Beam Machine are at the [[Future]] Miskatonic University: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (8 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode) and announce "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery." [action] If "Thomas and Mary have made a historic discovery" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at the [[Future]] Arkham Advertiser: Announce "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).
87024b.text: [action]如果托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于科里根工业：将放在一边的维度光束机器支援放置入场，由你控制(如果你被淘汰，将其放在一边，位于场外)。 [action]如果"传送研究开始了"，且托马斯·科里根、玛丽·杰林斯基和维度光束机器位于[[未来]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学：进行一次[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费2[per_investigator]个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为作为团队花费8[per_investigator]个线索)，并宣告"托马斯和玛丽取得了一项历史性发现。" [action]如果"托马斯和玛丽取得了一项历史性发现"，且托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于[[未来]]的阿卡姆广告报：宣告"托马斯和玛丽获得了诺贝尔奖。" 目标 - 如果本剧情卡牌上的全部3个能力均已触发，将其加入胜利牌区(每个能力触发时，在该能力上放置一个资源标记)。

87033b.name: 苦涩的竞争
87033b.real_text: [action] [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Fight/Evade. Either attack or attempt to evade Edwin Bennet. If you succeed, spend X clues as a group, where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a target. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 targets on him and he is at Tindalos, the forces of Tindalos seize him. Remove Edwin Bennet from the game and add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.
87033b.text: [action][action]：重整艾德温·贝内特，将其移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：攻击/躲避。攻击或尝试躲避艾德温·贝内特。如果你成功，作为团队花费X个线索，其中X为全局玩家人数。然后，在他身上放置1个资源，作为目标。(每轮团队限一次。) 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3个目标，且其位于廷达洛斯，廷达洛斯的势力将他捕获。将艾德温·贝内特移出游戏，并将每个时代的本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

87034b.name: 救赎旧日同事
87034b.real_text: [action] [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your location (even if he is in another era). [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, spend X clues, as a group where X is the global number of players. Then, place 1 resource on him, as a redemption. Objective - If Edwin Bennet has 3 or more redemption on him and he is at any Miskatonic University with Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski, he is redeemed. Remove all redemption from him and flip him over. Add all copies of this story card in each era to the victory display.
87034b.text: [action][action]：重整艾德温·贝内特，将其移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：谈判。进行一次[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，作为团队花费X个线索，其中X为全局玩家人数。然后，在他身上放置1个资源，作为救赎。 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3个或更多救赎，且他与托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基位于任意米斯卡塔尼克大学，他得到救赎。移除他身上的所有救赎并将他翻面。将每个时代的本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

87035b.name: 不安的联盟
87035b.real_text: [action] If Edwin Bennet is at your location and he is ready: Parley. Place 1 of your clues on him. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, place 1 more of your clues on him. If you fail, exhaust him. [action]: Ready and move Edwin Bennet to your loaction (even if he is in another era). Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 clue from Edwin Bennet (2 clues instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode). If you cannot, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - When Edwin Bennet would be abducted: Remove all damage and horror from him and place 2 doom on the current agenda instead. Objective - If "Thomas and Mary have won a Nobel Prize" and there is no [[Plot]] story card in play in any era, add this story card to the victory display.
87035b.text: [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点且处于重整状态：谈判。将你的1个线索放在他身上。你可以进行一次[intellect](4)检定。如果你成功，再将你的1个线索放在他身上。如果你失败，将其横置。 [action]：重整并将艾德温·贝内特移动到你所在地点(即使他位于另一时代)。 强制 - 一轮结束时：移除艾德温·贝内特上的1个线索(如果你在史诗多人模式中游戏，改为移除2个线索)。如果你无法如此做，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果可以导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 艾德温·贝内特将要被绑架时：改为移除其所有伤害和恐惧，并在当前密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。 目标 - 如果"托马斯和玛丽获得了诺贝尔奖。"，且任意时代的场上都没有[[情节]]剧情卡牌，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

linked_card.flavor: A truly brilliant, yet unstable, mastermind.
linked_card.name: Edwin Bennet
linked_card.real_text: [fast] If it is your turn and you are at a [[Portal]] location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.
linked_card.text: If it is your turn and you are at a Portal location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.

87036a.name: 艾德温·贝内特
87036a.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to a [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location.
87036a.text: 巡逻(最近的有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 艾德温·贝内特不能受到伤害。 不能发现艾德温·贝内特所在地点的线索。 强制 - 神话阶段结束时：对艾德温·贝内特所在地点的一张[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。

87036b.flavor: 一位才华横溢却又反复无常的谋略家。
87036b.name: 艾德温·贝内特
87036b.real_text: [fast] If it is your turn and you are at a [[Portal]] location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.
87036b.text: [fast]如果现在是你的回合，且你位于[[传送门]]地点，横置艾德温·贝内特并花费2个资源：移动到廷达洛斯。

linked_card.name: Edwin Bennet
linked_card.real_text: Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck. [reaction] When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.
linked_card.text:
Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck.

When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.

87037a.name: 艾德温·贝内特
87037a.real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location. Then, choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck.
87037a.text: 巡逻(最近的有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 艾德温·贝内特不能受到伤害。 不能发现艾德温·贝内特所在地点的线索。 强制 - 神话阶段结束时：对艾德温·贝内特所在地点的每张[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。然后，选择一位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。

87037b.name: 艾德温·贝内特
87037b.real_text: Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck. [reaction] When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.
87037b.text: 强制 - 艾德温·贝内特横置后：选择一位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。 [reaction]你抽取遭遇卡牌时，横置艾德温·贝内特：取消该卡牌的所有效果并弃掉它。

87038b.name: 时空异常
87038b.real_text: Abilities on locations with an anomaly cannot be triggered. [action] Spend any number of clues: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). You get +3 skill value to this test for each clue spent this way. If you succeed, remove 1 anomaly from your location (2 anomalies instead if you succeed by 3 or more). Then, if you succeed by 4 or more and "Corrigan Industries has been founded," remove 1 anomaly from a location with the same title as your location, in any era. Objective - If it is agenda 2a and each location has no anomalies, add this story card to the victory display.
87038b.text: 有异常地点上的能力不能触发。 [action]花费任意数量的线索：进行一次[willpower](3)或[agility](3)检定。以此方式每花费1个线索，你本次检定得到+3技能值。如果你成功，移除你所在地点的1个异常(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为移除2个异常)。然后，如果你成功超过难度至少4点，且"科里根工业成立"，移除任意时代中一处与本地点同名地点上的1个异常。 目标 - 如果当前密谋为2a，且每个地点均没有异常，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

87039b.name: 黑帮麻烦
87039b.real_text: [action] If "the debt has been paid," spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the play area, encounter deck, or encounter discard pile for a Sheldon Gang enemy and add it to the victory display. If you searched the encounter deck, shuffle it. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity. Objective - If all 3 Sheldon Gang enemies are in the victory display, add this story card to the victory display.
87039b.text: [action]如果"债务已偿还"，作为团队花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查找游戏区域、遭遇牌库或遭遇弃牌堆，找出一名谢尔顿帮敌人，将其加入胜利牌区。如果查找遭遇牌库，将其混洗。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果全部3名谢尔顿帮敌人均位于胜利牌区，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

87042b.name: 不可名状的怪物
87042b.real_text: [action] If Tyr'thrha is at your location, spend 1 clue: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, deal 2 damage to Tyr'thrha (3 damage instead if you succeed by 3 or more). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Objective - If Tyr'thrha is defeated, add this story card to the victory display.
87042b.text: [action]如果提尔斯哈位于你所在地点，花费1个线索：进行一次[intellect](3)检定。如果你成功，对提尔斯哈造成2点伤害(如果你成功超过难度至少3点，改为3点伤害)。本行动不会引发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果提尔斯哈被击败，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。

88009b.name: 赌场大厅
88009b.real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)
88009b.text: [action]：撤退。是时候离开这里了！ [action]如果调查员"扮演高额赌客"且你的警戒等级为6或更低，花费2资源：准备好送达金库的包裹。查找遭遇牌库和弃牌堆，找出一名[[赌场]]敌人，将其生成在此，然后将放在一旁的包裹送达剧情卡牌叠加到其上。(团队每场游戏限一次。)

88014b.name: 高注赌桌
88014b.real_text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."
88014b.text: [action]花费4资源：弃掉遭遇牌库顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子、花色全部相同，或其中4张卡牌大小相同，获得8资源并记住你"赢得邪教的护身符"。
88014b.traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏

88015b.name: 赌场交谊厅
88015b.real_text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.
88015b.text: [action]如果你"找到通风口"，位于赌场交谊厅的调查员可以作为团队共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：移动。移动到守卫室。然后，如果员工通道尚未揭示，揭示员工通道。请记住"通风口开启"。(团队每场游戏限一次。) 只要"通风口开启"，调查员可以从赌场交谊厅移动到守卫室，如同它们连接，反之亦然。

88028b.name: 万人迷
88028b.real_text: Cannot be discarded. [action] Parley. Choose a [[Casino]] enemy at your location or a connecting location and test [willpower] or [intellect] (2). If you succeed, exhaust The Face to reduce any investigator's alarm level by 1.

90023b.flavor: 你的魔法与艾尔佩斯的力量在夜空中轰然对撞，迸发出刺目的光芒。一阵如异界警笛般尖啸的爆鸣——仿佛在召唤审判的降临——令你与艾尔佩斯双双跪倒在地。她痛苦地蜷缩着，指甲深深掐入太阳穴。你释放出自己的力量，攫住她的记忆，用尽全力拉扯剥离。

- 艾格尼丝·贝克从供应堆获得2[per_investigator]个线索。
然后将此牌翻面，处于横置且未交战状态。

If you are at a Hideout location with no clues on it, investigators at that location spend clues, as a group, equal to its clue value: “Where is Dad now?” Add that location to the victory display, moving each enemy and investigator there to a connecting location.

90045a.name: 神秘照片
90045a.real_text: [fast] Exhaust Mysterious Photo: Either take a parley action on a [[Suspect]] enemy or flip Mysterious Photo over. [fast] If there is a [[Suspect]] enemy with no clues on it at your location, investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (2 [per_investigator] clues instead if it is agenda 2): “Have you seen my dad?” Add that enemy to the victory display.
90045a.text: [fast]横置神秘照片：选择一项：对一名[[嫌犯]]敌人执行谈判行动；或将神秘照片翻面。 [fast]如果你所在地点有一名其上没有线索的[[嫌犯]]敌人，该地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索(如果当前为密谋2，改为2[per_investigator]个线索)：“你见过我爸爸吗？”将该敌人加入胜利牌区。

90045b.text: [free]横置神秘相片：在一个[[窝点]]地点进行调查行动，或将神秘相片翻面。 [free]如果你位于一个没有线索的[[窝点]]地点，该地点的调查员共同花费等于其线索值数量的线索：“爸爸在哪里？” 将该地点加入胜利区，将位于该地点的每个敌人和调查员移动到一个连接地点。

90052b.name: 彼端
90052b.real_text:
Forced – One at a time, choose each non-weakness spirit attached to The Beyond and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it is... - ... an [elder_sign] token: You may either heal 1 horror, or attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. (Do not reveal tokens for the spirit you attach after resolving this effect.) - ... an [auto_fail] token: Discard this spirit. Take 1 direct damage/horror. - ...a [skull] token: Discard this spirit. Heal 1 horror. - ...a [cultist], [elder_thing], [tablet], or [curse] token: You must either discard this spirit or take 1 direct damage. - ...any other token: Discard this spirit. Flip this card back to its asset side.
Reminder: Spirits attached to The Beyond are in play but only retain their names and text boxes. Spirits do not take up slots and do not have health or sanity values. When a unique spirit is attached to The Beyond, any other asset that shares its name and is already in play is discarded. Spirits are always discarded to the bottom of the spirit deck.
90052b.text:
强制 - 依次对于彼端上每个附属的非弱点灵魂揭示一个混乱标记，如果揭示了…… ……[elder_sign]标记：你可以治愈1点恐惧，或将灵魂牌库顶的牌正面朝上附属到彼端上，作为一个灵魂。(不要为这个新的灵魂揭示标记) ……[auto_fail]标记：弃掉此灵魂，受到1点直接伤害/恐惧。 ……[skull]标记：弃掉此灵魂，治愈1点恐惧。 ……[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[curse]标记：弃掉此灵魂，或受到1点直接伤害。 ……其他标记：弃掉此灵魂。 将此牌翻回支援面。
规则详解：附属的灵魂视为在场，但只有名字和文本框生效。灵魂不占用槽位，也没有生命和神智。如果一个独特的支援被附属到彼端上，则场上其他的同名卡必须被弃掉。所有被弃掉的灵魂会返回灵魂牌库底。
